en_text: First thou must needs fill a crucible with metal. Then, using the bellows, make the fire as hot as possible. When the flame no longer continues to glow, thou art ready to proceed by setting the crucible on the fire to melt the metal.
Afterwards, pour the molten metal into the blade mold and let it cool. Be warned! The crucible is at an extremely high temperature. Do not burn thyself.

With the tongs, lift the cooled blade from the mold. Again heat up the fire and set the blade within. Be careful not to let it lose its shape though. Just set it in there long enough to become malleable.

When it is ready, take it to the anvil and finish shaping it with the hammer. When thou hast the desired blade, find the quenching barrel and plunge the sword in the cool water. It will quickly harden.
All that thou must needs do now is to put the pommel over the tang. It takes some doing to make a fine, sturdy sword, but the finished weapon is well worth it!

zh_text: 首先你需要將金屬裝滿坩堝。然後，使用風箱將火燒得越旺越好。當火焰不再發光時，你就可以準備將坩堝放在火上熔化金屬了。
然後，將熔化的金屬倒入刀刃模具中並讓其冷卻。警告！坩堝的溫度極高。小心不要燙傷自己。
用夾子將冷卻的刀刃從模具中取出。再次將火加熱，並將刀刃放入其中。不過要注意不要讓它變形。只要把它放在那裡足夠長的時間使其變得有延展性即可。
準備好後，將其拿到鐵砧上，用錘子完成塑形。當你得到理想的刀刃後，找到淬火桶，將劍浸入冷水中。它會很快變硬。
現在你所需要做的就是把劍首套在劍根上。要打造一把精良、堅固的劍需要花費一些功夫，但完成的武器絕對物超所值！

zh_text: 「歡迎，我的朋友，」他擁抱著你說道。「請告訴我，是什麼風把你吹來不列顛尼亞的！或者，更重要的是，是什麼『帶』你來的？」

en_text: Lord British laughs. "What, art thou joking, Avatar? Dost thou not recognize thine old friend?"
zh_text: 不列顛王大笑。「什麼，你在開玩笑嗎，聖者？難道你認不出你的老朋友了？」

en_text: "Do not forget, Avatar, that I have the power to heal thee. That is one bit of magic that still seems to work for me. And I could probably provide thee with some equipment and a spellbook."

en_text: "I am certain that thy friends have rued thine absence. 'Tis a shame thou didst stay away so long! But... I am so very happy to see thee. Britannia is prosperous and abundant. Look around thee. Explore the newly refurbished castle. Travel the land. Peace is prominent in all quarters.
zh_text: 「我敢肯定你的朋友們都為你的缺席感到惋惜。你離開這麼久真是太可惜了！但是... 我真的很高興見到你。不列顛尼亞繁榮而豐饒。看看你周圍。探索這座新翻修的城堡。在各地旅行。四處都充滿了和平。

en_text: "Yes, Britannia has never been better. Well, almost never."
zh_text: 」「是的，不列顛尼亞從未如此美好。嗯，幾乎從未。」

en_text: You see your old friend Nystul, now a decrepit old man in mage's robes. He seems lost in thought, far away.

法師看起來困惑了一會兒。「我的名字是 Nystul？是的，就是這樣！」

en_text: The mage looks confused a moment. "My name is Nystul? Yes, that is it!"
"Well, I used to perform quite a bit of magic," he says apologetically. "At least... I -think- I used to do so. There is a man named Lord British, I think. I work for him."
zh_text: 「嗯，我以前經常施展魔法，」他帶著歉意說。「至少... 我『認為』我以前是這麼做的。我想，有一個叫不列顛王的人。我為他工作。」

en_text: "Sometimes the magic works, sometimes it doth not." He waves his hand, and drops his wand. "Oops!" he cries, as he bends to pick it up.
zh_text: 「有時候魔法有效，有時候則不然。」他揮了揮手，結果魔杖掉了下來。「哎呀！」他叫了出來，彎下腰去撿。

en_text: "Art thou sure this man is not really the jester?"
zh_text: 「你確定這個人其實不是小丑嗎？」

en_text: "Anyway, as I was saying, uhm, what was I saying? Oh yes. Magic. I can still sell thee some spells or reagents if thou wouldst like."
zh_text: 「總之，正如我所說的，嗯，我剛說到哪了？喔對。魔法。如果你想要的話，我還是可以賣給你一些法術或藥材。」

en_text: "The magic is much better now. My spells all work very nicely. I thank thee, Avatar, for clearing the ether. Interested in any spells or reagents?"

en_text: "Dost thou wish to buy some spells?"
"Dost thou wish to buy some reagents?"
"Lord who? Dost thou mean that old man who sometimes sits on the throne?"
zh_text: 「什麼王？你是說那個有時候會坐在王座上的老頭子嗎？」

en_text: "He is the greatest ruler this land has ever known and I am proud to serve him."

en_text: "The three values of the Triad of Inner Strength are Strive For Unity, Trust Thy Brother and Worthiness Precedes Reward."
zh_text: 「內在力量三原則的三個價值觀是：『致力合一（Strive For Unity）』、『信賴你的兄弟 (Trust Thy Brother)』和『價值先行於報償 (Worthiness Precedes Reward)』。」

en_text: "The Fellowship advances the philosophy of sanguine cognition, a way to apply a positive order of thought to one's life through what is called the Triad of Inner Strength."
zh_text: 「友誼會推廣『自信認知（sanguine cognition）』的理念，這是一種透過所謂的『內在力量的三位一體（Triad of Inner Strength）』，將積極的思維秩序應用於個人生活的方式。」

en_text: "The Triad of Inner Strength is simply three basic values that, when applied in unison, enable one to be more creative, satisfied and successful in life."
zh_text: 「『內在力量三位一體（Triad of Inner Strength）』簡單來說就是三個基本的價值觀，當它們被統一起來應用時，就能使一個人在生活中更具創造力、更滿足、更成功。」

en_text: "Once a person has walked with The Fellowship long enough and applied the Triad of Inner Strength to his life, he has cleared his mind of all conflicting, counterproductive thoughts to the point where he may actually hear his internal voice of reason. This voice of reason is the core of thine inner mind which guides thee through pure instinct, wisdom and irreproachable logic. Once one starts to listen to it and follow its guidance, one has achieved the height of enlightenment. Perhaps thou shalt hear it one day."
zh_text: 「一旦一個人與友誼會同行夠久，並將『內在力量三位一體（Triad of Inner Strength）』應用於他的生活，他就能清除腦海中所有衝突、適得其反的念頭，達到他能實際聽到他內在理智聲音的地步。這個理智的聲音是你內心的核心，透過純粹的本能、智慧和無懈可擊的邏輯引導著你。一旦有人開始聆聽它並遵循它的指引，他就達到了啟蒙的最高境界。也許有一天你也會聽到它。」

en_text: "Goodbye. Be sure to come to the show when it opens!"*
zh_text: 「再見。開演時一定要來看戲喔！」*

en_text: "My real name is Stuart. My stage name is Laurence."
zh_text: 「我的真名是 Stuart 。我的藝名是 Laurence 。」

en_text: Stuart's feathers are obviously ruffled. "Yes. I have been cast as second banana yet again! I am much more suited to play the Avatar, but did Raymundo cast me? Noooo!"
zh_text: Stuart 明顯被激怒了。「是的。我又被選為配角了！我更適合扮演聖者，但 Raymundo 有選我嗎？沒——有！」

en_text: Stuart whispers to you, "Jesse is all wrong! Why, -thou- wouldst make a better Avatar than he! And -thou- probably couldst not act thy way out of a reagent bag! That is not a reflection on thee, but on Jesse."
zh_text: Stuart 對你耳語：「Jesse 完全不對！哎呀，-你- 都比他更適合演聖者！而 -你- 可能連演個裝藥材的袋子都不行！這不是在說你，而是在說 Jesse 。」

en_text: This actor has much stage presence and a booming voice.
zh_text: 這位男演員極具舞台魅力，聲音宏亮。

en_text: Stuart looks down his nose at you. "Yes?"
"I am the greatest actor who ever lived," he proclaims with absolutely no modesty. "I am playing the character 'Iolo' in the new play."
zh_text: 「我是有史以來最偉大的演員，」他毫不謙虛地宣布。「我在新戲裡扮演『Iolo』這個角色。」

en_text: "'Tis the name of a particular hero of mine."
zh_text: 「這是我心目中一位特定英雄的名字。」

en_text: "Of course thou art. And I am really Lord British. Thou must take me for an ass to think I would believe that."*
zh_text: 「你當然是。而我真的是不列顛王。你一定把我當成笨蛋，以為我會相信那種事。」*

en_text: Your friend whispers to you. "These actor types. A touchy bunch, eh?"*
zh_text: 你的朋友對你耳語。「這些演員類型。一群敏感的傢伙，對吧？」*

en_text: "I suppose he's a good director. He never casts me in the right roles, though. And to think I went to school with him! We were on our first stage crew together!"
zh_text: 「我想他是個好導演。不過他從來沒讓我演過合適的角色。想想我還和他一起上過學呢！我們曾在同一個舞台幕後工作！」

en_text: "Acting is the highest form of art. It allows one to step outside oneself and become another person. 'Tis like a game!"
zh_text: 「演戲是最高形式的藝術。它讓人能夠走出自我，成為另一個人。就像一場遊戲！」

en_text: "Goodbye. Be sure to come to the show when it opens!"*
zh_text: 「再見。開演時一定要來看戲喔！」*

en_text: "I have to memorize this preposterous children's story called 'Hubert's Hair-Raising Adventure'.
zh_text: 「我必須背誦這個名為『Hubert 令人毛骨悚然的冒險（Hubert's Hair-Raising Adventure）』的荒謬童話故事。

en_text: "Poo Poo Head!" she cries. She then rushes to him and kisses him full on the mouth. Shamino turns red and shuffles his feet.*
zh_text: 「Poo Poo 頭！」她大喊。然後她衝向他，在他的嘴上深深地吻了一下。 Shamino 臉紅了，不安地挪動著雙腳。*

en_text: "Dost thou know my beau? He is probably drowning his sorrows at the Blue Boar. The lazy knave! I will not let him go about adventuring. It is time for him to settle down. Thou canst tell him I said so!"
zh_text: 「你認識我的男朋友嗎？他大概正在藍野豬酒館（Blue Boar）借酒澆愁。這個懶骨頭！我不會讓他去冒險的。是時候讓他安定下來了。你可以去告訴他我說的！」

en_text: This lovely actress is dressed in a mouse costume.
zh_text: 這位可愛的女演員穿著老鼠裝。

en_text: "I am an actress at the Royal Theatre. I am playing the role of Sherry the Mouse in the new play."
zh_text: 「我是皇家劇院的女演員。在新戲中我扮演老鼠 Sherry 的角色。」

en_text: "'Tis a lovely space in which to perform. I have dedicated my life to acting, thou knowest."
zh_text: 「這是一個很棒的表演空間。你知道的，我把我的一生都奉獻給了演戲。」

en_text: "Raymundo himself had a hand in the design of the theatre."
zh_text: 「Raymundo 本人參與了這座劇院的設計。」

en_text: "Actually, this will be my debut theatrical performance. I have been working as a barmaid waiting for my first chance to be in the theatre."
zh_text: 「其實，這將是我的劇場處女作。我一直擔任酒吧女侍，等待我第一次參與劇院演出的機會。」

en_text: "Between thee and me, methinks the play stinks." She winks at you.
zh_text: 「在你我之間，我覺得這齣戲爛透了。」她對你眨了眨眼。

en_text: "Canst thou imagine such drivel? I do not believe there ever was a Sherry the Mouse. Who ever heard of a mouse that could talk! Especially these lines! I would rather play a queen. Much more fitting for me, I would say."
zh_text: 「你能想像這種胡言亂語嗎？我不相信曾經有過一隻叫 Sherry 的老鼠。誰聽說過會說話的老鼠！尤其是這些台詞！我寧願演個女王。我得說，那對我來說合適多了。」

en_text: "I asked Raymundo about this and he threw a tantrum. He said that it would not be historically accurate. Ha! As if that were something of any significance!"
zh_text: 「我問了 Raymundo 這件事，他大發脾氣。他說那不符合歷史的準確性。哈！說得好像那有什麼重要意義似的！」

en_text: "Not in front of the Avatar, Poo!"*
"To blazes with the Avatar!" She kisses him again. "The Avatar is the last one who will convince thee to settle down."
zh_text: 「去他的聖者！」她又吻了他一次。「聖者是最後一個能說服你安定下來的人。」

en_text: "Kristy, like Nicholas, is one of our orphans. She was found in an abandoned home in Paws by one of the Great Council members."
zh_text: 「Kristy ，和 Nicholas 一樣，是我們的孤兒之一。她是被一位大法師議會（Great Council）成員在 Paws 的一間廢棄房屋裡發現的。」

en_text: Kristy looks confused. "Sing. Horsey. Rosa. Winner."
zh_text: 「鬼抓人！玩鬼抓人！」幼童跑開去尋找育兒室的玩伴了。*Kristy 看起來很困惑。「唱歌。馬馬。 Rosa 。贏家。」

en_text: Kristy hugs her baby doll tight. "Rosa!"
zh_text: Kristy 看起來很困惑。「唱歌。馬馬。 Rosa 。贏家。」

en_text: This is a cute toddler holding a baby doll.
zh_text: 這是一個可愛的蹣跚學步幼童，手裡抱著一個洋娃娃。

en_text: "Tag! Playing tag!"The toddler runs off in search of a nursery-mate.*

zh_text: 幼童跑開去尋找育兒室的玩伴了。*

en_text: The toddler runs off in search of a nursery-mate.*
zh_text: Kristy 非常樂意這麼做。「A-B-C-D-E-F-G！H-I-K-M-M-M-O-P！Q-T-W-Y-X-Z！」她對自己的歌感到自豪，儘管她唱得不太對。

en_text: Kristy is more than happy to do so. "A-B-C-D-E-F-G! H-I-K-M-M-M-O-P! Q-T-W-Y-X-Z!" She is proud of her song, although she didn't get it quite right.
zh_text: 「我愛馬馬！」她用力搖著搖搖馬。

en_text: "I love horsey!" She rocks hard on the rocking horse.
zh_text: Kristy 緊緊抱住她的洋娃娃。「Rosa ！」

en_text: "She keeps saying that. I am not sure what it means. Something to do with a competition."
zh_text: 「她一直這麼說。我不確定那是什麼意思。可能跟某種比賽有關。」

en_text: "I'm a funny boy!" Max laughs hysterically. "Makth sing too!"
zh_text: 「玩鬼抓人！」男孩從你身邊跑開去抓另一個孩子。*「我是個搞笑的男孩！」 Max 歇斯底里地大笑。「Makth 也會唱歌！」

en_text: "Thou funny boy, -too-!" Max laughs madly as he throws his pacifier at you. He points at it and says, "Binky!"
zh_text: 「你也是，搞笑的男孩，-也- 是！」 Max 瘋狂地笑著，把他的奶嘴丟向你。他指著奶嘴說：「Binky ！」

en_text: Max nods furiously. "Binky! Get Binky! Get Binky!"
zh_text: Max 拼命地點頭。「Binky ！拿 Binky ！拿 Binky ！」

en_text: You realize that the boy wants you to pick it up. Apparently it is some kind of game that only toddlers understand. You pick it up and hand it to him. He immediately plugs it into his mouth.
zh_text: 你意識到這個男孩想讓你把它撿起來。顯然這是一種只有幼童才懂的遊戲。你撿起奶嘴遞給他。他立刻把它塞進嘴裡。

en_text: This toddler is full of energy and is playing hard when he sees you. He stops what he is doing.
zh_text: 這個蹣跚學步的孩子充滿活力，當他看到你時正玩得很起勁。他停下了手邊的動作。

en_text: "Playing tag!"The boy runs away from you to catch another child.*

zh_text: 男孩從你身邊跑開去抓另一個孩子。*

en_text: The boy runs away from you to catch another child.*
zh_text: 「我是個搞笑的男孩！」 Max 歇斯底里地大笑。「Makth 也會唱歌！」

en_text: Max stands upright and bellows, "Old Lord British had a farm, -e-i-e-i-o-! On this farm he had a drake, -e-i-e-i-o-! With a -roar- -roar- here, a -roar- -roar- there, here a -roar-, there a -roar-, everywhere a -roar- -roar-!    Old Lord British had a farm, -e-i-e-i-o-!"
zh_text: Max 站得筆直，大聲吼道：「老不列顛王有個農場，-e-i-e-i-o-！在這個農場裡他有一隻公鴨，-e-i-e-i-o-！這裡 -嘎- -嘎-，那裡 -嘎- -嘎-，到處都是 -嘎- -嘎-！老不列顛王有個農場，-e-i-e-i-o-！」

en_text: "Why, his job is to wet his diaper! Is that not right, Nicholas?" Nanna says in baby-talk.
zh_text: 「哎呀，他的工作就是尿濕他的尿布！對不對呀，Nicholas？」 Nanna 用疊字語氣說道。

en_text: You see a child that has recently grown into toddlerhood.
zh_text: 你看到一個最近剛長成蹣跚學步階段的孩子。

en_text: The toddler is obviously deeply engaged in a game of tag and will not stop to speak.*
zh_text: 這孩子顯然深深投入在鬼抓人的遊戲中，不願停下來說話。*

en_text: "Nicholas is one of our orphans. He was left in front of the castle one morning. 'Tis a sad state of affairs when this kind of thing happens."
zh_text: 「Nicholas 是我們的孤兒之一。某天早上他被遺棄在城堡前。發生這種事真是令人悲傷的狀況。」

en_text: You notice that Nicholas' diaper is wet.
zh_text: 你注意到 Nicholas 的尿布濕了。

en_text: "Oh, my. He's wet, is he not? Couldst thou be a dear and change him for me? I would appreciate it!"
zh_text: 「喔，天啊。他濕了，不是嗎？你能幫我個忙替他換一下嗎？我會很感激的！」
「咿——！尿-布！嘰——！」 Nicholas 高興地說。

en_text: "The diapers are there on that table. If thou wouldst just use one	on Nicholas...."
zh_text: 「尿布就在那張桌子上。如果你能拿一塊	用在 Nicholas 身上的話……」

en_text: Nicholas points to the diapers on the table.
Nanna gives you a stern look for bothering her during The Fellowship meeting, much like the look of an elementary school teacher you once had.*
zh_text: Nanna 因為你在友誼會集會時打擾她而給了你一個嚴厲的眼神，就像你曾經遇到過的小學老師那樣。*

en_text: "I cannot imagine where Batlin may be. He has never missed a Fellowship meeting!"
zh_text: 「我無法想像巴特林在哪裡。他從未缺席過友誼會的集會！」

en_text: "Oh! Hello! I must not stop to speak now. I am on my way to The Fellowship meeting!"*
zh_text: 「喔！哈囉！我現在不能停下來說話。我正在去友誼會集會的路上！」*

en_text: You see a working-class elderly woman who exudes sweetness.
zh_text: 你看到一位散發著和藹氣息的勞工階級年長婦女。

en_text: "Yes, may I help thee?" Nanna asks.
zh_text: 「是的，我能幫你嗎？」 Nanna 問。

en_text: "I watch over the Royal Nursery. I am the nanny of these wonderful children."
zh_text: 「我負責看管皇家育兒室。我是這些棒孩子們的保母。」

en_text: "There have been a great number of babies born in Britannia in recent years, so Lord British established this nursery. It is nice that the noblemen and noblewomen have this luxury so that they may attend to their daily duties."
zh_text: 「近年來不列顛尼亞出生了許多嬰兒，所以不列顛王建立了這個育兒室。貴族男女能有這種奢侈的服務真是不錯，這樣他們就能專心處理日常職務了。」

en_text: "Whew! Dost thou smell what I smell, Avatar?"*
zh_text: 「呼！你有聞到我聞到的味道嗎，聖者？」*

en_text: "I believe that is the smell of diapers, boy. When thou art a father one day, thou wilt come to know that smell quite well."*
zh_text: 「我相信那是尿布的味道，孩子。當有一天你成為父親時，你就會很熟悉那個味道了。」*

en_text: "Well, I feed them and change their diapers and read aloud all the books thou dost see lying around. Luckily, I have Sherry to help me."
zh_text: 「嗯，我餵他們吃飯、幫他們換尿布，並大聲朗讀你看到散落在一旁的所有書籍。幸運的是，我有 Sherry 來幫我。」

en_text: "Lord British brought them from his homeland. They are very foreign to us here in Britannia, but the children enjoy them just the same."
zh_text: 「不列顛王把這些書從他的家鄉帶來的。這些對我們不列顛尼亞來說非常陌生，但孩子們一樣很喜歡。」

en_text: "Sherry is a special mouse who has lived here in the castle for many, many years. She recites stories for the children."
zh_text: 「Sherry 是一隻特別的老鼠，她在城堡裡住了很多、許多年了。她會為孩子們朗誦故事。」

en_text: "They are lovely, are they not? Every day they seem to learn more and more. Most of the time they are a joy." Nanna whispers to you conspiratorially, "And other times I could happily throw them out with the bathwater!"
zh_text: 「他們很可愛，不是嗎？每一天他們似乎都學得越來越多。大部分時間他們都是一種快樂。」 Nanna 神秘兮兮地對你耳語，「而在其他時候，我真想把他們連同洗澡水一起倒掉！」

en_text: "The children must be outside playing with Sherry now."
zh_text: 「孩子們現在一定在外面和 Sherry 玩。」

en_text: "Yes, I suppose it really is a luxury. The poorer people in Britannia certainly do not have such a service for caring for their children. The rich do have an advantage." You detect a hint of bitterness in her voice.
zh_text: 「是的，我想這真的是一種奢侈。不列顛尼亞較貧窮的人當然沒有這種照顧他們孩子的服務。富人確實有優勢。」你從她的聲音中聽出了一絲苦澀。

en_text: "I do not mean to complain by any means. I adore my work. But contrary to the thinking of many of the noblemen and women, a class structure exists in Britannia more than ever before. Taxes are unbearable. The rich get richer, and the poor get poorer, as the saying goes."
zh_text: 「我絕不是要抱怨。我很熱愛我的工作。但與許多貴族男女的想法相反，不列顛尼亞的階級結構比以往任何時候都存在。稅收令人難以承受。俗話說，富人越來越富，窮人越來越窮。」

en_text: "The Britannian Tax Council drains us all dry. Especially the lower and middle classes."
zh_text: 「不列顛尼亞稅務委員會把我們都榨乾了。尤其是中下階層。」

en_text: "Well, look around! There are rich men who live in opulent castles. And right outside are poor people who live in hovels. Thou dost know how there are winged gargoyles and wingless gargoyles? Well, it seems the human race is getting to be just as divided. There is no unity in the land anymore. It is why I have joined The Fellowship."
zh_text: 「嗯，你看看周圍！有錢人住在富麗堂皇的城堡裡。而就在外面，窮人住在破屋裡。你知道石像鬼（gargoyles）有分有翅膀和沒翅膀的嗎？嗯，看來人類也變得同樣分裂了。這片土地上不再有團結了。這就是為什麼我加入了友誼會。」

en_text: She notices your medallion. "But thou dost know all that already!
zh_text: 她注意到了你的徽章。「但你已經知道這一切了！

en_text: "Thou shouldst really come to a meeting. Thou wouldst learn a lot!"
zh_text: 「你真的應該來參加集會。你會學到很多！」

en_text: "Good day! Do come back and visit again soon!"*
zh_text: 「祝你有個美好的一天！一定要快點再回來拜訪喔！」*

en_text: "When my name was Abrams, I lived on the island of New Magincia and did mine apprentice work there. My practice grew, and soon I was travelling by ship to Moonglow to see patients there."
zh_text: 「當我的名字是 Abrams 時，我住在 New Magincia 島並在那裡做學徒。我的診所發展壯大，很快我就乘船去 Moonglow 看那裡的病人了。」

en_text: "I am Csil the Healer, although in a past life I was known as Abrams. I became Csil when I was advanced."
zh_text: 「我是治療師 Csil ，雖然在過去的生活中我被稱為 Abrams 。當我晉升時我變成了 Csil 。」

en_text: You see a healer who looks wise and honest."I have been looking forward to thine arrival, Avatar. Word spreads quickly. I am pleased to meet thee!"
zh_text: 你看見一位看起來睿智而誠實的治療師。「我一直期待你的到來，聖者。消息傳得很快。很高興見到你！」

en_text: You see a healer who looks wise and honest.
zh_text: 你看見一位看起來睿智而誠實的治療師。

en_text: "I have been looking forward to thine arrival, Avatar. Word spreads quickly. I am pleased to meet thee!"
zh_text: 「我一直期待你的到來，聖者。消息傳得很快。很高興見到你！」

en_text: "Hello again, Avatar!" Csil says with a smile.
zh_text: 「又見面了，聖者！」 Csil 微笑著說。

en_text: "I am Britain's healer, and have been for many years. If thou wishest to employ my services, please say so. I shall be only too happy to help."
zh_text: 「我是不列顛城的治療師，已經很多年了。如果你希望雇用我的服務，請告訴我。我非常樂意幫忙。」

en_text: "Soon I had patients on three islands. It was then that Lord British received word of my practice."
zh_text: 「很快我在三個島上都有了病人。就在那時，不列顛王聽說了我的診所。」

en_text: "My practice grew swiftly. I am a modest man, but I do not mind saying that I was a popular healer."
zh_text: 「我的診所發展迅速。我是個謙虛的人，但我不介意說我是一個受歡迎的治療師。」

en_text: "He is probably the best healer in all Britannia. Why, he cured a, er, particular problem I had in no time at all."*
zh_text: 「他可能是全不列顛尼亞最好的治療師。哎呀，他立刻治好了我的一個，呃，特殊問題。」*

en_text: "Never mind. The whole world does not need to know about it."*
zh_text: 「別在意。全世界不需要知道這件事。」*

en_text: "Well, Lord British himself was struck down with some sort of malady. He sent for me. I arrived at the castle as soon as I could leave my patients, and I examined the king. It appeared to me that something had infested his blood. I have a theory about it, which I am convinced is correct. Others, however, do not share my view."
zh_text: 「嗯，不列顛王自己也感染了某種疾病。他派人找我。我一離開病人就趕到城堡檢查了國王。在我看來，似乎有什麼東西侵入了他的血液。我對此有一個理論，我堅信它是正確的。然而，其他人並不認同我的觀點。」

en_text: "I believe that most sicknesses are caused by tiny living things. We cannot see these things with the naked eye. However, I am working on developing an instrument which -can- see these creatures. I believe that someday, healing will not depend on magic at all, but on some form of treatment which makes one less vulnerable to these living creatures. Since these animals are biological, I call this theorized treatment 'antibiotics'. What dost thou think, Avatar? Am I on the right track?"
zh_text: 「我相信大多數疾病是由微小的生物引起的。我們無法用肉眼看到這些東西。然而，我正在致力於開發一種儀器，可以 -看到- 這些生物。我相信總有一天，治療將完全不依賴魔法，而是依賴某種形式的治療，使人不容易受到這些生物的感染。由於這些動物是生物，我稱這種理論上的治療為『抗生素療法』。你覺得呢，聖者？我走在正確的道路上嗎？」

en_text: "No? Hmmm." Csil looks concerned. "Well, I cannot believe in the archaic tradition of bleeding a person until the sickness has left his body. There must be another way..."
zh_text: 「不？嗯。」 Csil 看起來很憂慮。「好吧，我無法相信傳統的放血療法，直到疾病離開他的身體。一定有另一種方法……」

en_text: Csil looks at his notes, worried that his theory is invalid.
zh_text: Csil 看著他的筆記，擔心他的理論是無效的。

en_text: "There is a group of people who do not encourage my studies. We do not get along at all. I think they have something against healers which goes beyond simple distrust. Dost thou know whom I mean?"
zh_text: 「有一群人不鼓勵我的研究。我們完全合不來。我認為他們對治療師有一種超越單純不信任的反感。你知道我指誰嗎？」
「不知道？」 Csil 壓低聲音說。「是友誼會。」

en_text: "They have a doctrine which outlines their beliefs. They believe if one is faced with pain, then he has no choice but to go through it in order to be a 'better person'. I do not agree with this. No one should ever go through needless pain. But... they are entitled to their own opinions."
zh_text: 「他們有一套概述其信仰的教義。他們相信如果一個人面臨痛苦，那麼他別無選擇，只能經歷它才能成為一個『更好的人』。我不同意這點。沒有人應該經歷不必要的痛苦。但是……他們有權保留自己的意見。」

en_text: You see a lean, young fighter with a rather dashing flair.
zh_text: 你看見一位身材精瘦、帶有幾分瀟灑氣質的年輕戰士。

en_text: "I am a trainer. I specialize in hand-to-hand combat. After all, a fighter never knows when he might encounter an adversary and suddenly realize he is unarmed. I call it 'boxing'. Boxing is not only a method of fighting -- it is an art."
zh_text: 「我是個訓練員。我專精於肉搏戰。畢竟，一個戰士永遠不知道何時可能會遇到對手，卻突然意識到自己手無寸鐵。我稱之為『拳擊』。拳擊不僅是一種戰鬥方法——它是一門藝術。」

en_text: "The field of battle contains many arenas. Almost any situation could arise. Every fighter should be knowledgeable and adept at many forms of combat. I have mine own theory of fighting."
zh_text: 「戰場包含許多競技場。幾乎任何情況都可能發生。每個戰士都應該了解並精通多種戰鬥形式。我有我自己的戰鬥理論。」

en_text: "All the various arenas of combat, all the various styles one may learn in fighting with various weapons, are not fighting in its purest form. To truly be a great fighter one must go to the source of all fighting knowledge."
zh_text: 「所有不同的戰鬥競技場，以及在用不同武器戰鬥時可能學到的所有不同風格，都不是最純粹形式的戰鬥。要真正成為一名偉大的戰士，必須追溯到所有戰鬥知識的源頭。」

en_text: "Just as a castle is built from the foundation up, so must a fighter. One cannot simply begin by learning to fight with weapons. Weapons are merely an extension of a person's extremities. A true fighter learns by using those extremities first."
zh_text: 「就像城堡是從地基往上建的一樣，戰士也是如此。不能一開始就學習用武器戰鬥。武器只是人體末端的延伸。一個真正的戰士首先學會使用他的四肢。」

en_text: "Make no mistake. Fighters are made, not born. All the natural talent in the world will avail thee naught if one does not have the heart and the will to win. Part of that will is the courage to seek out thine own limitations and strive to better them."
zh_text: 「別搞錯了。戰士是後天訓練出來的，而不是天生的。如果沒有求勝的心和意志，世界上所有天賦都無濟於事。那種意志的一部分，是去尋找自己的極限並努力超越它們的勇氣。」

en_text: "Thine arms. Thy legs. Thy fists. This is what makes 'boxing'."
zh_text: 「你的手臂。你的雙腿。你的拳頭。這就是『拳擊』的基礎。」

en_text: "My price for training is 45 gold. Is this all right?"
zh_text: 「我的訓練價格是 45 金幣。可以嗎？」

en_text: "Then mayest thou find more inexpensive training elsewhere."
zh_text: 「那麼你或許可以在其他地方找到更便宜的訓練。」

en_text: "Be so kind as to return during normal training hours, wouldst thou?"
zh_text: 「麻煩你在正常的訓練時間再來，好嗎？」

en_text: "Whoa! Hey everyone! This here is the Avatar!"Everyone in the Blue Boar laughs."And I'd bet thou dost need a drink, right?"
zh_text: 「哇喔！大家聽好！這位就是聖者！」藍野豬酒館 (Blue Boar) 裡的每個人都笑了。「我敢打賭你需要來杯飲料，對吧？」

en_text: Everyone in the Blue Boar laughs.
zh_text: 藍野豬酒館 (Blue Boar) 裡的每個人都笑了。

en_text: You see an attractive woman in her fifties. She has a warm smile. "Welcome! Who art thou, stranger?"
zh_text: 你看見一位五十多歲、頗具魅力的女人。她帶著溫暖的微笑。「歡迎！陌生人，你是誰？」

en_text: "Whoa! Hey everyone! This here is the Avatar!"
zh_text: 「哇喔！大家聽好！這位就是聖者！」

en_text: "And I'd bet thou dost need a drink, right?"
zh_text: 「我敢打賭你需要來杯飲料，對吧？」

en_text: "Oh, really?" she says in mock surprise. "Why, I have always wanted to meet the Avatar!"
zh_text: 「喔，真的嗎？」她故作驚訝地說。「哎呀，我一直都很想見見聖者！」

en_text: "I run The Blue Boar. Oldest tavern in Britannia."
zh_text: 「我經營藍野豬酒館。不列顛尼亞最古老的酒館。」

en_text: "If thou dost want anything to eat or drink, just say so!"
zh_text: 「如果你想吃點或喝點什麼，只要說一聲！」

en_text: She addresses Dupre. "How about thou, handsome? Want something to eat?" She bats her eyelashes.*
zh_text: 她對 Dupre 說。「那你呢，帥哥？想吃點什麼嗎？」她眨了眨眼。*

en_text: "My dear, thou wouldst make any man hungry!"*
zh_text: 「親愛的，妳會讓任何男人都感到飢餓！」*

en_text: "I shall be happy to serve thee something if thou dost come to the pub during open hours!"
zh_text: 「如果你在營業時間來酒館，我很樂意為你服務！」

en_text: "Smashing place for a revel! It hath been here for ages! I inherited it from my grandfather. I enjoy it because I love to cook. And eat." She laughs. "And drink!" She laughs again.
zh_text: 「這是個適合狂歡的絕佳場所！它已經在這裡很久了！我從我祖父那裡繼承了它。我喜歡這裡是因為我熱愛烹飪。還有吃。」她笑著說。「還有喝！」她再次大笑。

en_text: "But mostly I like it because I meet so many interesting people. Just like thee,
zh_text: 「但最主要的是，我喜歡這裡是因為能遇到這麼多有趣的人。就像你一樣，

en_text: "Thou dost look like the kind of person who doth enjoy a fair bit of revelry!
zh_text: 「你看起來就像是那種喜歡好好狂歡一下的人！

en_text: "Come back to the pub in the evening to hear our house band, The Avatars!"
zh_text: 「晚上回到酒館來聽我們的駐唱樂團，『聖者旅團』的表演吧！」

en_text: "Our house band The Avatars is performing in the other room!"
zh_text: 「我們的駐唱樂團『聖者旅團』正在另一個房間表演！」

en_text: Lucy laughs. "Revelry! Singing! Dancing! Eating! Drinking! All in a time and place where one may stop and enjoy life! I can see it hath been too long since thou hast sampled the simple pleasures of life in Britannia!"
zh_text: Lucy 笑了。「狂歡！唱歌！跳舞！吃東西！喝酒！在一個可以讓人停下來享受生活的地方和時刻！我看得出來，你已經很久沒有品嚐不列顛尼亞生活中簡單的樂趣了！」

en_text: "They are a popular local singing group. I am sure thou wilt like them,
zh_text: 「他們是當地受歡迎的合唱團。我相信你會喜歡他們的，

en_text: "Oh, I so enjoy meeting men who like to go out and 'kill' things!"
zh_text: 「喔，我好喜歡認識那些喜歡出門『殺』東西的男人！」

en_text: "Everything I serve is delicious. I highly recommend that thou tasteth the Silverleaf dish. Worth every gold piece spent!"
zh_text: 「我這裡提供的每樣東西都很美味。我強烈推薦你嚐嚐『銀樹葉』這道菜。保證物超所值！」

en_text: "I serve Britain's finest ale and wine."
zh_text: 「我提供不列顛城最棒的麥酒和葡萄酒。」

en_text: "It's made from the root of a very rare tree. Quite superb, it is!"
zh_text: 「它是用一種非常稀有樹木的葉子做成的。非常棒！」

en_text: You see a gleeful-looking merchant with an enthusiastic voice and manner.
zh_text: 你看見一位滿臉笑容、說話和舉止都很熱情的商人。

en_text: "Why, what can I do for thee,
zh_text: 「哎呀，有什麼我能為你效勞的，

en_text: "Why, my name is Greg. It is good to see thee."
zh_text: 「哎呀，我的名字是 Greg 。很高興見到你。」

en_text: "Why, I run the Provisioner's Shop here in Britain. A second home to the intrepid, it is."
zh_text: 「哎呀，我在不列顛城這裡經營雜貨店。這是無畏勇者的第二個家。」

en_text: "Why, thou dost look to be a person to whom adventure is no stranger. Whether thou art climbing a mountain, sailing the ocean, crossing a desert, exploring a dungeon or sleeping under the stars I have just what thou mayest need."
zh_text: 「哎呀，你看起來像是一個對冒險毫不陌生的人。無論你是在爬山、航行在海洋、穿越沙漠、探索地城或在星空下露宿，我都有你可能需要的東西。」

en_text: "I have moved my store here as a service to Lord British, who uses me exclusively to outfit all of his various expeditions. It is true!"
zh_text: 「我把我的店搬到這裡，是為了服務不列顛王，他專門委託我為他的各種探險隊提供裝備。這是真的！」

en_text: "I used to have my shop in Paws. But no one in Paws has the money to buy much of anything."
zh_text: 「我以前的店開在 Paws 。但 Paws 沒有人有錢買太多東西。」

en_text: "What every adventurer needs is good luck! There is just something about this shop, about the items bought here, something about me and my shop that is simply very lucky. I can give thee an example of what I mean."
zh_text: 「每個冒險家需要的都是好運！這家店、這裡買的物品、關於我和我的店，就是有一種非常幸運的特質。我可以給你舉個例子來說明我的意思。」

en_text: "A fighting man named Gorn once bought a shovel from me and he told me that it saved his life."
zh_text: 「一個名叫 Gorn 的戰士曾經向我買了一把鏟子，他告訴我這把鏟子救了他的命。」

en_text: "Perhaps thou knowest of Gorn. He speaks with a most peculiar accent!"
zh_text: 「或許你認識 Gorn 。他說話帶有非常奇特的口音！」

en_text: "Gorn wanted to dig for some buried treasure somewhere, when he heard some noises behind him. Upon turning, he was horrified to see a swarm of undead skeletons rushing toward him! In his haste to dig up the treasure, he had unbuckled his belt and laid down his sword. The only thing in his hands was the shovel. He immediately began swinging it and ended up knocking all the skeletons to bits! He now considers it his 'lucky shovel'!"
zh_text: 「Gorn 想在某處挖掘埋藏的寶藏，這時他聽到身後有聲響。轉過身時，他驚恐地看到一群不死骷髏正向他衝來！在急於挖出寶藏的過程中，他解開了腰帶並放下了劍。他手裡唯一拿著的東西就是那把鏟子。他立刻開始揮舞它，結果把所有的骷髏都打成了碎片！他現在把它當成他的『幸運鏟子』！」

en_text: "This is Lord British's favorite provisionary shop. He told me so himself. All sorts of famous adventurers pass through these doors. Why, just last week, we had the Avatar himself in this, my very own store!"
zh_text: 「這是不列顛王最喜歡的雜貨店。他親口告訴我的。各種著名的冒險家都會走進這扇門。哎呀，就在上週，聖者本人就來過我這家店！」

en_text: "Why, now that I mention it, he was dressed a lot like thou art. Yes, he was."
zh_text: 「哎呀，既然我都提到了，他的穿著跟你還真像。是的，他真的很像。」

en_text: "Why, I seem to remember that Avatar was also wearing a Fellowship medallion like the one thou dost possess. Hmmmm. And he nearly robbed me blind. I shall have to keep a careful eye on thee, I will."
zh_text: 「哎呀，我好像記得那位聖者也戴著一個和你戴的那個一樣的友誼會徽章。嗯。而且他幾乎把我搶個精光。我得小心盯著你，我會的。」

en_text: "Well, he said he was the Avatar. But then it is not all that unusual encountering some loon or fool who claims to be the Avatar!" He looks at you and for a moment appears a little embarrassed.
zh_text: 「嗯，他說他是聖者。但話說回來，遇到一些瘋子或傻瓜自稱是聖者也沒什麼不尋常的！」他看著你，有一瞬間顯得有些尷尬。

en_text: "He was dressed like the Avatar, similarly to how thou art presently attired. At first I thought it was Jesse, the actor who is playing the Avatar in the play by that director... What is his name again?
zh_text: 「他穿得像聖者，就像你現在的打扮。起初我以為是 Jesse ，就是那位在那個導演的戲裡扮演聖者的演員……他叫什麼名字來著？

en_text: "Thou wouldst think that one who appears to be like the Avatar would be worthy of trust. But, no. In this day and age there is no telling what to expect!"
zh_text: 「你會以為一個看起來像聖者的人是值得信任的。但是，不。在這個時代，誰也說不準會發生什麼事！」

en_text: "My customers are all people who go out and perform dangerous feats of bravery and derring-do. But most keep returning to buy more provisions time and again. With all the dangerous things my customers do, it is a wonder I have not lost them all and gone out of business!"
zh_text: 「我的顧客都是那些出去展現英勇與大膽冒險的人。但大多數人都會一次又一次地回來購買更多物資。我的顧客做著這麼多危險的事，我居然沒有失去他們所有人並倒閉，這真是個奇蹟！」

en_text: "I am dreadfully sorry but the Provisioner's Shop is currently closed. Do return at noon when it shall be open once again."
zh_text: 「非常抱歉，雜貨店目前休息。請在中午重新營業時再來。」

en_text: "As I say, we have everything thou dost need to have a jolly splendid adventure!"
zh_text: 「就像我說的，我們有你度過一次美妙冒險所需的一切！」

en_text: "I must get to my performance at The Blue Boar! The Avatars are playing tonight!"*
zh_text: Neno 正忙著和『聖者旅團』一起表演，現在無法說話。*「我必須趕去藍野豬酒館 (Blue Boar) 表演！『聖者旅團』今晚要演出！」*
Neno 正忙著和『聖者旅團』一起表演，現在無法說話。*

en_text: Neno is busy performing with The Avatars and cannot speak at the moment.*
zh_text: 「我必須趕去藍野豬酒館 (Blue Boar) 表演！『聖者旅團』今晚要演出！」*

en_text: You see a handsome and flamboyant musician.
zh_text: 你看見一位英俊且打扮浮誇的音樂家。

en_text: The musician nods at you. "I am Neno."
"I am studying to be the greatest bard that Britannia has ever known. I probably already -am- the greatest bard Britannia has ever known." You note that Neno is not at all modest.
zh_text: 音樂家向你點點頭。「我是 Neno 。」

en_text: "It is a great honor to be a bard. Thou art someone who gives pleasure to other people, while at the same time fulfilling a creative urge within thyself. It is truly magical. I know this from mine experience playing with The Avatars."
zh_text: 「我正在學習成為不列顛尼亞有史以來最偉大的吟遊詩人。我可能 -已經- 是不列顛尼亞有史以來最偉大的吟遊詩人了。」你注意到 Neno 一點也不謙虛。

en_text: "The Music Hall provides a great environment for study. Judith is a wonderful teacher, and the opportunities here are of the highest quality. One day I shall travel the world and entertain the common folk and nobles alike."
zh_text: 「成為一名吟遊詩人是莫大的榮譽。你帶給其他人快樂，同時也滿足了自己內心的創作慾望。這真的很神奇。我是從我在『聖者旅團』演奏的經驗中知道這點的。」

en_text: "It is my dream to be famous throughout the land. I shall tour the country every year, and play in the largest pubs in every town." He winks at you. "I shall be assured of wooing the women, dost thou not think?"
zh_text: 「音樂廳提供了極佳的學習環境。 Judith 是位很棒的老師，而且這裡的機會都是最高品質的。總有一天我會環遊世界，娛樂平民和貴族。」

en_text: "'Tis a singing group I play with. We play at The Blue Boar every evening. Please, come listen to us." Neno leans in to whisper, "But I plan to begin performing alone very soon. I am obviously the most talented member of the quartet."
zh_text: 「我的夢想是名揚四海。我會每年在全國巡迴演出，並在每個城鎮最大的酒館表演。」他向你眨眼。「我一定能迷倒女人們，你不覺得嗎？」

en_text: "Farewell! Thou must watch the postings for our performance dates!"*
zh_text: 「這是一個我參與演出的合唱團。我們每晚在藍野豬酒館表演。請來聽我們演出。」 Neno 湊近耳語，「但我打算很快就開始獨唱。我顯然是這四重唱裡最有才華的成員。」
「再會！你一定要留意我們演出日期的公告喔！」*
Judith 正忙著和『聖者旅團』一起表演，現在無法說話。*「我得走了！我跟『聖者旅團』的表演要遲到了！晚點再跟你聊！」*

en_text: Judith is busy performing with The Avatars and cannot speak at the moment.*
zh_text: Judith 正忙著和『聖者旅團』一起表演，現在無法說話。*

en_text: "I must run! I am late for my performance with The Avatars! I shall talk with thee later!"*
zh_text: 「我得走了！我跟『聖者旅團』的表演要遲到了！晚點再跟你聊！」*

en_text: You see an attractive middle-aged woman with music in her eyes.
zh_text: 你看見一位眼中閃爍著音樂光芒、充滿魅力的中年婦女。

en_text: "I am Judith. And I already know who thou art!"
"I teach music at The Music Hall. I also fatten my purse a bit by playing with The Avatars!"
zh_text: 「我是 Judith 。而且我已經知道你是誰了！」

en_text: "Music is my life. I know I will never be a famous bard, but I receive great pleasure from playing and performing. I enjoy teaching as well."
zh_text: 「我在音樂廳教音樂。我也會透過與『聖者旅團』一起演奏來賺點外快！」

en_text: "Lord British appointed me music teacher a couple of years ago. It is a wonderful job!"
zh_text: 「音樂就是我的生命。我知道我永遠不會成為一個著名的吟遊詩人，但我從演奏和表演中獲得了極大的樂趣。我也很享受教學。」

en_text: "We are a singing group. We play at the Blue Boar every evening. Please come and hear us! My pupil, Neno, is in the group. We hope to tour the country next year, if we can raise the funds."
zh_text: 「不列顛王幾年前任命我為音樂老師。這是一份很棒的工作！」

en_text: "It fulfills my life's purpose to teach others. It also gives me time away from home."
zh_text: 「我們是一個合唱團。我們每晚在藍野豬酒館表演。請來聽我們的演出！我的學生 Neno 也在團裡。如果我們能籌到資金，我們希望明年能在全國巡迴演出。」

en_text: "Oh, I do not want to speak about mine home. Mine husband and I... well, we are not altogether... happy."

en_text: "It was held two years ago. I received 84 percent of the votes. It was an impressive victory, I must admit.
zh_text: 「那是在兩年前舉行的。我獲得了 84% 的選票。我必須承認，這是一場令人印象深刻的勝利。

en_text: "Of course, when one has a group like The Fellowship behind them..."
zh_text: 「當然，當一個人背後有像友誼會這樣的團體支持時……」

en_text: "He was an old farmer named Brownie. Didn't have much money to put into a campaign. Even the peasants didn't support him."
zh_text: 「他是一位名叫 Brownie 的老農夫。沒有多少錢投入競選。就連農民都不支持他。」

en_text: "My life has improved greatly since I joined. I find that mine honesty is impeccable, my leadership is unchallengeable, and my love for my wife is irreproachable.
zh_text: 「自從我加入後，我的生活有了很大的改善。我發現我的誠實無懈可擊，我的領導能力無可挑剔，我對妻子的愛更是無可指責。

en_text: "Thou shouldst consider attending one of our meetings in the evening."
zh_text: 「你應該考慮參加我們晚上的聚會。」

en_text: "I would wager that thy life has improved as well!"
zh_text: 「我敢打賭你的生活也改善了！」

en_text: "Did I say that? I certainly did not mean it. There is no class system in Britain anymore, nor in the entire country, for that matter! What I meant is that the 'peasantry', that is, those people who are not of superior lineage -- which is the type of man Brownie is -- -they- did not support him either. They knew who would be the best leader!"
zh_text: 「我有這麼說嗎？我絕對不是那個意思。不列顛城已經沒有階級制度了，整個國家也都沒有！我的意思是『農民階級』，也就是那些沒有優越血統的人—— Brownie 就是那種人——『他們』也不支持他。他們知道誰會是最好的領導者！」

en_text: "Did I say that? I do not think I really meant that the way it sounded. What I meant to say was that there are people who come from families of better standing than others. And Brownie is not one of them! But do not misunderstand me -- I still maintain that the class system in Britannia has been abolished!"
zh_text: 「我有這麼說嗎？我想我並不是那個意思。我想說的是，有些人出身於地位比其他人更好的家庭。而 Brownie 不是其中之一！但別誤會我——我仍然堅持不列顛尼亞的階級制度已經被廢除了！」

en_text: "She said what? Well, she's wrong! And to think she is a 'brother'. One of The Fellowship! I shall have to speak to Batlin about her."
zh_text: 「她說什麼？嗯，她錯了！虧她還是個『弟兄』。友誼會的一員！我得跟巴特林談談她的事。」

en_text: You notice that Patterson seems ill-at-ease.
zh_text: 你注意到 Patterson 似乎感到不安。

en_text: "I am obviously the most honest person in Britain! Perhaps I should move to Moonglow! Ha!"
zh_text: 「我顯然是不列顛城最誠實的人！也許我該搬去 Moonglow！哈！」

en_text: "Her name is Judith. She's the music teacher at The Music Hall. Perhaps thou hast met her. We have a wonderful relationship."
zh_text: 「她的名字是 Judith 。她是音樂廳的音樂老師。也許你見過她。我們的關係非常美好。」

en_text: "The land must have some way of generating income. Taxes are the only solution. Every merchant and farmer is taxed. Anyone who works for a living is taxed."
zh_text: 「這片土地必須有某種產生收入的方法。稅收是唯一的解決方案。每個商人和農夫都要納稅。任何靠工作謀生的人都要納稅。」

en_text: "The Britannian Tax Council has its main office in the Royal Mint."
zh_text: 「不列顛尼亞稅務委員會的主要辦公室在皇家造幣廠。」

en_text: "Why, I do not know what she is talking about! I work late, that is all!"
zh_text: 「哎呀，我不知道她在說什麼！我只是工作到很晚，僅此而已！」

en_text: Iolo whispers to you, "This man seems very defensive, dost thou not think? I say we should observe him and see where he goes after The Fellowship meeting tonight."
zh_text: Iolo 對你耳語：「這個人似乎很有防禦心，你不覺得嗎？我說我們應該觀察他，看看他今晚在友誼會聚會後去了哪裡。」

en_text: "How should I know? Anyway, his body was found in an abandoned building which is no longer standing. It used to be a storehouse of some kind, up near the castle. It was torn down a couple of years ago. The body was mutilated beyond belief. It was as if someone tied the poor man down with stakes and cut off all of his limbs. Finster was then beheaded. It was almost... what is the word... ritualistic!
zh_text: 「我怎麼會知道？總之，他的屍體在一個已經不存在的廢棄建築裡被發現。那裡曾經是某種倉庫，就在城堡附近。幾年前被拆除了。屍體被肢解得難以置信。就好像有人用木樁把那個可憐的人綁起來，然後砍斷了他所有的四肢。 Finster 然後被斬首了。這簡直是……怎麼說呢……儀式性的！

en_text: "And that is all I remember. No one was ever arrested for the crime."
zh_text: 「這就是我記得的全部。沒有人因為這項罪行被捕。」

en_text: Patterson nods his head at you.*
You see a flamboyant-looking gentleman. He is very cheerful and outgoing, greeting you with a smile and a wave.
zh_text: 你看見一位打扮浮誇的紳士。他非常開朗外向，面帶微笑揮手向你致意。

en_text: "In a wink, in a word,~"I do greet thee, Milord."
zh_text: 「眨眼間，一句話，~向您致意，大人哪。」

en_text: "To greet thee, On this day,~"'Tis my pleasure, Milady."
zh_text: 「在此吉日，向您致意，~這是我的榮幸，女士。」

en_text: "From out the dawn, when sun doth rise,~"Until next morn when moon must go,~"I answer to thy beck and cries,~"thine humble servant, Carrocio!"
zh_text: 「從破曉時分，太陽初升起，~直到隔日清晨，月亮漸隱去，~我聽候您的吩咐與呼喚，~您卑微的僕人， Carrocio ！」

en_text: "The puppet's curtain I unfurl,~"And from mine hands the story's told,~"For pleasure of a boy or girl,~"To see doth cost one coin of gold.~"To take good measure of thy power,~"Forged in fire of virtue's heart,~"To ring the bell this very hour,~"Do test thy strength 'til thy muscles smart."
zh_text: 「我揭開木偶戲的布幕，~故事從我手中娓娓道出，~為男孩女孩帶來歡樂，~觀賞只需一枚金幣付。~要衡量你的力量多大，~在美德之心的烈火中鍛打，~此時此刻來敲響那鐘，~測試你的力氣直到肌肉痠痛。」

en_text: "And perhaps impress thine own sweetheart!" Carrocio winks at you."Or dost thou wish to be a king?~"Yonder sticks a sword in stone.~"If thou canst only pull it out~ "Thou wilt be the next upon the throne!"
zh_text: 「或許還能讓你的心上人印象深刻！」 Carrocio 向你眨眼。「或者你想要成為國王？~那邊有把插在石中的劍。~只要你能把它拔出來，~你就會是下一個登上王座的人！」

en_text: "And perhaps impress thine own sweetheart!" Carrocio winks at you.
zh_text: 「或許還能讓你的心上人印象深刻！」 Carrocio 向你眨眼。

en_text: "Or dost thou wish to be a king?~"Yonder sticks a sword in stone.~"If thou canst only pull it out~ "Thou wilt be the next upon the throne!"
zh_text: 「或者你想要成為國王？~那邊有把插在石中的劍。~只要你能把它拔出來，~你就會是下一個登上王座的人！」

en_text: "My childhood's eye spied father's toil,~"A puppet's show of splendor royal.~"Time's breeze has blown, My father's gone,~"His child has grown, Regrets anon,~"Gears and wheels move the moppets now, in need of no one,~"And so I keep his carnival song playing on and on alone."
zh_text: 「我童年的眼看著父親辛勤工作，~一場華麗如皇家的木偶戲。~時光飛逝，父親已離去，~孩子已長大，懊悔不已，~齒輪與飛輪如今轉動著木偶，不再需要任何人，~所以我獨自讓他的嘉年華之歌一直播送下去。」

en_text: "I am sorry to say~"I have called it a day.~"Come to the	grounds to test thy fitness~"when I am, yea verily, open for business."
zh_text: 「很抱歉地說~我今天已經打烊。~請到場地來測試你的體能~當我，是的的確，開門營業時。」

en_text: "Take the hammer in thine hands and strike a blow upon the ground,~"If thine arms be possessed of might then thou shalt hear a ringing sound.~"Once thou hast struck if thou hearest naught then thou dost know thy strength is flagging.~"But if thou dost win the strength test game thou shalt receive a stuffed dragon."
zh_text: 「拿起槌子往地上敲一擊，~如果你的雙臂充滿力量，你就會聽到清脆的鐘聲。~如果你敲擊後什麼也沒聽到，你就知道你的力氣正在衰退。~但如果你贏了力量測試遊戲，你將會得到一隻絨毛龍。」

en_text: "I fear an end to my family craft, where the show is run by human heart,~"But bones do age, not so machines, and we cannot simply replace a part.~"I carry on as best I can, A machine to play my father's role,~"Control the marionettes unseen, struggling to imbue them with a soul."
zh_text: 「我擔心我的家族手藝會終結，那是用心來經營的表演，~但骨頭會老化，機器則不會，而我們不能輕易地更換零件。~我盡我所能地繼續下去，用機器來扮演我父親的角色，~在看不見的地方控制著懸絲木偶，努力為它們注入靈魂。」

en_text: "The faces pressed before me, fleeting moments chance of glee, From the lowly mongrel beggar to the resident of throne,~"Each know their place and gave me chase to find the one for me, Woman whom my life may share, this heart that waits alone."
zh_text: 「那些壓向我的臉孔，轉瞬即逝的歡樂時光，從低賤的乞丐到王座上的居民，~每個人都知道自己的位置，並讓我去尋找那個屬於我的人，那個可以分享我生命的女人，這顆孤獨等待的心。」

en_text: "A beggar man called Snaz will come to watch my show, ~"to steal and sell all my best jokes, mine own personal foe."
zh_text: 「一個名叫 Snaz 的乞丐會來看我的表演，~偷走並賣掉我所有最好的笑話，他是我個人的宿敵。」

en_text: "Thine ignorance doth make me skittish,~"surely thou hast heard of wise Lord British."
zh_text: 「你的無知讓我感到不安，~你肯定聽說過睿智的不列顛王。」

en_text: "The awakening of mine heart's idyll,~"Lies 'neath me for I see her still,~"No bard could e'er describe nor tell,~"the tenderness of my fair Nell."
zh_text: 「我心中田園詩的覺醒，~就在我身下，因為我依然看著她，~沒有任何吟遊詩人能描述或訴說，~我美麗 Nell 的溫柔。」

en_text: "'Tis said love is a fiery angel,~"Riding soft silk wings of pure redemption,~"My puppet's heart still as an anvil,~"At the wicked thrill of her attention.~"By mine angel Nell I am anointed,~"Humble cowardice felled by Passion's blade,~"As her beloved I was hence appointed,~"Perchance through destiny a marriage made."
zh_text: 「據說愛是位熾熱的天使，~乘著純粹救贖的柔軟絲翼，~我木偶般的心靜如鐵砧，~在她關注的邪惡刺激下顫動。~我被我的天使 Nell 膏抹，~卑微的懦弱被激情的利刃擊倒，~我因此被指定為她的愛人，~或許是命運促成了這段婚姻。」

en_text: Carrocio looks as if he is lost in a memory. After a moment he returns to reality.
zh_text: Carrocio 看起來彷彿陷入了回憶。過了一會兒，他回過神來。

en_text: "I would not be a gentleman if I spoke of this more, Forgive me the candor of mine heart's open door."~He appears somewhat embarrassed and clears his throat loudly several times.
zh_text: 「如果我再多說這件事，我就不是個紳士了，請原諒我敞開心扉的坦率。」~他顯得有些尷尬，並大聲清了幾次喉嚨。

en_text: "My coins are arrows rushing to make good,~"'Til the day when the jeweller sells his ring,~"For my sure heart is not but carved from wood,~"And she doth tend to the bed of a king."
zh_text: 「我的硬幣是急於兌現的箭，~直到珠寶商賣出戒指的那天，~因為我堅定的心並非木頭雕刻，~而她卻在照顧國王的床鋪。」

en_text: Carrocio gives you a shocked look and drops to his knees before you. "I beseech thee,
zh_text: Carrocio 震驚地看著你，並跪在你面前。「我懇求你，

en_text: , ~"Keep still thy tongue,~"My Nell has ne'er harmed anyone,~"It would cause grievous injury to her reputation,~"Through the town's wagging lips our secret to spread,~"'Twould make a permanent end of mine occupation,~"And kill our hope of a happy life dead." He looks you in the eyes, pleadingly. "In thee I must place mine hope and trust,~"Part, parcel and whole.~"To ne'er again speak of the spoils of my lust, ~"Thou must not tell a soul!"
zh_text: ，~請保持沉默，~我的 Nell 從未傷害過任何人，~透過城裡喋喋不休的嘴唇傳開我們的秘密，將會對她的名譽造成嚴重的傷害，~那將會永久終結我的職業，~並扼殺我們對幸福生活的希望。」他用懇求的眼神看著你。「我必須將我的希望和信任寄託在你身上，~全部的一切。~永遠不要再談論我慾望的戰利品，~你絕對不能告訴任何人！」

en_text: He looks at you awaiting some sort of indication. Will you keep his secret?
zh_text: 你看著他，等待某種指示。你會為他保守秘密嗎？

en_text: "Reconsider, I must insist of thee, Thou art too thin of hide,~"If he knew, Nell's brother would murder me,~"And I would not see Nell widowed before having the chance to become a bride."
zh_text: 「重新考慮吧，我必須堅持，你太不顧及別人了，~如果他知道， Nell 的哥哥會殺了我，~而我不願看到 Nell 在有機會成為新娘前就成了寡婦。」

en_text: "I am grateful for thine honesty about thy lack of care,~"But why hast thou placed thyself in the center of our affair?~"For Nell's sake I could not bring myself to cause harm to her brother,~"I shall convince him of mine intentions,~"I love Nell and no other.~"Leave me now for I must use this time to properly prepare."
zh_text: 「我很感激你誠實地表達了你的不在乎，~但你為何要把自己置於我們這段感情的中心？~為了 Nell 的緣故，我無法忍心傷害她的哥哥，~我會說服他我的意圖，~我只愛 Nell ，別無他人。~現在請離開，我必須利用這段時間好好準備。」

en_text: "I am sorry to say~"I have called it a day.~"Come to the grounds at daybreak~"when the puppets are, yea verily, up and awake."
zh_text: 「很抱歉地說~我今天已經打烊。~請在破曉時分來到場地~當木偶們，是的的確，已經起床並清醒時。」

en_text: "See foolish pride and love, brutality and sin, Carrocio's tiny world of moving dolls,~"Enough to make thee gasp, or cry or grin,~"All who wish to see 'tis time to hear my calls,~"For now the puppet show is about to begin!"*
zh_text: 「來看看愚蠢的驕傲與愛、殘暴與罪惡， Carrocio 的微小木偶世界，~足以讓你倒抽一口氣、哭泣或咧嘴笑，~所有想看的人，現在是聽我呼喚的時候了，~因為現在木偶戲即將開始！」*

en_text: "Perchance to find in mercy's ear, A voice to know as gentle friend,~"I bid thee well, but hark return, If thou wouldst see the puppet's play or test thy strength again."
zh_text: 「或許能在慈悲之耳中，找到一個如溫柔朋友般的聲音，~祝你一切順利，但也請記得回來，如果你想再次觀賞木偶戲或測試你的力量。」

en_text: "I am the caretaker of the Royal Orchards here in Britain."
zh_text: 「我是不列顛城這裡皇家果園 (Royal Orchards) 的管理員。」

en_text: Figg is too intent on listening to the Fellowship meeting to acknowledge your attempts to converse with him.*
zh_text: Figg 太過專心聆聽友誼會聚會，沒有理會你與他交談的嘗試。*

en_text: "Hast thou seen Batlin? Where is he? He needs to lead our meeting!"
zh_text: 「你有看到巴特林嗎？他在哪裡？他需要來主持我們的聚會！」

en_text: "My goodness! It is nine o'clock! Excuse me, I must get to tonight's Fellowship meeting."*
zh_text: 「天哪！九點了！抱歉，我必須趕去今晚的友誼會聚會。」*

en_text: You see a man whose wrinkled face forms a caricature of grumpiness.
zh_text: 你看見一個男人，他佈滿皺紋的臉構成了一副脾氣暴躁的滑稽漫畫。

en_text: "My responsibilities include caring for the trees, watching over the pickers at harvest time and protecting the Royal Orchard from thieves."
zh_text: 「我的職責包括照顧果樹，在收穫時節監督採摘工，以及保護皇家果園免受小偷的光顧。」

en_text: "Apple trees require constant care. I must make sure the trees all have enough water but not too much. I must keep all trees properly trimmed and be watchful so that the crop does not get infested by bugs or worms. I am also required to pick up all of the fallen apples, which is a job in itself."
zh_text: 「蘋果樹需要持續的照顧。我必須確保所有的樹都有足夠的水分，但又不能太多。我必須保持所有的樹都修剪得當，並保持警惕，以免作物被害蟲或蠕蟲感染。我還必須撿起所有掉落的蘋果，這本身就是一項工作。」

en_text: "Most of them are migrant farmers from Paws. Because they were once farmers, they are convinced they know more about the upkeep of the orchard than I! Of course that is preposterous. Also the pickers do not take orders very well."
zh_text: 「他們大多是來自 Paws 的移工。因為他們曾經是農夫，所以他們確信自己比我更了解果園的保養！這當然是荒謬的。而且採摘工不太服從命令。」

en_text: "They would rob us down to the last twig if I gave them the chance! I should be awarded a medal from Lord British himself the way I risk my very life and limb protecting this orchard. Why, I just caught another thief recently. His name was Weston."
zh_text: 「如果我給他們機會，他們會把我們搶到只剩最後一根樹枝！我冒著生命危險保護這片果園，不列顛王應該親自頒發獎章給我。哎呀，我最近剛抓到另一個小偷。他的名字是 Weston 。」

en_text: "Here are grown the finest apples in all of Britannia. I would let thee sample one but it would be against the law as thou art obviously not of noble stock."
zh_text: 「這裡種植著全不列顛尼亞最好的蘋果。我想讓你嚐嚐看，但這會違法，因為你顯然不是貴族血統。」

en_text: "He now resides in the prison, thanks to me! I knew what he was up to from the moment I saw him! He had the look of a hardened apple thief so I had him nicked by the town guard."
zh_text: 「多虧了我，他現在住在監獄裡！我一看到他就知道他想幹嘛！他有一副老練蘋果賊的模樣，所以我讓城鎮守衛把他抓了。」

en_text: "Yes, Weston is now living in our local prison. If thou dost not believe me, thou canst go there and see for thyself!"
zh_text: 「是的， Weston 現在就住在我們當地的監獄裡。如果你不相信我，你可以自己去那裡看看！」

en_text: "Oh, he came here with some sob story. But when one is as astute an observer of human behavior as I am, one can tell the true intent of people, which is often contrary to what they will say to thee!"
zh_text: 「喔，他帶著一些賺人熱淚的故事來這裡。但當一個人像我一樣是人類行為的敏銳觀察者時，就能看出人們的真實意圖，而這往往與他們告訴你的相反！」

en_text: "I do not recall, exactly. Something about his impoverished wife and family starving to death in Paws or some load of rubbish."
zh_text: 「我記不太清楚了。好像是關於他貧困的妻子和家人在 Paws 快餓死了，或者其他一堆廢話。」

en_text: "Yes, I do consider myself to be a more than passable judge of character. And dost thou know how I became so?"
zh_text: 「是的，我確實認為自己是一個非常合格的品格判斷者。你知道我是怎麼變得如此的嗎？」

en_text: "Then I shall tell thee! I am a member of The Fellowship!"
zh_text: 「那我告訴你吧！我是友誼會的成員！」

en_text: "I am a member of the Fellowship, yes. But it would be a crime for me to give apples from the Royal Orchard to The Fellowship, and it would be a violation of my sacred duty. While selling apples is also a violation, I was only trying to do this man Weston a favor. And I suppose these accusations are the thanks I get? Hmph!"

zh_text: 「喔，我想你現在想要一間客房了吧！看吧，我就是這個意思！每人每晚十枚金幣。你想要客房，對吧？」

en_text: "Thou art carrying too much to take the room key!"
zh_text: 「你帶了太多東西了，拿不下房間鑰匙！」

zh_text: 「這是你的房間鑰匙。它只有在你離開旅店前有效。」

zh_text: 「你沒有足夠的金幣在這裡開房間。現在我想你肯定要告訴我你是怎麼落得這般可憐的境地。好吧，我可不聽你說！」

en_text: James wipes his brow. "Phew! That was a close call!"
zh_text: James 擦了擦額頭。「呼！好險！」

zh_text: 你看見一位穿著盔甲、帶著一小批武器的迷人女子。

en_text: "We have been tracking this creature for years, ever since we completed our training. We have followed him from one end of Britannia to another. Sometimes he was just one step ahead of us. But now we know that we are nearer to him than we have ever been before."
zh_text: 「自從我們完成訓練以來，我們已經追蹤這隻怪物好幾年了。我們從不列顛尼亞的一端跟隨他到另一端。有時候他只領先我們一步。但現在我們知道，我們比以前任何時候都更接近他。」

zh_text: 「我們的父親為了生存勇敢地戰鬥。他並沒有輕易死去。他死得像個英雄。雖然我們可能都會在這場努力中死去，但我們打算給殺他的兇手一個真正惡棍應得的死法。」

en_text: "Thou shouldst be aware, however, that magic is not working in Britannia these days. It is a dying phenomenon. No one understands why. Nevertheless, my training should increase any magic user's primary chances for casting a spell, as well as their fighting skill."

en_text: "My fee for training is 75 gold. Does this meet with the approval of thy purse strings?"
zh_text: 「我的訓練費用是 75 金幣。這有獲得你錢包的同意嗎？」

en_text: Denby bows. "I am sorry my fee is too high for thee. Perhaps at another time thou wilt realize the value of my services."
zh_text: Denby 鞠躬。「很抱歉我的費用對你來說太高了。也許下次你會明白我服務的價值。」

en_text: "Morfin is an unusual character. If I did not know any better I would say he was involved with a number of shady business activities."
zh_text: 「Morfin 是個不尋常的人物。如果我不是比較了解狀況，我會說他捲入了一些見不得光的商業活動。」

en_text: "Paws is a good place to go to buy things for low prices. Many of the people are rather poor, I am sorry to say. There is little active commerce there, however. In Paws, one must deal with people on a more personal level."
zh_text: 「Paws 是個買便宜貨的好地方。很遺憾地說，那裡許多人相當貧窮。然而，那裡的商業活動很少。在 Paws ，人們必須在更私人的層面上與人打交道。」

en_text: "Thou must return when the Farmer's Market is open."
zh_text: 「你必須在農夫市集營業時再來。」

en_text: "Wouldst thou like to buy some meats?"
"We have a fine selection of meats for thee today,
zh_text: 「我們今天為你準備了上好的肉品，

zh_text: 「等你餓了再來，我們那時候再為你服務。」

en_text: "My Fred is one of the most respected merchants in Britain. He sells the eggs and vegetables grown by Brownie and Mack, as well as exotic imported fruits."
zh_text: 「我的 Fred 是不列顛城最受尊敬的商人之一。他賣 Brownie 和 Mack 種的蔬菜和雞蛋，還有異國進口水果。」

en_text: "The Farmer's Market is where most of Britain buys its food. Why even the people in Paws will come here to buy eggs and vegetables. Fred has never raised the price of anything since opening this market many years ago."
zh_text: 「農夫市集是大部分不列顛城人買食物的地方。哎呀，就連 Paws 的人也會來這裡買雞蛋和蔬菜。自從多年前開設這個市集以來， Fred 從未漲過任何東西的價格。」

en_text: You see a sturdy-looking farmer's wife. She gives you a hospitable smile before returning to her chores.
zh_text: 你看見一位看起來很結實的農婦。她給了你一個好客的微笑，然後回到她的雜務上。

en_text: "What brings us the pleasure of having thee back on this day,
zh_text: 「是什麼風把你今天又吹來了，

en_text: "Mine husband Fred and I run the Farmer's Market."
zh_text: 「我丈夫 Fred 和我經營這個農夫市集。」

en_text: "Farmer Mack's chickens lay plenty of eggs. It is a good thing the people here have such healthy appetites!"
zh_text: 「農夫 Mack 的雞下了很多蛋。這裡的人胃口這麼好真是件好事！」

en_text: "We sell those mostly to older people. Thou dost know, I am sure, how children do not like to eat their vegetables. Some people do not want to keep a lot of fruit in their home as they are afraid of attracting fruit flies."
zh_text: 「我們主要賣給年紀大的人。我相信你知道小孩子多不喜歡吃蔬菜。有些人不想在家裡放太多水果，因為怕招惹果蠅。」

en_text: "Brownie is a good man. I do hope he runs for the mayorship again. If he does thou must be sure to vote for him."
zh_text: 「Brownie 是個好人。我真希望他能再次競選市長。如果他選了，你一定要投給他。」

en_text: "I do believe that poor old Mack has been cooped up with his chickens for too long. He is a good person. Do not be put off by the strange stories he doth tell. He rarely ever sleeps as he spends most of the night staring at the sky. Of course his rooster crows at dawn and no farmer can afford to sleep past the dawn. So his mind is a bit ragged."
zh_text: 「我相信可憐的老 Mack 跟他的雞關在一起太久了。他是個好人。別被他講的奇怪故事給嚇跑了。他很少睡覺，因為他幾乎整晚都在盯著天空看。當然，他的公雞在黎明時會啼叫，沒有哪個農夫能睡到日出之後的。所以他的精神有點不濟。」

en_text: "Oh, in Britain they look for quality produce. I see the people who buy here look over every egg for cracks and every vegetable for any sign of spoilage."

zh_text: 「Paws 的人總是缺錢。我對他們深感同情。他們總是在找最便宜的物品來買，因為那是他們唯一負擔得起的。」

en_text: "The market is now closed. Thou must return when we are open for business."
zh_text: 「市集現在打烊了。你必須在我們營業時間再來。」

en_text: "Wouldst thou like to buy some eggs, fruits or vegetables? We have plenty of delicious fresh eggs here for thee. And our vegetables are sure to keep thee in good health."
zh_text: 「你想買些雞蛋、水果或蔬菜嗎？我們這裡有很多美味新鮮的雞蛋。而且我們的蔬菜保證能讓你保持健康。」

en_text: "I am sure we have something here that will be to thy liking."
zh_text: 「我相信我們這裡一定有你喜歡的東西。」

en_text: "My given name is Wilhelm, although no one calls me that. I prefer to be addressed as Willy. Thank thee very much."
zh_text: 「我的本名是 Wilhelm ，雖然沒人這樣叫我。我比較喜歡別人叫我 Willy 。非常感謝你。」

en_text: "Here thou art, laddie." Willy hands Spark a pastry and the boy devours it in one gulp.*
zh_text: 「給你，小夥子。」 Willy 遞給 Spark 一個糕點，男孩一口就把它吞了下去。*

en_text: "I am the baker here in Britain and I make the sweetest bread thou hast ever tasted!
zh_text: 「我是這裡不列顛城的烘焙師，我做的是你嚐過最甜的麵包！

en_text: "Hast thou had a chance to sample any of my bread yet?"
zh_text: 「你有機會嚐過我的麵包了嗎？」

en_text: "Ah, then thou dost agree it is the sweetest, dost thou not?"
zh_text: 「啊，那麼你也同意它是最甜的，不是嗎？」

en_text: "Ha! Thou dost see, then? Everyone agrees! That should be proof enough!"
zh_text: 「哈！你看到了吧？每個人都同意！這應該就是最好的證明！」

en_text: , I think we need a lot of this for the road. We had best buy some, all right?"*
zh_text: ，我想我們路上需要很多這個。我們最好買一些，好嗎？」*

en_text: "Thou dost not?! Why, do not be ridiculous! Of course thou dost!"
zh_text: 「你不同意？！哎呀，別開玩笑了！你當然同意！」

en_text: "Then here, thou must have some!" He tears a piece of bread off of one of several loaves he is carrying and stuffs it into your mouth. "There! Is it not the sweetest bread thou hast ever tasted? It is, is it not?!" You chew as fast as you can in order to answer him.
zh_text: 「那給你，你一定要嚐嚐！」他從帶著的幾條麵包上撕下一塊，塞進你嘴裡。「看吧！這不是你嚐過最甜的麵包嗎？是的，對不對？！」你盡快地咀嚼著，以便回答他。

en_text: He grabs your face by the cheeks and plants a big kiss on your forehead. "Thou art truly a person of good palate and refined taste!"
zh_text: 他捏住你的臉頰，在你的額頭上印下一個大大的吻。「你真是個有品味的好食客！」

en_text: Dejectedly Willy looks down at the loaf of bread he is carrying. He sniffs at it twice and tosses it out of sight.
zh_text: Willy 沮喪地低頭看著他拿著的麵包。他嗅了兩下，然後把它扔得遠遠的。

en_text: "Please come to the bakery when it is open in daytime hours and thou shalt sample some!"
zh_text: 「請在白天麵包店營業時來，你可以嚐嚐看！」

en_text: Willy wipes away a tear. "Gone. Both of them. Gone to join mine ancestors in that great kitchen in the sky. I will never be able to cook as they did. Still I plod along, trying to keep the family name alive, and that is why I am a baker. But I suppose it is not the only reason."
zh_text: Willy 擦去一滴眼淚。「都走了。兩個人都走了。去天上那個偉大的廚房與我的祖先相聚了。我永遠無法像他們那樣烹飪。但我還是堅持著，努力保持家族的名聲，這就是我成為烘焙師的原因。但我想這不是唯一的原因。」

en_text: He gives you a long puzzled look. After a moment he takes one of his loaves of bread and swats you over the head with it.
zh_text: 他疑惑地看著你好一會兒。過了一會兒，他拿起一條麵包，往你頭上敲下去。

zh_text: 「其實，我當烘焙師有一個很好的理由。」

en_text: "I not only have bread for sale, but pastries, cakes and rolls as well. The most delicious baked goods thou couldst ever wish to pop into thy mouth! Wouldst thou like to buy some?"

en_text: "If thou wert a person of truly refined taste, thou wouldst buy some!"
zh_text: 「如果你是一個真正有品味的人，你就會買一些！」

zh_text: 「恐怕麵包店已經打烊了。請在正常營業時間再來。」

en_text: "Very well. But I warn thee that employment is hard to obtain in these times!"
zh_text: 「很好。但我警告你，現在工作可不好找！」

en_text: "'Tis a pity thou art unavailable. Thou dost look like one who doth know their way around a kitchen."
zh_text: 「很可惜你沒空。你看起來像個懂得在廚房裡穿梭的人。」

en_text: "I would be happy to talk with thee about employment at my shoppe during normal business hours."
zh_text: 「我很樂意在正常營業時間與你談談在我店裡工作的事。」

zh_text: 「在這美好的一天你過得如何，

en_text: "I sell fish and chips from my wagon."
zh_text: 「請在我營業時間再來。」*「我有你在全不列顛尼亞能嚐到最棒的炸魚薯條。我的價格只要每份 8 枚金幣。你想來點嗎？」

en_text: "Come back later when I am open for business."*
"I have the best fish and chips thou shalt taste in all of Britannia. My price is only 8 gold coins per serving. Wouldst thou like to have some?"
zh_text: 「我有你在全不列顛尼亞能嚐到最棒的炸魚薯條。我的價格只要每份 8 枚金幣。你想來點嗎？」

en_text: He hands you a plate."They are indeed the best fish and chips in all of Britannia."
zh_text: 他遞給你一個盤子。「這真的是全不列顛尼亞最棒的炸魚薯條。」

en_text: "They are indeed the best fish and chips in all of Britannia."
zh_text: 「這真的是全不列顛尼亞最棒的炸魚薯條。」

en_text: "Thou art carrying too many things to take thy fish and chips from me!"
zh_text: 「你身上的東西太多，拿不下你的炸魚薯條了！」

en_text: "Thou dost not have enough gold to get any fish and chips. Sorry!"
zh_text: 「你沒有足夠的金幣來買炸魚薯條。抱歉啦！」

en_text: "Come back again when thou art hungry and I am sure thou shalt change thy mind."
zh_text: 「當你餓了的時候再來，我相信你會改變主意的。」

en_text: "Ever since I became a member of The Fellowship, business has been increasing steadily. I have refined and improved the recipe for my fish batter and it has since become a favorite meal of nearly everyone in Britain. I have even served my fish and chips to Lord British himself."
zh_text: 「自從我成為友誼會成員後，生意就穩定成長。我改良並提升了炸魚麵糊的食譜，從那以後它就成了幾乎所有不列顛城人最喜歡的一餐。我甚至還把炸魚薯條供應給不列顛王本人。」

en_text: "Thou dost know-- the bloke who wears a crown and acts like a king."
zh_text: 「你知道的——就是那個戴著王冠、舉止像國王的傢伙。」

en_text: "I am glad to see that thou art a member. Will I see thee at the next meeting?"
zh_text: 「很高興看到你也是成員。我們下次集會見？」

en_text: "Then I shall see thee at nine o'clock sharp!"
"Thou shouldst apply thyself more stringently to the ways of The Fellowship! Our meeting is at nine o'clock. I can see thou dost certainly need to attend."
zh_text: 「你應該更嚴格地實踐友誼會的教義！我們的集會是九點。我看你真的很需要參加。」

en_text: "As I am certain thou knowest, Buccaneer's Den was once a den of thieves and villains. As such, it held a romantic appeal for those who longed for a taste of such an adventurous existence. I confess, I am one of those people. When thou dost spend thy life selling fish from a wagon, thou art in need of excitement. The pirates eventually realized just how much they are secretly envied, and so they have turned their island into a place of thrilling amusements."
zh_text: 「我相信你也知道，海盜巢穴曾是小偷和惡棍的巢穴。因此，對於那些渴望體驗這種冒險生活的人來說，它有一種浪漫的吸引力。我承認，我就是其中之一。當你一生都在餐車賣魚時，你會需要一些刺激。海盜們最終意識到他們在暗地裡是多麼受人羨慕，所以他們把他們的島嶼變成了一個充滿刺激娛樂的地方。」

en_text: "It is said they have several games of chance there! Gold can be won wagering on the outcome of a race of fine stallions."
zh_text: 「據說他們那裡有幾種賭博遊戲！可以透過下注賽馬的結果來贏得金幣。」

en_text: "I saw thee receive thy medallion. I can certainly say the Fellowship has done wonders for my life and I know it will be the same for thee as well." He gives thee a knowing grin.
zh_text: 「我看到你領取了徽章。我敢肯定地說，友誼會為我的生活帶來了奇蹟，我知道對你也會是一樣的。」他給了你一個會心的微笑。

en_text: Sean is deep in concentration, listening to the Fellowship meeting.*
zh_text: 「我無法想像巴特林在哪裡。他從不錯過友誼會集會！」

en_text: "I cannot imagine where Batlin is. He never misses Fellowship meeting!"
zh_text: 「我現在不能停下來說話！我參加友誼會集會要遲到了！」*

en_text: "I must not stop to speak now! I am late for the Fellowship meeting!"*
zh_text: 你看見一個男人，他那張充滿孩子氣的臉龐上，鑲嵌著彷彿看透世事、充滿審視意味的雙眼。

en_text: You see a man whose boyish face is set with scrutinizing eyes that look as if they have seen much.
"And what may I do for thee,

zh_text: 「當我不在處理友誼會事務時，我是不列顛城這裡的珠寶商。如果你想買些什麼，請說！」

en_text: "When not tending to Fellowship affairs, I am a jeweller here in Britain. If thou dost wish to buy something, say so!"
zh_text: 「這是一項非常精細的工作。它需要只有少數人擁有的特殊手感。你必須確切地知道如何處理珍貴的材料。只有最優秀的工匠才能成為珠寶商，而且他們能獲得最高的報酬。」

en_text: "It is very delicate work. It requires a special touch that only a few have. Thou must know precisely how to handle precious materials. Only the finest of craftsmen become jewellers and they receive the highest compensation."
zh_text: 「我經常需要新材料來製作我非常特別的珠寶。我總是在市場上收購寶石。如果你有偶然發現任何寶石，而你想賣掉它們賺錢的話，我就是你要找的人。」

en_text: "I constantly require new materials with which to create my very special jewelry. I am always in the market to buy gems. If thou dost ever come across any, I am the man to come to if thou shouldst want to sell them and make money."
zh_text: 「就像我告訴你的，只有最優秀的工匠才能成為珠寶商，而我是最優秀的珠寶商。這難道還不夠明顯嗎？」 Sean 哼了一聲。「我的生意賺的錢比造幣廠還多！」他勉強地笑了笑。

en_text: "As I have told thee, only the finest of craftsmen become jewellers, and I am the finest of jewellers. Does that not tell thee something?" Sean sniffs. "My business makes more money than the mint!" He laughs forcibly.
zh_text: 「珠寶店目前打烊了。晚點再來！」

en_text: "The jeweller's shop is currently closed for business. Come back later!"
"Dost thou have a gem for sale?"
zh_text: 「我願意以每顆寶石 30 枚金幣的價格向你收購。這個價格你同意嗎？」

en_text: "I will pay thee 30 gold coins per gem. Is that price agreeable?"
zh_text: 「你以為我是傻瓜嗎？！這個藍色小玩意兒一文不值！」

en_text: "Dost thou think me a fool?! This little blue bauble is worthless!"
zh_text: Sean 的臉色緊繃。「這顆寶石又小又暗，就像邪惡巫妖的心臟一樣。拿走！」

en_text: Sean's face tightens. "This gem is small and dark as the heart of an unholy Liche. Away with it!"
zh_text: 「你根本沒有寶石！你這個騙子！我不跟你做生意了！」

en_text: "Thou dost have no gems! Thou art a liar! I will do no business with thee!"
"I see that thou has one gem."

zh_text: 「你身上的東西太多，拿不下你的報酬了！」

en_text: "Thou art carrying too much to take thy payment!"
"It seems we have little left to discuss then."
zh_text: 「如果你沒有寶石要賣，那就連提都別提，別浪費我的時間！」

en_text: "If thou dost have no gems for sale then do not even waste my time by mentioning it!"
zh_text: 「我看你也是成員！」 Sean 突然用較為尊敬的眼神看著你。「我相信友誼會未來會為你帶來無窮的好處。」他帶著高傲的笑容說道。

en_text: "I see thou art a member!" Sean suddenly looks at you with a bit more respect. "I am sure The Fellowship will do thee a world of good in the future." He smiles condescendingly.
zh_text: 「甚至連你也可以加入友誼會，我可以告訴你更多關於它的事。」

en_text: "Even thou mayest join The Fellowship and I can tell thee more about it."
zh_text: 「如果你想聽，我可以告訴你友誼會的理念。」

en_text: "I can tell thee about The Fellowship's philosophy if thou dost wish."
"Thou art really interested in hearing more?"
"I thought I was wasting my breath on thee."
zh_text: 「我把整個生意搬到不列顛城，就是為了靠近友誼會的總部。你根本無法想像我加入友誼會之後，我的生意改善了多少。」

en_text: "I moved mine entire business here to Britain to be near the main branch of The Fellowship. Thou hast no idea how much my business improved after I joined The Fellowship."
"Then please browse if thou dost like."
"Please come to the shop during normal business hours."
zh_text: 「我相信你一定得趕路了。」 Sean 微笑著。*

en_text: "I am sure thou must be on thy way." Sean smiles.*
"Patterson courted the support of The Fellowship. They forced a vote from all their members. Once word spread, my support drained away. No one wants to be on the losing side." Brownie sighs.
zh_text: 「Patterson 爭取了友誼會的支持。他們強迫所有成員投票給他。一旦消息傳開，我的支持者就流失了。沒有人想站在輸家那邊。」 Brownie 嘆了口氣。

en_text: You see a farmer who, despite showing considerable wear from hard work, appears energetic, cheerful and friendly.
zh_text: 你看見一位農夫，儘管繁重的工作讓他看起來相當疲憊，但他顯得精力充沛、開朗且友善。

en_text: "Well, I ran for the office of Mayor of Britain once, but I lost. Now I am back doing what I have been doing since I was a boy. Working the farm."
zh_text: 「嗯，我曾經競選過不列顛城的市長，但我落選了。現在我又回到了我從小就在做的事。在農場工作。」

en_text: "Patterson won the election. He spent a lot of money on his campaign. Most of it to buy votes. But I am not bitter. I was just not meant to be Mayor."
zh_text: 「Patterson 贏得了選舉。他在競選上花了很多錢。大部分是用來買票。但我並不怨恨。我只是注定當不了市長。」

en_text: "I do not really have any wish to succeed in politics. It just made me ill seeing all of the people with riches mistreat all of the people who are poor, and then have to listen to them talk about how the class system has been abolished."
zh_text: 「我其實沒有任何想在政治上獲得成功的願望。我只是看不慣那些有錢人虐待窮人，然後還得聽他們談論階級制度已經被廢除了。」

en_text: Brownie gestures toward your medallion. "Frankly, I do not know what thou seest in that group."
zh_text: Brownie 指著你的徽章。「說實話，我不知道你在那個團體裡看到了什麼。」

en_text: "If thou art not with The Fellowship thou art against them. I think they saw me as a potential enemy that had to be stopped."
zh_text: 「如果你不與友誼會同流合污，你就是在反對他們。我想他們把我視為一個必須被阻止的潛在敵人。」

en_text: "Of course, I could have won the election if I had wanted to. I had information about Patterson that would have ruined any chances of him winning."
zh_text: 「當然，如果我想要的話，我本來是可以贏得選舉的。我掌握了關於 Patterson 的情報，那會毀掉他所有獲勝的機會。」

en_text: "I could have revealed a secret about Patterson but if I did it would have hurt someone close to him very much. I did not want to be mayor that badly."
zh_text: 「我本來可以揭露一個關於 Patterson 的秘密，但如果我這麼做了，會對他身邊親近的人造成很大的傷害。我並沒有那麼想當市長。」

en_text: "Patterson does little to hide his secret. If thou dost keep an eye on him thou wilt surely learn of it sooner or later."
zh_text: 「Patterson 幾乎沒有掩飾他的秘密。如果你留意他，你遲早會發現的。」

en_text: "I feel more at home on the farm growing vegetables. There is another farmer named Mack who works a farm near Britain as well. He raises chickens."
zh_text: 「我還是覺得在農場種蔬菜比較自在。還有另一個農夫叫 Mack ，他也在不列顛城附近經營農場。他養雞。」

en_text: "I like him. He even voted for me. But to tell thee the truth about Mack, he is a lunatic."
zh_text: 「我喜歡他。他甚至還投票給我。但說實話，關於 Mack ，他是個瘋子。」

en_text: "I raise pumpkins. But I am in a bind at the moment and need some help."
zh_text: 「我種南瓜。但我現在遇到了一點麻煩，需要一些幫忙。」

en_text: "I strained my back the other day lifting heavy pumpkins. I cannot so much as lift a small one today! And I need help with the harvest of pumpkins so that I can get them to the market."
zh_text: 「前幾天我搬重南瓜時扭傷了背。我今天連一個小南瓜都搬不動！我需要有人幫忙收成南瓜，這樣我才能把它們送到市集去。」

en_text: "There are piles of pumpkins at the north end of the field. I need them brought down near my farmhouse. If thou wilt help me by bringing the pumpkins to me, I will gladly pay thee for thy work. How does one gold coin for every pumpkin carried sound?"
zh_text: 「田地北端有一堆南瓜。我需要把它們搬到我的農舍附近。如果你願意幫我把南瓜搬過來，我很樂意為你的工作付錢。每搬一個南瓜給你一枚金幣，聽起來如何？」

en_text: "Thou shouldst simply go to the north end of the field and bring back as many pumpkins as thou can carry!"
zh_text: 「你只要去田地北端，帶回盡可能多你能拿的南瓜就行了！」

en_text: "Well, 'tis not really lost. It is locked up in my shed. It is the key to the shed that is lost! I think I might have accidentally used it as a fishhook when I was fishing on the banks of Lock Lake. So now I cannot get into my shed. One would think I -am- a looney!"
zh_text: 「嗯，也不是真的不見了。它被鎖在我的棚子裡。不見的是棚子的鑰匙！我想我可能在 Lock Lake 岸邊釣魚時不小心把它當成魚鉤用了。所以現在我進不去我的棚子了。人家還真會以為我是個瘋子呢！」
「聖者！你回來了！」 Mack 驚呼。

en_text: You see a farmer with wild eyes widened in excitement.
zh_text: 你看見一位農夫，狂野的雙眼因為興奮而睜得大大的。

en_text: "I am a farmer, though most folks just call me a lunatic."
zh_text: 「我是個農夫，雖然大部分的人都叫我瘋子。」

en_text: "On my farm I raise chickens and grow vegetables. If thou dost need work, talk to me!"
zh_text: 「在我的農場裡，我養雞和種蔬菜。如果你需要工作，跟我說！」

en_text: "Thou dost also think so, eh? But I tell thee what I say is true! There are creatures visiting us from another place in the stars! I have seen them!"
zh_text: 「你也這麼認為，是吧？但我告訴你我說的都是真的！有來自星星上另一個地方的生物來拜訪我們！我親眼見過！」

en_text: "They are big mean ugly liontigers! Or is that tigerlions? They are ferocious and they want to eat us!"
zh_text: 「他們是又大又凶又醜的獅虎獸！還是虎獅獸？他們非常兇猛，而且想吃我們！」

en_text: "All I can say is that there are certainly no such creatures in this world! Nor is their ship like any that has ever been seen anywhere in Britannia."
zh_text: 「我只能說，這個世界上絕對沒有這種生物！他們的船也不像在不列顛尼亞任何地方見過的任何船隻。」

en_text: "With mine own eyes I have seen a star creature and the inexplicable conveyance which enabled it to travel to Britannia! I swear to thee! I am completely sane! I have proof!"
zh_text: 「我親眼見過一隻星際生物，以及讓它能旅行到不列顛尼亞的莫名交通工具！我向你發誓！我完全理智！我有證據！」

en_text: "Go and look behind my farm in the middle of the field. Take a look for thyself and thou shalt see my proof."
zh_text: 「去我農場後面的田野中央看看。你自己去看看，你就會看到我的證據。」

en_text: "I told thee I was not a looney! Didst thou see the proof?"
zh_text: 「我就告訴過你我不是瘋子！你看到證據了嗎？」

en_text: "Thou must go and look at what is in my field! Then come back here, for I must talk about this with someone who knows that I am not a looney!"
zh_text: 「你必須去看看我田裡有什麼！然後回來這裡，因為我必須跟知道我不是瘋子的人談談這件事！」

en_text: "Did I not tell thee that I am no loonie? Still, my story of how I did come across this thing is beyond belief."
zh_text: 「我是不是告訴過你我不是瘋子？不過，我如何偶然發現這東西的故事，簡直令人難以置信。」

en_text: "I like to stay up late. Sometimes I see bright lights flash across the sky. No one else ever pays them any mind. But one night I see this bright light come crashing down and it lands in my field."
zh_text: 「我喜歡熬夜。有時候我會看到明亮的光芒劃過天空。沒有其他人會去注意它們。但有一天晚上，我看到這道明亮的光芒墜落下來，降落在我的田裡。」

en_text: "I have been looking every night for another sign of those things but I have not seen any since that last time I told thee about it."
zh_text: 「我每天晚上都在尋找那些東西的另一個跡象，但自從我上次告訴你的那次之後，我就再也沒見過了。」

en_text: "I always watch for moving bright lights in the night sky. That is part of why people in the town say I am a loonie. But is what I do so different from what they do in the orrery?"
zh_text: 「我總是觀察夜空中移動的明亮光芒。這也是鎮上的人說我是瘋子的部分原因。但我所做的，跟他們在太陽系儀館裡做的事情有什麼不同嗎？」

en_text: "After the explosion and crash I ran out to my field. There I saw the strange machine that thou hast seen, only it was glowing hot. I was terrified. But then the top of the machine started to open."
zh_text: 「在爆炸和墜毀之後，我跑到了我的田裡。在那裡我看到了你所見過的那台奇怪的機器，只是它正發出熾熱的光芒。我嚇壞了。但接著機器的頂部開始打開。」

en_text: "It resembled a bird, but it was not a bird!"
"I could not move from the spot as I saw the strange ship open. From out of the top came the vicious tigerlion. There was a savage hunger in its eyes."
zh_text: 「當我看到那艘奇怪的船打開時，我嚇得無法動彈。從頂部出來的是一隻兇惡的虎獅獸。它的眼中充滿了野蠻的飢餓感。」

en_text: "In other words, it looked like it might eat me!"
zh_text: 「換句話說，它看起來好像會把我吃掉！」

en_text: "It came at me like a predator comes after prey. It was so fast that I could not even move. I thought I was going to be killed for certain. It reached me in a second. It looked into mine eyes, and then it died."
zh_text: 「它像掠食者追捕獵物一樣撲向我。它太快了，我甚至無法移動。我以為我死定了。它一秒鐘就衝到了我面前。它看著我的眼睛，然後它就死了。」

en_text: "What it and I had failed to notice was that I was holding mine hoe. It had once been accidentally enchanted by a passing mage, and it works wondrously in the fields. I use it for everything! The tigerlion had run itself through upon it. As it died, the thing spoke."
zh_text: 「它和我沒注意的是，我手裡正拿著我的鋤頭。它曾經被一個路過的法師意外地施了魔法，而且在田裡使用起來效果奇佳。我什麼事都用它！那隻虎獅獸自己撞穿在它上面。當它死的時候，那東西說話了。」

en_text: "It said two words. "Kill Wrathy." I do not know who this Wrathy person is, or why the tigerlion wanted me to kill him. But I do know I sure get worried now whenever I see moving lights in the night sky."
zh_text: 「它說了兩個字。『殺了 Wrathy。』我不知道這個 Wrathy 是誰，也不知道為什麼虎獅獸要我殺了他。但我知道現在每當我看到夜空中移動的光芒時，我就會感到很擔心。」

en_text: "I am sure thou dost know about the plague of looniness that has come to afflict all of the mages in the world. It was several years ago that I brought my broken hoe to a mage called Mumb. Fixing things was all he was good for anymore. There was also some fighter who wanted Mumb to enchant his sword, turning it into "The Sword of Death". It appears poor Mumb got confused and that fighter came back and killed him because the man wound up with a sword that was only good for cutting weeds. I could never figure out exactly what happened. It appears that old Mumb made mine hoe into the Hoe of Destruction! Unfortunately, the hoe is lost."

zh_text: 「擔任不列顛王的顧問，並作為我們種族在不列顛城這裡的代表。很榮幸能成為國王漫長的顧問名單中的一員。」

en_text: "To make sure the gargoyle race is heard in the castle. To have been a long road to acceptance and integration into Britannian society."
zh_text: 「為了確保石像鬼種族的聲音在城堡裡被聽見。要被不列顛尼亞社會接受和融合，是一條漫長的路。」

en_text: "To tell you that, not long after your last visit, the gargoyles settled upon Terfin, an island to the southeast. To have moved, little by little, onto the mainland."
zh_text: 「告訴你，在你上次拜訪後不久，石像鬼定居在東南方的 Terfin 島上。然後逐漸地，一點一點地搬到了大陸上。」

en_text: "To be accepted in most places. To feel sad, however, that there are still towns that do not accept us. But our Lord and King, Draxinusom, is still alive and is doing a magnificent job. To know and help all gargoyles who are alive."
zh_text: 「在大多數地方被接受了。然而，仍然有一些城鎮不接受我們，這讓人感到難過。但我們的國王，Draxinusom ，仍然活著，而且做得非常出色。去了解並幫助所有還活著的石像鬼。」

en_text: "To be concerned that Inamo's parent shall never know what happened." He appears saddened.
zh_text: 「擔心 Inamo 的父母永遠不會知道發生了什麼事。」他看起來很悲傷。

en_text: You see a very large mouse with an air of superior intelligence.
zh_text: 你看見一隻非常巨大的老鼠，散發出一種卓越智慧的氣息。

en_text: "Avatar!" she exclaims. "I cannot believe thou art here,
zh_text: 「聖者！」她驚呼道。「我不敢相信你在這裡，

en_text: "I am trying to keep up with these children! We are playing tag through the castle! I must run! Talk to me later in the nursery!"*
zh_text: 「我正努力跟上這些孩子！我們在城堡裡玩鬼抓人！我得跑了！晚點在育嬰室跟我說話！」*「白天我主要在皇家育嬰室協助 Nanna。晚上當 Nanna 去吃晚餐並參加她的友誼會集會時，我會單獨看顧孩子們。其他時間我則在城堡裡跑來跑去尋找老鼠食物！」

en_text: "I mainly assist Nanna in the Royal Nursery during the day. I watch the children alone in the evenings while Nanna has dinner and goes to her Fellowship meeting. Other times I run around the castle looking for mouse food!"
zh_text: 「我正努力跟上這些孩子！我們在城堡裡玩鬼抓人！我得跑了！晚點在育嬰室跟我說話！」*

en_text: "The children are so much fun. I like to read them their favorite story. It happens to be Lord British's favorite children's story, too! He read it to me oh, those many years ago."
zh_text: 「白天我主要在皇家育嬰室協助 Nanna。晚上當 Nanna 去吃晚餐並參加她的友誼會集會時，我會單獨看顧孩子們。其他時間我則在城堡裡跑來跑去尋找老鼠食物！」

en_text: "If thou hast not had the chance yet, do look around and meet them. They are most wonderful and amusing."
zh_text: 「孩子們太有趣了。我喜歡讀他們最喜歡的故事給他們聽。碰巧那也是不列顛王最喜歡的童話故事！很多很多年前，他也曾讀給我聽過。」

en_text: "It is much the same as it was when thou wert last here. There has been a bit of remodeling. After all, it has been 200 years since thou wert last here! I believe Lord British has a storeroom with quite a bit of equipment inside."
zh_text: 「如果你還沒有機會，請務必四處看看並見見他們。他們非常棒，也很逗趣。」

en_text: "Well, cheese is my favorite. If thou dost ever have cheese to give away, I will gladly eat it. But I will generally eat most anything. Dost thou have any cheese for me?"
zh_text: 「這跟妳上次來的時候差不多。有稍微改建了一下。畢竟，距離你上次來已經兩百年了！我相信不列顛王有一個裡面裝了不少裝備的儲藏室。」
「嗯，起司是我的最愛。如果你有起司可以給我的話，我會很樂意吃掉它的。但我通常什麼都吃。你有帶起司給我嗎？」

en_text: "I am unable to take thy cheese at the moment,
"Well! I thought thou wert my friend!"
"But thou hast not got any cheese!"
"Too bad! If thou dost find any, please keep me in mind!"
"Dost thou want to hear the story? It is called 'Hubert's Hair-Raising Adventure'."
zh_text: 「太可惜了！如果你找到了，請隨時想到我！」

en_text: Sherry stands on her hind legs, takes a deep breath, and then recites -- from memory -- very, very fast:
zh_text: 「你想聽這個故事嗎？它叫做『Hubert 的驚悚冒險』。」
Sherry 用後腿站立，深吸了一口氣，然後憑著記憶——非常、非常快地背誦了起來：

en_text: "For breakfast I usually prepare a dish that my Liege brought with him from his homeland. Here we call it Eggs British. It is served with assorted fruits and tea, of course. It is the King's favorite."
zh_text: 「早餐我通常會準備一道陛下從他家鄉帶來的美食。在這裡我們稱之為『不列顛蛋 (Eggs British)』。當然，它會搭配什錦水果和茶。這是國王的最愛。」

en_text: This is an elderly woman who epitomizes 'grandmotherly'.
zh_text: 這是一位老奶奶，簡直就是『慈祥祖母』的縮影。

en_text: "All my brothers and sisters called me 'Boots' when I was a baby, and it hath remained my name ever since."
zh_text: 「當我還是個小嬰兒的時候，我所有的兄弟姊妹都叫我『Boots』，從那以後這就成了我的名字。」

en_text: "Why, I am Lord British's personal cook! I prepare meals for the entire castle."
zh_text: 「哎呀，我是不列顛王的私人廚師！我負責準備整個城堡的餐點。」

en_text: "Just go to the dining room at breakfast or supper time and mine husband Bennie will serve thee!"
zh_text: 「只要在早餐或晚餐時間去餐廳，我丈夫 Bennie 就會為你服務！」

en_text: "This meal is usually whatever meat or game or fish Lord British requests, accompanied by several additional courses and a fine dessert."
zh_text: 「這頓飯通常是不列顛王要求的任何肉類、野味或魚，並伴隨幾道配菜和一份精美的甜點。」

en_text: "He's a dear, but he has become a little absent-minded in his later years. He never remembers to bring enough meat from the slaughterhouse in Paws. In fact, we are short this week!"
zh_text: 「他是個親愛的，但他晚年變得有點健忘。他總是不記得從 Paws 的屠宰場帶足夠的肉回來。事實上，我們這週缺貨了！」

en_text: "Last week I asked him to put a little garlic into some soup. He put in the garlic and then forgot about it. So he went and put some more in. Then he forgot he did that. So he put in more. Well, thou canst imagine the look on Lord British's face when he finally did taste that soup! It is a good thing we live and work in the castle of such a just ruler."
zh_text: 「上週我叫他在湯裡放一點大蒜。他放了大蒜，然後就忘了這回事。所以他又去放了一些。然後他又忘了自己放過。所以他又放了更多。嗯，你可以想像不列顛王最後嚐到那碗湯時臉上的表情！幸好我們是在如此公正的統治者的城堡裡生活和工作。」

en_text: "That is right, we do not have enough. If thou couldst bring me mutton from the slaughterhouse, I will pay thee 5 gold for every portion thou canst bring. All right?"
zh_text: 「沒錯，我們的肉不夠。如果你能從屠宰場帶羊肉給我，你每帶一份我就付你 5 枚金幣。好嗎？」

en_text: "Good, I will be awaiting thy return!"
"Oh dear. Well, I know thou art busy. Some other time, then."
zh_text: 「喔，親愛的。嗯，我知道你很忙。那就下次吧。」

en_text: "Splendid! Let's see, we agreed on 5 gold per portion, if I remember correctly."
zh_text: 「太棒了！讓我想想，如果我沒記錯的話，我們說好每份 5 枚金幣。」
「什麼事，聖者？」 Bennie 帶著權威的口吻問道。

en_text: "I am the Head Servant at the castle. My job consists of keeping the other servants in line and serving the meals."
zh_text: 「我是城堡的僕人總管。我的工作包括管理其他僕人，以及上菜。」

en_text: "Yes, I have been Head Servant for many years. Mine entire family works for Lord British. My son is the king's gentleman's gentleman. My daughter is the Royal Chambermaid. My wife is Head Cook. We are pleased to work for Lord British."
zh_text: 「是的，我擔任僕人總管已經很多年了。我整個家族都在為不列顛王工作。我的兒子是國王的貼身男僕。我的女兒是皇家女僕。我的妻子是主廚。我們很榮幸能為不列顛王工作。」

en_text: "My wife, Boots, is the head cook. Her specialty is roast beef. She makes wonderful pastries, too. Enough of those will give thee a very un-Avatar-like figure!
zh_text: 「我的妻子，Boots ，是主廚。她的拿手菜是烤牛肉。她也做非常棒的糕點。吃夠多這些東西，就會讓你擁有一個非常不『聖者』的身材！

en_text: "Wouldst thou like to order a meal?"
Bennie serves you and your party a delicious meal of beef and pastry.
zh_text: Bennie 為你和你的隊伍端上美味的牛肉和糕點。

en_text: "Return tomorrow and thou canst have another free meal."
zh_text: 「明天再來，你就可以享用另一頓免費餐點。」
