zh_text: ，但我一天只能為你服務一次。明天再來用餐吧。」

en_text: "Oh. Well, thou must return when thou art hungry."
zh_text: 「喔。嗯，當你餓的時候一定要回來。」

en_text: "Come to the dining room during breakfast or dinner and I will be most honored to serve thee!"
zh_text: 「在早餐或晚餐時間來到餐廳，我將非常榮幸為你服務！」

en_text: "Yes, I suppose I am. I am also becoming a little hard-of-hearing. When thou hast seen as many years as I have, one's faculties are no longer perfect."
zh_text: 「是的，我想我是。我的聽力也變差了一點。當你活到我這個歲數，人的感官能力就不再完美了。」

en_text: "I do not wish to bemoan my fate, but my family lives in Paws -- my wife Alina and my child Cassie. They were starving and I came to Britain to get food for them."
zh_text: 「我並不想哀嘆我的命運，但我的家人住在 Paws ——我的妻子 Alina 和我的孩子 Cassie 。他們快餓死了，我來不列顛城是為了給他們找食物。」

en_text: You see a thoroughly disheartened young man who is miserably languishing behind bars.
zh_text: 你看見一個徹底灰心喪志的年輕人，正在鐵窗後痛苦地憔悴著。

en_text: "I have none so long as I am left to rot here in this prison."
zh_text: 「只要我還被留在這座監獄裡等死，我就沒有工作。」

en_text: "Thy job is to pay for the crime thou hast committed."*
zh_text: 「你的工作就是為你犯下的罪行付出代價。」*

en_text: "My crime was stealing apples from the Royal Orchards. This I did and I admit it freely. If given the same set of circumstances I would do it again."
zh_text: 「我的罪行是從皇家果園偷蘋果。這是我做的，我也坦白承認。如果在同樣的情況下，我還會再做一次。」

en_text: "A-ha! Not only an unrepentant criminal but also a potential professional thief! Looks like this one has ended in the right place and just in the nick o' time."*
zh_text: 「啊哈！不僅是個不知悔改的罪犯，還是個潛在的職業小偷！看來這傢伙來對了地方，而且正是時候。」*

en_text: "I had offered to buy them first, but Figg, the caretaker of the orchard, set an exorbitant price which I am certain he would have pocketed for himself. So, yes, I admit to stealing them."
zh_text: 「我一開始有提議要買，但是果園管理員 Figg 開出了一個天價，我敢肯定他會把那筆錢中飽私囊。所以，是的，我承認我偷了它們。」

en_text: "See how the common criminal blames his type of immoral behavior on others, all the while denying it in himself! This one is irredeemable, he is."*
zh_text: 「看看這種普通罪犯如何將自己不道德的行為怪罪到別人身上，同時還不承認自己的錯！這傢伙已經無可救藥了。」*

en_text: "He gives baskets of fruit free to The Fellowship without Lord British's consent, I am quite certain."
zh_text: 「我相當肯定，他未經不列顛王的同意，就免費把一籃籃的水果送給友誼會。」

en_text: "Thou shouldst not listen to this obvious slander,
zh_text: 「你不應該聽信這種明顯的誹謗，

en_text: "Mine only regrets are that I did not try to steal something bigger and that	I did not get away with it."
zh_text: 「我唯一的遺憾是沒有試著偷更大點的東西，而且我沒有成功逃脫。」

en_text: . I am from Paws and it is another reason why they believe I can be trifled with."
zh_text: 。我來自 Paws ，這也是他們認為我可以被隨便對待的另一個原因。」

en_text: "This prisoner is from Paws! I bloody knew it! To his credit he was in town nearly an entire day before he stole something. For a citizen of Paws that is as honest as they come!"*
zh_text: 「這個囚犯來自 Paws ！我他媽的早就知道了！值得讚賞的是，他在鎮上待了將近一整天才偷東西。對一個 Paws 的公民來說，這已經是盡可能地誠實了！」*

en_text: "Paws is a town where thou mayest feel the icy grip of poverty about thine heart."
zh_text: 「Paws 是一個會讓你感到貧窮如冰冷之手般緊緊揪住你心臟的小鎮。」

en_text: "Oh bloody 'ell! Now I suppose he is going to go and tell us his whole pathetic life's story! Couldst thou wait until I get out mine handkerchief so I do not interrupt thee with all my wailing!"*
zh_text: 「喔該死！現在我猜他又要開始告訴我們他那可悲的一生了！你能不能等我拿出我的手帕，免得我嚎啕大哭打斷了你啊！」*

en_text: "Not so long ago Paws was a thriving rustic coastal village. But as Britain grew larger most of our local businesses moved there. We became a farming town and the seven year drought gave us a lashing that we have yet to recover from."
zh_text: 「不久前， Paws 還是一個繁榮的鄉村沿海村莊。但隨著不列顛城的擴張，我們大部分的當地企業都搬到了那裡。我們變成了一個農業小鎮，而那場七年的乾旱給了我們沉重的打擊，我們至今仍未恢復過來。」

en_text: "Oh, now! Do not go and bring up poverty as an excuse as to why thou hast turned to crime! My father was so poor he and his family had to eat dirt. But he still raised me proper. Beat the stuffings out of me if he ever so much as imagined I did anything wrong, I can tell thee that!"*
zh_text: 「喔，得了吧！別把貧窮當作你犯罪的藉口！我父親窮到他和他的家人必須吃土。但他還是把我教得好好的。我告訴你，如果他覺得我做錯了什麼事，他絕對會把我揍得屁滾尿流！」*

en_text: "I do not want any mercy for myself. I have admitted my guilt. But my life does not only belong to myself. It belongs to my wife and family as well. Without me they will suffer unbearable hardships, such as they might not survive."
zh_text: 「我不求對我自己的任何憐憫。我已經認罪了。但我的生命不只屬於我自己。它也屬於我的妻子和家人。沒有我，他們將遭受難以忍受的苦難，他們可能無法活下去。」

en_text: "Although there are fools who will speak otherwise, the people of Britannia are being crushed by the vicious tyranny of the class system. While a few have more than they could ever enjoy, there are many who go to sleep hungry every night. My wife and daughter to name two of them."
zh_text: 「儘管有些愚人會說出相反的話，但不列顛尼亞的人民正被階級制度的惡毒暴政所壓榨。當少數人擁有比他們能享受的還多更多的東西時，有許多人每晚卻只能餓著肚子入睡。我的妻子和女兒就是其中兩個。」

en_text: "Oh, that reminds me it is nearly time for my meal break! The trout is supposed to be delicious today at the Farmer's Market."
zh_text: 「喔，這提醒我快到我的用餐時間了！聽說今天農夫市集的鱒魚很美味。」

en_text: "Fools like our good friend the guard would have us believe that nothing has changed in Britannia for over two hundred years. That we can live our lives as if all of our problems do not exist. I say to thee that it is people like that who cause our problems in the first place."
zh_text: 「像我們這位好朋友守衛這樣的愚人，會想讓我們相信不列顛尼亞在兩百多年來什麼都沒變。我們可以裝作所有的問題都不存在一樣地過日子。我告訴你，一開始就是像那樣的人製造了我們的問題。」

en_text: "While I am certain Lord British is a just and fair ruler, he must be quite unaware of all that goes on in his kingdom. Surely he would not tolerate such inequity."
zh_text: 「雖然我肯定不列顛王是一位公正公平的統治者，但他必定對他的王國裡發生的一切相當不知情。他絕對不會容忍這種不平等的。」

en_text: "All right! That is enough noise out of thee! All day long yakkata-yakkata about the awful terrible class system! Why, the next thing thou knowest thou shalt be sayin' society is to blame for thy crimes. Not a word from anybody about any appreciation for keeping the laws and order. No, of course not! But all the pity in the world for the dangerous lawbreakers who are the real threat to society."*
zh_text: 「好了！你的廢話夠多了！整天唧唧歪歪地抱怨那可怕糟糕的階級制度！怎麼，接下來你是不是要說社會該為你的罪行負責？沒有任何人對維持法律和秩序表達任何感謝。沒錯，當然沒有！反而全世界的憐憫都給了那些對社會造成真正威脅的危險違法者！」*

en_text: "Wouldst thou speak with Lord British about me? I would bet that he is completely unaware of my case! Please! Wilt thou speak with him?"
zh_text: 「你願意跟不列顛王談談我的事嗎？我敢打賭他對我的案子完全不知情！拜託！你願意跟他談談嗎？」

en_text: "Oh, I thank thee, Avatar! My fate and the fates of my wife and daughter are in thine hands!"
zh_text: 「喔，感謝你，聖者！我的命運，以及我妻子和女兒的命運都掌握在你手中了！」

en_text: Weston lowers his head. "Then why art thou speaking with me? Go away and leave me to my misery."*
zh_text: Weston 低下頭。「那你為什麼要跟我說話？走開，讓我一個人痛苦吧。」*

en_text: "Inwisloklem and I are drafting a bill which would make illegal any distribution of waste products in Lock Lake, near Cove. The lake is quite defiled."
zh_text: 「 Inwisloklem 和我正在起草一項法案，將在 Cove 附近的 Lock Lake 排放任何廢棄物視為非法。那座湖已經被嚴重污染了。」

en_text: "That is good news! Perhaps thou couldst do us a great favor. We need this bill delivered to Lord Heather in Cove. He must read it and give us his approval by signing it. I know thou hast far more important things to do than running errands, but it would be greatly appreciated. Wilt thou do it?"
zh_text: 「那真是個好消息！也許你可以幫我們一個大忙。我們需要將這項法案送到 Cove 的 Lord Heather 那裡。他必須閱讀它並簽署以表示他的批准。我知道你有遠比跑腿更重要的事情要做，但如果你能幫忙，我們將不勝感激。你願意做嗎？」

en_text: "They have done immeasurable good for Minoc, helping to counter the disunity that can plague a town such as ours where so many people are fixated upon monetary gain."
zh_text: 「他們為 Minoc 做了無法估量的好事，幫助對抗在我們這樣一個許多人都專注於金錢利益的城鎮中可能發生的分裂。」

en_text: "Leave us in peace, damn thee! Elynor and I are in love and we wish to be alone together! Find thy cheap excitations elsewhere!"
zh_text: 「別打擾我們，該死！ Elynor 和我相愛著，我們希望能單獨在一起！去別處找你廉價的刺激吧！」

en_text: You see a young, bewitching gypsy woman with wise, soul-peering eyes.
zh_text: 你看到一位年輕迷人的吉普賽女人，有著充滿智慧、彷彿能看穿靈魂的雙眼。

en_text: "Thou vishest to speak vith me again?" Margareta asks.
zh_text: 「你希望再跟我說話嗎？」Margareta 問。

en_text: "Margareta at thy service," she speaks slowly.
zh_text: 「 Margareta 為你服務，」她緩慢地說著。

en_text: The gypsy woman smiles slightly. "To tell thy destiny."
zh_text: 吉普賽女人微微一笑。「為你占卜命運。」

en_text: "I knew it vould happen. I varned Frederico. He vouldn't listen."
zh_text: 「我就知道會發生這種事。我警告過 Frederico 。他不聽。」

en_text: "He vas my brother-in-law. His death makes me very sad."
zh_text: 「他是我丈夫的兄弟。他的死讓我非常傷心。」

en_text: "She vas Frederico's vife, but thou dost know that already, no? She vas a good voman."
zh_text: 「她是 Frederico 的妻子，但你已經知道了，不是嗎？她是個好女人。」

en_text: "He has been led astray. It is unfortunate that he vill realize his mistake only as a result ov the death ov his parents."
zh_text: 「他誤入歧途了。不幸的是，他只有在父母雙亡的結果下，才會意識到自己的錯誤。」

en_text: "There are many, many others like Sasha who have been led astray. For them, I see no future."
zh_text: 「還有很多很多像 Sasha 一樣誤入歧途的人。對他們，我看不到未來。」

en_text: Margareta sees your medallion and raises her eyes."I see thou art vearing vone ov their medallions, but thou art not truly a member, art thou? Bevare -- there are those in The Fellowship that vill see through thy deception."
zh_text: Margareta 看到你的護身符，抬起了眼睛。「我看到你戴著他們的一個護身符，但你並不是真正的成員，對吧？小心點——友誼會裡有些人會看穿你的偽裝。」

en_text: Margareta sees your medallion and raises her eyes.
zh_text: Margareta 看到你的護身符，抬起了眼睛。

en_text: "I see thou art vearing vone ov their medallions, but thou art not truly a member, art thou? Bevare -- there are those in The Fellowship that vill see through thy deception."
zh_text: 「我看到你戴著他們的一個護身符，但你並不是真正的成員，對吧？小心點——友誼會裡有些人會看穿你的偽裝。」

en_text: "Thou vilt soon be enlightened about their true nature."
zh_text: 「你很快就會明白他們的真面目。」

en_text: "Thou shalt learn more about them in due time."
zh_text: 「到了適當的時候，你會了解更多關於他們的事。」

en_text: "Jergi is mine husband, ov course. Now he has the veight ov guiding the gypsy race in these	troubled times."
zh_text: 「 Jergi 當然是我的丈夫。現在他肩負著在這些動盪時期引導吉普賽民族的重任。」

en_text: "My parents - Frederico and Tania - vere murdered. I do not know vhy anyone vould vant to harm them." The words choke out of the boy. Suddenly he is overwhelmed by grief and is unable to speak further.
zh_text: 「我的父母—— Frederico 和 Tania ——被謀殺了。我不知道為什麼有人會想傷害他們。」男孩哽咽地說出這些話。突然間，他被悲傷淹沒，無法再說下去了。

en_text: "I have returned to be vith Margareta and Jergi to grieve for my parents. They did not approve of my joining The Fellowship but I know that they vere concerned out of their love for me, just as I loved them."
zh_text: 「我回來和 Margareta 及 Jergi 在一起，為我的父母哀悼。他們不贊成我加入友誼會，但我知道他們是出於對我的愛才關心我的，就像我愛他們一樣。」

en_text: You see a young gypsy lad. He is wearing a Fellowship medallion. His eyes look down and his expression is one of extreme sorrow.
zh_text: 你看到一個年輕的吉普賽小夥子。他戴著一個友誼會的護身符。他垂著眼，表情極度悲傷。

en_text: Sasha looks up. "Good day to thee,
zh_text: Sasha 抬起頭。「祝你有個美好的一天，

en_text: "I am too young to have a job. I am a gypsy as my parents vere gypsies. I am also a member of The Fellowship."
zh_text: 「我太年輕了，還不能工作。我是個吉普賽人，因為我的父母也是吉普賽人。我也是友誼會的成員。」

en_text: "It happened at the sawmill in Minoc."
zh_text: 「這發生在 Minoc 的鋸木廠。」

en_text: "For the past veek I have been avay from home doing vork for The Fellowship."
zh_text: 「在過去的一個星期裡，我一直離家為友誼會工作。」

en_text: "She is very vise and knows many things but vhen I asked her if I should go back to The Fellowship or stay with them she did not answer me."
zh_text: 「她非常聰明，知道很多事情，但是當我問她我應該回到友誼會還是留下來和他們在一起時，她沒有回答我。」

en_text: "He vas my father's brother. He is a good man and vise. Now he is the leader of our people. He vill do what is right for us."
zh_text: 「他是我父親的兄弟。他是個好人，也很聰明。現在他是我們人民的領袖。他會做對我們有益的事。」

en_text: The lad stoically nods and turns away.*
zh_text: 小夥子堅忍地點點頭，轉身離開。*

en_text: "I shudder to think such foul deeds are so freely committed in our fair town. Art thou investigating it? I wish thee all success in tracking the culprit. I barely knew Frederico or Tania, but I did meet their son Sasha once."
zh_text: 「一想到在我們美麗的城鎮裡竟會如此輕易地發生這種卑劣的行為，我就不寒而慄。你正在調查這件事嗎？我祝你在追查犯人時一切順利。我幾乎不認識 Frederico 或 Tania ，但我確實見過他們的兒子 Sasha 一次。」

en_text: "There is active commerce here in Minoc sufficient to keep the Artist's Guild financially solvent. But in recent weeks I have come to fear we may not keep it going for very much longer. Unlike The Fellowship or Owen's monument, we do not have much political power. Now other events make our troubles seem less important."
zh_text: 「 Minoc 這裡活躍的商業足以讓藝術家公會在財務上保持償付能力。但在最近幾個星期裡，我開始擔心我們可能撐不了多久。不像友誼會或是 Owen 的紀念碑，我們沒有太大的政治權力。現在發生的其他事件讓我們的麻煩顯得不那麼重要了。」

en_text: "Surely thou hast heard about the murders of Frederico and Tania?!"
zh_text: 「你肯定聽說過 Frederico 和 Tania 的謀殺案了吧？！」

en_text: "Owen the shipwright is commissioning a statue of himself to be built in the center of town. The Artist's Guild decided to have nothing to do with this foolishness, of course. But just the word of this statue has spread and now orders are coming in from all over Britannia. Merchants want to have a ship built by the 'famous' Owen, master shipwright of Minoc."
zh_text: 「造船匠 Owen 正委託人在城鎮中心建造一座他自己的雕像。藝術家公會當然決定與這種愚蠢的行為毫無牽扯。但光是這座雕像的消息傳開，現在訂單就從不列顛尼亞各地湧來。商人們希望由『著名的』 Minoc 造船大師 Owen 來建造船隻。」

en_text: You see a handsome craftsman with an intense, piercing gaze.
zh_text: 你看到一位英俊的工匠，有著強烈、敏銳的目光。

en_text: Gladstone shakes your hand and you can feel just a trace of sculptor's clay clinging to his palm. Although he hardly knows you, he treats you like an old friend.
zh_text: Gladstone 和你握手，你能感覺到他的手掌上還沾著一絲雕塑用的黏土。雖然他幾乎不認識你，但他把你當老朋友一樣對待。

en_text: "I am a glassblower and a sculptor. I make mostly bottles and bowls. But in my time I have constructed all manners of statuary out of glass as well."
zh_text: 「我是一名吹玻璃工和雕塑家。我主要製作瓶子和碗。但在過去，我也用玻璃製作過各種雕像。」

en_text: The man's eyes study you for a moment. "Thou dost not know what has happened? William, our local Sawyer found two gypsies murdered in his sawmill."
zh_text: 男人的眼睛打量了你一會兒。「你不知道發生了什麼事嗎？我們當地的鋸木工 William 在他的鋸木廠裡發現兩個吉普賽人被謀殺了。」

en_text: "The Artist's Guild is taxed mercilessly by the Britannian Tax Council. Even in our best year it is a struggle to make ends meet. It seems that we are not considered important enough to be given an even chance."
zh_text: 「藝術家公會被不列顛尼亞稅務委員會無情地徵稅。即使在我們情況最好的一年，要維持收支平衡也是一場掙扎。看來我們並沒有被認為重要到能獲得公平的機會。」

en_text: "The Artist's Guild is a group of local craftsmen. We sell our wares here in Minoc. While we are organized as a guild of equal members, I am tentatively the Guild head."
zh_text: 「藝術家公會是一群當地工匠的組織。我們在 Minoc 這裡販賣我們的商品。雖然我們是一個由平等成員組成的公會，但我暫時擔任公會的會長。」

en_text: "He befriended Seara and stayed the night with us once. He seemed like a nice young man, but misguided."
zh_text: 「他與 Seara 交了朋友，並在我們這裡住過一晚。他似乎是個不錯的年輕人，但誤入歧途了。」

en_text: "We do not get along very well with those people. I believe we have been unofficially marked as enemies of The Fellowship ever since all of the members of the Artist's Guild refused Elynor's invitation to join. They dislike us because they consider us to be indisposed toward Unity."
zh_text: 「我們和那些人相處得不是很好。我相信自從藝術家公會的所有成員都拒絕 Elynor 的入會邀請後，我們就已經被非正式地標記為友誼會的敵人了。他們不喜歡我們，因為他們認為我們無意於團結。」

en_text: "Dost thou think of us as thine enemy?"
"Then I shall give thee the benefit of the doubt for now. But know that I do what I must to protect our Guild."
zh_text: 「那麼我暫且相信你。但要知道，為了保護我們的公會，我必須做我該做的事。」

en_text: "Oh, yes, that reminds me! I cannot speak for long, I'm afraid. There is, after all, that barren slab in the center of town with nothing for it now. The Mayor has commissioned us to create something to fill the empty space. I don't want to say anything about it other than it's going to be wonderful. It will not be ready for quite a while but once it is, I hope thou wilt be able to return to Minoc then and see it. In better times perhaps. Farewell, then."*
zh_text: 「哦，對了，這提醒了我！恐怕我不能聊太久。畢竟，城鎮中心有一塊空蕩蕩的石板，現在上面什麼也沒有。鎮長委託我們創作一些東西來填補那個空白。除了這會是非常棒的作品之外，我不想多說什麼。還需要相當長的一段時間才能準備好，但一旦完成，我希望你那時候能回到 Minoc 來看看它。也許在更好的時機。那麼，再會了。」*

en_text: "I fear we have grievously miscalculated by thinking that if we boycotted the statue, it would not be built. It seems all the talk of it has made Owen into some sort of bizarre legend around this area, and the bloody statue hasn't even gone up yet! But that, I fear, is not the worst of the situation."
zh_text: 「我擔心我們嚴重地失算了，以為如果我們抵制這座雕像，它就不會被建造。似乎所有的談論已經把 Owen 變成了這個地區某種奇怪的傳奇人物，而那該死的雕像甚至還沒立起來呢！但我擔心，這還不是情況最糟糕的部分。」

en_text: "Once the statue is built, orders for ship-building are bound to increase even more! It won't take long before all local commerce will become affected by it. Owen will be purchasing more of the local resources, which will cause prices to rise, especially at the sawmill, and that will surely force the Artist's Guild into bankruptcy."
zh_text: 「一旦雕像建成，造船的訂單肯定會增加得更多！用不了多久，所有當地的商業都會受到影響。 Owen 將會購買更多當地資源，這會導致價格上漲，特別是在鋸木廠，而那肯定會迫使藝術家公會破產。」

en_text: "I regret that I do not have any of my work for sale at present. Like our other artists I have a backlog of orders that will keep me busy for the foreseeable future. But there are several examples of my work, of which I am most proud, in the Guild Hall on display. If thou art interested, please have a look at them."
zh_text: 「我很遺憾目前沒有任何作品可供出售。就像我們其他的藝術家一樣，我積壓了許多訂單，在可預見的未來裡我都會很忙碌。但在公會大廳裡展出著幾件我最引以為傲的作品。如果你有興趣，請去看看。」

en_text: "It is so terrible! I never knew Frederico or Tania personally, but I did meet their son, Sasha, once. He was a nice boy, if somewhat misguided. He spent the night with us once at the Artist's Guild, as a guest of Seara."
zh_text: 「這太可怕了！我個人並不認識 Frederico 或 Tania ，但我確實見過他們的兒子 Sasha 一次。他是個好男孩，如果沒有誤入歧途的話。他曾作為 Seara 的客人，在我們藝術家公會住過一晚。」

en_text: "Yes, she's quite a recruiter. Why, she got Burnside, our Mayor, to join, as well as Gregor, the local head of the Britannian Mining Company, and Owen, our shipwright. He is soon to be famous, I am sorry to say. She has never asked me to join, thank goodness."
zh_text: 「是的，她很擅長招募。怎麼說呢，她讓我們的鎮長 Burnside 加入了，還有不列顛尼亞礦業公司當地負責人 Gregor ，以及我們的造船匠 Owen 。很遺憾地說，他很快就會出名了。謝天謝地，她從來沒邀請過我加入。」

en_text: Xanthia looks shocked. "How horrible! I swear I do not know how it could have gotten there! Thou shouldst certainly ask Elynor about it!"
zh_text: Xanthia 看起來很震驚。「太可怕了！我發誓我不知道它是怎麼到那裡的！你一定要去問 Elynor 這件事！」

en_text: "They are to build a monument to Owen for some reason or another. Owen and Elynor refuse to use anyone from the Guild to help build it! Rather rude of them, dost thou not think?"
zh_text: 「他們出於某種原因要為 Owen 建造一座紀念碑。 Owen 和 Elynor 拒絕使用公會的任何人來幫忙建造它！他們相當無禮，你不覺得嗎？」

en_text: You see a cheerful woman with bright eyes and blonde hair.
zh_text: 你看到一位開朗的女人，有著明亮的眼睛和金色的頭髮。

en_text: "I am a member of the Artist's Guild in Minoc. I make and sell candelabras."
zh_text: 「我是 Minoc 藝術家公會的成員。我製作並販售燭台。」

en_text: "If thou wouldst not mind, we can perhaps get to know each other during a more sociable occasion! Two people have been recently murdered over at William's sawmill! This is hardly the time to get to know someone!"
zh_text: 「如果你不介意的話，也許我們可以在更有交際氣氛的場合互相認識！最近有兩個人在 William 的鋸木廠被謀殺了！這可不是認識新朋友的時候！」

en_text: "We are a guild of artists and craftspeople united for the common good and dedicated to the advancement of the arts, as well as showing other artists that it is possible to exist solely by thine own efforts without sacrificing thy creativity."
zh_text: 「我們是一個由藝術家和工匠組成的公會，為了共同利益而團結一致，致力於藝術的發展，並向其他藝術家展示，完全靠自己的努力生存而不犧牲創造力是可能的。」

en_text: "I make simple candelabras, but sometimes I will do commissioned work, making more specific ones. I was hired by The Fellowship to make the candelabras for all of their Fellowship halls."
zh_text: 「我製作簡單的燭台，但有時我也會接委託工作，製作更特別的款式。我受僱於友誼會，為他們所有的友誼會大廳製作燭台。」

en_text: "Elynor, the head of the local Fellowship branch, showed me a picture of the Fellowship symbol and I based the design for my candelabra on that."
zh_text: 「當地友誼會分會的負責人 Elynor 給我看了一張友誼會標誌的圖片，我就是根據那個來設計我的燭台。」

en_text: You describe the candelabra found at the murder scene to Xanthia. Her eyes widen with recognition. "Yes, that is one of the candelabras I made. 'Twas in the sawmill at the murder site?"
zh_text: 你向 Xanthia 描述在謀殺現場發現的燭台。她認了出來，睜大了眼睛。「是的，那是我做的其中一個燭台。它在謀殺現場的鋸木廠裡？」

en_text: She gives you a slightly cross look. "Well, I hope that thou didst not steal it from Elynor."
zh_text: 她略帶怒意地看了你一眼。「好吧，我希望你不是從 Elynor 那裡偷來的。」

en_text: "With the success of the mine, Minoc is a prosperous city. Not a place where one is used to having murders happen. A good place for our Artist's Guild to do well. But things have always been hard for us here. Now I fear they may get worse."
zh_text: 「隨著礦業的成功， Minoc 是個繁榮的城市。不是一個人們習慣發生謀殺案的地方。是個很適合我們藝術家公會發展的好地方。但我們這裡的情況一直很艱難。現在我擔心情況可能會變得更糟。」

en_text: "That is what Gladstone says. Thou hadst better ask him about it."
zh_text: 「這就是 Gladstone 說的。你最好去問他這件事。」

en_text: . I hope I was of some assistance to thee."*
You present the Caddellite to Zorn. "This is amazing! Why I thought that the only place to find Caddellite was the lost island of Ambrosia. What should I make with this?"
zh_text: 你將 Caddellite 交給 Zorn 。「這太驚人了！我還以為唯一能找到 Caddellite 的地方是失落的 Ambrosia 島呢。我該用這個做什麼？」

en_text: Zorn takes the Caddellite from you and begins his work.
zh_text: Zorn 從你手中接過 Caddellite 並開始他的工作。

en_text: Zorn takes the Caddellite from you and begins his work. You watch in fascination as the master blacksmith softens the ore in the fire, then molds it into	shape. Zorn quickly takes the necessary measurements, then makes some adjustments with the hot material. Finally, it is done.
zh_text: Zorn 從你手中接過 Caddellite 並開始工作。你著迷地看著這位鐵匠大師在火中軟化礦石，然後將其塑形。 Zorn 迅速地進行了必要的測量，然後用熱材料進行了一些調整。最後，完成了。

en_text: You see a man whose long hours of difficult, smouldering work have frozen his face into a rigid expression with eyes like hot coals.
zh_text: 你看到一個男人，長時間悶熱而艱苦的工作讓他的臉凝固成僵硬的表情，眼睛像熾熱的煤炭。

en_text: "How may I serve thee?" says Zorn.
"Dost thou have no respect for the dead? Indeed, trying to solicit at a terrible time like this! When people have been found murdered over at William's sawmill!"
zh_text: 「你對死者難道沒有一點尊重嗎？竟然在這樣糟糕的時刻來拉客！這時可是有人被發現死在 William 的鋸木廠裡！」

en_text: "Minoc is quite a city. Money changes hands here. But it does not keep people happy. They find something to squabble over. And now these terrible murders have everyone afraid."
zh_text: 「 Minoc 是個大城市。金錢在這裡易手。但它並不能讓人們快樂。他們總能找到爭吵的理由。而現在這些可怕的謀殺案讓每個人都感到害怕。」

en_text: "All of the weapons and armour I sell are made by mine own hand. They would serve thee well."
zh_text: 「我賣的所有武器和護甲都是我親手製作的。它們會很好地為你效勞。」

en_text: "Perhaps we could speak more of these things another time. Say, perhaps during the business hours of my shop?"
zh_text: 「也許我們可以改天再談論這些事情。比如說，也許在我的商店營業時間裡？」

en_text: "The smithy is currently closed for outside business. Thou shalt have to return some other time."
zh_text: 「鐵匠鋪目前不對外營業。你得改天再來。」

en_text: "I have an assortment of very lethal weapons to show thee."
zh_text: 「我有很多非常致命的武器可以給你看。」

en_text: "The smithy is currently closed for outside business. Thou shalt have to return some other time."
zh_text: 「鐵匠鋪目前不對外營業。你得改天再來。」

en_text: "Thou mayest buy fine armour from me."
zh_text: 「你可以向我購買精良的護甲。」

en_text: "This noise over Owen's monument, for instance. People ought to tend to their own business and let others handle their own, foolish or not."
zh_text: 「例如這個關於 Owen 紀念碑的喧鬧聲。人們應該管好自己的事，讓別人去處理他們自己的事，不管那是否愚蠢。」

en_text: "He is our town shipwright. He is a man who has an exceedingly high opinion of himself."
zh_text: 「他是我們鎮上的造船匠。他是個極度自負的人。」

en_text: "Owen is building a monument to himself. It is forty feet tall, depicting him holding up a roll of plans. Pigeons will have a place to sit, forevermore. Why argue over something as unimportant as that?"
zh_text: 「 Owen 正在為自己建造一座紀念碑。它有四十英尺高，描繪他拿著一卷設計圖的樣子。永遠都會有鴿子停在上面了。為什麼要為那麼不重要的事情爭吵呢？」

en_text: "No one in this town ever really hated the gypsies, at least not that I have ever been aware of. Who could have done such a thing?"
zh_text: 「這個鎮上從來沒有人真正討厭過吉普賽人，至少我從來沒意識到有。誰會做這種事？」

en_text: You describe the sort of helmet that you require, one that can block out the dangerous sound from the cube generator. Zorn nods. "Yes, I can make some for thee. I shall start work immediately."
zh_text: 你描述了你需要的頭盔種類，一種可以阻擋來自方塊產生器危險聲音的頭盔。 Zorn 點點頭。「是的，我可以為你做一些。我會立刻開始工作。」

en_text: "But thou dost not have any Caddellite chunks with which to make helmets!"
zh_text: 「但是你沒有任何可以用來製作頭盔的 Caddellite 礦塊！」

zh_text: Zorn 將頭盔浸入水中冷卻。

en_text: "Here, I have met thy request to thy precise specifications."
zh_text: 「給，我已經按照你精確的要求完成了委託。」

en_text: "It is horrible. Frederico and Tania were looking for their son, Sasha. He had run away to join the Fellowship. How could this have happened to them?" Seara slowly shakes his head.
zh_text: 「這太可怕了。 Frederico 和 Tania 當時正在尋找他們的兒子 Sasha 。他離家出走去加入友誼會了。這種事怎麼會發生在他們身上？」Seara 緩緩地搖了搖頭。

en_text: "Yes, we have an Artist's Guild here in Minoc. I am a member. The other members are Xanthia and Gladstone. Thou canst purchase some of the finest crafts available anywhere in Britannia there. I, for example, make clocks."
zh_text: 「是的，我們 Minoc 這裡有一個藝術家公會。我是其中一員。其他成員還有 Xanthia 和 Gladstone 。你可以在那裡買到不列顛尼亞各地能找到的最精美的工藝品。例如我，就是製作時鐘的。」

en_text: "Their camp is just outside of town. There are not too many of them left. I understand that Sasha's aunt, Margareta, is an amazing fortune teller. For a few gold coins, she can tell thee many things that may be very useful to thee."
zh_text: 「他們的營地就在鎮外不遠處。他們剩下的人不多了。我知道 Sasha 的姑姑 Margareta 是個不可思議的占卜師。只要幾枚金幣，她就能告訴你很多可能對你非常有用的事情。」

en_text: You see a handsome, creative-looking young man.
zh_text: 你看到一位英俊、看起來很有創造力的年輕人。

en_text: "I am a member of our local Artist's Guild here in Minoc."
zh_text: 「我是 Minoc 當地藝術家公會的成員。」

en_text: , now is not the time to speak in such a casual way! Why, not far from this very spot there have been not one, but two murders committed!"
zh_text: ，現在可不是用這種隨便的語氣說話的時候！就在離這裡不遠的地方，發生了不只一起，而是兩起謀殺案！」

en_text: "Xanthia is a very talented young woman. She makes very elaborate and distinctive candelabras."
zh_text: 「 Xanthia 是個非常有才華的年輕女子。她製作非常精緻且獨特的燭台。」

en_text: "Gladstone is a sculptor and a glassblower. He also is in charge of most of the business decisions for the Guild."
zh_text: 「 Gladstone 是一位雕塑家兼吹玻璃工。他也負責公會大部分的商業決策。」

en_text: "I make all types of clocks and watches that tell the time reliably to the second. I would be happy to sell thee one but right now I have a two year backlog to fill."
zh_text: 「我製作各種類型的時鐘和手錶，它們能可靠地將時間精確到秒。我很樂意賣給你一個，但現在我積壓了兩年的訂單要趕。」

en_text: "Until the monument was to be built and now these murders I believed this town to be a good place to live."
zh_text: 「在要建造紀念碑以及現在發生這些謀殺案之前，我一直認為這個城鎮是個適合居住的好地方。」

en_text: "I met him a few weeks ago when he came to town looking for the local Fellowship branch. I once let him stay the night at the Guild Hall. He said his father would beat him if he knew he was thinking of joining The Fellowship and I believed him. Sasha's father could be a cruel man. He is basically a good lad, just looking for the truth like a lot of us are. Unfortunately, he is looking in the wrong place."
zh_text: 「幾個星期前，當他來到鎮上尋找當地友誼會分會時，我見過他。我曾讓他在公會大廳住過一晚。他說如果他父親知道他想加入友誼會，就會打他，我相信他的話。 Sasha 的父親可能是個殘酷的人。他基本上是個好小夥子，就像我們很多人一樣，只是在尋找真理。不幸的是，他找錯了地方。」

en_text: "I have not seen or heard of Sasha since we last spoke of him. I do not know if he ever joined The Fellowship."
zh_text: 「自從我們上次談到 Sasha 之後，我就再也沒見過或聽說過他的消息了。我不知道他是否加入了友誼會。」

en_text: "No offense intended to thee, but I do not share thy beliefs. In fact I think few of the members of thy Fellowship are sincere in all their talk of unity, trust and worthiness. But Sasha is old enough to make up his mind for himself, though I regret not sending him home that night."
zh_text: 「無意冒犯，但我不認同你的信仰。事實上，我認為你們友誼會裡很少有成員是真心誠意地談論團結、信任和價值的。不過 Sasha 已經夠大，能自己做決定了，雖然我很後悔那天晚上沒有把他送回家。」

en_text: "No, I am not a member or anything like that, but I have heard the basic speech from Sasha so many times that I have it memorized. I never tried to dissuade him from joining The Fellowship even though I have no belief in it. I think Sasha is old enough to start making his decisions for himself. Now I truly regret not sending him home the moment I saw him."
zh_text: 「不，我不是成員之類的，但我聽 Sasha 說過那麼多次基本教義，我都能背下來了。我從未試圖勸阻他加入友誼會，即使我根本不信那一套。我認為 Sasha 已經大到可以開始為自己做決定了。現在我真的很後悔在看到他的那一刻沒有把他送回家。」

en_text: "That shipwright Owen is a self-righteous fool. His statue will be nothing more than a monument to all the hurtful bad feelings he has caused in this town. I cannot believe that such a meaningless and obvious charade	could jeopardize our Guild's future."
zh_text: 「那個造船匠 Owen 是個自以為是的傻瓜。他的雕像只不過是他為這個城鎮帶來所有傷害與反感的紀念碑而已。我簡直不敢相信，這種毫無意義且明顯的鬧劇，竟然會危及我們公會的未來。」

en_text: "Thou hadst best ask Gladstone about that."
"I am not in the habit of speakin' to strangers but seein' as how thou dost not appear to be very intelligent, I shall humor thee for now. My name is Karl, formerly of Minoc."
zh_text: 「我沒有和陌生人說話的習慣，但看在你似乎不是很聰明的份上，我暫且遷就你一下。我的名字是 Karl ，以前住在 Minoc 。」

en_text: "I confronted Owen with this and he denied that it had anything to do with his workmanship. I returned that night and stole the plans he had drafted, so at least no other ships would ever be built like them again. But it left me so angry at the world that I knew I could not live among people ever again. I went away to live up in the mountains. The only times I ever come back are to fetch a few supplies and maybe have a drink of Rutherford's fine ale once in a while."
zh_text: 「我為這件事和 Owen 對質，但他否認這和他的手藝有任何關係。那天晚上我回去偷了他起草的設計圖，至少這樣就不會再有像那樣的船被建造出來了。但這讓我對這個世界感到非常憤怒，我知道我再也無法在人群中生活了。我離開並去山裡生活。我唯一會回來的時候就是為了拿些補給品，也許偶爾喝一杯 Rutherford 釀的好麥酒。」

en_text: "I still have those plans up in my cabin. Every once in a while I try to figure them out. I suspect no one in town, save for Owen himself, could understand them. Maybe Julia, the tinker, would be able to shed some light on them. But she would never listen to an old mountain man like me."
zh_text: 「我還把那些設計圖留在我的小屋裡。每隔一段時間我就會試著弄懂它們。我懷疑鎮上除了 Owen 本人之外，沒有人能看懂它們。也許修補匠 Julia 能夠看出一點端倪。但她絕對不會聽我這個住在山裡的老頭子的話。」

en_text: You see a mountain man who appears to have been in the wilderness a long time. He gives you a long look, then he snorts and looks away.
zh_text: 你看到一個似乎在荒野中待了很長一段時間的山裡人。他盯著你看了很久，然後哼了一聲，把頭轉開。

en_text: "What dost thou want? Leave me alone!"

?! Firstly, if thou dost wish to offer me employment I have no interest in it. Fourth and lastly, if thou dost wonder why I have no job then stop it right now because it is none of thy business!"*
zh_text: ？！首先，如果你想提供我工作機會，我沒興趣。其次，如果你想因為任何原因僱用我做任何事，那我極度熱烈地拒絕你的提議。第三，如果你想知道我的職業是什麼，別想了，因為我沒有。第四也是最後一點，如果你想知道我為什麼沒有工作，現在就給我打住，因為那不關你的事！」*

en_text: "Do not ask me of Minoc, the filthy little town of Fellowship fools, casual murders and monuments to incompetence. I do not even live here and I would not if thou didst pay me!"
zh_text: 「別問我關於 Minoc 的事，那個充滿友誼會傻瓜、隨機謀殺案和無能紀念碑的骯髒小鎮。我甚至不住在這裡，就算你付錢給我我也不會住！」

en_text: "Hmmph. Why should that be any concern of mine? People kill each other every day. Oh, thou art investigating the crime! Well, do not let me keep thee from it. After thou dost catch the murderer thou canst build a statue of him."
zh_text: 「哼。那干我什麼事？每天都有人互相殘殺。哦，你在調查這起犯罪！好吧，別讓我妨礙你。等你抓到兇手後，你可以為他建個雕像。」

en_text: "Gads! Thou dost want me to join! Away from me, thou dolt!"*
zh_text: 「老天！你想讓我加入！離我遠點，你這笨蛋！」*「我看起來像友誼會的成員嗎？我甚至不知道友誼會是什麼！而且我也不在乎！」*

en_text: "Do I look like a member of The Fellowship to thee? I do not even know what The Fellowship is! And I do not care!"*
zh_text: 「老天！你想讓我加入！離我遠點，你這笨蛋！」*

en_text: "Owen, the shipwright, dost deserve to have a monument built to him. It should be in the shape of a gallows and it should have him hanging from it."*
zh_text: 「我看起來像友誼會的成員嗎？我甚至不知道友誼會是什麼！而且我也不在乎！」*

en_text: "My brother - mine only family in the world - served aboard a ship built by Owen. The ship was one of several that sank three years ago during the first storm it ever encountered. My brother went down with it and was never seen again."
zh_text: 「造船匠 Owen 確實值得為他建造一座紀念碑。它的形狀應該是一座絞刑架，而且還得把他吊在上面。」*

en_text: "Three other ships that were built from Owen's basic designs all sunk within the first year of their launch. Over a dozen lives were lost due to that vainglorious bastard!"
zh_text: 「我的兄弟——我在世上唯一的親人——曾在 Owen 建造的一艘船上服役。那艘船是三年前在遇到第一場風暴時沉沒的幾艘船之一。我的兄弟和船一起沉沒，再也沒有人見過他。」

en_text: "If not for Rutherford's fine ale, there would no purpose to the existence of civilization."
zh_text: 「其他三艘根據 Owen 的基本設計建造的船，都在下水的第一年內沉沒了。有超過十二條生命因為那個虛榮的混蛋而喪生！」

en_text: "Yes I would, Karl! Thou dost have too low opinion of thyself! Raise thy spirits, please!"
zh_text: 「如果不是為了 Rutherford 釀的好麥酒，文明的存在就沒有任何意義了。」

en_text: "Far away from the mire of present day society is where I belong. In the wilderness thou canst know what is what."
zh_text: 「我會聽的， Karl ！你太看輕自己了！請振作起來！」

en_text: "If thou dost want to show Julia the plans, I will give them to thee. They are in my cabin southeast of the BMC office."
zh_text: 「遠離當今社會的泥沼才是我該待的地方。在荒野中，你才能認清事物的本質。」

en_text: "Make up thy mind! Art thou following me or not?! If thou art following me then close thy mouth, move thy feet and let us get on."
zh_text: 「如果你想把設計圖給 Julia 看，我會把它們給你。它們在不列顛尼亞礦業公司辦公室東南方的我的小屋裡。」

en_text: "I know I can be a bear to get along with sometimes. I reckon it is just my nature to be an ornery bastard. But I do appreciate what few friends I have and I know that thou hast been one to me. Take good care of thyself, Avatar."*
zh_text: 「下定決心吧！你到底跟不跟著我？！如果你要跟著我，那就閉上嘴，邁開腳步，我們繼續走。」

en_text: "Cease thy racket then before I lose my temper!"*
zh_text: 「我知道我有時候很難相處。我想這就是我那倔強混蛋的本性吧。但我確實很感激我為數不多的幾個朋友，而且我知道你一直對我很好。好好保重，聖者。」*「在我發脾氣之前，停止你的喧鬧聲吧！」*
「我知道我有時候很難相處。我想這就是我那倔強混蛋的本性吧。但我確實很感激我為數不多的幾個朋友，而且我知道你一直對我很好。好好保重，聖者。」*
「在我發脾氣之前，停止你的喧鬧聲吧！」*

en_text: "The Crown Jewel was in town and left early this morning. It was scheduled to sail for Paws."
zh_text: 「Crown Jewel 曾在鎮上，並於今天清晨離開了。它預定航向 Paws。」

en_text: Owen looks at you and suddenly seems flustered. "Uh, I have no ships for sale presently. I have been working on a few improvements. But if thou wouldst, thou couldst commission me to build one for thee. A deed to one of the ships I build costs 1000 gold coins. Dost thou wish to buy one?"
zh_text: Owen 看著你，突然顯得有些慌亂。「呃，我目前沒有船可以賣。我正在進行一些改進。但如果你願意，你可以委託我為你建造一艘。我建造的一艘船的船契要價 1000 枚金幣。你想買一艘嗎？」

en_text: "Apparently, building the greatest ships to ever set sail in history and all that that has done for Minoc are no longer enough! No! Thanks to that pompous idiot of a mayor I am denied the rightful tribute of which I have proven myself more than worthy. Design flaws, bah! How many ships has Mayor Burnside built in his miserable little life?!"
zh_text: 「顯然，建造史上最偉大的航行船隻以及為 Minoc 所做的一切已經不夠了！不！多虧了那個自大白痴的鎮長，我被剝奪了理應屬於我的致敬，我早就證明我完全受之無愧。設計缺陷，呸！Burnside 鎮長在他那悲慘的一生中到底造過幾艘船？！」

en_text: "I have heard nothing more of the Crown Jewel since we last spoke of it,

en_text: Owen will not interrupt his participation in The Fellowship meeting to talk with you.*
zh_text: 「我參加友誼會集會遲到了！我現在不能和你說話！」*

en_text: "I am late for The Fellowship Meeting! I cannot speak with thee now!"*
zh_text: 你看到一位穿著昂貴外衣的年輕男子。他非常嚴肅。

en_text: You see a young man dressed in an expensive tunic. He is very serious.
zh_text: Owen 看著你並哼了一聲。「看來你又想和我說話了。」

en_text: Owen looks at you and sniffs. "It would appear thou dost wish to speak with me again."

zh_text: 他直視你的眼睛，毫無謙虛地說。「我是，」他說，「Minoc 歷史上最偉大的造船匠。我是有史以來最偉大的造船匠！」

en_text: He looks you in the eye and speaks without the slightest trace of modesty. "I am," he says, "the greatest shipwright in the history of Minoc. I am the greatest shipwright who has ever lived!"
zh_text: 「在辛勞多年試圖為這個忘恩負義的小鎮做點什麼之後，我放棄了。我發誓我這輩子再也不會造船了。這會給他們一個教訓！不管他們怎麼乞求或懇求，我都不會做的。」

en_text: "After years of breaking my back trying to make something of this ungrateful little town, I'm giving up. I swear I will never build another ship as long as I live. That will teach them! No matter how they may beg or plead, I will not do it."
zh_text: 「好吧，我當然會原諒你粗劣的舉止，因為我知道能見到我你一定覺得很榮幸。但你必須知道，剛才在鋸木廠發現了兩個人，他們被謀殺了！」

en_text: "Well, I shall certainly forgive thy poor manners for I know how privileged thou must feel for meeting me, but thou must know that two people have just been discovered in the sawmill, having been murdered!"
zh_text: 「你知道我是怎麼變成這樣的嗎？我告訴你！我開始聽到腦海裡有一個聲音！喔，我知道你會覺得我瘋了……」

en_text: "And dost thou know how I became that way? I shall tell thee! I started to hear a voice in mine head! Oh, I know that thou shalt think me mad..."
zh_text: 「這些聲音不是我認識的任何人的。但這些聲音仍然對我有深遠的影響……」

en_text: "These were not the voices of anyone I have ever known. But still these voices had a profound effect on me..."
zh_text: 「在尋找這聲音的意義時——這很困難，因為你怎麼能告訴別人，尤其是一個陌生人，你腦海裡聽到聲音呢——我遇見了友誼會。他們教導我那聲音是什麼。」

en_text: "After searching for a meaning to this voice - which proved difficult, for how dost thou tell someone, especially a stranger, that thou art hearing a voice in thine head - I came across The Fellowship. They taught me what the voice was."
zh_text: 「這是我腦海中的理智之聲，試圖引導我的人生走向正確的方向。友誼會教我如何信任這個聲音並傾聽它所說的。你可以在我的生活中看到結果！我掌握了我的技藝，並透過我設計的方法推進了造船技術。」

en_text: "This was the voice of reason within mine own mind which sought to guide my life in its proper direction. The Fellowship taught me how to trust this voice and heed what it says. And thou canst see the results in mine own life! I have mastered my craft and advanced the techniques of ship-building through the methods I have devised."
zh_text: 「你會發現這筆錢花得很值得的！我會立刻開始工作。我將根據我最近的一些設計來建造。我會提前把船契給你。」

en_text: "'Tis money well spent, thou shalt see! I shall begin work immediately. I will be building based upon some of my more recent designs. I shall give thee thy ship's deed in advance"

zh_text: 「我很想把船契給你，但你帶了太多東西了。」

en_text: "I would give thee thy deed but thou art carrying too much."
zh_text: 「把你的金幣拿回去吧！我不能昧著良心留下它！」

en_text: "Take thy gold back! I cannot in good conscious keep it!"
zh_text: 「我很想把金幣還給你，但我似乎忘記放哪了。」

en_text: "I would give thee thy gold back but I seem to have misplaced it."

zh_text: 「為什麼呢，我有一次和這個 Hook 打了一架。我很幸運，只失去了一條右臂，還留下一隻好眼睛。差不多就是那時候，我開始重新考慮我當海盜的職涯，然後現在我就在這裡了。」「我最近沒見過他，但對謀殺現場的描述聽起來絕對是他的傑作！」

en_text: "I know him! He be a pirate who lives in Buccaneer's Den. They say Hook is so mean he'd kill his own mudder for the right price, an' I would wager they's right.
zh_text: 「我認識他！他是個住在海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)的海盜。他們說 Hook 很卑鄙，只要價錢對，他連自己的親娘都會殺，我打賭他們是對的。

en_text: "Why, I got into a fight with this Hook once. I was lucky and I escaped losin' only my right arm and still with one good eye left. It was somewhere around that time that I started having second thoughts about my career as a pirate and now here I be.
zh_text: 「為什麼呢，我有一次和這個 Hook 打了一架。我很幸運，只失去了一條右臂，還留下一隻好眼睛。差不多就是那時候，我開始重新考慮我當海盜的職涯，然後現在我就在這裡了。」

en_text: You see a weary-looking man who is missing his right arm. With his one hand he scratches his head and squints in your general direction.
zh_text: 你看到一個神情疲憊、失去右臂的男人。他用單手抓了抓頭，朝你的方向瞇起眼睛。

en_text: He lets out a sharp cough to clear his throat. "Rutherford's me name. Pleased ta meet 'chur."
zh_text: 他發出一聲尖銳的咳嗽來清喉嚨。「我的名字是 Rutherford。很高興認識你。」

en_text: He extends his greasy hand for you to shake and does not retract it until it is clasped.
zh_text: 他伸出油膩的手要和你握手，直到你握住他才縮回。

en_text: He coughs into the rag he had just been using to polish the bar.
zh_text: 他對著剛才用來擦拭吧檯的抹布咳嗽。

en_text: "Hello again, Sir Dupre! Didst thou enjoy mine establishment so much that thou hast returned?"*
zh_text: 「又見面了，Dupre 爵士！你這麼喜歡我的店，所以又回來了嗎？」*

en_text: "'Tis no time for idle chatter! There have been two people murdered over at William's sawmill!"
zh_text: 「現在可不是閒聊的時候！William 的鋸木廠有兩個人被謀殺了！」

en_text: "We have a cornucopian variety of elixirs to quench thy tongue and gourmet dishes to appease thy palate."
zh_text: 「我們有各種豐富的靈藥可以為你解渴，還有美食可以滿足你的味蕾。」

en_text: "As I have finished my workday, I ask thee to come back another time. Thou dost have my thanks."
zh_text: 「因為我今天的工作已經結束了，請你下次再來吧。非常感謝你。」

en_text: "A room for the night is quite reasonable. Only 8 gold per person. Want one?"
zh_text: 「住一晚的房間非常合理。每人只要 8 枚金幣。要一間嗎？」

en_text: "Thou art carrying too much to take the room key,
zh_text: 「你帶太多東西了，拿不了房間鑰匙，

en_text: "Here is thy room key. It is good only until thou dost leave."
zh_text: 「這是你的房間鑰匙。這只在你離開前有效。」

en_text: "Thou dost not have enough gold, eh? That be right bad."
zh_text: 「你沒有足夠的金幣，是吧？那可真糟糕。」

en_text: "If thou wouldst please make thy request at a time that was during my normal business hours, I would be most grateful."
zh_text: 「如果你能在我的正常營業時間內提出請求，我會非常感激的。」

en_text: "Yep, this town's usually bloody quiet. That was until recently!" His squinting eye suddenly opens wide and stares straight at you.
zh_text: 「是的，這城鎮通常非常安靜。直到最近！」他瞇著的眼睛突然睜大，直直地盯著你。

en_text: "Say, when exackly again didst thou say thou didst arrive in town, stranger?"
zh_text: 「話說，陌生人，你剛才是說你什麼時候抵達鎮上的？」

en_text: After a moment of carefully observing you, he shrugs his shoulders and goes back to wiping off the bar.
zh_text: 在仔細觀察了你一會兒之後，他聳了聳肩，又回去擦拭吧檯了。

en_text: "Before all this evil at the sawmill, the buzz were all about the monument."
zh_text: 「在鋸木廠發生這些邪惡的事情之前，大家都在談論紀念碑。」

en_text: "Well, I suppose that clears thee from the list o' possible murderers. If'n thou wert the murderer, thou wouldst not have to be askin' questions o'people about wha' 'appened regardin' the murders. Thou wouldst already know, havin' been there."
zh_text: 「好吧，我想這就排除了你是可能兇手的嫌疑。如果你是兇手，你就不必到處問人關於謀殺案發生了什麼事。你早就在那裡，早就知道了。」

en_text: "Say, thou be not from around here?" He looks at you skeptically. "Thou art not from the Fellowship by any chance, art thou?"
zh_text: 「喂，你不是本地人吧？」他懷疑地看著你。「你該不會是友誼會的人吧？」

en_text: "Just askin'! Thou dost not have to take any offense!"
zh_text: 「只是問問！你不需要覺得被冒犯！」

en_text: "I have not seen him recently, but the description of the murder scene certainly sounds like his handiwork!"
zh_text: 「我最近沒見過他，但對謀殺現場的描述聽起來絕對是他的傑作！」

en_text: "That ship was, indeed, here of late. In fact, 'twas the night of the murders! Could there be a connection? Hmmm..."
zh_text: 「那艘船最近的確在這裡。事實上，就是謀殺案發生的那晚！這之間會有什麼關聯嗎？嗯……」

en_text: "Thank goodness that with all the town at each others' throats in recent weeks we have the Fellowship tryin' to hold the town together. I be no member or nothin', but I just a'heared of all the good things they done. Feedin' the poor an' such."
zh_text: 「謝天謝地，最近這幾週整個鎮上的人都吵得不可開交，還好有友誼會試圖把城鎮團結起來。我不是成員什麼的，但我聽說了他們做的所有好事。像是救濟窮人等等。」

en_text: "Oh, thou must mean thet statuer they are goin' ta build of our shipwright. His name is Owen, a local boy. I understan' it is to be as tall as a man on horseback and shows Owen gazin' through a telerscope or some such thing like that."
zh_text: 「喔，你一定是指他們要為我們的造船匠建造的那座雕像。他叫 Owen，是個本地男孩。我聽說它會有一個騎在馬上的人那麼高，並且展示 Owen 透過望遠鏡凝視之類的樣子。」

en_text: "I shall see thee later... At least I will if thou dost stay in the front o' me good eye."*
zh_text: 「晚點見……至少如果你待在我好的這隻眼睛前面，我就看得到你。」*

en_text: "I take the logs that are made from all the trees that are cut down by the logger in Yew, and cut them into planks in the local sawmill. Then I sell the planks - mostly to Owen the shipwright, and some to the Artist's Guild as well."
zh_text: 「我接收在 Yew 被伐木工砍下所有樹木製成的圓木，然後在當地的鋸木廠將它們切成木板。接著我出售木板——大部分賣給造船匠 Owen，也賣一些給藝術家公會。」
「聖者！怎麼了？為什麼你又想和我說話？現在又出什麼事了？！」William 說。

en_text: "I must not stop to speak with thee now! I am late for the Fellowship meeting at the hall!"*
zh_text: 「我現在不能停下來跟你說話！我去大廳參加友誼會集會已經遲到了！」*

en_text: You see a man with a very worried look on his face.
zh_text: 你看到一個臉上帶著非常擔憂神情的男人。

en_text: "Avatar! What is it? Why dost thou want to talk to me again? What is wrong now?!" says William.
"I work in the sawmill here in Minoc."
zh_text: 「我在 Minoc 這裡的鋸木廠工作。」

en_text: "What a ludicrous question at a time like this! Why, I have just been given the fright of my life when I entered my sawmill and saw those two who have not only been killed quite dead, but torn apart nearly beyond recognition!"
zh_text: 「在這種時候問這個問題真是太荒謬了！天啊，當我走進我的鋸木廠，看到那兩個人不僅死透了，還被撕裂得幾乎無法辨認時，我簡直嚇得魂飛魄散！」

en_text: "It was such a quiet town until these murders happened. I cannot believe it."
zh_text: 「在這些謀殺案發生之前，這是一個如此安靜的城鎮。我無法相信。」

en_text: "I found the bodies first thing this morning when I went to open the sawmill. It took all of the discipline I have gained from the Triad of Inner Strength and the teachings of The Fellowship to keep from going mad at the sight of it. It must have happened sometime last night but I swear to thee I never heard a thing!"
zh_text: 「今天早上，我一開鋸木廠的門就發現了屍體！靠著從內在力量的三位一體，和友誼會教誨中獲得的所有自律，我當下才沒發瘋。這件事一定發生在昨晚某個時候，但我向你發誓，我什麼都沒聽到！」

en_text: "I swear by The Fellowship I have already told thee all I know concerning the murders!"
zh_text: 「我以友誼會的名義發誓，我已經把我知道關於謀殺案的一切都告訴你了！」

en_text: "I have been a member of The Fellowship for only a short time. I have only of late begun attending Elynor's meetings. Only since they announced the monument was to be built."
zh_text: 「我成為友誼會成員的時間還不長。我最近才開始參加 Elynor 的集會。就在他們宣布要建造紀念碑之後。」

en_text: "I am so glad thou art my brother in The Fellowship; I know I may trust thee. It is all of the others in this town that I worry about."
zh_text: 「我真高興你是我在友誼會裡的兄弟；我知道我可以信任你。我擔心的是這鎮上的其他人。」

en_text: "Wouldst thou like to know more of The Fellowship?"
zh_text: 「你想多了解一些友誼會的事嗎？」

en_text: "Trust me, thou canst not possibly understand how cruel and terrible life can be! Thou dost need The Fellowship! I am lucky to have found it in time to face mine own moment of truth! I hope thou dost realize that thou dost need The Fellowship before it is too late!"
zh_text: 「相信我，你不可能了解生活有多麼殘酷和可怕！你需要友誼會！我很幸運能及時找到它來面對我自己的關鍵時刻！我希望你能在太遲之前意識到你需要友誼會！」

en_text: "Thou dost know! The monument of Owen the shipwright standing on the bow of a tall ship. Everyone in town doth know of it!"
zh_text: 「你知道的！造船匠 Owen 站在高大船首上的紀念碑。鎮上每個人都知道！」

en_text: As soon as he has dismissed you, the overwrought William hides his face in his hands.*
zh_text: 一旦他打發了你，過度勞累的 William 隨即用雙手掩面。*

en_text: "I am a teacher in Minoc, along with Jakher."
zh_text: 「我是 Minoc 的教師，和 Jakher 一起。」

en_text: "Minoc was usually busy, but quiet. Then our town was bothered by this nonsense over Owen's monument, and now these murders."
zh_text: 「Minoc 通常很忙碌，但很安靜。然後我們的城鎮就被 Owen 紀念碑這些無稽之談給困擾，現在又發生了這些謀殺案。」

en_text: "Frederico, the leader of the Gypsies, and his wife, Tania, were good people. Why, the worst thing I ever knew either of them to do was a simple prank."
zh_text: 「吉普賽人的首領 Frederico 和他妻子 Tania 都是好人。哎，我所知道他們做過最糟糕的事，也不過是個簡單的惡作劇罷了。」

en_text: You see a stealthy-looking woman, dressed all in green. There is a wicked grin on her face.
zh_text: 你看到一個神情鬼祟的女人，全身穿著綠色。她臉上帶著邪惡的笑容。

en_text: "How good to see thee again," says Karenna.
"I answer to Karenna, and to nothing else."
zh_text: 「我只回應 Karenna 這個名字，其他一概不理。」

en_text: "An odd question to ask at such a time as this,
zh_text: 「在這種時候問這個問題真是奇怪，

en_text: . Dost thou know that two people lie dead in that sawmill and they are dead from the hand of perpetrator or perpetrators unknown?"
zh_text: 。你知道有兩個人死在那座鋸木廠裡，而且他們死於身分不明的兇手或兇手們的手中嗎？」

en_text: "Shocking! Such things do not normally happen here. It well proves the value of knowing how to defend oneself."
zh_text: 「令人震驚！這種事通常不會發生在這裡。這充分證明了懂得如何自衛的價值。」

en_text: "He is quite an able trainer in his own right. Not as skilled as myself, obviously. But I do think he is cute, though I bid thee, do not tell him that I spoke of this. It will only encourage him."
zh_text: 「他本身是個相當能幹的訓練師。當然沒有我這麼熟練。但我確實覺得他很可愛，不過我求你，別告訴他我說過這事。那只會助長他的氣焰。」

en_text: "Art thou speaking about me? Mine ears are burning!"*
zh_text: 「你是在說我嗎？我的耳朵在發燙呢！」*

en_text: "Nothing thou shouldst be concerned about, Jakher." She winks at you.*
zh_text: 「沒什麼你需要擔心的事，Jakher。」她對你眨了眨眼。*

en_text: "I teach that singular skill which enables one to learn all the lessons of life without losing it in the process. Combat!
zh_text: 「我教授那種能讓人在過程中不致喪命、從而學習所有人生課題的奇特技能。戰鬥！

en_text: "I would charge thee 20 gold for each training session. Art thou still interested?"
zh_text: 「我每次訓練將向你收取 20 枚金幣。你還有興趣嗎？」

en_text: "Very well. If thou art fortunate thou wilt not have cause to regret it."
zh_text: 「很好。如果你運氣好，你將不會有後悔的理由。」

en_text: "Our establishment is now closed. Please come by during business hours."
zh_text: 「我們的店現在已經打烊了。請在營業時間過來。」

en_text: "I understand it is to be thirty feet high and will display our local shipwright as he holds aloft a sextant. Thou wouldst not believe a thing as benign as this could create such trouble."
zh_text: 「我聽說它會有三十英尺高，並展示我們當地的造船匠高舉六分儀的樣子。你不會相信這麼無害的東西竟然能惹出這麼大麻煩。」

en_text: "It would seem the increase in hostilities amongst the fair citizenry over our shipwright's monument has filled much of the local populace with a burning desire to acquire combative skills. Business has never been better!"
zh_text: 「看來良好市民之間對我們造船匠紀念碑日益增加的敵意，讓許多當地民眾充滿了學習戰鬥技能的強烈渴望。生意從來沒這麼好過！」

en_text: "Everyone in town is all up in arms about this and that. But surely others would know more of these local politics. I care not."
zh_text: 「鎮上每個人都為了這事那事大動肝火。但其他人肯定比我更了解這些地方政治。我才不在乎。」

en_text: "Jakher told thee he doth find me attractive? He denies it, of course, but I have known for years that he doth have feelings for me."
zh_text: 「Jakher 告訴你他覺得我有魅力？他當然否認，但我很多年前就知道他對我有感覺。」

en_text: "Nothing, Jakher. Go away." She giggles conspiratorally at you.*
zh_text: 「沒事，Jakher。走開。」她對你發出心照不宣的咯咯笑聲。*

en_text: "Once Frederico threw a rock through the window of the local Fellowship branch... Oh, well, I thought it was amusing!"
zh_text: 「有一次 Frederico 丟石頭砸破了當地友誼會分會的窗戶……喔，好吧，我覺得那滿有趣的！」

en_text: "Farewell. May all thy journeys be interesting ones."*
zh_text: 「再會。願你所有的旅程都充滿樂趣。」*

en_text: "I am Jakher, named after a great general from the ancient times of Sosaria. Welcome to Minoc."
zh_text: 「我是 Jakher，以 Sosaria 古代一位偉大將軍的名字命名。歡迎來到 Minoc。」

en_text: "I have known Owen as long as anyone in this town. Several years ago, three ships that he built sank. The brother of Karl, one of our more colorful local residents, was killed. No investigation was ever made into the cause of the sinkings, but Owen once confided to me that he secretly blamed himself. He started drinking heavily, and eventually took up with The Fellowship."
zh_text: 「我和鎮上任何人一樣，認識 Owen 很久了。幾年前，他建造的三艘船沉沒了。我們當地一位較有特色居民 Karl 的兄弟被殺了。從未對沉船原因進行過調查，但 Owen 曾向我吐露，他暗地裡責怪自己。他開始酗酒，最終加入了友誼會。」

en_text: You see a stern but friendly-looking man, dressed in a military fashion. As you watch him, you get the feeling he is sizing you up as well.
zh_text: 你看到一個嚴厲但看起來很友善的男人，穿著軍裝。當你看著他時，你會覺得他也在打量你。

en_text: "How may I be of service to thee?" says Jakher.
zh_text: 「我有什麼可以為你效勞的嗎？」Jakher 說。

en_text: "Along with Karenna, I am a trainer in the fighting arts. My specialty is strength and strategy. On the field of battle, if one does not use his head while using one's muscles, he is in danger of losing it."
zh_text: 「和 Karenna 一樣，我也是戰鬥技藝的訓練師。我的專長是力量與策略。在戰場上，如果一個人在使用肌肉的同時不用腦子，他就有掉腦袋的危險。」

en_text: "Perhaps that is something of which we should speak in a more appropriate time. Right now our concern should be to discover who could have been responsible for the two murders	that have just been discovered in William's sawmill."
zh_text: 「也許這是我們應該在更合適的時間談論的事情。現在我們應該關心的是，找出是誰對剛在 William 鋸木廠發現的兩起謀殺案負責。」

en_text: "My price is 20 gold for each training session. Art thou still interested?"
zh_text: 「我的收費是每次訓練 20 枚金幣。你還有興趣嗎？」

en_text: "The true value of what I teach is beyond measure. My time is precious to me and therefore valuable. If thou didst pay me a paltry sum and I trained thee anyway, it would be an insult to us both."'Tis a pity few truly comprehend the value of strategy and tactics. Thou mayest hack and slash with thy sword all that thou wilt, but it cannot do thy thinking for thee."
zh_text: 「我所教導的真正價值是無法估量的。我的時間對我來說很寶貴，因此很有價值。如果你付給我微不足道的錢，而我依然訓練你，那對我們雙方都是一種侮辱。「可惜很少有人真正理解策略和戰術的價值。你可以盡情地用劍揮砍，但它無法代替你思考。」

en_text: "The true value of what I teach is beyond measure. My time is precious to me and therefore valuable. If thou didst pay me a paltry sum and I trained thee anyway, it would be an insult to us both.
zh_text: 「我所教導的真正價值是無法估量的。我的時間對我來說很寶貴，因此很有價值。如果你付給我微不足道的錢，而我依然訓練你，那對我們雙方都是一種侮辱。

en_text: "'Tis a pity few truly comprehend the value of strategy and tactics. Thou mayest hack and slash with thy sword all that thou wilt, but it cannot do thy thinking for thee."
zh_text: 「可惜很少有人真正理解策略和戰術的價值。你可以盡情地用劍揮砍，但它無法代替你思考。」

en_text: "I am not in the habit of running training sessions at this particular time."
zh_text: 「我沒有在這個特定時間進行訓練的習慣。」

en_text: "Ours is a city of commerce, although lately its primary trade seems to be gossip and envy. Before these murders, the latest local scandal had been the statue to be built of Owen, the shipwright."
zh_text: 「我們的城市是一個商業城市，儘管最近它的主要交易似乎是八卦和嫉妒。在這些謀殺案發生之前，當地最新的醜聞是即將為造船匠 Owen 建造的雕像。」

en_text: "I suspect the killer -- or killers -- are from out of town, and probably long gone by now. There has not been a local murder for	some time before today. Our fair measure of prosperity has made the people here mostly tolerant of each other. That is why the gypsies settled here. The apparent lack of motive is puzzling."
zh_text: 「我懷疑兇手——或者兇手們——是從外地來的，而且現在可能早就離開了。在今天之前，這裡已經有一段時間沒有發生過謀殺案了。我們相當程度的繁榮使得這裡的人們大多能互相包容。這就是吉普賽人定居在這裡的原因。顯然缺乏動機這一點令人費解。」

en_text: "I doubt that anyone in our community is the killer. If the stranger, or strangers, involved were to remain for long after the crime, they would soon be revealed. Therefore,the killers are no longer in town."
zh_text: 「我懷疑我們社區裡有人是兇手。如果涉案的陌生人，在犯案後繼續逗留很長時間，他們很快就會暴露。因此，兇手已經不在鎮上了。」

en_text: "A skillful and fierce battler, but a bit short-sighted when it comes to tactics, I'm afraid. Still, a woman as attractive as	she is diverting enough when encountered. But do not mention to her that I said that. It would just encourage her. It is uncomfortable enough sharing the same roof with her as it is."
zh_text: 「一個技巧嫻熟且兇猛的戰士，但恐怕在戰術方面有點短視。儘管如此，像她這樣有吸引力的女人，在遇到時也足夠有趣了。但別告訴她我這麼說過。這只會鼓勵她。現在和她同住一個屋簷下已經夠不自在了。」

en_text: "What art thou whispering about over there?"*
"Nothing! Nothing at all!" Jakher winks at you.*
zh_text: 「沒什麼！什麼都沒有！」Jakher 對你眨了眨眼。*

en_text: "She is the sort of person who labors under the belief that all problems can be solved in one of three ways. Hit them harder. Hit them faster. Or, hit them some more."
zh_text: 「她是那種堅信所有問題都可以用三種方法之一解決的人。打得更用力。打得更快。或者，打得更多。」

en_text: "Art thou talking about me? I feel mine ears burning!"*
zh_text: 「你是在說我嗎？我感覺我的耳朵在發燙！」*

en_text: "Thou art dreaming, Karenna. Why would I talk about thee?" He giggles conspiratorially at you.*
zh_text: 「你在作夢，Karenna。我為什麼要談論你？」他對著你神秘地竊笑。*

en_text: "There used to be two training halls in Minoc but one of them burned down after being struck by lightning. Now we are both forced to share this one."
zh_text: 「Minoc 以前有兩個訓練館，但其中一個被閃電擊中後燒毀了。現在我們兩人都被迫共用這一個。」

en_text: "Ah, so Karenna said I was cute, did she? Yes, I have known she has had her sights set on me for years."
zh_text: 「啊，所以 Karenna 說我很可愛，是嗎？是的，我知道她看上我很多年了。」

en_text: "Thou wouldst do better to ask Karenna. She is a good friend of the gypsies and would know more about them than I."
zh_text: 「你最好去問 Karenna。她是吉普賽人的好朋友，會比我更了解他們。」

en_text: "It has been a pleasure speaking with thee."*

"Frederico vas mine only brother, and no vone loved Tania more than I did, save for Frederico himself. Vhat happened to them vas unspeakable. I vish I could tell thee more. If thou vishest thou may speak to Sasha, but only briefly. Now is the time for him to mourn."
zh_text: 「Frederico 是我唯一的兄弟，除了 Frederico 本人之外，沒有人比我更愛 Tania。發生在他們身上的事令人難以啟齒。我希望我能告訴你更多。如果你願意，你可以和 Sasha 談談，但只能簡短地談。現在是他哀悼的時候。」

en_text: "He is the son ov Frederico and Tania. He left us to learn more about The Fellowship. Ov course, he feels responsible for vhat happened..."
zh_text: 「他是 Frederico 和 Tania 的兒子。他為了解更多關於友誼會的事，離開我們了。當然，他對發生的事情感到自責……」

en_text: You see a swarthy gypsy with soulful eyes, dressed in colorful clothes. He looks as if he has the weight of the world on his shoulders.
zh_text: 你看到一個有著深情雙眼、膚色黝黑的吉普賽人，穿著色彩鮮豔的衣服。他看起來彷彿把整個世界的重擔都扛在肩上。

en_text: "Greetings vonce again," Jergi says as he bows, making a swirling gesture with his hand.
zh_text: 「再次問候你，」Jergi 說著鞠了個躬，用手做了一個旋轉的姿勢。

en_text: "I am Jergi. Pleased to make thine acqvaintance."
"I am the King ov the Gypsies."
"My people have almost completely died out in this vorld. Now that I am their leader I am making their velfare my sole responsibility. Soon I vill decide if ve vill leave Minoc."
zh_text: 「我的人民在這個世界上，幾乎已經完全滅絕了。既然…我是他們的領袖，我必將他們的福祉，視為我唯一的責任。很快，將決定我們是否要離開 Minoc。」

en_text: "Ve gypsies are a people who live to vander. But there are fewer and fewer places vhere ve are velcome. Ve are victimized by the ancient hatreds that have plagued our kind since the days ov ancient Sosaria."
zh_text: 「我們吉普賽人是為了流浪而生的民族。但…歡迎我們的地方越來越少了。我們是自古 Sosaria 時代以來，一直困擾我們族群的古老仇恨的受害者。」

en_text: "Our people came here because ve thought ve vould be accepted. It seemed for a very long time that ve vere. But after these savage murders it looks like it is time for us to roam vonce again."
zh_text: 「我們以為會被接受，所以來到這裡。而且，很長一段時間以來，似乎的確如此。但…這起野蠻的謀殺案發生之後，看起來…是我們再次流浪的時候了。」

en_text: "Ve have alvays been subject to the prejudices ov others! Ve are called thieves and vorse! But ve are a people that only vish to play our music, and dance, and live in peace. I thought the people here understood this."
zh_text: 「我們總是受到他人的偏見！我們被稱為小偷或更糟的稱呼！但我們是一個只希望演奏音樂、跳舞、並和平生活的民族。我以為這裡的人理解這一點。」

en_text: "Some thought ov my brother Frederico as a harsh man, but those ov us who knew him could see that he vas simply governed by the same prides and passions that rule all gypsies."
zh_text: 「有些人覺得…我的兄弟 Frederico 是個嚴苛無情的人，但咱們這幫懂他的人都瞧得明白——他呀，不過就是被那股支配著全天下吉普賽人的驕傲與激情給推著走罷了。」

en_text: "She vas the most beautiful voman I had ever seen. Both my brother and I vere in love vith her. Ve both tried to vin her heart. I failed and thought that I vould spend the rest ov my life vith no vone. It vas not until last year that my vife Margareta and I vere married and my secretly broken heart vas mended."
zh_text: 「她是我見過最美麗的女人。我兄弟和我兩人都愛上了她。我們都試圖贏得她的芳心。我失敗了，並以為我會在孤獨中度過餘生。直到去年，我的妻子 Margareta 和我結婚，我暗自破碎的心才得以修復。」

en_text: "Ve do not blame Sasha for vhat happened. Ve vill not punish him."
zh_text: 「我們不怪 Sasha 發生了什麼事。我們不會懲罰他。」

en_text: "Sasha vill have to decide if he vants to stay vith his people or return to The Fellowship. I believe he vill make the right choice."
zh_text: 「Sasha 必須決定他是想留在他的族人身邊，還是回到友誼會。我相信他會做出正確的選擇。」

en_text: "My vife is a vise voman who has some ov the necessary talents to see the future. Thou shouldst speak vith her."
zh_text: 「我的妻子是個有智慧的女人，她有一些預見未來的天賦。你應該跟她談談。」

en_text: "I do not know vhat thou art talking about. I know nothing of a mage named Nicodemus, nor of his hourglass. Be vary -- mages are quite mad these days!"
zh_text: 「我不知道你在說什麼。我對一位名叫 Nicodemus 的法師，或是他的沙漏一無所知。要小心——這些天法師們都相當瘋狂！」

en_text: "Mayest thou have much fortune in thine endeavors."*

"Currently most of the miners are away as the machines are being repaired. Right now we have two engineers, Owings and Malloy, down in a branch of the main tunnel. Do not disturb them, for they are involved in a special project. We also have a gargoyle, Fodus, who is helping to maintain a semblance of the mine's usual operations."
zh_text: 「因為機器正在維修，目前大部分的礦工都不在。現在我們有兩位工程師 Owings 和 Malloy 在主隧道的一個分支裡。別打擾他們，因為他們正在進行一個特殊專案。我們還有一個石像鬼 Fodus ，他在幫忙維持礦場通常運作的樣子。」

en_text: You repeat the words to Mikos that you heard Fodus say. Mikos gives you a shocked look. "I have no idea what he is talking about, but I would say it is typical for a gargoyle. Just trying to shirk of his duty. Say, thou hadst better leave this place if thou ist spending all thy time disrupting the work of the mine!"*
zh_text: 你向 Mikos 複述了你聽到 Fodus 說的話。 Mikos 露出震驚的表情。「我完全不知道他在說什麼，但我只能說這是石像鬼的典型行為。只是想逃避責任而已。聽著，如果你把時間都花在擾亂礦場工作上，那你最好離開這個地方！」*
Mikos 在友誼會的集會中陷入冥想，沒有聽到你的聲音。*

en_text: Mikos is lost in meditation at the Fellowship meeting and does not hear you.*
zh_text: Mikos 在友誼會的集會中陷入冥想，沒有聽到你的聲音。*「我必須趕去參加友誼會集會！我們下次再聊！」*

en_text: "I must run to the Fellowship meeting! I shall speak with thee another time!"*
zh_text: 「我必須趕去參加友誼會集會！我們下次再聊！」*

en_text: A sneering man watches as you approach. His eyes shift back and forth suspiciously.
zh_text: 一個面帶冷笑的男人看著你靠近。他懷疑地東張西望。

en_text: Mikos heaves his shoulders and sighs. "What dost thou want this time?"
zh_text: Mikos 聳了聳肩，嘆了口氣。「你這次又想要什麼？」

en_text: "I am the foreman of the Minoc mine."
He spits on the ground. "A pox on them! Down here I am safe from all of their arguing. Next, they will be killing each other."

"This mine is run by the Britannian Mining Company. It is inside what was once the dungeon Covetous. They mine for iron ore, lead and other minerals with highly trained miners and special mining machinery."
zh_text: 他往地上吐了口口水。「去他們的！在這裡我很安全，遠離他們所有的爭吵。接下來，他們就要互相殘殺了。」

en_text: "This place is full of machinery that is very dangerous if thou dost not know what thou art doing. Thou dost not wish to see what one of those digging contraptions can do to a man if he gets too close!"
zh_text: 「這座礦場由不列顛尼亞礦業公司經營。它位於曾經是 Covetous 地城的地方。他們使用訓練有素的礦工和特殊的採礦設備來開採鐵礦石、鉛和其他礦物。」

en_text: Mikos shakes his head slowly. "I am not sure where the Britannian Mining Company found them."
zh_text: 「這地方充滿了非常危險的機器，如果你不知道自己在做什麼的話。你絕對不想看到如果有人靠得太近，那些挖掘裝置會對他造成什麼下場！」
Mikos 緩緩地搖了搖頭。「我不知道不列顛尼亞礦業公司是從哪裡找到他們的。」
這個像猿猴般的雌性顯得很緊張。
這個雌性森靈顯得很緊張。

en_text: Saralek greets you. "Hello is said to you, human."
zh_text: Saralek 向你打招呼。「向你說聲哈囉，人類。」

en_text: She shies away for a moment, and then cautiously steps forward. "I am called Saralek."
zh_text: 她退縮了一會兒，然後小心翼翼地走上前。「我被稱為 Saralek 。」

en_text: "`Job' is not understood. Family is what you mean?"
zh_text: 「『職業』不被理解。你是指家人嗎？」

en_text: "Yes, I am part of a family. The Silverleaf tree is my home. I am bonded with Trellek."
zh_text: 「是的，我是一個家庭的一份子。銀葉樹是我的家。我與 Trellek 結為伴侶。」

en_text: "Trellek has been met by you?" She smiles proudly, and takes another step forward. "What was said by him?"
zh_text: 「你見過 Trellek 了？」她驕傲地微笑著，又往前邁進了一步。「他說了什麼？」

en_text: "There are fewer and fewer Silverleaf trees. Many are cut down often. Soon, no Silverleaf trees will be around for our homes."
zh_text: 「銀葉樹越來越少了。很多樹經常被砍伐。很快地，我們的家園就不會再有銀葉樹了。」

en_text: "The trees are cut by a human with a shiny, sharp item."
zh_text: 「這些樹被一個拿著閃亮、鋒利物品的人類砍倒了。」

en_text: "Permission from Salamon must be gained first. Then permission from me will be granted. Your return to me is necessary for that."
zh_text: 「必須先獲得 Salamon 的允許。然後我才會給予許可。為此你需要再回到我這裡。」

en_text: "That is good!" She seems very happy and relieved.
zh_text: 「太好了！」她看起來非常高興且鬆了一口氣。

en_text: "She is a very wise Emp. Many humans have been met by her. Knowledge and experience are her talents."
zh_text: 「她是一位非常充滿智慧的森靈。她見過很多人類。知識和經驗是她的天賦。」

en_text: Her eyes begin to mist over.
zh_text: 她的雙眼開始泛起淚光。

en_text: "I am sorry. A lie was told by me. Trellek's leaving is not desired by me. Permission will not be given."
zh_text: 「對不起。我撒了個謊。我並不希望 Trellek 離開。我不會給予許可。」

en_text: "What is the reason you asked him?"
"An idea how you can be helped by Trellek is had by me. Wisps are contacted by Trellek's whistling. A whistle for you can be made by him, perhaps. Talking with him again should be your next action."
zh_text: 「我有個關於 Trellek 能如何幫助你的主意。 Trellek 的口哨聲可以和鬼火聯繫。或許他可以為你做一個哨子。你接下來應該再去和他談談。」

en_text: You see a wingless gargoyle with a terrible skin disease. It looks as if his face is falling off in patches.
zh_text: 你看到一隻沒有翅膀的石像鬼，患有可怕的皮膚病。看起來他的臉似乎正一塊塊地掉下來。

en_text: "To be a digger in the mines. To be looking for iron ore and lead and..."
zh_text: 「是礦場裡的挖掘工。正在尋找鐵礦石和鉛，還有……」

en_text: "The secret ore..."A wave of delirium passes over the gargoyle. "To... to be going back to work now, Mikos!... To be working hard!... To have no need to give me any more of the the silver fluid..."
zh_text: 「祕密的礦石……」一陣譫妄襲過這隻石像鬼。「現……現在回去工作，Mikos！……要努力工作！……不需要再給我銀色液體了……」

en_text: A wave of delirium passes over the gargoyle. "To... to be going back to work now, Mikos!... To be working hard!... To have no need to give me any more of the the silver fluid..."
zh_text: 一陣譫妄襲過這隻石像鬼。「現……現在回去工作，Mikos！……要努力工作！……不需要再給我銀色液體了……」

en_text: "To be the lode located in a hidden area of the mine..." The gargoyle's eyes roll up into his head. He is obviously sick.
zh_text: 「是位於礦場隱藏區域的礦脈……」石像鬼翻了個白眼。他顯然病得不輕。

en_text: "To need the venom... to have more venom..."
"To be going back to work now, Mikos..."*
The ape-like creature in front of you approaches very cautiously.  After a few minutes of staring you up and down, it cocks its head toward you.
zh_text: 你面前這個像猿猴般的生物非常謹慎地靠近。在上下打量你幾分鐘後，他對你歪了歪頭。

en_text: The Emp in front of you approaches very cautiously. After a few minutes of staring you up and down, he cocks his head towards you.
zh_text: 你面前這個森靈非常謹慎地靠近。在上下打量你幾分鐘後，他對你歪了歪頭。

en_text: "You are greeted by me, human." Tavenor slowly approaches.
zh_text: 「我向你問候，人類。」 Tavenor 緩慢地靠近。

en_text: "No job is had by me. Food is gathered by me and my family."
zh_text: 「我沒有職業。我和我的家人負責收集食物。」

en_text: "`Job' now understood by me. No job is had by me. Food is gathered by me and my family." He watches you carefully. "Your job is to cut down Silverleaf trees, yes?"
zh_text: 「我現在理解『職業』了。我沒有職業。我和我的家人負責收集食物。」他仔細地觀察你。「你的職業是砍伐銀葉樹，對吧？」

en_text: "The truth is known to me, but, belief is hard for me."
zh_text: 「我明白這是真相，但，我很難相信。」

en_text: "The truth is spoken by the human," Trellek says to the other Emp. "He is to be trusted. His good will was felt by me."*
zh_text: 「這個人類說的是實話，」 Trellek 對另一個森靈說。「他是值得信任的。我能感受到他的善意。」*

en_text: The Emp nods at Trellek, and then turns to you. "The truth is now clear to me. You are wished good luck."
zh_text: 這個森靈對 Trellek 點點頭，然後轉向你。「我現在清楚真相了。祝你好運。」

en_text: The Emp eyes you a little longer. "Your good intentions are known to    me. You are asked to be the messenger. Humans will not be destroyers, please."
zh_text: 這個森靈又多看了你一會兒。「我知道你的好意。請你做個傳信人。人類請不要成為破壞者。」

en_text: "Fruit and milk are Emp foods. Especially fruits are liked by me. Meats," he shakes his head,
zh_text: 「水果和牛奶是森靈的食物。我特別喜歡水果。肉類，」他搖搖頭，

en_text: "Milk is good. Milk with honey is preferred by me."
zh_text: 「牛奶很好。我比較喜歡加了蜂蜜的牛奶。」

en_text: "Meats are from killed animals. Killing is bad. Destroying is bad."
zh_text: 「肉類來自被殺死的動物。殺戮是不好的。破壞是不好的。」

en_text: "Fruits are good and sweet -- like honey!"
zh_text: 「水果很好吃而且很甜——就像蜂蜜一樣！」

en_text: "Honey is favorite food of all Emps!"
zh_text: 「蜂蜜是所有森靈最喜歡的食物！」

en_text: You see a wizened female ape-like creature.
zh_text: 你看到一隻乾癟的雌性猿猴般生物。

en_text: You see a wizened female Emp.
zh_text: 你看到一隻乾癟的雌性森靈。

en_text: "I am without job. All Emps are without jobs. Food gathering and shelter-building are Emp jobs."
zh_text: 「我沒有職業。所有森靈都沒有職業。收集食物和建造庇護所就是森靈的工作。」

en_text: She gives you a hard look.
"Silverleaf trees are where Emp's homes can be found."
zh_text: 「銀葉樹是能找到森靈家園的地方。」

en_text: "Only fruits, vegetables, and milk-stuffs are eaten by Emps. Bread is also eaten."
zh_text: 「森靈只吃水果、蔬菜和乳製品。也會吃麵包。」

en_text: "Milk and cheese and butter are milk-stuffs."
zh_text: 「牛奶、起司和奶油都是乳製品。」

en_text: "Bread is hard to make for Emps. No stoves or ovens are owned by Emps. But bread is well liked."
zh_text: 「森靈很難製作麵包。森靈沒有爐子或烤箱。但麵包很受歡迎。」

en_text: "Fruits and vegetables are our favorites. Many are sweet."
zh_text: 「水果和蔬菜是我們的最愛。很多都是甜的。」

en_text: "Sweet things are desired by Emps. Honey is sweetest! More honey is had by you?"
zh_text: 「甜食是森靈所渴望的。蜂蜜是最甜的！你還有更多的蜂蜜嗎？」

en_text: Her eyes widen and her lips part around a very large and hopeful smile.
zh_text: 她睜大雙眼，嘴唇微張，露出一個非常燦爛且充滿希望的微笑。

en_text: "More honey will be given by you?"
"You are thanked," she says, taking the honey.
"A mean trick was played by you," she says, frowning.
zh_text: 「你開了個卑劣的玩笑，」她皺著眉頭說。她似乎很驚訝，但很快就恢復了。
「我理解你的感受，」她嘆了口氣。

en_text: She seems surprised, but quickly recovers.
zh_text: 「你開了個卑劣的玩笑，」她皺著眉頭說。

en_text: "Your feelings are understood by me," she sighs.

zh_text: 她似乎很驚訝，但很快就恢復了。
「我理解你的感受，」她嘆了口氣。

en_text: "No dead animal flesh -- what is called `meat' by humans -- is eaten by an Emp."
zh_text: 她嘆了口氣，明顯感到失望。

en_text: "Meat is without a good taste," she shudders. "It is not preferred!"
zh_text: 「森靈不吃死去的動物屍肉——也就是人類所謂的『肉』。」

zh_text: 「肉沒有好味道，」她渾身發抖。「這不是我們的偏好！」

en_text: "The signed contract must be seen by me."

"Trellek is another Emp. He should be spoken to by you.

en_text: "There is much damage to the forest and the Silverleaf trees. The damage is caused by your people, human. The responsibility to reverse the damage is also yours, human.
"Trellek should be sought by you," she says emphatically. "He should be asked to join you."

zh_text: 幫我個忙，聖者先生。修好那該死的以太，好嗎？做到了我就能給你的玻璃沙漏 (glourblass) 附魔。我是說麵粉沙漏 (floursass) 。我是說沙漏 (hourglass) 。把這告訴你的『時間領主』。你還可以告訴他，他需要洗個澡了。」

en_text: "Potions? What makes thee think I have potions? Art thou sure thou dost not want Lotions? I certainly have lotions! Otions, slotions, motions, votions! Ha ha ha! Wait! Oh, yes! zh_text: 「藥水 (Potions) ？你怎麼會覺得我有藥水？你確定你不想要乳液 (Lotions) ？我絕對有乳液！ Otions, slotions, motions, votions ！哈 哈 哈！等等！喔，對了！我確實有藥水！我告訴過你的，不是嗎！讓我們看看……我這裡有這瓶黑色的藥水。我不太確定它具體的作用，但我很確定它能讓人隱形。

en_text: "That is a very good question. Some days I can actually remember. Let's see... today... Yes! I am Nicodemus! Nicodomus! Nicodimus! Nico-nico-kukodamus! Ha ha ha!"
zh_text: 「這是一個非常好的問題。有些日子我真的能記得。讓我想想……今天……對！我是 Nicodemus ！ Nicodomus ！ Nicodimus ！ Nico-nico-kukodamus ！哈 哈 哈！」

en_text: "What's this? An hourglass of some kind? Wait! It looks vaguely familiar! Thief!! This is mine hourglass! I have been looking for it for years! Where didst thou get it, scoundrel? I shall turn thee into a duck!"
zh_text: 「這是什麼？某種沙漏？等等！它看起來有點眼熟！小偷！！這是我的沙漏！我找它找了好幾年了！你從哪裡弄來的，無賴？我要把你變成一隻鴨子！」

en_text: Nicodemus intones some spell and points at you, but nothing happens.
zh_text: Nicodemus 念了個法術並指著你，但什麼事也沒發生。

en_text: "Zounds! Thou art no more a quacker than I am. Nothing works anymore. Quacker slacker wacker flacker! Ha ha ha!"
zh_text: 「天啊！你跟我一樣不是隻會嘎嘎叫的鴨子。什麼都沒用了。嘎嘎 懶鬼 哇哇 飛飛！ (Quacker slacker wacker flacker!) 哈 哈 哈！」

en_text: "This Time Lord told thee what? An hourglass! I have no blinking hourglass! Glassy wassy hoursplassy! Ha ha ha! Wait! An enchanted hourglass? That does ring a bell. Clang Clang Clang! I suppose if the ether is repaired, I could possibly re-enchant it. Bring it to me and we'll see what we can do. I know! We can play a rousing game of chess! But only if I can deal at all times. zh_text: 「這個時間領主告訴你什麼？一個沙漏！我沒有什麼見鬼的沙漏！玻璃-玻璃 沙漏-沙漏！ (Glassy wassy hoursplassy!) 哈 哈 哈！等等！一個附魔的沙漏？這聽起來很耳熟。叮叮噹噹！哈 哈 哈！等等！我記得了。我以前有一個沙漏。我把它賣了。賣給了一個吉普賽人。還是一個古董商？我想我可能把它賣給了不列顛城的一個吉普賽古董商。或是 Paws 。在那片土地上的某個地方。但如果我沒記錯的話，那個沙漏的魔力已經用光了，這就是我賣掉它的原因。我想如果以太修復了，我或許可以重新給它附魔。把它帶來給我，我們看看能做些什麼。我知道了！我們可以來一場激烈的西洋棋！但前提是必須總是由我發牌。我不信任你。」

en_text: "Who art thou?" Nicodemus asks. "Oh, I remember. Remember demember! Ha ha ha!"
zh_text: 「你是誰？」 Nicodemus 問。「噢，我記得了。記得 (Remember) 皮得 (demember) ！哈 哈 哈！」

en_text: "Timey Limey Lord? Hmmm. I don't know him. Wait! Yes I do. Does he have a big black mustache and three pairs of pants? No! I know who he is. He's the fellow who came to fix my sundial the other day, right?"
zh_text: 「滴答滴答領主 (Timey Limey Lord) ？嗯。我不認識他。等等！對，我認識。他是不是留著黑色大鬍子，還穿著三條褲子？不！我知道他是誰了。他是前幾天來修我日晷的傢伙，對吧？」

en_text: "I thought so! Tell him that bloody thing still doesn't work! It gives me three shadows! Dadows badows whoopeee! Ha ha ha!"
zh_text: 「我就知道！告訴他那該死的東西還是壞的！它給了我三個影子！ Dadows badows whoopeee ！哈 哈 哈！」
你的老朋友 Nicodemus 的眼神顯得很遙遠。

en_text: Your old friend Nicodemus has a far away look in his eyes.
"Why, to perform magic! It seems that the disturbance in the ether has been repaired! I can also sell thee some reagents or spells."
zh_text: 「哎呀，為了施展魔法啊！看來以太的干擾已經修復了！我也能賣給你一些秘藥或法術。」

en_text: "Magic? What magic!? All the magic in the world has gone completely topsy-turvy! Oh, blurpsy-flurpsy! Ha ha ha! Those are silly words, are they not? 'Tis a pity they are not magical! Ha ha ha!"
zh_text: 「魔法？什麼魔法！？世界上所有的魔法都已經完全亂套了！喔，糊裡糊塗！哈 哈 哈！這些字很蠢，不是嗎？可惜它們沒有魔力！哈 哈 哈！」

en_text: "The ether is repaired. The mages of the world are indebted to thee."
zh_text: 「以太修復了。全世界的法師都欠你一個人情。」

en_text: "Dost thou wish to buy some spells?"
"Dost thou wish to buy some reagents?"

zh_text: 「你想要它嗎，比方說，75 個金幣？」

zh_text: 「你沒有足夠的空間來攜帶藥水！」

zh_text: 「你想騙我嗎？你沒有足夠的金幣！」

zh_text: 「我好幾個月沒跟時間領主說過話了！那老傢伙好嗎？代我向他問好。告訴他我很想念我們的騎士橋棋遊戲！」

en_text: "'Tis a life-size board game. I have a book around here somewhere which contains the rules."
zh_text: 「這是一種真人大小的棋盤遊戲。我這附近應該有一本書裡面寫著規則。」

en_text: "Mine old hourglass! Of course I remember it! I believe I sold it to an antique dealer in Paws. I might be able to re-enchant it if thou wouldst bring it to me."
zh_text: 「我的舊沙漏！我當然記得它！我相信我把它賣給了 Paws 的一個古董商。如果你能把它帶來給我，我或許可以重新給它附魔。」

en_text: "Mine old hourglass! I suppose I could revitalize the enchantment upon it."
zh_text: 「我的舊沙漏！我想我可以重新恢復它的魔力。」

en_text: "I would be most happy to enchant the hourglass. After freeing the ether, I am most indebted to thee. Let me see it..."

en_text: Nicodemus takes the hourglass and studies it a moment. He sets it on a table and closes his eyes, concentrating. He intones a few words, throws some reagents into the air, and passes his hand over the artifact.
zh_text: Nicodemus 拿過沙漏，研究了一會兒。他把它放在桌上，閉上眼睛集中精神。他念了幾個字，向空中撒了一些秘藥，然後把手拂過這件神器。

en_text: "That should do it." He hands the hourglass back to you.
zh_text: 「這樣應該就行了。」他把沙漏交還給你。

en_text: "Where is it? Thou dost not have the hourglass!"

en_text: Eyeing you carefully, the man before you takes an aggressive stance.
zh_text: 你面前的男人仔細地打量著你，擺出了一個充滿攻擊性的姿勢。

en_text: He stares at you for a moment. "Thad is my name,
zh_text: 他盯著你看了一會兒。「我的名字是 Thad ，

en_text: "Job? I have not the time for a job. I am on a quest to rid this land of that which plagues it!"
zh_text: 「職業？我沒時間做什麼工作。我的使命是為這片土地剷除那些為非作歹的瘟疫！」

en_text: "I have devoted mine entire life to this, nothing will get in my way, not even Batlin."
zh_text: 「我為此奉獻了我的一生，沒有什麼能阻擋我，連巴特林也不能。」

en_text: "He is the leader of the cursed organization, The Fellowship!"
zh_text: 「他是那個被詛咒的組織，友誼會的首領！」

en_text: "Surely thou hast heard of The Fellowship, a most foul and evil organization. It has even infested the lovely forest of Yew!"
zh_text: 「你肯定聽過友誼會，一個最齷齪邪惡的組織。它甚至已經入侵了美麗的 Yew 森林！」

en_text: "I know little about their practices, but I do know they live outside the bounds of moral decency. They have kidnapped my beloved sister, Millie, and have cast a spell of enchantment. Now she lives as they do. I have vowed to remove this wicked spell and will slay the entire organization should that prove necessary!
zh_text: 「我對他們的做法所知甚少，但我知道他們的行為超越了道德倫理的底線。他們綁架了我親愛的妹妹， Millie ，並對她施了某種蠱惑的法術。現在她過著和他們一樣的生活。我發誓要解除這個邪惡的法術，如果有必要，我會殺光整個組織！

en_text: "Thou, also, hast taken up a similar cause, I expect. Yes?"
zh_text: 我想，你也肩負著類似的使命吧。是嗎？」

en_text: "Excellent." He shakes your hand. "Thou art indeed a worthy warrior,
zh_text: 「太好了。」他握了握你的手。「你確實是一位值得尊敬的戰士，

en_text: "I know the land, but not the people. There is nothing useful I have to tell thee." He appears thoughtful for a moment. "Perhaps I can aid thee a bit. I do know that there are two hunters who sometimes frequent this area. One, a woman, carries a spear. The other is an archer. That is all I can tell thee."
zh_text: 「我了解這片土地，但不了解這裡的人。我沒有什麼有用的消息可以告訴你。」他沉思了一會兒。「或許我可以幫你一點忙。我確實知道有兩個獵人有時會出沒在這個區域。其中一個是女人，帶著長矛。另一個是弓箭手。這是我能告訴你的全部了。」

en_text: "The forest attracts a lot of people who want to spend some time away from the larger towns like Minoc and Britain. So they come to Yew.

en_text: "And, something about the woods makes most people want to explore." He pats his bow.
zh_text: 而且，這片森林的某些特質讓大多數人想要探索。」他拍了拍他的弓。

en_text: "That is where this comes in. The bow is the tool of survival in the forest. And I," he jerks his thumb to his chest, "teach proficiency with the bow."
zh_text: 「這就是它派上用場的時候了。弓是森林裡的生存工具。而我，」他用大拇指指著自己的胸口，「負責教導使用弓的技巧。」

en_text: "I love the forest. It is very beautiful. Also," he raises his bow, "I moved out here to be near the two great archers, Iolo and Tseramed."*
zh_text: 「我愛這片森林。它非常美麗。而且，」他舉起弓，「我搬到這裡來是為了靠近兩位偉大的弓箭手， Iolo 和 Tseramed 。」*
