en_text: You see a man leaning on a longbow.
zh_text: 你看到一個男人倚著一把長弓。

en_text: "Why, 'tis my job to train the many who visit Yew to become more agile."
zh_text: 「哎呀，我的工作就是訓練許多來 Yew 的人變得更加敏捷。」

en_text: "There are many exciting things to see in the forest. Not a day goes by when I do not see something interesting: a new type of bird, a beautiful butterfly, or, best of all -- a deer."
zh_text: 「森林裡有許多令人興奮的事物可以看。我每天都會看到有趣的東西：一種新鳥、一隻美麗的蝴蝶，或者最棒的——一隻鹿。」

en_text: "'Tis my weapon of choice. It takes a keen eye and a steady arm to shoot accurately. I think it has more finesse than a sword or a spear, for example."
zh_text: 「這是我首選的武器。它需要敏銳的眼睛和穩定的手臂才能準確射擊。我認為它比劍或長矛等武器更需要技巧。」

en_text: "Thank you for thy kind words, good sir. Perhaps we may practice sometime in the future."*
zh_text: 「謝謝你的讚美，好先生。或許我們未來可以找個時間切磋一下。」*

en_text: "He is a great archer who resides in the forest. He moved here to get away from the far-too-quickly growing towns."
zh_text: 「他是一位居住在森林裡的偉大弓箭手。他搬到這裡來是為了遠離發展過快的城鎮。」

en_text: "If thou wantest to train, my charge is 30 gold. Art thou still interested?"
zh_text: 「如果你想訓練，我的收費是 30 個金幣。你還有興趣嗎？」

en_text: "Thou hast met Penni? I hope thou hast not trained with her," he winks. "She is a valuable friend, but she hunts as well as a weed and she is as clumsy as an ox. I am afraid she knows nothing about fighting."
zh_text: 「你見過 Penni 了？我希望你沒有跟她一起訓練，」他眨了眨眼。「她是一個珍貴的朋友，但她打獵的技術就像根雜草，而且笨拙得像頭牛。我恐怕她對戰鬥一無所知。」

en_text: "Thou, of course, hast never met them," he says, his brow narrowing, "but we have a pirate, and," he pauses, "a troll. If thou dost wish to see them, speak with Goth, the jailer."
zh_text: 「你當然沒見過他們，」他眉頭深鎖，「但我們有一個海盜，還有，」他停頓了一下，「一個巨魔 (troll) 。如果你想見他們，去跟獄卒 Goth 談談。」

en_text: The man greets you with stern, suspicious eyes.
zh_text: 這名男子用嚴厲、懷疑的眼光跟你打招呼。

en_text: "I am the High Court official at the prison here in the Abbey."
zh_text: 「我是這修道院裡監獄的高等法院官員。」

en_text: "I am the judiciary part of Britannia's government. It is my job to see that criminals are brought to justice."
zh_text: 「我是不列顛尼亞官府司法部門的人。我的工作就是確保罪犯受到法律制裁。」

en_text: "We have two prisoners already, but there are many scoundrels who still roam free."
zh_text: 「我們已經有兩名囚犯了，但還有很多無賴逍遙法外。」

en_text: "See for thyself, the posted bills for known villains are in the log book in the courtroom."
zh_text: 「自己去看吧，關於已知惡棍的公告都在法庭的日誌本裡。」

en_text: "He has only been working here for a few weeks, but I already know he is not trustworthy. There is something obviously unscrupulous about him. He is not a friend of thine, is he?"
zh_text: 「他才在這裡工作了幾個星期，但我已經知道他不可靠。他身上明顯有一種肆無忌憚的氣質。他不是你的朋友，對吧？」

en_text: "I suspected as much." He turns away from you.*
zh_text: 「我就知道。」他轉身不看你。*「不是，」他緊緊盯著你說，「他當然不是。」

en_text: "No," he says, watching you closely, "of course he is not."
"The monks live and study there, but they do little more than winemaking. Well, I know one of them tends the garden."
zh_text: 「不是，」他緊緊盯著你說，「他當然不是。」

en_text: "Keep thine heart and mind on the straight path,
zh_text: 「僧侶們在那裡生活和學習，但他們除了釀酒幾乎什麼都不做。嗯，我知道他們其中有一個人在打理花園。」

en_text: "Well, Oi only know a few people 'ere, but Oi'll try an' 'elp as best as Oi am able. 'Oo do ye want to know about? My two best friends are Garth an' Darek, but Oi often talk to Nina an' Bart when Oi get the chance.
zh_text: 「嗯，我只認識這裡的幾個人，但我會盡量幫忙。你想知道誰的事？我最好的兩個朋友是 Garth 和 Darek ，但我一有機會也常跟 Nina 和 Bart 聊天。

en_text: "Recently, that Perrin fellow from across the way 'as been spendin' some toime with me. 'E's a real nice chap. A l'ttle brainy, perhaps,
zh_text: 「最近，對面的那個叫 Perrin 的傢伙花了一些時間跟我在一起。他是個很好的人。或許有點聰明，

en_text: "Well, Oi only know a few people 'ere, but Oi'll try an' 'elp as best as Oi am able. 'Oo do ye want to know about? My two best friends are Garth an' Darek, but Oi often talk to Nina an' Bart when Oi get the chance.
zh_text: 「嗯，我只認識這裡的幾個人，但我會盡量幫忙。你想知道誰的事？我最好的兩個朋友是 Garth 和 Darek ，但我一有機會也常跟 Nina 和 Bart 聊天。

en_text: You see an unkempt, yet dapper man talking to himself.
zh_text: 你看到一個不修邊幅卻又有些衣冠楚楚的男人在自言自語。

en_text: "Eh, 'ow's that? Oh, m'job. Why, Oi take good care o' me buddies in the graveyard 'ere in Empath Abbey, Oi do."
zh_text: 「呃，那又怎樣？喔，我的工作。哎呀，我好好照顧著這人神修道院墓園裡的朋友們，真的。」

en_text: "What do ye mean did Oi 'umpeth Abby. 'Course Oi didn't. Oi never went anywhere near Abby. 'Oo told ye that?"
zh_text: 「你說我『對 Abby 發情』是什麼意思。我當然沒有。我從來沒靠近過 Abby 。誰告訴你的？」
「人神修道院？哎呀，這裡就是人神修道院啊，

en_text: . Oi don't mean to pry, but if ye knowest not where ye be, why 'ave ye come 'ere?" He shakes his head. "It's just as Oi was tellin' Darek the other day, `If ye never want to be lost,' Oi said, `don't ever go nowheres.'"
zh_text: 。我無意打聽，但如果你不知道自己在哪裡，你幹嘛來這？」他搖搖頭。「就像我前幾天跟 Darek 說的，我說『如果你永遠不想迷路，就永遠哪裡都別去。』」

en_text: "What wrong with the bodies? Oi don' do nothing more than bury 'em! A fellow could get in lots o' trouble spreading rumors like that."
zh_text: 「屍體怎麼了？我只不過是把他們埋了而已！像那樣散播謠言會惹上大麻煩的。」

en_text: "Barry? Oh, 'im. Oi don't know what ye's talkin' about. Oi never met Barry's woife! 'Twas just a lie they's spreadin' about me."
zh_text: 「Barry ？喔，他。我不知道你在說什麼。我從來沒見過 Barry 的老婆！那只是他們散播的關於我的謊言。」
「我已經告訴過你那是我的工作了。」

en_text: "That's right. M'buddies! Oi bury 'em. It's m'job." He squints at you. "Unless,
zh_text: 「沒錯。我的朋友們！我埋了他們。這是我的工作。」他瞇著眼看你。「除非，

en_text: "No! Of course Oi don't use peep holes. What sort o' question is that to ask a fellow,
zh_text: 「沒有！我當然沒用偷窺孔。你怎麼會問這種問題，

en_text: "Recently, that Perrin fellow from across the way 'as been spendin' some toime with me. 'E's a real nice chap. A l'ttle brainy, perhaps,
zh_text: 「最近，對面的那個叫 Perrin 的傢伙花了一些時間跟我在一起。他是個很好的人。或許有點聰明，

en_text: , but Oi like 'im just the same. Anyone else ye'd like to know about?"
zh_text: ，但我還是很喜歡他。你還想知道其他誰的事嗎？」

en_text: "Well, that Perrin fellow'd be a better one to ask than Oi'd be,
zh_text: 「嗯，問那個叫 Perrin 的傢伙會比問我好，

en_text: . 'E knows a lot, that one does."
"All right then, glad Oi could introduce ye to a few o' my friends."
zh_text: 「好吧，很高興能介紹幾個朋友給你認識。」

en_text: . 'Ave a pleasant journey. Oi'll tell Malc 'allo for ye."*
zh_text: 。祝你旅途愉快。我會替你向 Malc 問好的。」*

en_text: "I am of the clan Ironheart, the eleventh son of Valador. They call me Iskander."
zh_text: 「我是鐵心氏族 (Ironheart) 的人，是 Valador 的第十一個兒子。他們叫我 Iskander 。」

en_text: "Then they called me 'Wonder Boy'. For nearly a hundred years that was the nickname by which I was known. I was most grateful when they stopped doing that!"
zh_text: 「然後他們叫我『神奇男孩 (Wonder Boy) 』。近一百年來，那都是我的綽號。當他們不再那麼叫我時，我非常感激！」

en_text: "I know that Eiko and Amanda have been after me for some time looking for vengeance. I say let them come. I will not stand still for them nor shall I run from them. When they find me they are welcome to try and take their justice from me. If they win then it was meant to be. If they do not I will have no regrets."
zh_text: 「我知道 Eiko 和 Amanda 一直在追捕我尋求復仇。我說讓她們來吧。我不會站在原地等她們，也不會逃避她們。當她們找到我時，歡迎她們試著從我這裡討回她們的正義。如果她們贏了，那也是命中注定。如果她們輸了，我也沒有遺憾。」

en_text: "My cyclopean people say I am a hero. Many of you humans say I am a monster. No doubt, the truth is somewhere in between."
zh_text: 「我的獨眼巨人族人說我是個英雄。你們許多人類說我是個怪物。毫無疑問，真相介於兩者之間。」

en_text: "One hundred and eighty-nine years ago I slew the seven Gazer Princes when they used their magic to steal the eye from the leader of our tribe, but such things are now ancient history and are no longer of any consequence."
zh_text: 「一百八十九年前，當那七位凝視者 (Gazer) 王子用魔法偷走我們部落首領的眼睛時，我殺了他們，但這些事現在已經是古老的歷史，不再重要了。」

en_text: "On numerous occasions I have caused the unpleasant end of human interlopers who mistakenly believed our race was fit for nothing save to be plundered. But I have no quarrel with thee." He pauses to scrutinize you. "For the moment."
zh_text: 「在無數次的情況下，我讓那些誤以為我們種族只配被掠奪的人類入侵者落得悲慘的下場。但我跟你無冤無仇。」他停下來仔細端詳你。「目前是這樣。」

en_text: "Thou dost know my name, but I still do not know the name of thee. I like to know to whom I am speaking. What is thy name?"
zh_text: 「你知道我的名字，但我還不知道你的名字。我喜歡知道我在跟誰說話。你的名字是什麼？」

en_text: "I have heard of thee, Avatar. Thou hast come into conflict against our kind before, I know. But I have also heard the tales of thine heroic and spiritual quests and I believe thee to be a just and noble man. Thou mayest call me friend."
zh_text: 「我聽過你的事，聖者。我知道你以前曾與我們同類發生過衝突。但我也聽過關於你的英雄事蹟和精神探索的故事，我相信你是一個公正高尚的人。你可以稱我為朋友。」

en_text: "Those of my tribe are a quiet people. They farm the rocky soil, but are also very good tool makers. I was sent to find them a new homeland."
zh_text: 「我部落的人是安靜的人民。他們在岩石土壤上耕作，同時也是非常好的工具製造者。我被派去為他們尋找新的家園。」

en_text: "The eye of a cyclops is considered quite a delicacy to some of the less genteel races of Britannia. Twice have foul creatures tried to take mine, and twice have I dined on their hearts."
zh_text: 「獨眼巨人的眼睛對不列顛尼亞一些不那麼文明的種族來說，被視為一種珍饈。曾經有兩次邪惡的生物試圖奪取我的眼睛，而我也兩次吃了他們的心臟。」

en_text: Iskander squints his eye at you. "Do not start that again!"
zh_text: Iskander 瞇著眼睛看你。「別再提那個了！」

en_text: "My village lies a great many days' journey away. The people there desire a place where they can live in peace with their surroundings. I have not found such a place yet, but I will search everywhere until I do."
zh_text: 「我的村莊在很多天的路程之外。那裡的人們渴望一個能與周遭環境和平共處的地方。我還沒找到這樣的地方，但我會到處尋找，直到我找到為止。」

en_text: "While I am two hundred and six, not long in years for one of my race, I already have the heart of an old man. A hero's adventures have no more attraction for me. I long to settle down with my people and spend my days tending the fields or in my workshop building things."
zh_text: 「雖然我兩百零六歲了，這對我們種族來說並不算老，但我已經有一顆老人的心。英雄的冒險對我已經沒有吸引力了。我渴望和我的族人安定下來，在田裡耕種，或在我的工坊裡製作東西度日。」

en_text: "My searches have brought me to this dreadful place. I incorrectly surmised that since magic does not work it would be relatively safe. It is here that I have been perplexed by a terrible riddle."
zh_text: 「我的尋找把我帶到了這個可怕的地方。我錯誤地以為既然魔法失效了，這裡會相對安全。但在這裡，我被一個可怕的謎團困惑住了。」

en_text: "Standing at the doorway of one room in this place, I saw an enormous image of a tetrahedron. As I tried to near it a wave of amnesia passed over me. Once more I was standing in the doorway. I could remember nothing more."
zh_text: 「站在這個地方其中一個房間的門口，我看到了一個巨大的四面體影像。當我試圖靠近它時，一陣失憶的感覺襲來。我又回到了門口。我什麼都不記得了。」

en_text: "I believe that is word you humans use to describe a polyhedron with four faces."
zh_text: 「我相信那是你們人類用來描述有四個面的多面體的詞。」

en_text: "This same wave of amnesia struck me every time I tried to approach the tetrahedron. I do not know what sort of foul magic this is."
zh_text: 「每次我試圖靠近四面體時，這種失憶的感覺都會襲來。我不知道這是什麼邪惡的魔法。」

en_text: "Now that thou hast destroyed the mysterious tetrahedron I will complete mine exploration of this place. I have a feeling that the homeland I seek is very far away but one never knows where the next clue will be that shall lead me to it."
zh_text: 「既然你已經摧毀了神秘的四面體，我將完成我對這個地方的探索。我有一種感覺，我尋找的家園非常遙遠，但誰知道下一個能指引我找到它的線索會在哪裡呢。」

en_text: "Perhaps thou shalt be able to solve this mystery. I have been unable to as of yet. But I shall remain here until its secret is revealed."
zh_text: 「或許你能解開這個謎團。我到目前為止都無法解開。但我會留在這裡，直到它的秘密被揭開。」

en_text: "I warn thee that this place is not safe. It holds unknown perils. Perhaps thou wouldst do better to leave this place."
zh_text: 「我警告你這個地方不安全。它潛藏著未知的危險。或許你離開這裡會比較好。」

en_text: "Surely, thou dost know that magic no longer functions as it once did. There are those who say that the age of magic is over. If that is so, then I fear that there may be no place left in this world for my people."
zh_text: 「你肯定知道魔法不再像以前那樣有效了。有人說魔法的時代已經結束了。如果是這樣，我擔心這個世界上可能沒有我族人的容身之處了。」

en_text: "Of course, now that thou hast destroyed the tetrahedron all magic has been restored. I congratulate thee for thine heroic deed!"
zh_text: 「當然，既然你已經摧毀了四面體，所有的魔法都已經恢復了。我祝賀你的英雄事蹟！」

en_text: "Yes, I have heard those names before. Those are the names of two warriors who have been after me for revenge. They say I killed their father and I must admit to thee that it is true. I did kill their father."
zh_text: 「是的，我以前聽過這些名字。那是兩名一直追著我尋仇的戰士的名字。她們說我殺了她們的父親，我必須向你承認這是真的。我確實殺了她們的父親。」

en_text: "Their father's name was Kalideth. He suffered from the mage madness. His attack on me was unprovoked. For some reason he blamed the failure of magic upon my people. His own magics were still quite potent and I barely survived the encounter. I killed Kalideth in self-defense, but I did not want to kill him. I wish there to still be some magic left in this world and I mourned his passing as much as anyone."
zh_text: 「她們父親的名字是 Kalideth 。他患有法師的瘋狂症。他對我的攻擊是毫無理由的。出於某種原因，他把我族人歸咎於魔法失效的原因。他自己的魔法依然相當強大，我勉強在戰鬥中活了下來。我出於自衛殺了 Kalideth ，但我並不想殺他。我希望這個世界上還留存一些魔法，我和其他人一樣哀悼他的離世。」

en_text: The woman greets you with shining eyes.
zh_text: 這個女人閃著明亮的眼睛跟你打招呼。

en_text: "I am Reyna," she says, brushing the hair out of her face.
zh_text: 「我是 Reyna ，」她說著，把頭髮從臉上撥開。

en_text: "I am a healer. I have chosen to set up shop here near the forest."
zh_text: 「我是一名治療師。我選擇在靠近森林的這裡開店。」

en_text: "I wanted to live and work here because the land is very beautiful. I have found many things to do and see. Unfortunately, the forest is so spread out that I have yet to meet many of the others who live in this area. I do know that the Abbey is just across the way from mine house.
zh_text: 「我想在這裡生活和工作，因為這片土地非常美麗。我發現了很多可以做和可以看的事物。不幸的是，森林太廣闊了，我還沒有遇見許多住在這裡的其他人。我確實知道修道院就在我家對面。

en_text: "And somewhere nearby is a scholar." She appears thoughtful for a moment. "Also, I believe there is a prison just east of the Abbey.
zh_text: 而且附近某處有一位學者。」她若有所思了一會兒。「另外，我相信在修道院東邊有一座監獄。」

en_text: "I've never actually seen it," she laughs, "but rumor has it that the cells are located right next to the court, for quick, easy imprisonment after the trial."
zh_text: 「我從來沒真的看過它，」她笑著說，「但傳聞說牢房就在法庭旁邊，為了在審判後能快速、輕易地監禁。」

en_text: "From Aimi I have heard that he is brilliant, and... also a bit overzealous to instruct those interested in increasing their knowledge."
zh_text: 「我從 Aimi 那裡聽說他很聰明，而且……對於教導那些有興趣增加知識的人也有一點過於熱心。」

en_text: "She is the monk who tends the garden at the Abbey."
zh_text: 「她是在修道院打理花園的僧侶。」

en_text: "She is one of the monks who lives at the Abbey. At this time, she is the only other person I have actually met here in the forest."
zh_text: 「她是住在修道院的僧侶之一。目前，她是我在這片森林裡唯一真正見過的其他人。」

en_text: "That is how this area -- Empath Abbey -- got its name, from the monks who live at the abbey of the Brotherhood of the Rose. They are said to make delicious wine. One of the monks cares for a beautiful garden in her spare time. In fact, I often buy flowers from her.
zh_text: 「這就是這個區域——人神修道院——名字的由來，得名於住在玫瑰友誼會修道院裡的僧侶。據說他們釀的酒很美味。其中一位僧侶在閒暇時照料著一個美麗的花園。事實上，我經常向她買花。

en_text: But," she grins, "as for the other monks, all that I	ever see them do is make wine and wander the countryside."
zh_text: 但是，」她咧嘴一笑，「至於其他的僧侶，我只看過他們釀酒和在鄉間閒晃。」

en_text: "Aimi is the only one I have met, but I know there are one or two others who make wine there."
zh_text: 「Aimi 是我唯一見過的，但我知道那裡還有一兩個人在釀酒。」

en_text: "Yes, I get them for my mother."
She looks down at her feet, and then back up at you. It is obvious she is fighting an urge to cry.
zh_text: 她看著自己的腳，然後抬頭看你。很明顯她正在強忍著淚水。

en_text: "Several months ago, my mother passed away in her home town. She was born here in the forests, and had asked to be buried here, near me. Every morning I come out here to visit her and set flowers by her grave.
zh_text: 「幾個月前，我母親在她的家鄉過世了。她出生在這片森林裡，並要求被埋葬在這裡，靠近我的地方。每天早上我都會來這裡看她，並在她的墓前放上花。

en_text: "But," a lone tear escapes and trickles down her cheek, "I am the only member of our family who lives nearby. No one else is able to visit or leave flowers very often.
zh_text: 但，」一滴眼淚從她的臉頰滑落，「我是我們家唯一住在附近的人。沒有其他人能經常來探望或留下花朵。

en_text: "Her grave looks so bare sometimes." She looks off into the horizon and sighs. "
zh_text: 有時她的墓看起來好空蕩。」她望向地平線，嘆了口氣。「

en_text: Her eyes light up as she sees the bouquet of flowers.
zh_text: 當她看到那束花時，眼睛亮了起來。

en_text: "They are lovely! Thou art too kind,
, to bring flowers for my mother! I cannot wait to set them by her grave."
zh_text: ，為我母親帶來了花！我等不及把它們放在她的墓前了。」

en_text: "For thy kindly gift of flowers, I will aid thee for half price." She smiles at you.
zh_text: 「為了你贈花的好意，我會以半價為你提供治療。」她對你微笑。

en_text: , but, unless this is an emergency, I would prefer to wait until my shop is open."
zh_text: ，但除非這是緊急情況，否則我比較希望等到我的店開門。」

en_text: "I am sorry, but thy wounds are not mortal. Perhaps thou canst visit me when my shop is open."
zh_text: 「我很抱歉，但你的傷並不致命。或許你可以在我的店開門時來拜訪我。」

en_text: "I very much love animals. When I was very young, I found an ailing dove that I was unable to nurse back to health. Since that time, I began to study the healing arts, so that I would be able to help other animals who might need healing.
zh_text: 「我非常喜歡動物。當我還很小的時候，我發現了一隻生病的鴿子，卻無法把它治好。從那時起，我開始學習治療的藝術，這樣我就能幫助其他可能需要治療的動物了。

en_text: "Of course," she laughs, "now that I have the skills, I use them to help people, too."

en_text: "My favorite ones are the birds, especially the Golden-Cheeked Warbler. I love to follow and watch them. They do not seem to have a very good sense of direction, however." He sighs. "But there is a great variety of species in this land."

I do not know what exactly happened to this upstart, but I understand that he is now dead. I am not trying to suggest the Library of Scars had anything to do with it, of course. zh_text: 「正如你可能看到的，我們幾名成員因為榮譽旗和一個當地的麻煩製造者發生了爭執。我們傷疤圖書館對我們的組織有著強烈的奉獻精神。我不知道這個暴發戶具體發生了什麼事，但我知道他現在已經死了。當然，我不是在暗示傷疤圖書館與此有關。只是想說，最好別惹我們。」

en_text: "I have heard that thou didst kill several of our members while champion of a duel defending the thief of our honor flag." His eyes narrow as he stares at you intensely. "Outstanding! I am a man who values nothing higher than the application of skill. I salute thee on thy victory. Perhaps thou wouldst like to join our group?"
zh_text: 「我聽說你在為那個偷我們榮譽旗的小偷辯護的決鬥中，殺了我們幾名成員。」他瞇起眼睛緊盯著你。「太出色了！我這個人最看重的就是技巧的運用。我為你的勝利向你致敬。或許你想加入我們的組織？」

en_text: "Thy companions and thee look fit enough for an informal practice session. Consider it a demonstration of my fighting style."
zh_text: 「你的同伴和你看起來夠強壯，適合進行一場非正式的練習。就把它當作我戰鬥風格的示範吧。」

en_text: "As my style of fighting is the superior style, I am only interested in training the best. Perhaps thy companions and thee qualify. We might find out, that is, if thou art courageous enough."
zh_text: 「因為我的戰鬥風格是優越的風格，我只對訓練最優秀的人有興趣。或許你的同伴和你夠資格。我們可以測試看看，前提是，如果你夠勇敢的話。」

en_text: "Fortunately for Sprellic our honor flag was returned. If it had not been we would have had no choice but to regain our honor with his blood."
zh_text: 「對 Sprellic 來說幸運的是，我們的榮譽旗被歸還了。如果沒有，我們別無選擇，只能用他的血來挽回我們的榮譽。」

en_text: "Thou canst walk away so easy without a demonstration! Thou shalt have one anyway!"*
zh_text: 「你休想沒有進行示範就這麼輕易走掉！無論如何你都得來一場！」*

en_text: "Elizabeth and Abraham?" Joseph scratches his head. "Oh, yes! They were the Fellowship members who were just here! They were trying to start a branch in Jhelom. I am undecided on what to tell them. We will probably have a town meeting to decide if there should be a branch here. The couple said they were returning to Britain for a few days."
zh_text: 「Elizabeth 和 Abraham ？」 Joseph 抓了抓頭。「喔，對了！他們就是剛剛來過的友誼會成員！他們試圖在 Jhelom 建立分會。我還沒決定要怎麼回覆他們。我們可能需要召開鎮民大會來決定是否要在這裡設立分會。這對夫婦說他們要回不列顛城幾天。」

en_text: "Elizabeth and Abraham?" Joseph scratches his head. "Oh, yes! They were the Fellowship members who were here -- why, it must have been last week or so. I have not seen them since."
zh_text: 「Elizabeth 和 Abraham ？」 Joseph 抓了抓頭。「喔，對了！他們是來過這裡的友誼會成員——哎呀，那一定是上個禮拜左右的事了。從那之後我就沒見過他們了。」

en_text: "Speak to Daphne or Ophelia at the Bunk and Stool, our town pub and inn."
zh_text: 「去跟我們鎮上酒館兼旅館的 Daphne 或 Ophelia 談談。」

en_text: "De Snel, the leader of the Library of Scars, requires that his members fight in many duels. One week they will fight for one cause and the next week for the opposite side."
zh_text: 「傷疤圖書館的領導人 De Snel 要求他的成員參與許多決鬥。這個禮拜他們可能為某個理念而戰，下個禮拜又為相反的立場而戰。」

en_text: "De Snel says he only wishes the best for his school. If his fighters are ever beaten he throws them out and recruits the winner to join the Library of Scars."
zh_text: 「De Snel 說他只希望他的學校能有最好的人才。如果他的戰士被打敗了，他會把他們踢出去，並招募勝利者加入傷疤圖書館。」

en_text: "It attracts fighters from all over Britannia who want to learn from De Snel. They are an unruly bunch. Thou wouldst do best to stay clear of them."
zh_text: 「它吸引了來自全不列顛尼亞想要向 De Snel 學習的戰士。他們是一群不守規矩的人。你最好離他們遠點。」

en_text: "De Snel and I have an understanding. He works his side of the street and I work mine. It is hard enough to maintain order in this town without jeopardizing that. If I intervene De Snel will challenge me to a duel and if I am killed then his control of our town would be absolute."
zh_text: 「De Snel 和我有一種默契。他管他的，我管我的。要在這座城鎮維持秩序已經夠難了，我不想破壞這種平衡。如果我介入， De Snel 就會向我挑戰決鬥，如果我被殺了，他對這座城鎮的控制將會是絕對的。」

en_text: "When I say that De Snel would challenge me to a duel I do not mean to insinuate that it would in any way be a fair or honorable contest-- more like a dagger in the back from one of his bullies as I was walking down a dark alley somewhere. That it would be a duel is just the story he would tell to make mine assassination somehow honorable."
zh_text: 「當我說 De Snel 會向我挑戰決鬥時，我並不是在暗示那會是一場公平或光榮的比賽——更可能是我走在某條暗巷時，被他手下的某個惡霸從背後捅一刀。所謂的決鬥只是他用來讓暗殺我這件事聽起來光榮一點的說詞。」

en_text: You see a man who exudes the outward mannerisms of a shrewd administrator, in contrast to his youthful appearance.
zh_text: 你看到一個男人散發著精明管理者的外在舉止，與他年輕的外表形成對比。

en_text: Joseph nods his head respectfully to you. "How may I assist thee?"
zh_text: Joseph 恭敬地對你點頭。「我能為你效勞嗎？」

en_text: "Presently, I am the mayor of Jhelom."
"I may seem a bit young for the job, but in a town such as this I am called upon to help keep order as often as administrate. I use my sword and pen in equal measure."
zh_text: 「我做這份工作可能看起來有點年輕，但在這樣一個城鎮，我不僅要管理行政，也經常被要求幫忙維持秩序。我劍與筆並用。」

en_text: "This town is a rough place. A fine place for fighting men and women to live. Perhaps thou hast seen our local sport?"
zh_text: 「這座城鎮是個粗獷的地方。對於戰鬥的男男女女來說是個好住處。或許你已經看過我們當地的運動了？」

en_text: "Why, 'tis duelling! At twelve noon every day, the town square becomes a battlefield."
zh_text: 「哎呀，就是決鬥！每天中午十二點，城鎮廣場就會變成戰場。」

en_text: "Well, the sound is worse than the act. 'Tis actually just a form of training and exercise. The fighters practice with targets and such. That is where I can be found, keeping mine own skills sharp."
zh_text: 「嗯，聽起來比實際情況糟。這其實只是一種訓練和運動的形式。戰士們用標靶等東西練習。那就是能找到我的地方，我也在那裡保持我自己的技術敏銳。」

en_text: "I am exaggerating. Many of the fighters in town gather to spar with the training dummies and practice various methods of combat. There are a few harmless matches at times. Some are a bit rough every now and then. Some folks take wagers on it and turn a profit."
zh_text: 「我誇張了。鎮上許多戰士會聚在一起和訓練假人對打，練習各種戰鬥方法。有時候也會有一些無害的比賽。偶爾會有點粗暴。有些人會為此下注並從中獲利。」

en_text: "Ahem... Of course most duels are simply to the blood, not to the death. It is a practice that helps restrain the passing knaves and rogues."
zh_text: 「咳嗯……當然，大多數的決鬥只是點到為止，不是生死決鬥。這種做法有助於克制路過的無賴和流氓。」

en_text: "That is what many of the duels are fought over! Some say The Fellowship is a load of rot, some say it is the only truth. Others say it is foolishness. Of course, as Mayor I remain neutral on such matters."
zh_text: 「這就是許多決鬥的原因！有人說友誼會是一堆垃圾，有人說它是唯一的真理。其他人則說那是愚蠢的。當然，作為市長，我在這些事情上保持中立。」

en_text: Joseph looks a little embarrassed. "I meant no insult to thee as a member of The Fellowship,
zh_text: Joseph 看起來有點尷尬。「作為友誼會的一員，我無意冒犯你，

en_text: "If thou must know mine opinion," he says to you in quiet confidence, "I agree with those that say The Fellowship is a bunch of foolishness."
zh_text: 「如果你非得知道我的意見，」他自信地小聲對你說，「我同意那些說友誼會是一堆愚蠢玩意的人。」

en_text: "Yes, I have heard of the events surrounding this fellow Sprellic and the duels against the Library of Scars, but frankly, mine official policy has been to not get involved in these sort of personal disputes."
zh_text: 「是的，我聽說過關於 Sprellic 這個人和對抗傷疤圖書館決鬥的事，但坦白說，我的官方政策是不介入這種私人爭端。」

en_text: "As Mayor and the peacekeeper I have to pick and choose my fights very carefully. There is no love lost between myself and the members of the Library of Scars, but they can legitimately claim that they have been wronged. I am required to remain impartial in this matter. As far as I can see, Sprellic brought this on himself when he took the honor flag. If thou dost wish to stop the duel, thou dost need only convince him to give it back."
zh_text: 「作為市長和維和者，我必須非常謹慎地選擇我的戰鬥。我和傷疤圖書館的成員之間沒有任何好感，但他們可以合理地聲稱自己受了委屈。我在這件事上必須保持中立。就我所見， Sprellic 拿走榮譽旗是自找麻煩。如果你想阻止這場決鬥，你只需要說服他把旗子還回去。」

en_text: "Believe me, we are not in each other's company so often because we are friends. We do so to maintain a careful watch on each other. Keep thy friends close, but keep thine enemies closer. Words to live by in Jhelom."
zh_text: 「相信我，我們經常在一起並不是因為我們是朋友。我們這麼做是為了仔細監視對方。親近你的朋友，但更要親近你的敵人。這是 Jhelom 的生存法則。」

en_text: "Enjoy thy stay in my city. But if thou hast no stomach for fighting thou shouldst not stay long."*
zh_text: 「祝你在我的城市玩得愉快。但如果你沒有戰鬥的膽量，你不該久留。」*

en_text: You relate Sprellic's story to the old man who listens intently. "It sounds to me like the work of Sullivan, the Trickster. He is a legendary thief and swindler who has never once been caught! Indeed, few even believe he actually exists. Thou shalt not be able to dissuade the duellists with a tale like that."
zh_text: 你向這位全神貫注聽著的老人講述 Sprellic 的故事。「聽起來像是騙子 Sullivan 的傑作。他是一個從未被抓到過的傳奇小偷和騙子！甚至很少有人相信他真的存在。你不可能用那樣的故事來勸阻決鬥者。」

en_text: "The only thing that can dissuade them from wanting to kill poor Sprellic is to return the honor flag! It must have been taken away by Sullivan, but the duellists do not know that! If we had a duplicate of the honor flag we could give them that instead!"
zh_text: 「唯一能勸阻他們不殺可憐的 Sprellic 的方法就是歸還榮譽旗！它一定是被 Sullivan 拿走了，但決鬥者們不知道！如果我們有一個榮譽旗的複製品，我們就可以把它給他們！」
「你好！」 Kliftin 說。「你最近有遇到什麼麻煩嗎？」

en_text: You see a battle-scarred old soldier.
zh_text: 你看到一個身經百戰、滿佈傷痕的老兵。

en_text: "Greetings!" says Kliftin. "Hast thou gotten into any scrapes lately?"
"In my day I was a pretty damned good soldier. Now I am the master of the Armoury here in Jhelom."
zh_text: 「在我的年代，我是個非常出色的士兵。現在我是 Jhelom 這裡軍械庫的主人。」

en_text: "I sell armour and weapons here. I have something to meet thine every need. Dost thou wish to see armour or weapons?"
zh_text: 「我在這裡販售防具和武器。我有東西能滿足你的各種需求。你想看防具還是武器？」

en_text: "My shop is presently closed for business, but do return again,
zh_text: 「我的店目前休息中，但請再回來，

en_text: "Surely thou dost not want to listen to old war stories?! I have seen my share of death and destruction. Leave it at that."
zh_text: 「你肯定不想聽那些古老的戰爭故事吧？！我看過太多死亡和毀滅了。就說到這吧。」

en_text: "I sell and collect weapons of all types. Business is always excellent, although my best customers keep getting killed in duels!"
zh_text: 「我販售並收藏各種類型的武器。生意一直都很好，雖然我最好的顧客總是死在決鬥中！」

en_text: "Jhelom is a rough place. If thou dost not like trouble then I can think of many better places for thee to be than here."
zh_text: 「Jhelom 是個粗獷的地方。如果你不喜歡惹麻煩，那麼我可以想到許多比這裡更好的地方讓你待著。」

en_text: "Every day at noon in the Town Square people come to settle their differences. They fight to the blood or to the death. It is a madness! Like that Sprellic fellow for instance."
zh_text: 「每天中午在城鎮廣場，人們都會來解決他們的分歧。他們戰鬥到見血或分出死活。這簡直是瘋了！就像那個 Sprellic 一樣。」

en_text: "Sprellic, our rather mild-mannered innkeeper, stole the honor flag from the wall of the Library of Scars and refused to return it. Now he must fight three of our best local fighters in a duel to the death."
zh_text: 「Sprellic ，我們這位脾氣相當溫和的旅館老闆，從傷疤圖書館的牆上偷走了榮譽旗，而且拒絕歸還。現在他必須和我們當地最優秀的三名戰士進行生死決鬥。」

en_text: "It is good of thee to help that poor Sprellic fellow in his hour of need."
zh_text: 「你在那個可憐的 Sprellic 需要時幫助他，真是太好了。」

en_text: "Thou canst ask about the entire matter at the pub if thou dost wish to know more about it."
zh_text: 「如果你想了解更多關於這整件事的詳情，你可以去酒館問問。」

en_text: "In my day I was fairly handy at stitching wounds... Hmmm, perhaps I can make a duplicate of the honor flag. The deception only has to work long enough for them to formally call off the duel."
zh_text: 「在我的年代，我縫合傷口的技術相當不錯……嗯，或許我可以製作一面榮譽旗的複製品。這個欺騙的把戲只需要撐到他們正式取消決鬥就行了。」

en_text: "I stitched so many of my comrades back together after all the battles I fought in. Now that I am retired, sewing has sort of become mine hobby." He looks at you with a little embarrassment. "There is nothing wrong with that!"
zh_text: 「在我經歷過的所有戰鬥之後，我縫合了太多同志的傷口。現在我退休了，縫紉反而成了我的嗜好。」他有些尷尬地看著你。「這沒什麼不對吧！」

en_text: "Even if they notice that it is not their true honor flag they would never admit it. To do so would make them look foolish. They would rather simply challenge anyone who might say it is not their honor flag to yet another	duel! But let us deal with one duel at a time here."
zh_text: 「即使他們發現那不是真正的榮譽旗，他們也絕對不會承認。那樣做會讓他們看起來很愚蠢。他們寧願直接向任何說那不是他們榮譽旗的人挑戰另一場決鬥！但我們還是一次解決一場決鬥吧。」

en_text: "Dost thou want me to make an honor flag that can be given to the Library of Scars so the duels can be stopped?"
zh_text: 「你要我製作一面可以交給傷疤圖書館的榮譽旗，好讓決鬥停止嗎？」

en_text: "Then thou must be sure to come pick it up from me before thou dost go to the Duelling Area. It is the area outside my shop next to the Library of Scars. I had best get busy if I am to have it finished in time! Please return to my shop in a few hours."*
zh_text: 「那你必須確保在你去決鬥區之前來跟我拿。決鬥區就在我店外靠近傷疤圖書館的地方。如果要及時完成，我最好現在就開始忙！請幾小時後再回我的店裡。」*

en_text: "Then thou must be sure to come pick it up from me before Sprellic goes to the Duelling Area. I had best get busy if I am to have it finished in time. Please return to my shop in a few hours."*
zh_text: 「那你必須確保在 Sprellic 去決鬥區之前來跟我拿。如果要及時完成，我最好現在就開始忙。請幾小時後再回我的店裡。」*

en_text: "Thou dost wish to deal with the Library of Scars personally? Very well then, but be warned -- the only type of honor they believe in is victory."
zh_text: 「你想親自對付傷疤圖書館？那很好，但要警告你——他們唯一相信的榮譽就是勝利。」

en_text: "How canst thou have the key to saving Sprellic's life in thine hand and do nothing as he faces certain death?!"
zh_text: 「你手裡明明握著拯救 Sprellic 生命的鑰匙，怎麼能在面對必死結局時袖手旁觀呢？！」

en_text: "Here is the imitation I have made of the Library of Scars' honor flag."
zh_text: 「這是我製作的傷疤圖書館榮譽旗的仿製品。」

en_text: "The time for the duels must be drawing near. Good luck to Sprellic, and to thee as well!"
zh_text: 「決鬥的時間一定快到了。祝 Sprellic 好運，也祝你好運！」

en_text: "Thou must put something down if thou art to carry the flag!"
zh_text: 「如果你要拿旗子，你必須先放下一些東西！」

en_text: "I am a barmaid. I do most of the work at The Bunk and Stool here in Jhelom."
zh_text: 「我是個酒館女侍。在 Jhelom 這裡的舖位與凳子(Bunk and Stool)，大部分的工作都是我在做。」

en_text: "Ever since Sprellic, the owner, was challenged to those duels by the three students at the Library of Scars, he has been busy preparing himself. I have been running the place all by myself... although Daphne has been helping me, I suppose."
zh_text: 「自從老闆 Sprellic 被傷痕圖書館的那三個學生挑戰決鬥後，他就一直忙著準備。我一直獨自經營這個地方……我想 Daphne 也算是有幫忙啦。」

en_text: "Thou shalt have to see Daphne about that. Thou wouldst not expect me to have to go into the kitchen?" Ophelia laughs.
zh_text: 「這件事你必須去找 Daphne。你總不會期望我必須進廚房吧？」Ophelia 笑著。

en_text: "It will be a great fighting school. Already, fighting men and women are coming to Jhelom to become Sprellic's students. They all long to know the secret that I can tell thee right now."
zh_text: 「那將是一所很棒的戰鬥學校。已經有男女戰士來到 Jhelom 成為 Sprellic 的學生。他們都渴望知道我現在就能告訴你的秘密。」

en_text: Ophelia motions you closer to her. She whispers to you. "Sprellic is really the Avatar returned to us after all these years." She nods solemnly.
zh_text: Ophelia 示意你靠近她。她對你低語。「Sprellic 其實就是經過這麼多年後回到我們身邊的聖者。」她莊嚴地點頭。

en_text: Ophelia motions you closer to her. She whispers to you. "Sprellic can call upon the Avatar to come and be his champion." She nods solemnly.
zh_text: Ophelia 示意你靠近她。她對你低語。「Sprellic 可以呼喚聖者來當他的冠軍戰士。」她莊嚴地點頭。

en_text: "Very well. Let me give thee markers for thy gold. Each one is worth 10 gold coins. If Sprellic wins, thou mayest come collect twice that amount of gold from me.
zh_text: 「很好。我給你代表你金幣的籌碼。每個籌碼價值 10 枚金幣。如果 Sprellic 贏了，你可以來找我拿兩倍數量的金幣。

en_text: "Then if thou wouldst like to bet against Sprellic, thou mayest see Daphne, but I warn thee thou wilt be throwing thy money away!"
zh_text: 「那麼如果你想賭 Sprellic 輸，你可以去找 Daphne，但我警告你，你這是在把錢丟進水裡！」

en_text: "Do not get thine hopes up yet, my dear Daphne! I have put a condition on our marriage and poor Cosmo will never be able to fulfill it!"
zh_text: 「別高興得太早，親愛的 Daphne！我對我們的婚姻提出了一個條件，而可憐的 Cosmo 永遠也無法達成它！」

en_text: A pretty woman gives you a friendly grin and then coyly turns her eyes away from you.
zh_text: 一位漂亮的女人對你露出友好的笑容，然後羞怯地將目光移開。

en_text: "Honestly, I cannot imagine why thou wouldst be interested in her." She lets out a throaty laugh.*

zh_text: 「我的故事很離奇。這可能會讓你感到不安和困惑。你確定你想聽嗎？」

zh_text: 「好吧，那麼希望我曾對你有所幫助。永遠別了，

zh_text: 「無意冒犯，但他也是友誼會的成員！」

"I fear that this stranger was not who he claimed to be at all. I was a victim of a great and terrible deception that was perpetrated upon me."
zh_text: 「我擔心這個陌生人根本不是他所聲稱的那個人。我是一個巨大且可怕的騙局的受害者。」

en_text: "This stranger ordered one of every kind of food and drink on the menu. So if he ever wanted anything, it would be right there to eat. I was cooking for hours. But then it got worse. He went to bed."

en_text: "In desperation I ran down the street. It was the middle of the night. All of the shops were closed. The only thing I could find was some sort of old tapestry hanging on a wall. So I took it down."
zh_text: 「在絕望中，我跑到街上。那是半夜。所有的商店都關門了。我唯一能找到的，就是一塊掛在牆上的舊掛毯。所以我就把它拿了下來。」

en_text: "Actually, now as I recall being out in the night air, it was a quite tolerable evening. Alas, I was oblivious to little else but the prospect of earning a goodly sum in the service of the stranger. Woe is me!"
zh_text: 「其實，現在回想起來，在夜晚的空氣中外出，那是一個相當宜人的夜晚。唉，當時我滿腦子只想著為那位陌生人服務能賺到一筆可觀的錢。我真悲哀！」

en_text: "The next thing I remember there was an angry woman chasing after me. For some reason she wanted to kill me! I managed to get away from her and get back to the inn and cover the stranger with the tapestry. Finally he fell asleep."
zh_text: 「我接下來記得的是，有一個憤怒的女人追著我。不知為何她想殺了我！我設法逃脫了她，回到旅店，用掛毯把陌生人蓋上。最後他終於睡著了。」

en_text: "Actually, I had seen this angry woman before. She would enter mine establishment upon occasion. Unfortunately, this was our first formal acquaintance."
zh_text: 「其實，我以前見過這個憤怒的女人。她偶爾會光顧我的店。不幸的是，這是我們第一次正式打交道。」

en_text: "As I have said, I was rooked by a professional. A Master Criminal, no doubt -- and one who is still at large!"

en_text: "I will say this of the Lady Syria. She is quite beautiful when she is angry... At least, the visions of her that swam through mine head after she had hit me were quite beautiful. Tragically, I awoke."

en_text: "Mine only hope for survival is to find a champion who could stand up to the fiercest fighters in Jhelom."

en_text: "Oh, nothing is ever new in New Magincia, as the joke around here goes. But that is how we like it. We have few visitors here."
zh_text: 「喔，就像這裡流傳的笑話說的， New Magincia 永遠沒有『新』鮮事。但我們就喜歡這樣。我們這裡很少有訪客。」

en_text: You see the locket Henry described to you hanging around Magenta's neck. "Is it not beautiful? I found it in the secret hiding place behind mine husband's bar."
zh_text: 你看到 Henry 描述的吊飾盒掛在 Magenta 的脖子上。「它不美嗎？這是我在我丈夫吧檯後面的祕密藏匿處找到的。」

en_text: "Well, I thought at first that Boris had bought the locket for me as a surprise! Wait until I get mine hands on that no good..." Magenta's face turns as red as her hair.
zh_text: 「嗯，我起初還以為 Boris 買了這個吊飾盒要給我個驚喜！等我抓到那個沒用的……」Magenta 氣得滿臉通紅。

en_text: You see a humble-looking older woman. She gives you a friendly smile.
zh_text: 你看到一位看起來很謙虛的年長婦女。她對你露出友好的微笑。

en_text: "It is a job that requires little actual administration. I mostly try to make sure that everyone is getting along with everyone else. Apart from that, the town practically runs itself."
zh_text: 「這份工作其實不太需要實際的行政管理。我主要是確保大家都能和睦相處。除此之外，這個鎮幾乎是自行運作的。」

en_text: "Why even the taxes here are less severe than anywhere else in Britannia. The Britannian Tax Council sometimes forgets to come collecting here for years on end."
zh_text: 「甚至這裡的稅收也比不列顛尼亞的任何其他地方都輕。不列顛尼亞稅務委員會甚至有時會連續好幾年忘記來這裡收稅。」

en_text: "Boris is the local innkeeper and a bit of a scoundrel if I say so myself. But he pours a good drink and tells a good story. Although I have to keep an eye on him, I love him."
zh_text: 「Boris 是當地的客棧老闆，說句實話，他有點像個無賴。但他很會倒酒，也很會說故事。雖然我得盯著他，但我愛他。」

en_text: "I hear there are three other new arrivals wandering around here somewhere. I always try to give people the benefit of the doubt, but be careful of them."
zh_text: 「我聽說還有三個新來的人在附近徘徊。我總是盡量把人往好處想，但你還是要小心他們。」

en_text: "Certainly some of the other townsfolk must have seen them by now. Perhaps they will have more information."
zh_text: 「鎮上的其他人現在肯定已經見過他們了。也許他們會有更多消息。」

en_text: "I would never have suspected anything so romantic from Boris. The locket must be a surprise for me!"
zh_text: 「我從沒想過 Boris 會這麼浪漫。這個吊飾盒一定是給我的驚喜！」

en_text: "He must be trying to get back on my good side after all of the times I have caught him wenching and carousing."
zh_text: 「在被我抓到那麼多次尋歡作樂和狂歡之後，他一定是在想辦法重新討我歡心。」

en_text: "Well, I -did- think he was going to give it to me to make up for all the times I have caught him wenching and carousing."
zh_text: 「嗯，我『確實』認為他是想把它送給我，好彌補他被我抓到那麼多次尋歡作樂和狂歡的事。」

en_text: "Say, dost thou think that Boris could have meant to give this locket to someone else?"
zh_text: 「說真的，你覺得 Boris 會不會是想把這個吊飾盒送給別人？」
Magenta 震驚地睜大眼睛。「誰？」

en_text: "I cannot possibly wear a piece of jewelry meant for another woman. As mayor, I charge thee, Avatar, with the task of returning it to her, or more properly to the person who had intended to give it to her. As for Boris... well, I shall deal with him later!"
zh_text: 「我絕不可能戴著原本要送給別的女人的珠寶。作為鎮長，聖者，我將把它還給她（或者更確切地說，還給本來打算送她的人）的任務交給你。至於 Boris ……哼，我晚點再來收拾他！」

en_text: "I cannot give thee the locket. Thou art too encumbered. Come back after thou hast put a few things down."
zh_text: 「我不能把吊飾盒交給你。你帶太多東西了。放下一點東西後再來吧。」

en_text: Magenta looks puzzled. "I wonder who it could be?Then Magenta gets a devilish gleam in her eye. "Well then. I shall just beat it out of him!"
zh_text: Magenta 看起來很困惑。「我想知道那是誰？」然後 Magenta 眼神中閃過一絲凶光。「那麼，我就去把他打到招認為止！」

en_text: Magenta looks puzzled. "I wonder who it could be?
zh_text: Magenta 看起來很困惑。「我想知道那是誰？」

en_text: Then Magenta gets a devilish gleam in her eye. "Well then. I shall just beat it out of him!"

en_text: Magenta sighs with relief. "I am glad thou hast said this. Now I shall feel no guilt about keeping it."
zh_text: Magenta 鬆了一口氣。「我很高興你這麼說。現在我收下它就不會有罪惡感了。」

en_text: "I am flattered Boris would buy me such an obviously expensive gift. But how could he ever have afforded it?"
zh_text: 「Boris 願意買這麼昂貴的禮物給我，我受寵若驚。但他怎麼買得起？」

en_text: Although Magenta struggles to retain her dignity, she cannot hide her disappointment. "As Mayor, I charge thee with the task of locating the rightful owner of this locket and returning it to them."

en_text: "Thou hast not room to carry even such a small thing as this! If thou wilt set something down, I will give thee the locket."
zh_text: 「你連這麼小的東西都帶不下了！如果你能放下一些東西，我就把吊飾盒交給你。」

en_text: Magenta looks puzzled. Then she smiles. "Oh well. It sure is nice, is it not? If he thought this would improve our marital relations, he was not altogether wrong!"
zh_text: Magenta 看起來很困惑。然後她笑了。「喔，好吧。它真的很漂亮，不是嗎？如果他認為這樣能改善我們的夫妻關係，那他也沒完全錯！」

en_text: "I look forward to the next time when I will see thee."*
"Katrina is a shepherd here on New Magincia. She has been a friend of mine since I was a boy."
zh_text: 「Katrina 是 New Magincia 的牧羊女。她從我小時候就是我的朋友了。」

en_text: "Although I am called a peddler, I have the greatest selection of items to be found in New Magincia."
zh_text: 「雖然我被稱為小販，但我擁有 New Magincia 裡最齊全的商品。」

en_text: "There are three other strangers in New Magincia. They arrived a few days before thee. Their ship was sunk and they barely made it here with their lives."
zh_text: 「New Magincia 還有三個陌生人。他們比你早幾天到。他們的船沉了，他們好不容易才保住性命來到這裡。」

en_text: You hand the locket to Henry. "Now I may give it to Constance and keep my promise to her! I cannot thank thee enough, Avatar!"
zh_text: 你把吊飾盒交給 Henry 。「現在我可以把它交給 Constance ，並實現我對她的承諾了！我實在感激不盡，聖者！」

en_text: You see a scruffy young man who is obviously suffering from a broken heart.
zh_text: 你看到一個衣衫襤褸的年輕人，顯然正在承受失戀之痛。

en_text: Henry greets you. "It is good to speak with thee again,
zh_text: Henry 向你打招呼。「很高興再次和你說話，

en_text: "Job?! Who can work when he has a broken heart?!"
zh_text: 「工作？！誰心碎了還有辦法工作？！」

en_text: "I have lived here all of my life and have never known anyplace else. It is a basically a very nice place where people still adhere to the old ways and values. The rest of the world must think it has passed us by, but it is they who have lost what once was."
zh_text: 「我一輩子都住在這裡，從沒去過其他地方。這裡基本上是個非常美好的地方，人們仍然堅持著古老的傳統和價值觀。世界上的其他人一定認為時代拋棄了我們，但其實是他們失去了曾經擁有的一切。」

en_text: "I have been rejected by the woman I love."

His eyes light up. "Her name is Constance, she is the most beautiful woman in the world, and for a time we were in love." His face falls, and he sighs deeply. "But that was before I made a terrible mistake..."
zh_text: 他的眼睛亮了起來。「她的名字是 Constance ，她是世界上最美麗的女人，我們曾經相愛過一段時間。」他神色黯然，深深嘆了口氣。「但那是在我犯下一個可怕的錯誤之前……」

en_text: "She is the waterbearer of the town. She carries water from the well of Humility to all the homes in town."
zh_text: 「她是鎮上的挑水工。她將謙卑之井的水送到鎮上的每戶人家。」

en_text: "I promised to give her a very old and valuable locket as a token of mine affection. My childhood friend, Katrina, had given the locket to me."
zh_text: 「我答應送給她一個非常古老且珍貴的吊飾盒，作為我愛慕的信物。我兒時的朋友 Katrina 把那個吊飾盒送給了我。」

en_text: "Before I could give her the locket, I lost it. I have searched everywhere but I cannot find it. Now, Constance thinks I am a cad and has forsaken me."
zh_text: 「我還來不及把吊飾盒交給她就弄丟了。我找遍了所有地方都找不到。現在， Constance 認為我是個無賴，拋棄了我。」

en_text: "We have had some good memories, have we not, Henry?"
zh_text: 「我們曾有過一些美好的回憶，不是嗎， Henry ？」

zh_text: 「喔，確實如此！但妳不願做我的愛人，所以我們很久以前就認命當『普通朋友』了，不是嗎？」
「妳說什麼就是什麼，親愛的 Henry 。」

en_text: "I noticed I had lost the locket right after I spoke with those three strangers yesterday. Wouldst thou help me find it?"
zh_text: 「我昨天和那三個陌生人說過話後，就發現我的吊飾盒不見了。你能幫我找到它嗎？」

en_text: ! If not for thee, I would be lost."
zh_text: ！如果不是你，我真不知道該怎麼辦。」

en_text: "Oh, well... I know thou art busy on thine own quest. I thank thee for listening to my tale,
zh_text: 「喔，好吧……我知道你忙著自己的任務。謝謝你聽我訴苦，

en_text: "I am glad that this situation has concluded in thy favor, dear Henry."
zh_text: 「我很高興這件事對你有了好結果，親愛的 Henry 。」

en_text: He looks distraught when you make no move to give it to him. "Where is it?! I need it if I am to prove myself to the woman I love!"
zh_text: 當你沒有要把它交給他時，他看起來心急如焚。「它在哪裡？！我需要它來向我愛的女人證明我的心意！」

en_text: You gently explain to Constance that Robin, Battles and Leavell were scoundrels with intent to do her great harm. She is quite alarmed. Then you explain that they will not be troubling her anymore. She thanks you.
zh_text: 你溫和地向 Constance 解釋， Robin 、 Battles 和 Leavell 是無賴，意圖對她造成極大的傷害。她非常震驚。然後你解釋說他們不會再找她麻煩了。她向你道謝。

en_text: You tell Constance of Robin's plans for her. She gives you a shocked look. "Many thanks. I now know that my rightful place is with Henry."
zh_text: 你告訴 Constance 關於 Robin 對她的計畫。她震驚地看著你。「非常感謝。我現在知道我真正的歸宿是和 Henry 在一起。」

en_text: "I carry water from the well of humility to all of the homes here in New Magincia."
zh_text: 「我將謙卑之井的水送到 New Magincia 的每戶人家。」

en_text: "I, too, am feeling dry. Wouldst thou share thy water with me, milady?" Constance fills the dipper with water for Shamino and he drinks until water runs down his chin.*

en_text: "I was born in New Magincia and I have lived here mine entire life. But now I wish to leave for mine heart hath been broken."
zh_text: 「我在 New Magincia 出生，一輩子都住在這裡。但現在我想離開，因為我的心碎了。」

en_text: You tell Constance of how you have returned the locket that has been stolen from Henry. "Oh, how could I ever have doubted my dear darling Henry?" she frowns. "I thank thee for telling me the truth."
zh_text: 你告訴 Constance 你是如何歸還從 Henry 那裡被偷走的吊飾盒。「喔，我怎麼能懷疑我親愛的 Henry 呢？」她皺起眉頭。「謝謝你告訴我真相。」

en_text: "There is a charming and mysterious stranger on the island named Robin. He says one day he may show me the world and buy me many fine things." Constance sighs. "He even gave me some lovely flowers."
zh_text: 「島上有個迷人又神祕的陌生人，名叫 Robin 。他說有一天他會帶我去看世界，買很多好東西給我。」Constance 嘆了口氣。「他甚至送了我一些漂亮的花。」

en_text: "He is a wealthy man and his two friends are big, strong men. They have been telling me about a very wonderful-sounding place called Buccaneer's Den."
zh_text: 「他是個有錢人，他的兩個朋友是高大強壯的男人。他們一直跟我說一個聽起來很棒的地方，叫海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)。」

en_text: "Their names were Battles and Leavell. Both of them treated me like proper gentlemen."
zh_text: 「他們的名字是 Battles 和 Leavell 。他們兩人都像真正的紳士一樣對待我。」

en_text: "Buccaneer's Den must be a wonderland. There is a spinning wheel that gives thee money! Canst thou imagine! And opulent, luxurious baths."
zh_text: 「海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den) 一定是個仙境。那裡有一個會給你錢的紡車！你能想像嗎！還有富麗堂皇、奢華的浴池。」

en_text: "Well, they certainly have nothing like that in New Magincia. I had never even heard of such a thing before!"
zh_text: 「嗯， New Magincia 絕對沒有那種東西。我以前甚至從沒聽說過那種事！」

en_text: You see an angelic young woman who gives you a smile of complete innocence.

en_text: !" says a wide-eyed Constance, "What may I do for thee?"
zh_text: ！」Constance 睜大眼睛說，「我能為你做什麼嗎？」

zh_text: ，我的名字是 Constance。」她害羞地垂下眼睛。

en_text: "I shall wait until we find something a bit stronger than water to quench my thirst."*
zh_text: 「我還是等我們找到比水更『夠勁』的東西再來解渴吧。」*

en_text: "If thou wouldst ever change thy mind thou needest only let me know."
zh_text: 「如果你改變主意，只要告訴我一聲就行了。」

en_text: "There are three strangers on the island! They have been shipwrecked here! I have met them. Their leader's name is Robin."
zh_text: 「島上有三個陌生人！他們在這裡遭遇了船難！我見過他們。他們的領袖名叫 Robin 。」

en_text: "Once I was in love with Henry, the peddler, but then I learned he is a liar and a cad. Perhaps soon mine heart shall belong to another."
zh_text: 「我曾經愛過小販 Henry ，但後來我得知他是個騙子，也是個無賴。也許很快我的心就會屬於別人。」

en_text: "Constance, I am sorry that things ran afoul as they did, but if thou wilt, I would like thee to have this locket as a symbol of my love."*
zh_text: 「Constance ，我很抱歉事情變得這麼糟，但如果妳願意，我希望妳收下這個吊飾盒，作為我愛情的信物。」*

en_text: "My sweet Henry, mine heart belongs to only thee."*
zh_text: 「我親愛的 Henry ，我的心只屬於你。」*

en_text: "Battles was quiet at first. I thought he was mean-looking, but he is nice once thou dost get to know him. He told me of the various monsters he fought, and exciting stories of how he raided ships in the south seas."
zh_text: 「Battles 起初很安靜。我以為他看起來很兇，但一旦你認識他，會發現他人很好。他告訴我他對抗過各種怪物，還有他在南海劫掠船隻的刺激故事。」

en_text: "Leavell was charming and witty. He can always make me laugh."
zh_text: 「Leavell 迷人又風趣。他總能讓我笑。」

en_text: "It was a pleasure speaking with thee,
"Yes, money! For I have found something here in New Magincia that will be worth more than gold in Buccaneer's Den."
zh_text: 「是的，錢！因為我在 New Magincia 這裡找到了一樣東西，在海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)它的價值將超過黃金。」

zh_text: 「你是友誼會的成員！多年來，我一直看到友誼會的成員在賭坊 (House of Games)贏得大筆賭金。你能告訴我他們的祕密嗎？」

en_text: Robin looks you in the eye. "Thou art truly a kind friend. I suppose then I should tell thee what it is we are planning on bringing back from New Magincia."
zh_text: Robin 直視著你的眼睛。「你真是個好朋友。我想我該告訴你我們打算從 New Magincia 帶回什麼了。」

zh_text: 。很高興見到你。我最近才來到 New Magincia。」

zh_text: 「我不是本地人。在與賭場老闆發生爭執後，我和我的同僚們不得不迅速離開海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)。那也是一段艱辛的航程。」

en_text: "My friends are Battles and Leavell. Their job is to protect me and my winnings. In exchange they share in my profits."
zh_text: 「我的朋友是 Battles 和 Leavell。他們的工作是保護我和我贏來的錢。作為交換，他們可以分享我的利潤。」

zh_text: 「我贏了賭場一筆驚人的黃金，那裡的『先生』Gordy 指控我作弊。他派了他的打手 Sintag 來追捕我們。海盜可不喜歡輸！」

en_text: "We took the first ship out, but before we got back to the mainland it had sunk. The three of us barely managed to make it to New Magincia with our lives. Now we are marooned here."
zh_text: 「我們搭了第一艘出港的船，但在我們回到大陸之前，它就沉了。我們三個好不容易才死裡逃生來到 New Magincia。現在我們被困在這裡了。」

en_text: "We are trying to return to Buccaneer's Den. I was hoping to sell a gold locket which came into my possession to buy our passage back, but I fear it is lost. If thou dost come across it be sure to let me know."
zh_text: 「我們正試圖回到海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)。我本來希望能賣掉我手邊的一個金吊飾盒來買我們回去的船票，但我恐怕它已經遺失了。如果你有遇到它，一定要讓我知道。」

en_text: "I could pay thee well if thou wouldst	take us back to Buccaneer's Den."
zh_text: 「如果你願意載我們回海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)，我可以付給你豐厚的報酬。」

en_text: "Of course, I cannot pay thee right now at this moment.	But when we reach Buccaneer's Den, I promise thee, I shall be able to get mine hands on a lot of money."
zh_text: 「當然，我現在此時此刻無法付錢給你。但當我們到達海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)時，我向你保證，我能拿到很多錢。」

en_text: "Before I tell thee what it is, wilt thou promise to take me and my mates back to Buccaneer's Den?"
zh_text: 「在我告訴你那是什麼之前，你願意答應帶我和我的夥伴回海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)嗎？」

en_text: You see a roguish man dressed in what appears to be some nobleman's ratty hand-me-downs.
zh_text: 你看到一個流氓般的男人，穿著似乎是某個貴族破舊的二手衣服。

en_text: "Greetings, and how may I be of service to thee?" asks Robin.
zh_text: 「你好，有什麼我可以為你效勞的嗎？」Robin 問道。

en_text: "My father, a well-respected nobleman whose name I will not defame by mentioning, bastardized and disowned me. But he did teach me mine occupation."
zh_text: 「我父親，一位受人尊敬的貴族——為了不玷污他的名聲，我就不提他的名字了——他不承認我是他的合法子嗣，並與我斷絕了關係。但他確實教會了我謀生的職業。」

en_text: "Why, that most glamorous and respected of occupations,
zh_text: 「哎呀，當然是那個最迷人、最受人尊敬的職業，

en_text: "I rescued him from his captain who was about to make him walk the plank. I diced with that Captain for the lad's life. Later, Battles led a mutiny that took the ship, and... well, that is another story."
zh_text: 「我從他那準備逼他跳板的船長手中救了他。我用擲骰子跟那位船長賭這小子的命。後來，Battles 領導了一場叛變奪取了那艘船，還有……嗯，那是另一個故事了。」

en_text: "I rescued him from a gaggle of angry noblemen's daughters who had just discovered he was courting all of them simultaneously. If not for me he would have certainly perished! But I am ahead of myself."
zh_text: 「我從一群憤怒的貴族女兒手中救了他，她們剛剛發現他同時在追求她們所有人。如果不是我，他肯定已經沒命了！但我說得太遠了。」

en_text: "It is where we live most of the year. There are a lot of rough characters there and it is not a place to be seen carrying large amounts of money."
zh_text: 「那是我們大半輩子居住的地方。那裡有很多粗暴的傢伙，而且在那裡帶著大量金錢閒晃可不是什麼好主意。」

en_text: "Do not ask me why he is called that! Everyone there calls him that, though!"
zh_text: 「別問我他為什麼叫那個名字！不過那裡的每個人都這麼叫他！」

en_text: "I do not know of any. I only just arrived here myself."
zh_text: 「我不知道有什麼陌生人。我自己也才剛到這裡。」

en_text: "One rough character in particular to stay away from is a man called Hook. He would kill thee for a trifle. Thou canst tell him by the hook he has for a hand."
zh_text: 「特別要遠離的一個粗暴傢伙是一個名叫 Hook 的男人。他會為了一點小事就殺了你。你可以從他那隻鐵鉤手認出他。」

en_text: "I know nothing more. If thou thinkest that I would willingly cross paths with the likes of him thou must have me mistaken for someone else!"
zh_text: 「我不知道更多了。如果你認為我會自願與那種人打交道，那你一定是認錯人了！」

en_text: "Forgive me if I do not believe thee."
"That is right. We cannot afford the stinking ship sold by the shipwright."But say, thou must have gotten here in some manner! Dost thou have some manner of ship on which we could leave the island?"
zh_text: 「沒錯。我們買不起造船匠賣的那艘破船。「不過話說回來，你一定是用某種方式來到這裡的！你有什麼船可以讓我們離開這座島嗎？」

en_text: "That is right. We cannot afford the stinking ship sold by the shipwright.
zh_text: 「沒錯。我們買不起造船匠賣的那艘破船。

en_text: "But say, thou must have gotten here in some manner! Dost thou have some manner of ship on which we could leave the island?"
zh_text: 「不過話說回來，你一定是用某種方式來到這裡的！你有什麼船可以讓我們離開這座島嗎？」

en_text: "If thou shouldst come across a way off this island please permit us to leave with thee."
zh_text: 「如果你有找到離開這座島的方法，請允許我們與你同行。」

en_text: "Then I cannot trust thee enough to tell thee of my plans. Go away."
zh_text: 「那麼我就無法信任你，不能告訴你我的計畫。走開。」

en_text: "Since thou art truly a friend then I know that I can ask a favor of thee. Why dost thou not bring back that lost locket to me and we shall speak of these things some more." He flashes you a wicked grin.
zh_text: 「既然你真的是個朋友，那我知道我可以請你幫個忙。你何不把那個遺失的吊飾盒拿回來給我，我們再來多談談這些事。」他對你露出邪惡的笑容。

en_text: "Since thou hast brought my locket back here, I suppose that I can trust thee. I intend to take Constance back with us and sell her to the operator of the baths."
zh_text: 「既然你把我的吊飾盒帶回來了，我想我可以信任你。我打算把 Constance 帶回去，把她賣給浴池的經營者。」

en_text: "Thou must get thy boat ready to leave this place immediately. My lads and I shall get Constance and then we shall join thee. But wilt thou tell me where thy boat is located?"
zh_text: 「你必須馬上準備好你的船，準備離開這個地方。我和我的手下會去把 Constance 抓來，然後我們就去跟你會合。但你能告訴我你的船在哪裡嗎？」

en_text: You give Robin the location of your boat. He slowly breaks into an evil laugh. "I thank thee, friend. All that is left for us is to eliminate one remaining loose end. Now that we know where thy boat is we will collect more on our investment by simply killing thee and taking it."*
zh_text: 你告訴 Robin 你的船的位置。他慢慢地爆發出邪惡的笑聲。「謝謝你，朋友。我們剩下要做的就是消除最後一個未了結的問題。既然我們知道你的船在哪裡，我們只要殺了你並奪走它，就能從我們的投資中獲得更多回報。」*

en_text: "Thou hast lost thy stomach for our game, eh? If that is the case then my lads and I have no choice but to kill thee dead to protect our secret!"*
zh_text: 「你對我們的遊戲失去膽量了嗎，嗯？如果是這樣，那麼我和我的手下別無選擇，只能殺了你來保護我們的祕密！」*

en_text: "It has been a pleasure speaking with thee,

"The casino in Buccaneer's Den is called the House of Games and it the most fabulous place I have ever seen in me life. I shall never forget the first time Robin took me there. He walked away with a hundred gold pieces for less than an hour's work!"
zh_text: 「海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den) 的賭坊 (House of Games)，那是我這輩子見過最棒的地方。我永遠不會忘記 Robin 第一次帶我去那裡的情景。他不到一個小時就帶著一百枚金幣離開了！」

en_text: "We be looking to get off this boring rock, New Magincia, and back to Buccaneer's Den. If ye have a way to get us there, and away from these peasant knaves, Master Robin shall pay ye well."
zh_text: 「我們正想離開這塊無聊的破石頭，New Magincia，回到海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)去。如果你有辦法帶我們去那裡，遠離這些鄉巴佬，Robin 少爺會付你豐厚的報酬的。」

en_text: "Battles. M'self, I be a stranger to New Magincia."
zh_text: 「Battles。我自己對 New Magincia 來說也是個陌生人。」

en_text: "Robin be a high stakes gamblin' gent who makes his living inna casino at Buccaneer's Den."
zh_text: 「Robin 是個玩大賭注的賭客，他在海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)的賭場裡討生活。」

en_text: "I sar a locket jus' like the one thou be describin' in the possession o' Master Robin. The last time I sar it was... Lessee... It was right before the three of us went drinkin' at the Modest Damsel."
zh_text: 「我看到 Robin 少爺手裡有一個就像你描述的那樣的吊飾盒。我最後一次看到它是在……讓我想想……就在我們三個去端莊少女(Modest Damsel)酒館喝酒之前。」

en_text: "I be hired as a bodyguard for Master Robin, as is me partner, Leavell. The pay be good."
zh_text: 「我被僱來當 Robin 少爺的保鑣，我的夥伴 Leavell 也是。這份差事薪水很不錯。」

en_text: The man before you examines you with shifty eyes. He has a slightly crouched posture as if constantly poised to strike out at the world around him.
zh_text: 你面前的男人用狡詐的眼神打量著你。他微微彎著腰，彷彿隨時準備對周圍的世界發動攻擊。

en_text: "A living that would not have been anything near as profitable if not for thy good works, Battles."*
zh_text: 「如果沒有你出色的工作，這份營生可就沒這麼賺錢了，Battles。」*

en_text: "Gamblin' is how Robin makes his living. I do not think he has had a regular post in all of his life!"
zh_text: 「Robin 靠賭博維生。我想他這輩子從來沒有過一份正經的工作！」

en_text: "Why, I thank thee for the compliment, Battles!"*
"He's a lady's man, he is. But do not be thinkin' he cannot handle hissel' inna fight. T'would be yer last mistake."
zh_text: 「他是個萬人迷，真的。但別以為他不會打架。那會是你犯的最後一個錯誤。」

en_text: "I can near out wrestle thee, Battles, ye old dog!"*
zh_text: 「我幾乎能把你摔倒，Battles，你這老狗！」*

en_text: "Why, I reckon Leavell has broken near as many hearts as I have made stop beating!"
zh_text: 「哎呀，我估計 Leavell 傷透的心，跟我讓其停止跳動的心臟差不多一樣多！」

en_text: "Just the practice Leavell has had in fending off jealous husbands 'twould make any man a master combatant!"
zh_text: 「光是 Leavell 在應付那些嫉妒的丈夫們時所受的訓練，就足以讓任何人成為戰鬥大師了！」
「陌生人？～～你說的肯定是我們！」Battles 大聲地哼了一聲。

en_text: Thou must mean us!" Battles snorts loudly.
"Canst thou imagine spending thine entire life here with nothing happening day after day after day? 'Tis enough to drive a man mad!"
zh_text: 「你能想像一輩子待在這裡，日復一日什麼事都沒發生嗎？這足以把人逼瘋！」

en_text: "The people here are so lacking in education that they never even heard of gamblin' before! Never heard of gamblin'? That is what life is all about!"
zh_text: 「這裡的人太沒見識了，他們甚至從沒聽過賭博！沒聽過賭博？那可是人生的全部啊！」

en_text: "Along with Battles, I am a bodyguard for Master Robin. If not for him, I would have landed in prison instead of in New Magincia."
zh_text: 「和 Battles 一起，我是 Robin 少爺的保鑣。要不是他，我早就進監獄了，而不是來到 New Magincia。」

en_text: "When Master Robin could not pay his debts, The Mister sent his legbreaker, Sintag, and his knaves after us. We had to leave on the first ship out of Buccaneer's Den. I do not know why he is called 'The Mister'."
zh_text: 「當 Robin 少爺無法償還債務時，『先生』派了他的打手 Sintag 和他的無賴們來追捕我們。我們不得不搭乘第一艘離開海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)的船。我不知道他為什麼被稱為『先生』。」

en_text: "He had devised a clever method of cheating at all the various games at the House of Chance. It had earned him several times his weight in gold coins, I am certain."
zh_text: 「他設計了一個聰明的方法，可以在機會之屋(House of Chance)的所有各種遊戲中作弊。我敢肯定，這讓他賺到了好幾倍於他體重的金幣。」

en_text: "If thou wouldst have some way of getting us back to Buccaneer's Den, Master Robin would reward thee handsomely."
zh_text: 「如果你有辦法讓我們回到海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)，Robin 少爺會豐厚地獎賞你。」

en_text: "He is a gambler by profession, who earns his winnings at the House of Games's tables on Buccaneer's Den."
zh_text: 「他是一名職業賭徒，在海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)的遊戲廳賭桌上贏錢。」

en_text: "Battles and myself are more than capable of taking care of Sintag..." *
zh_text: 「Battles 和我絕對有能力對付 Sintag……」 *

en_text: "The ship we sailed on sank, leaving us stranded here. We were lucky to make it to New Magincia with our lives!"
zh_text: 「我們乘坐的船沉了，把我們困在這裡。我們能活著來到 New Magincia 真幸運！」
Leavell 在指尖上平衡著他的匕首。在一陣模糊的動作中，他從半空中抓住了它，並指向你。他直視著你的眼睛。

en_text: You see a young man balancing a dagger on the tip of his finger. He tries hard to ignore you.
zh_text: 你看到一個年輕人在指尖上平衡著一把匕首。他努力想忽視你。

en_text: Leavell balances his dagger on his fingertip. In a blur of motion, he snatches it out of the air, pointing at you. He stares you in the eye.
"I do not know what thou art talking about."
"He has an eye like a hawk, and is quicker than a cat. 'Twould be wise of thee to pay him respect."
zh_text: 「他有著像老鷹般銳利的眼睛，而且動作比貓還快。你最好放尊重點。」

en_text: "Har! Har! Thou art too correct, Leavell!"
"If Battles had not spotted that approaching storm we would have all been dead men for certain!"
zh_text: 「如果 Battles 沒有發現那場逼近的風暴，我們肯定早就沒命了！」

en_text: "It took a terrible toll on our boat, but if truth be told I have seen far worse."
zh_text: 「它對我們的船造成了嚴重的破壞，但老實說，我見過更糟的。」

en_text: "I have seen Battles has reflexes faster than a snake."
zh_text: 「我見過 Battles 有著比蛇還快的反應速度。」

en_text: "Yes, I have done things to be put in prison for. But I am not ashamed of my life. I do not have to be held accountable to thee about it."
zh_text: 「是的，我做過一些足以讓我被關進監獄的事。但我對我的生活並不感到羞恥。我也不需要向你交代。」

en_text: "And while thou art about it, thou mayest show respect to me, too." Leavell says with a sneer.
zh_text: 「既然說到這，你也應該對我放尊重點。」Leavell 冷笑著說。

en_text: "Soon we shall return and the money will pour like sweet wine once again, eh, Leavell?"
zh_text: 「很快我們就會回去，錢又會像甜酒一樣湧進來，是吧，Leavell？」

en_text: "Gambling is what Robin does for money. But he spends so much time talking about Lord British that thou wouldst think he was royalty or something!"
zh_text: 「賭博是 Robin 賺錢的方式。但他花了很多時間談論不列顛王，你甚至會以為他是皇室成員還是什麼的！」

en_text: Suddenly Leavell gets an embarrassed look on his face and stops talking.*
zh_text: Leavell 臉上突然露出尷尬的表情，並停止了說話。*

en_text: "We ran into some misfortune the last time we were there. The Mister at the House of Games learned	of Master Robin's system and caused him to lose much of his gold."
zh_text: 「我們上次在那裡遇到了一些不幸。遊戲廳的『先生』得知了 Robin 少爺的作弊系統，讓他輸掉了很多黃金。」

en_text: "Yeh, thou art bloody right we coulda handled him! We'd a slit him like a sheep! Har!" *
zh_text: 「是啊，你說得他媽的太對了，我們能搞定他！我們會像宰羊一樣割斷他的喉嚨！哈！」 *

en_text: "But Gordy had hired a troupe of ruffians to chase after us. 'Tis a pity. I would have liked to teach him a lesson or two. In fact, one day I think I shall."
zh_text: 「但 Gordy 雇了一群暴徒來追捕我們。真可惜。我本來想教訓他一兩頓的。事實上，我想總有一天我會的。」

en_text: "The crew could not believe it! The vessel was almost new. It had sailed all the way from Minoc without a problem. In fact, that was the first storm that ship had ever encountered. None of the crew survived, poor buggers."
zh_text: 「船員們都不敢相信！那艘船幾乎是新的。它從 Minoc 一路航行過來都沒有問題。事實上，那是那艘船遇到的第一場風暴。船員沒有一個活下來，可憐的傢伙們。」

en_text: "Peasant fools and sheep. The only thing worth a second look in this whole town is Constance."
zh_text: 「全是些鄉巴佬蠢貨和羊群。這個鎮上唯一值得多看一眼的就只有 Constance。」

en_text: "Here, what is not one is the other. This place is so isolated that it is backward. What is worse, they prefer it this way!"
zh_text: 「這裡的人不是前者就是後者。這個地方太與世隔絕，所以很落後。更糟的是，他們還喜歡這樣！」

en_text: "She doth put a spring in a man's step! We have our eye on her, we do!" Leavell quickly clears his throat and he looks away from you momentarily.
zh_text: 「她確實能讓男人充滿活力！我們已經盯上她了，沒錯！」Leavell 迅速清了清嗓子，暫時把目光從你身上移開。

en_text: "While I myself have seen no such locket, perhaps thou shouldst ask Master Robin about it."
zh_text: 「雖然我自己沒見過這樣的吊飾盒，也許你應該問問 Robin 少爺。」

en_text: With that Leavell goes back to playing with his dagger.*
zh_text: 說完，Leavell 又回去玩他的匕首了。*

en_text: "Yes, I saw Henry walking past my shop with that locket looking for Constance. It must have been shortly after he received it from Katrina. I remember it because I gave him a flower to give to Constance. Poor fellow, by the time he found her it was all he had to give her."
zh_text: 「是的，我看到 Henry 拿著那個吊飾盒走過我的店，在找 Constance 。那一定是在他從 Katrina 那裡收到它後沒多久。我記得這件事，因為我給了他一朵花讓他送給 Constance 。可憐的傢伙，等他找到她時，那是他唯一能給她的東西了。」

en_text: "The way I perceive it I do not really have a job. I sell flowers to the people of New Magincia. Although I am paid for it, it is something I enjoy doing very much. I wonder, does that still qualify as a job?" He scratches his chin thoughtfully.
zh_text: 「在我看來，我並沒有真正的工作。我賣花給 New Magincia 的人們。雖然我有拿到錢，但這是我非常喜歡做的事。我想知道，這樣還能算是工作嗎？」他若有所思地抓了抓下巴。

en_text: You see a content-looking bearded man, with deep-set laugh lines in his face and gentle eyes.
zh_text: 你看到一位看起來很滿足的蓄鬍男子，臉上有著深深的笑紋和溫柔的雙眼。

en_text: "Hey there, how are things with thee?" says Sam.
"My name is Sam. I am the Flower Man. And what is thy name?"
zh_text: 「我的名字是 Sam 。我是賣花人。你叫什麼名字？」

en_text: "Fine. If thou dost wish to be the Avatar, I will not argue. Thou canst be the Avatar if thou dost want to be."
zh_text: 「好吧。如果你想當聖者，我不會爭辯。如果你想當的話，你就可以當聖者。」

en_text: "I grow all of the flowers that I sell in a greenhouse which is also mine home. I sell a lot of red roses but I have many varieties. If thou art interested in buying some, please say so!"
zh_text: 「我把我賣的所有花都種在一個也是我家的溫室裡。我賣很多紅玫瑰，但我有很多品種。如果你有興趣買一些，請告訴我！」

en_text: "I built my greenhouse by hand. When I am not selling flowers I am engaged in various studies of plants and nature there. I find it fascinating. As thou mayest have noticed, I prefer to grow them big!"
zh_text: 「我親手建造了我的溫室。當我不賣花時，我在那裡從事各種植物和自然的研究。我覺得這很迷人。你可能已經注意到了，我喜歡把它們種得很大！」

en_text: "Presently I am studying possible uses and applications of wheatgrass. One day soon I shall begin compiling my notes but it will require a long effort for there is much that I have learned. It is mostly to support my work that I operate my flower wagon."
zh_text: 「目前我正在研究小麥草可能的用途和應用。很快地，總有一天我會開始整理我的筆記，但這需要漫長的努力，因為我學到了很多。我經營花車主要是為了支持我的工作。」

en_text: "It is because of what I learn in my studies that I may grow my flowers to be so large and healthy."
zh_text: 「正是因為我在研究中學到的東西，我才能把花種得如此巨大和健康。」

en_text: "Actually my business does quite well and I do like the way my flowers brighten the whole place. But who really cares about business anyway, so why shouldst thou ask? Suffice it to say that life is sweet!"
zh_text: 「實際上我的生意很好，我也喜歡我的花點亮整個地方的樣子。但反正誰在乎生意呢，你為什麼要問這個？只要說生活很美好就夠了！」

en_text: "Thou hast enough money as long as thou dost have a place to live and can afford food, so I consider myself a wealthy man. I enjoy a good drink and round of song at the Modest Damsel nightly. I have a thriving business and stimulating work. I consider every resident of this island a good friend. I feel anger towards no one and do not desire anything more. I have never had reason to feel lonely, worried or bored. What else is there? Life is good!"
zh_text: 「只要你有地方住、買得起食物，你就有足夠的錢，所以我認為自己是個富有的人。我每晚在謙遜少女酒館享受美酒和歌聲。我有著興隆的生意和刺激的工作。我把島上的每位居民都當作好朋友。我不對任何人感到憤怒，也不渴望更多。我從來沒有理由感到孤獨、擔憂或無聊。還有什麼比這更好的呢？生活很美好！」

en_text: "There are many pretty ladies on this island and they are in the habit of receiving flowers from the gentlemen they meet. It would cause a dreadful embarrassment if thou didst not have any!
zh_text: 「這島上有許多漂亮的女士，她們習慣從遇見的紳士那裡收到花。如果你沒有花，那會造成可怕的尷尬！」

en_text: "The gentlemen of this island have a peculiarity in their taste in women. They cannot refuse anything of a woman who wears flowers. If thou dost not wear any they will simply ignore thee!"Surely thou dost wish to purchase some?"
zh_text: 「這島上的紳士對女人的品味有個怪癖。他們無法拒絕任何戴著花的女人。如果你沒有戴花，他們只會忽略你！」「你肯定想買一些吧？」

en_text: "The gentlemen of this island have a peculiarity in their taste in women. They cannot refuse anything of a woman who wears flowers. If thou dost not wear any they will simply ignore thee!
zh_text: 「這島上的紳士對女人的品味有個怪癖。他們無法拒絕任何戴著花的女人。如果你沒有戴花，他們只會忽略你！」

en_text: "Surely thou dost wish to purchase some?"
"A bouquet costs 12 gold. Art thou still interested?"
zh_text: 「一束花要 12 枚金幣。你還有興趣嗎？」

en_text: "Thine hands are too full to take the bouquet!"
zh_text: 「你的手太滿了，拿不下這束花！」

en_text: "Thou dost not have the money to buy flowers. But take heart, whenever thou canst afford them, I shall still be selling them."
zh_text: 「你沒有錢買花。但別灰心，只要你買得起，我還是會賣的。」

en_text: "I am afraid that my shop is now closed, but if thou wilt return during business hours, I shall provide the solution to thine apparent floral emergency."
zh_text: 「恐怕我的店現在關門了，但如果你在營業時間回來，我會為你明顯的花卉緊急情況提供解決方案。」

en_text: "There are three strangers on this island that have washed ashore in a shipwreck. Perhaps thou shalt meet them."
zh_text: 「這島上有三個陌生人是在船難中被沖上岸的。也許你會遇見他們。」

en_text: "Why, he sounds like one of those three strangers! I have met him. He talked as if he wanted to buy some flowers but he just walked away. Later I noticed a bouquet of flowers was missing from my wagon. The scoundrel must have pilfered them!"
zh_text: 「唉呀，他聽起來像是那三個陌生人之一！我見過他。他說話的樣子好像想買些花，但他卻直接走開了。後來我發現我的花車上少了一束花。那個無賴肯定把它們偷走了！」

en_text: "He must be one of those shipwrecked visitors we have on our island. Yes, when the three of them came up to my wagon he gave me a stare that sent a chill through my blood. I did my best to ignore him. I absolutely abhor violence."
zh_text: 「他一定是我們島上那些遇船難的訪客之一。是的，當他們三個走到我的花車前時，他瞪了我一眼，讓我背脊發涼。我盡力忽略他。我絕對痛恨暴力。」

en_text: "So that is the name of one of our uninvited guests! When the three of them came to my wagon earlier, he was very friendly while talking to me, but I saw through him. He mentioned noticing Constance, but the others gestured for him to be quiet."
zh_text: 「原來那就是我們不速之客其中之一的名字！稍早他們三個來到我的花車時，他跟我說話時非常友善，但我看穿了他。他提到注意到了 Constance ，但其他人示意他安靜。」

en_text: "I was not born here. I came here as a young man. My father was a nobleman who was more interested in my counting gold than devoting myself to my studies. For a time I travelled the world until I landed here. It is a special place unlike any other in all of Britannia. So while thou art here please help us take good care of it."
zh_text: 「我不是在這裡出生的。我年輕時來到這裡。我的父親是個貴族，他更感興趣的是我數金幣，而不是致力於學習。有一段時間我在世界各地旅行，直到我落腳在這裡。這是一個與不列顛尼亞其他地方都不同的特別之地。所以當你在這裡時，請幫我們好好照顧它。」

en_text: "Next de voice ov Brom says to me "Trust My Brothers". Dis is strange because all ov my brothers are back in Balema, und I vould never trust dem anyvays. Dey vere all bigger den me and vere alvays beating me. But even dat vas not as strange as da next strange ting."
zh_text: 「接下來 Brom 的聲音對我說『信任我的兄弟們（Trust My Brothers）』。這很奇怪，因為我所有的兄弟都在 Balema ，而且我無論如何都不會信任他們。他們都比我大，而且老是欺負我。但就連那個都比不上下一件奇怪的事。」

en_text: "De first strange ting dat he says to me is "Strive For Unity". I say, yah, dat is vhy I am performing mine heroic deeds. Den Brom says someting else dat is strange."
zh_text: 「他說的第一件奇怪的事是『致力合一（Strive For Unity）』。我說，嗨，這正是我在執行英雄壯舉的原因。然後 Brom 又說了另一件奇怪的事。」

en_text: "De voice ov Brom tells me dat "Worldliness Receives Avard". I haf been tinking about dat von for a long time und I still haf not figured it out. But I vill not give up until I find Brom."
zh_text: 「 Brom 的聲音告訴我『價值先行於報償（Worldliness Receives Award）』。我思考那句話很長時間了，還是沒想通。但我不會放棄，直到找到 Brom 。」

en_text: "De voice ov Brom has told me not to trust thee, Avatar," says Gorn. "I tought dat ve vere friends and I do not vish to cause thee harm. But I varn thee, do not speak mit me anymore!"*
zh_text: 「 Brom 的聲音告訴我不能信任你，聖者，」 Gorn 說道。「我以為我們是朋友，我也不想傷害你。但我警告你，不要再跟我說話！」*

en_text: "He is my master, und de master ov all ov de people ov Balema. Brom is all powerful und if I am strong he vill aid me. Sometimes I hear de voice ov Brom inside ov mine head."
zh_text: 「他是我的主人，也是所有 Balema 人的主人。 Brom 無所不能，如果我夠強壯，他就會幫助我。有時候我能在腦海中聽到 Brom 的聲音。」

en_text: Shamino whispers to you. "Luckily, Gorn was hit in the one spot where he has no feeling whatsoever -- his head!"*
zh_text: Shamino 悄聲對你說：「幸好 Gorn 是被打在他唯一沒有感覺的地方——他的腦袋！」*

en_text: Gorn seems distracted for a moment. He places his hand to his ear as if he is listening to something. He looks back at you and there is a shocked look on his face. "I haf just heard de voice ov Brom and he has told me not to trust thee! Go avay from me, Avatar! I tought dat thou vert my friend! I do not vish to speak vith thee anymore!"*
zh_text: Gorn 若有所思地愣了一下。他把手放到耳邊，像是在聆聽什麼。他回過頭看著你，臉上露出震驚的表情。「我剛剛聽到了 Brom 的聲音，他告訴我不能信任你！你從我身邊走開，聖者！我以為你是我的朋友！我不想再和你說話了！」*

en_text: Gorn has a confused look on his face. "Vhy vill thou not help me find Brom? Dost thou tink dat dis is all some kind ov trick, or should I go on looking for Brom by myself?"
zh_text: Gorn 臉上帶著困惑的表情。「你為什麼不幫我找 Brom ？你是覺得這全是某種把戲，還是說我應該繼續獨自尋找 Brom ？」

en_text: Gorn seems distracted for a moment. He puts his hand to his ear as if he is listening to something. He looks back at you with a shocked expression on his face. "I haf just heard de voice ov Brom and he says dat I should not trust thee! I tought dat thou vert my friend, Avatar! Go avay! I do not vish to speak vith thee again!"*
zh_text: Gorn 若有所思地愣了一下。他把手放到耳邊，像是在聆聽什麼。他帶著震驚的表情看著你。「我剛剛聽到了 Brom 的聲音，他說我不該信任你！我以為你是我的朋友，聖者！走開！我不想再和你說話了！」*

en_text: You see a familiar face, a stern-looking bearded warrior whom you have met on one of your previous journeys to Britannia.
zh_text: 你看到一張熟悉的臉，是個嚴肅的大鬍子戰士，你曾在上一次前往不列顛尼亞的旅途中見過他。

en_text: "Ho, Avatar!" says Gorn. "Thou dost vish to speak mit me?"
zh_text: 「嗨喲，聖者！」 Gorn 說道。「你想跟我說話嗎？」

en_text: The warrior's eyes narrow. "I am Gorn, as if thou didst not remember! It is good to see thee again." He laughs and slaps you on the shoulder.
zh_text: 那戰士瞇起眼睛。「我是 Gorn ，好像你不記得了一樣！很高興再次見到你。」他大笑著拍了你的肩膀。

en_text: "My job is a never-ending qvest of high adventure. Ever since I vas a child und vas taken from mine homeland of Balema, I haf spent my life in search of heroic deeds to perform."
zh_text: 「我的職業是永無止境的壯闊冒險之旅。打從我還是個孩子，從我的家鄉 Balema 被帶走，我就用一生在追尋可以執行的英雄壯舉。」

en_text: "Yah, Balema is vere I vas born. I vas a child dere. It is a vonderland ov snow-covered mountains und dark forests. It vas not an easy life, but it vas a place dat made young boys into strong heroic men. Dat vas long before I came to Britannia."
zh_text: 「嗨， Balema 就是我的出生地。我小時候在那裡。那是個由白雪覆蓋的山脈和黑暗森林組成的奇妙之地。那不是輕鬆的生活，但那是個把男孩鍛造成強壯英雄的地方。那是我來到不列顛尼亞之前的事了。」

en_text: "Yah! I came to Britannia t'rough vone ov de Moongates, de same as thee. Dat vas many, many years ago."
zh_text: 「嗨！我穿過一道月之門（Moongate）來到不列顛尼亞，就像你一樣。那是很多很多年前的事了。」

en_text: "I perform heroic deeds in honor ov Brom. Everyting I do is in service to him."
zh_text: 「我以 Brom 的名義執行英雄壯舉。我做的每一件事都是為了服侍他。」

en_text: "Ya! Brom he is my master. If he vishes me to do someting, I must do it! If he does not vant me to do someting, I must not do it!"
zh_text: 「嗨！ Brom 是我的主人。如果他希望我做某事，我就必須做！如果他不想讓我做某事，我就不能做！」

en_text: "Ya! Only recently I haf begun to hear his voice in mine head. His voice tells me vat to do! As I came tovard dis cave de voice ov Brom became clearer."
zh_text: 「嗨！最近我才開始在腦海中聽到他的聲音。他的聲音告訴我該怎麼做！當我走向這個洞穴時， Brom 的聲音變得更清晰了。」

en_text: "Vhen I first heard de voice ov Brom, he told me dat I should follow him. But how does one follow de voice ov someone dat thou cannot see vhen de voice is coming from inside ov thine head?"
zh_text: 「當我第一次聽到 Brom 的聲音時，他告訴我應該跟隨他。但當聲音是從你腦海裡傳來時，要怎麼跟隨一個你看不見的人的聲音呢？」

en_text: "Dis vas very, very difficult for me but after a vhile I vas able to figure out how to do it. Vhen I came nearer to da camp surrounding dis cave da voice vould get louder. Vhen I vould move avay de voice vould be qvieter."
zh_text: 「這對我來說非常、非常困難，但過了一段時間我找到了方法。當我越靠近這個洞穴周圍的營地，聲音就越大。當我遠離時，聲音就越小。」

en_text: "It vas very simple for a trained varrior like myself to slip into de camp ov dose who are holding Brom prisoner. Dey posed no threat vatsoever. So dat means dat de danger must be vaiting down here. But I cannot find it!"
zh_text: 「對像我這樣訓練有素的戰士來說，溜進那些關押 Brom 的人的營地非常簡單。他們根本不構成任何威脅。所以危險一定是在下面等著。但我找不到它！」

en_text: "I can see by dat medallion thou dost vear dat thou hast snuck into dis place by disguising thyself as vone of dem. Very clever, Avatar!"
zh_text: 「我看到你戴著那個徽章，你是偽裝成他們其中之一潛入這裡的。非常聰明，聖者！」

en_text: Iolo whispers to you, "This fellow is quite sharp, is he not?"*
zh_text: Iolo 悄悄對你說：「這個人腦袋很靈光，是吧？」*

en_text: "Zo far de only danger I haf found down here has been a female fighter. She vas beautiful. Vhen I vent to talk to her she hit me over de head mit her svord. Vhen I voke up she vas gone. I bet she tought she had killed me but mine head is harder dan dat. I vas not even vounded."
zh_text: 「迄今為止我在這裡找到的唯一危險，是一個女戰士。她很漂亮。當我去和她說話時，她用劍的劍柄打了我的頭。我醒來後她已經不見了。我打賭她以為已經殺了我，但我的頭比那個硬多了。我甚至沒有受傷。」

en_text: "Hey, vhat are you vhispering about over dere?"*
zh_text: 「嗨，你們在那邊竊竊私語什麼？」*

en_text: "I know dat Brom is somevhere down in dis cave, und I vill not leave dis place until I find him!"
zh_text: 「我知道 Brom 在這個洞穴的某處，在我找到他之前我不會離開這裡！」

en_text: "The nearer I haf come to dis cave, the more times I haf been hearing de voice ov Brom. But lately he has been saying tings to me dat are very, very strange!"
zh_text: 「我越靠近這個洞穴，就越常聽到 Brom 的聲音。但最近他說的話對我來說非常、非常奇怪！」

en_text: "A mysterious voice speaking inside someone's head, suggesting the philosophy of The Fellowship. Does this sound familiar,
zh_text: 「一個神秘的聲音在某人的腦海中說話，宣揚友誼會的理念。聽起來是否很熟悉，
「你願意幫我找到 Brom 嗎？」

en_text: "If dat is how thou vants it. Den I shall go on searching for Brom mit no vone else but myself. Good luck in vhatever qvest thou art on, Avatar. Farewell to thee!"*
zh_text: 「如果你這樣想的話。那我就繼續獨自一人搜尋 Brom 了。祝你在你的任務上好運，聖者。再會！」*

en_text: "Dat is de name ov de female fighter who has been guarding dis place. I haf fought her vonce already. She is a strong fighter! I haf to find her so I can make her to tell me vhere is Brom!"
zh_text: 「那是一直守衛這個地方的那個女戰士的名字。我已經和她打了一仗。她是個強悍的戰士！我必須找到她，讓她告訴我 Brom 在哪裡！」

en_text: "For all the years I've been in Skara Brae, he's been a raving lunatic. What with all o' them silly rhymes and his crazy laughter.
zh_text: 「我在 Skara Brae 的這些年裡，他一直都是個瘋子。伴隨著他那些愚蠢的押韻詩和他瘋狂的笑聲。

en_text: "Then one night, we all hears thunder when there isn't a cloud in the starry sky, and I seem to recall a full moon..." He gets a thoughtful look on his face. "But as I was sayin', there was this thunder, then this deep, dark laughter coming from the tower on the northern point -- Horance's Dark Tower." After this he falls silent for a moment.
zh_text: 「有一天晚上，我們所有人都聽到了雷聲，儘管星空中連一朵雲都沒有，我似乎還記得有滿月……」他的臉上露出深思的表情。「但我剛才說到，先是一陣雷聲，然後從北面岬角的那座塔裡傳來低沉、黑暗的笑聲—— Horance 的黑暗塔。」說完這段話後，他沉默了片刻。

en_text: He looks uncomfortable, "Caine blew the town to the four winds, and now we're all trapped here, slaves of that bastard Horance." Tiny blue flames appear in the pupils of his glazed eyes, then go out as he regains his composure.
zh_text: 他看起來很不自在，「 Caine 把鎮上炸得七零八落，現在我們都被困在這裡，成了那個混蛋 Horance 的奴隸。」他呆滯的瞳孔中出現了微小的藍色火焰，當他恢復鎮定時又熄滅了。

en_text: "Please, Markham. Have a little pity for Caine. He was trying to create something to save the town when he made his fatal mistake." The pale ghost looks deeply troubled.
zh_text: 「拜託， Markham 。對 Caine 有點同情心吧。當他犯下那個致命的錯誤時，他正試圖創造一些東西來拯救這個鎮。」這個蒼白的幽靈看起來深受困擾。

en_text: "That's just the name the rest of us in Skara Brae call him -- the Tortured One," he grins, embarrassed.
zh_text: 「這只是我們其他在 Skara Brae 的人對他的稱呼——受折磨的人。」他尷尬地笑了笑。

en_text: This undead fellow looks through you. Though he is obviously aware of his surroundings, you are quite sure that he doesn't even see you.*
zh_text: 這名不死生物空洞的目光，望向了你。顯然它察覺到了你的存在，但是你非常確定它並未看見你。*

en_text: You attempt to start a conversation with the portly ghost, but he seems distanced from you and everything else.*
zh_text: 你試著與那肥胖的鬼魂攀談，但他似乎對你、以及周遭的一切都顯得極為疏離。*

en_text: The heavy-set ghost looks a bit shaken and his speech is a little slurred as he says, "Excuse me, yer honor. But I got me a splittin' headache. Do ya mind if we continue this little chat later?"
zh_text: 這位發福的幽靈看起來有些不安，他說話有點含糊不清，「不好意思，大人。但我頭痛得厲害。你介意我們晚點，再繼續這個小小的談話嗎？」

en_text: He begins to rub his temples with both hands.*
zh_text: 他開始用雙手揉著太陽穴。*

en_text: "Oh, hello there, lady Rowena. 'Tis good to see ye again. It brings a ray o' sunshine into this old man's heart ta see yer beauteous face," he says, smiling.*
zh_text: 「喔，你好，Rowena 女士。很高興再次見到妳。看到妳美麗的容顏，讓我這老頭子的心裡照進了一縷陽光。」他微笑著說。*

en_text: She curtsies delicately and smiles back.
zh_text: 她優雅地屈膝行禮並報以微笑。

en_text: "Hello, Markham. It is good, indeed, to see that none of this horrible business can keep thee from giving a lady a compliment."*
zh_text: 「你好， Markham 。很高興看到這些可怕的事情都無法阻止你對一位女士的讚美。」*

en_text: "Oh, uh, hello there Mayor. I thought ye were sequestered in the Town Hall. Well, uh, it's good ta see ya again."*
zh_text: 「喔，呃，你好啊，鎮長。我還以為你一直躲在鎮政廳裡呢。嗯，呃，很高興再次見到你。」*

en_text: "Yes, well, it is good to see thee again, too."*
zh_text: 「是的，嗯，也很高興再次見到你。」*

en_text: The corpulent, undead barkeep greets you with a wide, gruesome smile. "Come, stranger. Have a seat near old Markham and tell me o' yer travels. I don't often get visitors in here anymore."

en_text: "I should go to the Salty Dog and see Polly." Thurston stares off into space for a few moments, his eyes are big and he has a moony expression on his face. Suddenly, he snaps back to reality. "Excuse me, thou wert saying something?"
