zh_text: 「你把袋子交給 Thurston。他打開它，把手伸進去。他的手拿出來時抓滿了小麥。他用手指篩了篩。『我知道 Camille 經營農場經常很忙。謝謝你幫忙送貨。』」

en_text: "I have no wife or family. I have thought about joining The Fellowship, but I refuse. I have nothing but my work, and a drink at the Salty Dog now and then."
zh_text: 「我沒有妻子或家人。我曾經考慮過加入友誼會，但我拒絕了。我除了工作，就只有偶爾在 Salty Dog 喝杯酒。」

en_text: You relate to Thurston what Polly had said about him. He looks at you with joyous surprise. "Did Polly really say these things?! It is ridiculous that she believes I am too good for her!" Suddenly he forgets his work and starts hurrying around in excitement. "For years I have loved this woman from afar. I will begin courting her immediately!"
zh_text: 「你向 Thurston 轉述了 Polly 對他說的話。他帶著驚喜的表情看著你。『Polly 真的這麼說嗎？！她認為我對她來說太好了，這太荒謬了！』突然他忘記了工作，興奮地四處走動。『多年來我一直遠遠地愛著這個女人。我會立刻開始追求她！』」

en_text: You see a man covered in the sweat of a hard day's work.
zh_text: 「你看到一個因為一天辛勤工作而渾身是汗的男人。」

en_text: "I operate the mill here in Paws."
zh_text: 「我在 Paws 這裡經營磨坊。」

en_text: "The local economy depends upon the mill for flour. So I ensure that the mill runs. Sometimes, I feel that keeping the wheels turning is the only reason to live."
zh_text: 「當地經濟依賴磨坊提供麵粉。所以我確保磨坊運轉。有時候，我覺得保持輪子轉動是活著的唯一理由。」

en_text: "A sack will cost thee 12 gold. Art thou interested in purchasing some?"
zh_text: 「一袋要價 12 枚金幣。你有興趣買一些嗎？」

en_text: "Here it is," he says, handing you the sack. "Wouldst thou wish another?"*
"Thou hast not the room for this sack."
"Thou hast not the gold for this,

zh_text: 「磨坊目前關閉了。如果你願意等它重新開張時再來，我很樂意賣給你所有你能拿得動的麵粉。」

en_text: "The mill is closed at present. If thou wouldst please return when it is open again I would gladly sell thee all the flour thou canst carry."
zh_text: 「如果你沒注意到，住在這兒的人沒有他們住在不列顛城的親戚那麼富裕。事實上，我們最近甚至發生了一起竊盜案。」

en_text: "In case thou hadst not noticed, the people who live here are not so well off as their cousins who live in Britain. In fact, we have even had a theft recently."

zh_text: 。這鎮上有個小偷！一位名叫 Morfin 的商人，被偷了幾瓶珍貴的銀蛇毒液。」

en_text: . There is a thief in this town! Morfin, a merchant, had several vials of valuable silver snake venom stolen."
zh_text: 「它是從銀蛇身上取得的。我相信在過去，石像鬼習慣性地使用它。我不太確定它對人類會有什麼影響。也許 Morfin 可以告訴你更多。」

en_text: "It is procured from the Silver Serpent. I believe Gargoyles used it habitually in the old days. I am not so sure what it might do to a human. Perhaps Morfin can tell thee more."
zh_text: 「我已經付過你一次送貨費了。我不會再付一次的。」

en_text: "I have paid thee once for thy delivery. I shall not do so again."
zh_text: 「這應該能補償你的辛勞。」他遞給你十枚金幣。

en_text: "This should compensate thee for thy trouble." He hands you ten gold pieces.
zh_text: 「這真是個謎！Camille 答應今天某個時候送小麥給我，而且已經晚了。我想知道它會在哪裡。」

en_text: "'Tis a puzzlement! Camille promised to make a delivery of wheat to me sometime today and it is late. I wonder where it could be."
zh_text: 「我知道他們在鎮上做了很好的工作，但他們身上就是有些東西讓我感到不舒服。」

en_text: "I know they do good work here in town, but there is just something about them that makes me uncomfortable."
zh_text: 「他注意到你的友誼會徽章，急忙清了清嗓子。『無意冒犯，

en_text: He notices your Fellowship medallion and hurriedly clears his throat. "No offense intended,

zh_text: 「說實話，我去那裡更多是為了靠近旅館老闆 Polly，而不是為了喝酒。但我肯定她總是在忙著照顧酒吧，沒有時間理我。」

en_text: "In truth, I go there more to be near Polly, the innkeeper, than for the wine. But she is always busy tending bar and has no time for me, I am sure."
zh_text: 「我想感謝你告訴我關於 Polly 對我感覺的真相。我一直經營這個該死的磨坊，真是個死腦筋，如果她背上貼著告示，我可能也永遠不會注意到！這正是我開始享受生活所需要的幫助！」

en_text: "I want to thank thee for telling me the truth about Polly's feelings about me. I can be such a stick in the mud running this bloody mill all of the time that I would never have noticed it if she were wearing a sign on her back! This is just what I needed to help me start enjoying my life!"
"They would be Morfin, Andrew, Thurston, and Beverlea."
"I run the Fellowship shelter with my wife Brita and my son Garritt here in Paws."
zh_text: 「我和我的妻子 Brita 以及兒子 Garritt 在 Paws 這裡經營友誼會的庇護所。」

en_text: "Oh. Them. Komor and Fenn." Feridwyn rolls his eyes.
zh_text: 「喔。他們。Komor 和 Fenn。」Feridwyn 翻了翻白眼。

en_text: "I am so sorry! Thou hast just missed them! Elizabeth and Abraham were here delivering funds, but they have gone now to Jhelom. There is currently no Fellowship branch there, so they are taking the Triad of Inner Strength to lands west!"
zh_text: 「我很抱歉！你剛好錯過他們了！Elizabeth 和 Abraham 在這裡遞送資金，但他們現在已經去了 Jhelom。那裡目前沒有友誼會分會，所以他們要把內在力量的三位一體帶到西方的土地上！」

en_text: "Avatar! Oh Avatar! I have news!""Garritt, my son, told me that Tobias was in possession of some silver snake venom. I went to investigate and found Tobias with it!"*

en_text: "Garritt, my son, told me that Tobias was in possession of some silver snake venom. I went to investigate and found Tobias with it!"*

en_text: "I have often said that Tobias was no good. Now here is proof. He is the thief that has been praying upon one of our honest merchants! And to think I let him come into contact with my son! en_text: "That would be Camille and her son Tobias."
zh_text: 「那就是 Camille 和她的兒子 Tobias。」

en_text: "Our residents include Alina and her child, and Merrick."
zh_text: 「我們的居民包括 Alina 和她的孩子，以及 Merrick。」

en_text: "I have not seen Elizabeth and Abraham for many days now."
zh_text: 「我已經很多天沒見過 Elizabeth 和 Abraham 了。」

en_text: "Fenn is a beggar who refuses all aid from The Fellowship. A pathetic case. Not even his former friend Merrick can reach him any more."
zh_text: 「Fenn 是一個拒絕友誼會所有援助的乞丐。一個可悲的案例。連他以前的朋友 Merrick 都無法再接觸到他。」

en_text: "Thank goodness Garritt, my sharp eyed boy, got to the bottom of this business of the snake venom thefts. Frankly, I had my suspicions about Tobias myself."
zh_text: 「謝天謝地，我那眼尖的男孩 Garritt 查清了這起蛇毒竊案的真相。坦白說，我自己也懷疑過 Tobias。」

en_text: You realize that the Cube did not bring out anything that Feridwyn did not actually believe himself. He is one of the innocent followers of The Guardian.
zh_text: 「你意識到這個方塊，並沒有引出任何 Feridwyn 自己不相信的東西。他是 Guardian 那些天真的追隨者之一。」

en_text: "Avatar! Didst thou know that the merchant Morfin had a quantity of silver serpent venom stolen? This theft has caused the community no small amount of distress."
zh_text: 「聖者！你知道商人 Morfin 被偷了一批銀蛇毒液嗎？這起竊案給社區帶來了不小的困擾。」

en_text: "That is correct! I am a witness that what Feridwyn has said is the truth!"*
zh_text: 「沒錯！我是見證人，Feridwyn 說的是實話！」*

en_text: You see a small man with twisted, sloped posture. He looks you up and down before deciding he will speak to you.
zh_text: 「你看到一個身形矮小，姿勢扭曲傾斜的男人。他上下打量你後，才決定跟你說話。」

en_text: "I had gotten word that thou wert coming to our town. I have been expecting thee. I must admit, though, that I find it difficult to believe that thou art truly the Avatar."
zh_text: 「我得到消息說你要來我們的鎮上。我一直期待著你。但我必須承認，我很難相信你真的是聖者。」

en_text: "Thou dost wish to speak with me again, Avatar?" says Feridwyn.
zh_text: 「你想再跟我說話嗎，聖者？」Feridwyn 說。

en_text: "Gentle Avatar, it is good of thee to come to our humble town. Thou canst well see that The Fellowship has much work to do if it is to alleviate the suffering of the unfortunate of Britannia."
zh_text: 「你還不明白，透過友誼會的指引，你的生活可以得到多大的改善。」

en_text: "This is the only place in all of Britannia designed for the aid and care of the poor. It is hard work, but then one strives to be worthy of that which we wish to receive."
zh_text: 「溫和的聖者，你來我們這個簡陋的小鎮真是太好了。你很清楚，如果要減輕不列顛尼亞不幸者的痛苦，友誼會還有很多工作要做。」

en_text: "A wonderful woman. Thou shouldst meet her."
zh_text: 「這是全不列顛尼亞唯一一個為援助和照顧窮人而設的地方。這是一項艱苦的工作，但我們努力使自己配得上我們想要得到的東西。」

en_text: "Mine husband is such a flatterer. The truth is that our work for The Fellowship has brought us closer together."*
zh_text: 「一位很棒的女人。你應該見見她。」

en_text: "As thou dost already know my wife Brita, I am certain thou wilt agree that thou couldst not find a more dedicated practitioner of The Fellowship's teachings."
zh_text: 「我丈夫真是個馬屁精。事實是，我們為友誼會所做的工作讓我們更親近了。」*

en_text: "Thankfully, we have been able to raise our son properly by emphasizing the teachings of The Fellowship. Garritt shall not be trapped in the poverty of his surroundings. He shall be intellectually, spiritually, and morally superior. He's talented, too!"
zh_text: 「既然你已經認識我的妻子 Brita，我敢肯定你會同意，你找不到比她更致力於友誼會教義的實踐者了。」

en_text: "He plays the whistle panpipes extremely well for a lad his age! Brita and I are very proud. He could probably attend The Music Hall in Britain when he is older!"
zh_text: 「幸運的是，透過強調友誼會的教義，我們能夠適當地撫養我們的兒子。Garritt 不會被周圍的貧困困住。他將在智力、精神和道德上更加優越。他還很有才華呢！」

en_text: "As this is a small town with few privileges and little privacy, our family has come to know everyone in Paws quite well. Is there someone thou dost wish to hear about? I am well acquainted with these people."
zh_text: 「以他這個年紀的男孩來說，他把排笛吹得非常好！Brita 和我都很驕傲。當他長大後，他或許能進入不列顛城的音樂廳！」

en_text: "She is a nearly blind elderly woman who runs the antique shoppe on the east side of the river."
zh_text: 「因為這是一個沒有什麼特權，也沒什麼隱私的小鎮，我們家對 Paws 的每一個人都相當了解。有你想聽聽關於誰的事嗎？我對這些人很熟悉。」

en_text: "Her husband is currently in Britain somewhere. I do not know the details. She has a small child."
zh_text: 「她是一位幾乎失明的年長婦女，在河東岸經營古董店。」

en_text: "Thurston owns the mill. He could do better if he ran his business with more of an eye toward profit."
zh_text: 「她的丈夫目前在不列顛城的某個地方。我不知道詳情。她有一個小孩子。」

en_text: "She's a sad woman -- a widow -- who is living in the past. 'Tis a pity, really. Fortunately her husband left her the farm which does happen to turn a profit."
zh_text: 「Thurston 擁有磨坊。如果他經營事業時能多著眼於利潤，他可以做得更好。」

en_text: "A splendid example of The Fellowship turning someone's life around. Presently he resides in our shelter."
zh_text: 「她是個悲傷的女人——一個寡婦——活在過去。真是可惜。幸運的是她丈夫留給她的農場的確還有盈利。」

en_text: "Morfin is a clever and industrious member of The Fellowship. He runs the local slaughterhouse and is also a snake venom merchant."
zh_text: 「這是一個友誼會徹底改變某人生活的好例子。目前他住在我們的庇護所裡。」

en_text: "Andrew is such a happy young man. He doth not notice the myriad of personal problems that he is afflicted with."
zh_text: 「Morfin 是一個聰明勤奮的友誼會成員。他經營當地的屠宰場，也是個蛇毒商人。」

en_text: "A local rascal. I normally would not allow Garritt to associate with such a troublemaker, but The Fellowship has taught me to be a tolerant parent. Besides, associating with my son might do the lad some good. Who knows?"
zh_text: 「Andrew 是一個非常快樂的年輕人。他沒有注意到自己身上有著無數的個人問題。」

en_text: "No matter that Tobias did not personally steal the venom himself. He caused the theft by means of his corrupting influence on my son. While his actions are just short of criminal, I still blame Tobias."
zh_text: 「當地的流氓。我通常不會允許 Garritt 跟這樣的麻煩製造者交往，但友誼會教我要做個寬容的父母。此外，跟我的兒子交往可能會對那小夥子有些好處。誰知道呢？」

en_text: "Komor is the most hateful man I have ever met. He is a bundle of bitterness. In all the time I have known him, Komor has never spoken a word to me that was not at best a thinly veiled insult."
zh_text: 「不管 Tobias 有沒有親自偷毒液。我兒子就是被他帶壞的，因此發生這起竊案。雖然他的行為還不到犯罪的程度，我還是怪罪 Tobias。」

en_text: "Thankfully we can now put this business of snake venom thefts behind us, thanks to thy thorough efforts. I shall deal with my son. Let us speak of this no more."
zh_text: 「Komor 是我見過最可恨的人。他就是個滿腹怨氣的結合體。在我們認識的時間裡，Komor 對我說的每一句話，充其量也不過是層薄薄偽裝的侮辱。」

en_text: "Morfin, the local merchant, informs me that a quantity of silver serpent venom was stolen from him. The thief is still at large, so be wary! Of course, I do not know why anyone would want the vile substance. It is surely not good for one's health."
zh_text: 「幸好有你徹底的努力，我們現在可以把這起蛇毒竊案拋在腦後了。我會處理我兒子的。我們別再談這件事了。」

en_text: "I promise thee, I shall apply the necessary discipline to my son to insure that this bad habit he has picked up from the local riffraff will not trouble this community again."
zh_text: 「當地的商人 Morfin 告訴我，他的一批銀蛇毒液被偷了。小偷仍在逃，所以要小心！當然，我不知道為什麼會有人想要這種邪惡的物質。這對健康肯定沒好處。」

en_text: "Thou didst find the venom vial in Garritt's belongings? I am amazed! I am astonished! I am-- sorry."
zh_text: 「我向你保證，我會對我的兒子施加必要的管教，以確保他從當地小混混那裡沾染的壞習慣，不會再給這個村子帶來麻煩。」

en_text: "Thou art a resourceful person. Unfortunately, thy discovery has upset me a great deal."
zh_text: 「你在 Garritt 的物品中發現了裝毒液的小瓶？我很驚訝！我大為震驚！我……很抱歉。」

en_text: "Thou dost say my son has admitted to stealing the venom?! I do not know what to say. My thanks, Avatar, for uncovering the truth."
zh_text: 「你真是個足智多謀的人。不幸的是，你的發現讓我非常難過。」
「你說我兒子承認偷了毒液？！我不知道該說什麼。感謝你，聖者，揭開了真相。」

en_text: "Camille is a farm widow. She tends to live in the past, following the old virtues and questioning the ways of The Fellowship. These country folk are so superstitious, thou knowest. zh_text: 「Camille 是一個農場寡婦。她傾向於活在過去，遵循舊有的美德並質疑友誼會的做法。你知道的，這些鄉下人很迷信。這是他們智力低下造成的。她甚至沒有注意到她的兒子 Tobias 長大後變成了什麼樣的流氓！完全不像我們的兒子 Garritt。」

en_text: "I help mine husband Feridwyn run The Fellowship's shelter in Paws."
zh_text: 「我幫我丈夫 Feridwyn 經營友誼會在 Paws 的庇護所。」

en_text: Brita beams. "Garritt is a wonderful son. He is being raised to follow the values of The Fellowship. His worthiness has been rewarded."
zh_text: 「Brita 喜笑顏開。『Garritt 是一個很棒的兒子。他正在被撫養長大以遵循友誼會的價值觀。他的價值得到了回報。』」

en_text: A stern-looking woman stares back at you without humor.
zh_text: 「一個表情嚴厲的女人毫不幽默地盯著你看。」

en_text: "Mine husband is a good man who devotes himself selflessly to helping the poor of this town, something they do not appreciate. He is a good man and a dutiful Fellowship member."
zh_text: 「我丈夫是個好人，他無私地奉獻自己來幫助鎮上的窮人，而他們卻毫不感激。他是個好人，也是個盡責的友誼會成員。」

en_text: "Mine husband is the most honorable man I have ever met in my life."
zh_text: 「我丈夫是我這輩子見過最可敬的人。」

en_text: "Do not put stock in the proud boasts of wives, good Avatar. I am a simple man who only does what he can."*
zh_text: 「別相信妻子驕傲的自誇，善良的聖者。我只是一個盡己所能的普通人。」*

en_text: "Thou shouldst speak to mine husband of The Fellowship. I am certain thou wilt be most impressed by what he shall have to tell thee."
zh_text: 「你應該跟我丈夫談談友誼會的事。我敢肯定你對他要告訴你的事會印象深刻的。」

en_text: "Seeing that thou hast joined The Fellowship only confirms what I already know. That The Fellowship is the path by which we shall lead Britannia to a wonderful new future. News that thou hast joined us is spreading far and wide!"
zh_text: 「看到你加入了友誼會，只是證實了我早已知道的事。那就是友誼會是我們帶領不列顛尼亞邁向美好新未來的道路。你加入我們的消息正在四處傳開！」

en_text: "Running the shelter is hard work for mine husband and me, but it is worth the effort to ease the suffering of those less fortunate than we."
zh_text: 「經營庇護所對我丈夫和我來說是項艱苦的工作，但為了減輕那些比我們不幸的人的痛苦，這是值得的。」

en_text: "We hear about everything that goes on in Paws. If I do not know about it then mine husband does. Is there anyone in particular thou dost wish to know about?"
zh_text: 「我們聽說了 Paws 發生的一切。如果我不知道，那我丈夫也一定知道。有你想特別了解的人嗎？」

en_text: "It is good to determine an impression of others on one's own."
zh_text: 「自己決定對他人的印象是件好事。」

en_text: "Alina lives in the shelter with her baby, poor thing. Her husband is a common thief who even now sits in prison. But we shall help her get her life straightened out once we persuade her to join The Fellowship. She is not smart enough, thou knowest, to see the advantages for herself. She must be carefully instructed."
zh_text: 「Alina 和她的孩子住在庇護所裡，可憐的東西。她的丈夫是個普通的小偷，現在還在監獄裡。但一旦我們說服她加入友誼會，我們就會幫助她把生活整頓好。你知道的，她不夠聰明，看不出這對她有什麼好處。必須仔細指導她。」

en_text: "A simply wretched little urchin. Always sulking. But then, one must realize that he has no father to discipline him properly."
zh_text: 「一個非常可憐的小鬼。總是悶悶不樂。但是，必須了解到他沒有父親來好好管教他。」

en_text: "Thou dost say that vial of venom was found in Garritt's belongings? I do not believe it! Art thou saying my son is a liar and a thief? I wilt not believe it! Good day to thee!"*
zh_text: 「你說在 Garritt 的物品中發現了那瓶毒液？我不相信！你是說我兒子是個說謊者和小偷嗎？我不會相信的！祝你有個美好的一天！」*「所以 Garritt 承認他偷了毒液瓶。我簡直不敢相信！我不知道該說什麼。」

en_text: "So Garritt admits he stole the venom vial. I cannot believe it! I do not know what to say."
zh_text: 「你說在 Garritt 的物品中發現了那瓶毒液？我不相信！你是說我兒子是個說謊者和小偷嗎？我不會相信的！祝你有個美好的一天！」*

en_text: Brita frowns even more than before. "If thou dost ask me, 'twas all a plot to get my little boy in trouble. If thou had not come to town, this entire incident would not have happened!"
zh_text: 「所以 Garritt 承認他偷了毒液瓶。我簡直不敢相信！我不知道該說什麼。」

en_text: "Garritt is so talented at the whistle panpipes! It is truly a gift!"
zh_text: 「Brita 皺眉皺得比以前更厲害了。『如果你問我，這全是一個讓我小男孩惹上麻煩的陰謀。如果你沒有來鎮上，這整個事件就不會發生！』」

en_text: "Polly runs the local tavern to be near people. She is a lonely soul and feels that there is simply no one who wishes for her heart. It makes me so sad to think of her. She could find all the companionship she could want if she would join The Fellowship."
zh_text: 「Garritt 在吹排笛方面太有天賦了！這真是一份禮物！」

en_text: "One of our members, a local merchant named Morfin, had a shipment of silver serpent venom stolen from him. Not that I care about the venom itself, but is it not shocking?"
zh_text: 「Polly 經營當地酒館是為了靠近人群。她是一個孤獨的靈魂，覺得根本沒有人渴望她的心。想到她就讓我好難過。如果她加入友誼會，她就能找到所有她想要的陪伴。」

en_text: "I have never seen any myself. I have no idea what it does to someone, but it cannot possibly be good!"
zh_text: 「我們的一名成員，當地商人 Morfin，被偷了一批銀蛇毒液。雖然我不在乎毒液本身，但這難道不令人震驚嗎？」

en_text: "Mayest thou walk with The Fellowship, Avatar."*
zh_text: 「我自己從沒見過。我不知道它對人有什麼作用，但它絕對不可能是好東西！」

en_text: You see a simple peasant woman. Her face is etched with sorrow.
zh_text: 「你看到一個單純的農婦。她的臉上刻滿了悲傷。」

en_text: , save for being the mother of my child. I am waiting for mine husband, Weston, to return from Britain."
zh_text: 。除了作為我孩子的母親，我正在等我丈夫 Weston 從不列顛城回來。」

en_text: "Cassie is my daughter. Just a wee babe, she is mine only joy."
zh_text: 「Cassie 是我的女兒。還只是個小嬰兒，她是我唯一的快樂。」

en_text: ! Mine husband was pardoned by Lord British. He even provided Weston with short-term employment so that he may return to me with money enough in his pockets to feed us for some time!
zh_text: ！我丈夫被不列顛王赦免了。他甚至為 Weston 提供了短期的工作，這樣他就能口袋裡帶著足夠養活我們一段時間的錢回到我身邊！

en_text: "Mine husband is imprisoned in Britain for stealing fruit from the Royal Orchards."
zh_text: 「我丈夫因為偷了皇家果園的水果被關在不列顛城的監獄裡。」

en_text: . He went there to buy fruit for the child and me so that we would have enough to eat. He has been wrongfully accused, I am certain of it!"
zh_text: 。他去那裡是為了給孩子和我買水果，這樣我們才有足夠的食物吃。他被冤枉了，我肯定！」

en_text: "We are very poor. My baby and I are presently living in the Fellowship shelter because we have nowhere else to go."
zh_text: 「我們非常窮。我的寶寶和我目前住在友誼會的庇護所裡，因為我們無處可去。」

en_text: "It was a member of The Fellowship that has accused mine husband. Now they wish for me to join them."
zh_text: 「是指控我丈夫的一名友誼會成員。現在他們希望我加入他們。」

en_text: "Mine husband is innocent, I know it!. He intended to buy the fruit. Why must I join thy society in order for me to be taken at my word?"
zh_text: 「我丈夫是無辜的，我知道！他原本是想買水果的。為什麼我必須加入你們的社團，你們才肯相信我的話？」

en_text: "We are fortunate that we are able to live by The Fellowship's good graces, but I do not know how long we will be allowed to stay."
zh_text: 「我們很幸運能靠著友誼會的恩典生活，但我不知道我們被允許住多久。」

en_text: "I cannot join The Fellowship without feeling that I am betraying mine husband. How could I become one of those who have falsely accused him? Yet, if I do not, they will not allow my child and me to live here."
zh_text: 「我覺得如果我加入友誼會，就是在背叛我的丈夫。我怎麼能成為那些誣告他的人之一？然而，如果我不加入，他們就不會允許我的孩子和我住在這裡。」

en_text: She sobs and covers her face with her hands. "It is so unfair. I must choose between starvation and betrayal. If only Weston were here. I do not know what to do!"
zh_text: 她抽泣著，雙手摀住臉。「這太不公平了。我必須在挨餓和背叛之間做出選擇。要是 Weston 在這裡就好了。我不知道該怎麼辦！」

en_text: "They say if I join they will attempt to free mine husband. But it was they who unjustly accused him. I cannot trust them, but I fear I may have no choice."
zh_text: 「他們說如果我加入，他們會試圖釋放我丈夫。但是他們不公正地指控了他。我無法信任他們，但我擔心我可能別無選擇。」

en_text: "They tell me the shelter is only for members of The Fellowship. Unless I join soon, I shall be asked to leave. And I have nowhere else to go."
zh_text: 「他們告訴我，庇護所只對友誼會成員開放。除非我盡快加入，否則我會被要求離開。而且我無處可去。」

en_text: "I was a farmer; of course, that was before the seven year drought. Komor, Fenn and myself were reduced to paupers."
zh_text: 「我曾經是個農夫；當然，那是在七年乾旱之前。Komor、Fenn 和我淪為了窮光蛋。」

en_text: "Fenn was a farm laborer, and one of Komor's most trusted friends. With the farm gone Fenn just did not have any place to go or any way to live."
zh_text: 「Fenn 是個農場勞工，也是 Komor 最信任的朋友之一。農場沒了，Fenn 就無處可去，也無法生存了。」

en_text: "For years Komor, Fenn and I lived off of the rubbish of others, sleeping by the side of the road. Then I found The Fellowship and my life was changed for the better. I have tried to share my newfound fortune with my friends but I fear they hate me for being more resourceful than they."
zh_text: 「多年來，Komor、Fenn 和我靠著別人的垃圾為生，睡在路邊。然後我找到了友誼會，我的生活變得更好了。我試圖與我的朋友們分享我新找到的財富，但我擔心他們因為我比他們更有辦法而恨我。」

en_text: "Thou art a most pathetic little worm. Really, all this Avatar nonsense is nothing more than a sad plea for attention."*
zh_text: 「你真是個最可悲的小蟲子。真的，所有這些關於聖者的胡言亂語不過是為了引起注意的可悲乞求。」*

en_text: "I used to be a farmer here in Paws. Now I suppose I work for the Fellowship. I live in their shelter."
zh_text: 「我曾經是 Paws 這裡的農夫。現在我想我是為友誼會工作。我住在他們的庇護所裡。」

en_text: "I do most humbly apologize to thee,
"I heard that Garritt was the one who stole the venom. Hmm! And to think I live under the same roof with the hoodlum. I shall have to guard my belongings more."
zh_text: 「我聽說是 Garritt 偷了毒液。哼！想想看，我竟然和這個小流氓住在同一個屋簷下。我必須更加小心看管我的物品。」

en_text: "I have lived here in Paws all my life. I will not leave it now. I shall never leave."
zh_text: 「我一輩子都住在 Paws 這裡。我現在不會離開。我永遠不會離開。」

en_text: "I have heard that some of Morfin's venom hath been stolen. I cannot imagine who would do it, unless it was that brat that lives with the farmer widow."
zh_text: 「我聽說 Morfin 的一些毒液被偷了。我無法想像誰會這麼做，除非是那個和農場寡婦住在一起的臭小子。」

en_text: "He once owned one of the largest farms in all of Britannia. He was born to wealthy parents. After he lost his farm he took to sleeping along the road. One night a gang of bullies wanted to steal his gold. He had none so they beat him until he was lame. He is a very bitter man. Tragic."
zh_text: 「他曾經擁有全不列顛尼亞最大的農場之一。他出生於富裕的家庭。失去農場後，他開始睡在路邊。一天晚上，一群惡霸想搶他的金幣。他沒有，所以他們把他打成了瘸子。他是個充滿怨恨的人。真悲慘。」

en_text: "I am Garritt, the son of Feridwyn and Brita."
zh_text: 「我是 Garritt，Feridwyn 和 Brita 的兒子。」

en_text: "I stole the venom from Morfin so I could put the blame on Tobias."
zh_text: 「我從 Morfin 那裡偷了毒液，這樣我就可以把責任推給 Tobias。」

en_text: "I do not know why Morfin has it or what he does with it. I only knew that it was valuable and that it would cause everyone worry if it were stolen."Garritt does not meet your eyes. You instinctively know he is not telling the truth and may very well be using the venom.
zh_text: 「我不知道 Morfin 為什麼有那東西，也不知道他用來做什麼。我只知道它很有價值，如果被偷了會讓每個人都擔心。」Garritt 避開了你的目光。你本能地知道他沒有說實話，而且很可能正在使用毒液。

en_text: You see a jovial young man who gives you a friendly greeting.
zh_text: 你看到一個開朗的年輕人向你友善地打招呼。

en_text: "I am too young to learn a trade of mine own yet, but I do assist my parents in running the shelter. I hope to be a counselor in The Fellowship one day. Or a professional whistle panpipes player."
zh_text: 「我還太小，無法學習自己的手藝，但我確實協助我的父母經營庇護所。我希望有一天能成為友誼會的顧問。或者是專業的排笛手。」

en_text: "My father works for The Fellowship helping the poor people in Paws. He tries to recruit them, but most refuse."
zh_text: 「我父親為友誼會工作，幫助 Paws 這裡的窮人。他試圖招募他們，但大多數人都拒絕了。」

en_text: "Actually, I do not like this town very much. The people here are all poor and the only one mine own age is Tobias."
zh_text: 「其實，我不太喜歡這個城鎮。這裡的人都很窮，和我同年紀的只有 Tobias。」

en_text: "And," he adds, "there is a thief here."
zh_text: 「而且，」他補充道，「這裡有個小偷。」

en_text: "I have been playing panpipes since I was little. I'm pretty good now, if I say so myself! I keep the whistle by my bed and practice every night before going to sleep!"
zh_text: 「我從小就開始吹排笛了。如果我自己說的話，我現在吹得滿好的！我把笛子放在床邊，每天睡前都會練習！」

en_text: "I may not have told the truth about Tobias stealing the venom, but I know that he is up to no good. He shall come to a bad end, just thou wait and see!"
zh_text: 「我可能沒有說出關於 Tobias 偷毒液的真相，但我知道他不懷好意。他會有壞下場的，你等著看吧！」

en_text: "He and his mother reject The Fellowship. They are witless and stupid and I do not like them."
zh_text: 「他和他的母親拒絕友誼會。他們既無知又愚蠢，我不喜歡他們。」

en_text: "I have said it a thousand times. Tobias is weak of character! He and his mother are poor because they are lazy. Now I am proven right because Tobias is a thief. A thief who has been caught!"
zh_text: 「我已經說過一千次了。Tobias 性格軟弱！他和他的母親很窮是因為他們很懶惰。現在證明我是對的，因為 Tobias 是個小偷。一個被抓住的小偷！」

en_text: "My father was once the head recruiter in Britain until they moved him here. I once heard him talking to mother about how The Fellowship was wasting its time here."
zh_text: 「我父親曾經是不列顛城的首席招募員，直到他們把他調來這裡。我曾聽他對母親說，友誼會在這裡是浪費時間。」

en_text: "My father says that the poor people reject The Fellowship because the Triad of Inner Strength requires strength of character."
zh_text: 「我父親說窮人拒絕友誼會，是因為內在力量的三位一體需要堅強的品格。」

en_text: "My father says the poor are weak of character and that is why they are poor. They do not have to be. They are just too lazy to work. Dost thou agree?"
zh_text: 「我父親說窮人品格軟弱，這就是他們貧窮的原因。他們不必這樣。他們只是太懶得工作了。你同意嗎？」

en_text: "I was not so sure, but since that is what my father says, it must be true."
zh_text: 「我本來不太確定，但既然我父親這麼說，那一定是真的。」

en_text: "Hmpf. For a Fellowship member, thou dost lack recognition. Thou dost not understand the teachings of The Fellowship."
zh_text: 「哼。作為一個友誼會成員，你缺乏認知。你不了解友誼會的教義。」

en_text: "Then thou must be a person of weak character, also."
zh_text: 「那麼你也必定是個品格軟弱的人。」

en_text: "Oh, she is just my mother. She does whatever my father doth tell her to do."
zh_text: 「喔，她只是我的母親。我父親叫她做什麼，她就做什麼。」

en_text: "Plenty of beds are available if thou wouldst like to stay in the shelter," he says with a condescending tone.
zh_text: 「如果你想住在庇護所裡，有足夠的床位可供使用，」他用居高臨下的語氣說道。

en_text: "I am a member and I am proud to say I recruit for them as well."
zh_text: 「我是一名成員，我很自豪地說我也為他們招募。」

en_text: "Oh, I can tell thee all thou dost need to know about us!"
zh_text: 「哦，我可以告訴你關於我們所有你需要知道的事！」

en_text: "I am also quite knowledgeable when it comes to our philosophy. We follow the Triad of Inner Strength and do let personal failures get in our way or slow us down.""Dost thou want to join?"
zh_text: 「談到我們的理念，我也相當了解。我們遵循內在力量的三位一體，不讓個人的失敗阻礙我們或拖累我們。」「你想加入嗎？」

en_text: "I am also quite knowledgeable when it comes to our philosophy. We follow the Triad of Inner Strength and do let personal failures get in our way or slow us down."
zh_text: 「談到我們的理念，我也相當了解。我們遵循內在力量的三位一體，不讓個人的失敗阻礙我們或拖累我們。」

en_text: "Thou hast found me out! Yes, it was I who planted the venom on Tobias. He did deserve it! I beg thee, please do not tell my parents!"
zh_text: 「你發現我了！是的，是我把毒液栽贓給 Tobias 的。他是罪有應得！我求求你，請不要告訴我父母！」

en_text: "I do not know why Morfin has it or what he does with it. I only knew that it was valuable and that it would cause everyone worry if it were stolen."
zh_text: 「我不知道 Morfin 為什麼有那東西，也不知道他用來做什麼。我只知道它很有價值，如果被偷了會讓每個人都擔心。」

en_text: Garritt does not meet your eyes. You instinctively know he is not telling the truth and may very well be using the venom.
zh_text: Garritt 避開了你的目光。你本能地知道他沒有說實話，而且很可能正在使用毒液。

en_text: Garritt shuffles his feet and frowns. "Well... I tried it just once. I am sorry. I will never use it again."
zh_text: Garritt 拖著腳步並皺起了眉頭。「好吧……我只試過一次。對不起。我再也不會用了。」

en_text: "I thought that if Tobias were accused of stealing something that everyone would notice, his mother would join The Fellowship and force him to join, too. It would improve their lives and force them to see the truth about themselves."
zh_text: 「我認為如果 Tobias 被指控偷了大家都會注意到的東西，他的母親就會加入友誼會並強迫他也加入。這將改善他們的生活，並迫使他們看清自己的真相。」

en_text: "But I, like thee, am a member of The Fellowship. Thou must stand in unity with me for what I tried to do!"
zh_text: 「但我，像你一樣，是友誼會的成員。對於我試圖做的事，你必須與我團結一致！」

en_text: "Thou art weak of character! Or otherwise thou wouldst understand what I tried to do!"
zh_text: 「你品格軟弱！否則你會明白我試圖做的事！」

en_text: "I thank thee most enthusiastically! It will be our little secret then."
zh_text: 「我非常熱情地感謝你！那這就是我們的小秘密了。」

en_text: "There is a thief in this town! Our merchant Morfin had some valuable silver serpent venom stolen from him. The culprit is still free. So be wary!"
zh_text: 「這個鎮上有個小偷！我們的商人 Morfin 被偷了一些珍貴的銀蛇毒液。罪犯還在逃。所以要小心！」

en_text: "I do suppose my ventures are profitable enough for me to afford to move to Britain, but things are so much less expensive here. Of course, the theft has me a bit wary.
zh_text: 「我想我的生意賺的錢足夠讓我搬到不列顛城了，但這裡的東西便宜多了。當然，這起竊盜案讓我有點警惕。

en_text: "If thou dost wish to know more about the people here, speak to the couple who run the Fellowship shelter, Feridwyn and Brita."

en_text: "I have a sextant that was sold by the world-famous shipwright Owen of Minoc. They are going to be building a monument to him, I understand. en_text: You see an old woman who gives you a smile of grandmotherly sweetness. You can see immediately that her vision is poor.
zh_text: 「你看到一位老婦人，她對你露出祖母般甜美的微笑。你可以立刻看出她的視力很差。」

en_text: . It is so good to see thee!" says Beverlea.
"Why, I run the House of Items here in Paws."
zh_text: 「哎呀，我在 Paws 這裡經營雜貨鋪。」

zh_text: 「這是一間賣古董和二手物品的雜貨鋪。經營這家商店讓我保持年輕和活力。能把東西賣給鎮上那些原本買不起的窮人，令人感到欣慰。」

en_text: "Here in Paws the people have very little money, but it matters not, because they care for each other."
zh_text: 「在 Paws 這裡，人們雖然沒什麼錢，但這不重要，因為他們彼此關心。」

zh_text: 「在我的店裡可以買到許多稀有精美的東西。全不列顛尼亞其他地方都找不到的便宜貨。」

zh_text: 「我的店現在打烊了。我通常在下午營業。」

zh_text: 「讓我想想……有一個搖籃要賣。一匹搖馬。一個鈴鐺。一個沙漏。一個痰盂。一把魯特琴。一個六分儀……既然我最近動作慢了點，我就讓客人自己幫忙，拿走他們買的東西。當然，前提是他們先付錢。我信任大家會付給我正確的金額。恐怕我幾乎快瞎了。」

zh_text: 我想也許她不想提起，是因為鎮上有那麼多人屬於友誼會。而且也因為那會讓她傷心。」

en_text: "Dost thou not know a farm when thou dost see one?"
"Surely thou canst find the farm. It is just north of the shelter."
zh_text: 「你一定找得到農場。它就在庇護所的北邊。」

en_text: Tobias looks at you as if he thinks you are a bit dim.
zh_text: Tobias 看著你，好像覺得你有點遲鈍。

en_text: "She sells grain to Thurston the miller from time to time so that we may go to the pub or buy milk at the dairy every once in a while, but we usually just grow crops to keep ourselves fed."
zh_text: 「她有時會把穀物賣給磨坊主人 Thurston，這樣我們偶爾就可以去酒館，或者在乳製品廠買牛奶，但我們通常只是種農作物來養活自己。」

en_text: "It's that place just south of here. It's run by The Fellowship."
zh_text: 「就是這裡南邊的那個地方。是友誼會經營的。」

en_text: "He is one of the few people in town that I like. He is nice to us."
zh_text: 「他是我在鎮上少數喜歡的人之一。他對我們很好。」

en_text: "The dairy is south of the shelter. Andrew -- the man who runs the dairy -- his father was friends with my father."
zh_text: 「乳製品廠在庇護所的南邊。Andrew ——經營乳製品廠的人——他父親是我父親的朋友。」

en_text: For the first time he looks you in the eye. "I hate The Fellowship! The only other person in town mine own age is that cretin Garritt and it is all he ever talks about! He is always trying to convince my mother to join." He clenches his fist angrily. "Please do not mention them again."
zh_text: 他第一次直視你的眼睛。「我討厭友誼會！鎮上唯一和我同年紀的人就是那個白痴 Garritt，而他嘴裡總是掛著這個！他總是試圖說服我母親加入。」他憤怒地握緊拳頭。「請不要再提他們了。」

en_text: "Those bloody Fellowship people know that everyone is never more than a meal away from being penniless. They say that they want us to join immediately because the shelter is intended to help only Fellowship members. If we ever need to live there they may have to turn us away in favor of other Fellowship members."
zh_text: 「那些該死的友誼會的人知道每個人距離身無分文永遠只有一餐之遙。他們說要我們立刻加入，因為庇護所是為了幫助友誼會成員而設的。如果我們有一天需要住在那裡，他們可能會為了其他友誼會成員而把我們拒之門外。」

en_text: "I do not know anything about the stolen venom. I am falsely accused!"
zh_text: 「我對被偷的毒液一無所知。我是被誣陷的！」

en_text: "That is right! Garritt did it. I just know it. He was in my room the other day when I came in from the fields. He said he was looking for a ball, but I do not believe him. Thou canst believe me or not, I do not care. But if thou art truly the Avatar, thou wilt know I am telling the truth."
zh_text: 「沒錯！是 Garritt 幹的。我就是知道。那天我從田裡回來時他在我房間裡。他說他在找一顆球，但我不相信他。你信不信我，我不在乎。但如果你真的是聖者，你就會知道我說的是實話。」

en_text: , for not believing I was the guilty one. I am not sure if thou art truly the real Avatar but thou dost certainly have the way of the Avatar about thee."
zh_text: ，謝謝你沒有相信我是有罪的。我不確定你是否真的是聖者，但你身上確實有聖者之道的影子。」

en_text: "He is the only other boy in town anywhere near mine age. His parents do not want him playing with me because they think that 'associating with those kind of people' will 'hamper his education' or some such rubbish. I cannot stand the little bastard. And I hate the way he plays those stinking whistle panpipes!"
zh_text: 「他是鎮上唯一和我年紀相仿的男孩。他父母不想讓他和我玩，因為他們認為『和那種人交往』會『阻礙他的教育』之類的廢話。我受不了那個小混蛋。我討厭他吹那種臭排笛的樣子！」

en_text: "That spoiled brat Garritt must have planted the venom in my room! He is usually lounging about, even if his parents disapprove of him playing with me. I know he is up to something no good! Thou shouldst look in HIS room!"
zh_text: 「那個被寵壞的臭小子 Garritt 一定是把毒液栽贓到我房間了！他通常都在閒逛，即使他父母反對他和我玩。我知道他不懷好意！你應該去搜他的房間！」

en_text: "Be on thy way then, o great and wise Avatar."*
zh_text: 「那就上路吧，偉大又充滿智慧的聖者。」*

en_text: "The owner and proprietor of the Salty Dog, the finest eating and drinking establishment in all of Paws, at thy service."
zh_text: 「我是 Salty Dog 鹹狗酒館——整個 Paws 最好吃好喝的場所——的老闆和經營者，為你服務。」

en_text: "However, the Salty Dog is now closed. Please return during business hours."
zh_text: 「然而，Salty Dog 現在打烊了。請在營業時間再來。」

en_text: You relate to Polly what you heard Thurston say about her. She is taken completely by surprise. "Thurston really said that about me! I have always liked him, but in truth I have always thought I was not good enough for him!"
zh_text: 「你向 Polly 轉述了你聽到 Thurston 說關於她的話。她完全驚呆了。『Thurston 真的那麼說我嗎！我一直很喜歡他，但老實說，我一直覺得自己配不上他！』」

en_text: You see the town bartender. She looks very busy, but she obviously takes pride in her work.
zh_text: 「你看到鎮上的酒館老闆娘。她看起來很忙碌，但她顯然為自己的工作感到自豪。」

en_text: Polly smiles. "What can I do for thee,
zh_text: Polly 笑了笑。「我能為你做什麼，

en_text: "I am Polly. It is a pleasure to meet thee."
"For but 5 gold thou canst let one of our lovely rooms. Dost thou wish to stay here for the night?"
zh_text: 「只要 5 枚金幣，你就可以租用我們一間可愛的房間。你想在這裡過夜嗎？」

en_text: "Here is thy key for this inn. 'Twill only work once."
zh_text: 「這是這間客棧的鑰匙。只能使用一次。」

en_text: , thou must lose some of thy bundles before I can give thee thy key."
zh_text: ，你必須放下一些行囊，我才能把鑰匙給你。」

en_text: , but the rooms cost more gold than thou hast."
zh_text: ，但這房間的費用超過你擁有的金幣。」

en_text: "Actually, there are no other inns or pubs in Paws. It is a small place, but our food and drink here is quite good, honestly."
zh_text: 「事實上，Paws 沒有其他的客棧或酒館了。這是一個小地方，但老實說，我們這裡的食物和飲料相當不錯。」

en_text: "There is a thief in this town! Silver serpent venom was stolen from Morfin, the merchant who operates the slaughterhouse."
zh_text: 「這個鎮上有個小偷！經營屠宰場的商人 Morfin 被偷了銀蛇毒液。」

en_text: "He used to be a farmer. He is not a bad sort. He has just had a bad run of luck. Now he is a devout Fellowship member."
zh_text: 「他曾經是個農夫。他人不壞。他只是運氣不好。現在他是個虔誠的友誼會成員。」

en_text: "Morfin is a very shrewd and successful merchant, and also a Fellowship member, but I cannot help but feel that he would sell his own mother if he could get the right price for her. 'Tis little wonder why the thief chose to steal from him."
zh_text: 「Morfin 是個非常精明且成功的商人，也是個友誼會成員，但我忍不住覺得，如果價錢合適，他連自己的母親都會賣掉。難怪小偷會選擇偷他的東西。」

en_text: "Mine own Orb of the Moons exploded recently! To no longer be able to travel via Moongates. To be strange!"
zh_text: 「我自己擁有的月之寶珠 (Orb of the Moons) 最近爆炸了！再也無法透過月之門旅行了。真奇怪！」

en_text: ~"To especially regret selling my Ethereal Ring."
zh_text: ~「特別後悔賣掉了我的以太戒指 (Ethereal Ring) 。」

en_text: "To be a shame. To be taking the news to Teregus of his youngling. To be wondering why we had not heard from Inamo recently."
zh_text: 「真是個遺憾。會把這個消息帶給 Teregus 。還在納悶為什麼最近都沒聽到 Inamo 的消息。」

en_text: "To tell you that his weanling, Inamo, is in Trinsic at this time."
zh_text: 「告訴你他的孩子， Inamo ，現在在 Trinsic 。」

en_text: "To inform you that The Fellowship is directed by two winged brethren. To be called Runeb and Quan."
zh_text: 「通知你，友誼會由兩位有翼弟兄領導。叫做 Runeb 和 Quan 。」
「很高興再次見到你，老朋友。這麼快又需要 Draxinusom 了？」

en_text: You see an aged gargoyle, bent and withered, with a regal bearing. He smiles gently.
zh_text: 你看到一位年邁的石像鬼，身軀彎曲枯槁，卻帶著一種王者的風範。他溫和地笑了笑。

en_text: "To be good to see you again, old friend. To be needing Draxinusom again so soon?"
"To have been many years. To be your old acquaintance,

"To ask about Job? To be unable to say that I truly have one at this time. To notice how the young ones no longer look to me for guidance any more. To look more to Teregus, or, more often, to those in The Fellowship."
zh_text: 「問起職業？目前無法說我真的有一份職業。注意到年輕人不再向我尋求指導了。更多是去找 Teregus ，或者，更常見的是去找友誼會裡的人。」

en_text: "To be quite comfortable for our needs. To be, however, unfortunate that it was thought necessary to isolate us from the humans. To have engendered resentment and tension in our younger generations. To remember not the old days, my friend -- the days when we had to work together to survive." He smiles, reliving old memories, then shakes his head.
zh_text: 「對我們的需求來說相當舒適。然而，不幸的是，人類認為有必要將我們隔離起來。這在我們的年輕一代中引發了怨恨和緊張。他們不記得過去的日子，我的朋友——我們必須共同努力才能生存的日子。」他笑了笑，重溫著往昔的記憶，然後搖了搖頭。

en_text: "To have had to give up many much when we moved."
zh_text: 「我們搬遷時不得不放棄很多東西。」

en_text: "To have been many favorite possessions. To be too much trouble to move so much." He sighs.
zh_text: 「有很多最喜歡的財產。搬運這麼多東西太麻煩了。」他嘆了口氣。

en_text: "Ah. To be, indeed, a lovely treasure. To have been quite useful. A shame to have been, really, to have had to sell it. To have been one of my favorites."
zh_text: 「啊。確實是一件可愛的寶物。曾經非常有用。真的，不得不賣掉它真是個遺憾。曾經是我最喜歡的寶物之一。」

en_text: "To have sold most of my treasures when we were... uh... asked, shall to say, to move to the island. To have all happened rather quickly, you see. To have sold most to the Sultan of Spektran."
zh_text: 「當我們被……呃……可以說是被要求搬到這座島上時，賣掉了我大部分的寶物。這一切都發生得相當快，你看。大部分都賣給了 Spektran 的蘇丹。」

en_text: "To have seemed nice enough, for a human. To be a bit mad, he is, even for a human. To tell you he lives on an island just to the west of us. To know, at least, that my prized possessions would be safe in his hands."
zh_text: 「對人類來說，他看起來夠好。即使以人類的標準來看，他也有點瘋狂。告訴你，他住在我們西邊的一個島上。至少我知道，我珍貴的財產在他手上會很安全。」

en_text: He nods his head. "To be rumored to have one of the best-guarded vaults in all of Britannia. To be supposedly enchanted. To know not details."
zh_text: 他點點頭。「據說擁有全不列顛尼亞防守最嚴密的金庫之一。據說是被附魔過的。不知道細節。」

en_text: "To be a fine young gargoyle. To have been raised by Teregus, keeper of the altars. To have left town because of the tension between the altar worshippers and The Fellowship. To have been angry and distrustful of The Fellowship. To have news of him?"
zh_text: 「是個優秀的年輕石像鬼。由祭壇看守者 Teregus 撫養長大。因為祭壇崇拜者與友誼會之間的緊張關係而離開了城鎮。對友誼會感到憤怒且不信任。有他的消息嗎？」

en_text: "To be excellent! To have seen him? To know how he is faring? To be well?"
zh_text: 「太好了！你見過他？知道他過得怎樣嗎？好嗎？」

en_text: "Ah. To be too bad. To tell you Teregus wanted to know how he was doing."
zh_text: 「啊。太糟糕了。告訴你， Teregus 想知道他過得怎樣。」

en_text: "To be very good. To know Teregus will be pleased to learn that, as well!"
zh_text: 「非常好。知道 Teregus 聽到這個消息也會很高興的！」

en_text: "To be terrible news! To have been such a fine gargoyle. To know Teregus will be heartbroken. To be wishing not for him to grieve, but to take to him the news immediately. To be better to hear it from you."
zh_text: 「真是個壞消息！他是個這麼好的石像鬼。知道 Teregus 一定會心碎。希望他不要太傷心，但你應該立刻把消息帶給他。由你來告訴他會比較好。」

en_text: "To be truly a fine young gargoyle. To be one of the most sensible, too. To have seen fit to adhere to the old ways, the ways of the altars. To see that some of the youngest still look up to him, but the majority seem to have been wooed away by the glamor of The Fellowship."
zh_text: 「確實是個優秀的年輕石像鬼。也是最明理的之一。選擇堅持古老的方式，祭壇的方式。看到一些最年輕的仍然仰慕他，但大多數似乎都被友誼會的魅力吸引走了。」

en_text: "To know not what to think of them and their tenets. To seem not dangerous, but not to be following the old ways, the ways of Passion, Diligence, and Control. To feign worship to the shrines here in Terfin, of course, especially to Control, but not yet to trust them. To wait and see. To have forceful leaders who espouse doctrines of submission." He shrugs.
zh_text: 「不知道該如何看待他們和他們的教義。似乎不危險，但沒有遵循古老的方式，也就是熱情、勤勉和控制的方式。當然，假裝崇拜 Terfin 的神殿，特別是控制神殿，但還不能信任他們。等著瞧吧。有著強勢的領袖擁護著屈服的教義。」他聳了聳肩。

en_text: "To be genuinely inspired, perhaps, and perhaps not."
zh_text: 「也許真的受到了啟發，也許沒有。」

en_text: "To mean, in your language, `Red Mist'. To have been given that name because that is all he leaves behind of an adversary in battle. Before his conversion by The Fellowship, to have been known as a particularly cruel and dangerous gargoyle."
zh_text: 「在你們的語言中，意思是『紅色迷霧』。之所以被賦予這個名字，是因為這就是他在戰鬥後留給對手的一切。在被友誼會改變之前，被認為是個特別殘忍且危險的石像鬼。」

en_text: "Ah, to be an interesting one. To be a strong, powerful personality, to be from one of the families most able to claim noble lineage in our society. To have been always most self-serving, striving only to gain status and wealth for himself. To have certainly changed his tune since joining The Fellowship. To have my doubts, however, that his goals have changed as well."
zh_text: 「啊，是個有趣的人。擁有強大有力的性格，來自我們社會中最能宣稱擁有高貴血統的家族之一。一直都非常自私，只努力為自己獲取地位和財富。自從加入友誼會後，他的態度的確改變了。然而，我懷疑他的目標是否也改變了。」

en_text: "To bid farewell, old friend. To not be hesitating to return if there is aught else I can do for you. To be lonely here now for an old gargoyle dedicated to the ancient ways..."*
zh_text: 「道別了，老朋友。如果還有什麼我能為你做的，請毫不猶豫地回來。對於一個致力於古老傳統的老石像鬼來說，這裡現在很孤單……」*

en_text: "To tell you Forbrak knows much about Terfin and its residents, and," he says, "about its conflicts."
zh_text: 「告訴你 Forbrak 對 Terfin 和其居民了解很多，而且，」他說，「也了解這裡的衝突。」

en_text: The gargoyle has a pleasant expression on his face.
zh_text: 這位石像鬼臉上帶著愉快的表情。

en_text: "To be pleased at your return, human," says Inforlem.
zh_text: 「很高興你回來了，人類，」 Inforlem 說。

en_text: "To train others in Terfin to be strong and powerful. To sell some weapons, also."
zh_text: 「訓練 Terfin 的其他人變得強壯有力。也賣一些武器。」

en_text: "To sell during shop hours. To ask you to come back to me at that time, please."
zh_text: 「在營業時間才販售。請你在那時再來找我。」

en_text: "To be a better warrior or mage?"
zh_text: 「想成為更好的戰士還是法師？」

en_text: "To train during training hours. To ask you to come back to me at that time, please."
zh_text: 「在訓練時間才進行訓練。請你在那時再來找我。」

en_text: "To charge 50 gold for each training session. To be all right?"
zh_text: 「每次訓練收費 50 金幣。還好嗎？」

en_text: "To apologize, but I must charge that amount!"
zh_text: 「很抱歉，但我必須收取這個金額！」

en_text: "To charge 50 gold for each training session. To be acceptable?"
zh_text: 「每次訓練收費 50 金幣。可以接受嗎？」

en_text: "To apologize, but I must charge that amount!"
zh_text: 「很抱歉，但我必須收取這個金額！」

en_text: "To know of the conflicts between the altars and the Fellowship, but to have no information. To suggest you see Quan, The Fellowship leader here and ask him."
zh_text: 「知道祭壇和友誼會之間的衝突，但沒有任何情報。建議你去找這裡的友誼會領袖 Quan 問他。」

en_text: "To see there are troubles here, but to be unaware of the causes and solutions."
zh_text: 「看出這裡有麻煩，但不知道原因和解決方法。」

en_text: "To expect to see you again, human."*
"To tell you to seek out Draxinusom, human, or Forbrak. To have much information about Terfin."
zh_text: 「告訴你去找 Draxinusom ，人類，或是 Forbrak 。他們有許多關於 Terfin 的情報。」

en_text: "To be our leader. To live near the Hall of Knowledge."
zh_text: 「是我們的領袖。住在知識大廳 (Hall of Knowledge) 附近。」

en_text: "To be called Inmanilem, human. To wish information about Terfin?"
zh_text: 「我叫做 Inmanilem ，人類。想知道關於 Terfin 的情報嗎？」

en_text: You are greeted by a friendly gargoyle.
zh_text: 一位友善的石像鬼向你打招呼。

en_text: "To see you are doing well, human," says Inmanilem.
zh_text: 「看到你過得很好，人類，」 Inmanilem 說。
「在石像鬼語中是『治癒者』的意思。」

en_text: "To feel sorry, but to be busy with other things now. To ask you to come back when I have the time to heal you."
zh_text: 「感到抱歉，但現在正忙於其他事情。請你有空再來，我才有時間為你治療。」

en_text: "To be the tavernkeeper. To be very strong of body, and of mind."
zh_text: 「是酒館老闆。身心都非常強壯。」

en_text: "To be the city of gargoyles. To be the one of two towns where many gargoyles live. To like it here," he adds, smiling.
zh_text: 「是石像鬼的城市。是許多石像鬼居住的兩個城鎮之一。喜歡這裡，」他笑著補充。

en_text: "To tell you the other is called Vesper. To be in the desert in northeastern Britannia. To have also humans living there, unlike here."
zh_text: 「告訴你另一個叫 Vesper 。位於不列顛尼亞東北方的沙漠中。不像這裡，那裡也有人類居住。」

en_text: "To be where the three altars of singularity are kept."
zh_text: 「是保存三個單一性祭壇的地方。」

en_text: "To be Passion, Control, and Diligence. To be the values that most gargoyles hold as the key of our existence."
zh_text: 「是熱情、控制和勤勉。這是大多數石像鬼視為我們存在關鍵的價值觀。」

en_text: He nods his head emphatically. "To be quite similar to the human concept of virtues."
zh_text: 他用力地點點頭。「非常類似於人類美德的概念。」

en_text: "There is a rival now -- The Fellowship. To know not if it is good or bad, but to know I do not follow it!"
zh_text: 「現在有了一個競爭對手——友誼會。不知道它是好是壞，但我知道我不會追隨它！」

en_text: "To know only of one dissatisfied gargoyle. To have always been problem, but now acting hostile and aggressive. To be named Silamo, the gardener.
zh_text: 「只知道一個不滿的石像鬼。一直都是個麻煩，但現在變得充滿敵意和攻擊性。名字叫做園丁 Silamo 。
建議你去跟 Silamo 談談。」

en_text: "To be glad that Quan is now running our branch. To believe that he is misguided, but to be a much more reasonable gargoyle to deal with now that Runeb is gone."
zh_text: 「很高興現在是 Quan 在管理我們的分會。相信他是被誤導了，但在 Runeb 離開後，他是個講理得多的石像鬼。」

en_text: "To be wary of Fellowship ideals. To be ignoring the altars in their search for unity, and to be losing respect for the old ways. To be not bad. To tell you our branch is run by Quan and Runeb."
zh_text: 「對友誼會的理想保持警惕。在追求團結的過程中忽視了祭壇，並失去了對古老傳統的尊重。還算不壞。告訴你我們的分會是由 Quan 和 Runeb 管理的。」

en_text: You see a winged gargoyle in his physical prime.
zh_text: 你看到一隻正值壯年的有翼石像鬼。

en_text: "Hail, human! To be welcome to the house of the altars. To be helpful to you in any way?"
zh_text: 「向你致敬，人類！歡迎來到祭壇之屋。有什麼我可以幫忙的嗎？」

en_text: "To have returned! To be glad to see you again, human," says Teregus. "To be welcome to the house of the altars. To be helpful to you?"
zh_text: 「回來了！很高興再次見到你，人類，」 Teregus 說。「歡迎來到祭壇之屋。需要什麼幫助嗎？」

en_text: "To be caring for the altars of Control, Passion, and Diligence. To be a position of great responsibility. To be especially important in these times of trouble."
zh_text: 「負責照顧控制、熱情和勤勉的祭壇。是個責任重大的職位。在這個動盪的時期尤其重要。」

en_text: "To have been many disagreements in town lately. To be much tension between the followers of the principles of the altars and the followers of The Fellowship. To have heard rumors of threats to the altars."
zh_text: 「最近鎮上有很多分歧。祭壇原則的追隨者與友誼會追隨者之間關係非常緊張。聽到過威脅祭壇的謠言。」

en_text: "To be sorry that we have lost Runeb. Perhaps to be for the best. To be certainly overjoyed to have avoided damage to the altars."
zh_text: 「為失去 Runeb 感到遺憾。或許這樣最好。但肯定很高興能避免祭壇受到破壞。」

en_text: "To have heard that someone in town is planning to destroy the physical representations of the altars. To be not the same, of course, as actually destroying the basic principles of Control, Passion, and Diligence, but to be bad for us nonetheless. To be finding out for us who is planning this, if there is time, perhaps. To return to me with evidence when you determine course of action. To be very grateful for your assistance."
zh_text: 「聽說鎮上有某人計畫破壞祭壇的物理實體。當然，這與實際摧毀控制、熱情和勤勉的基本原則不同，但對我們來說依然是件壞事。如果有時間的話，或許能幫我們查出是誰在策劃這件事。當你決定行動方針時，帶著證據回來找我。會非常感謝你的協助。」

en_text: "To have brought me something, some evidence about the rumors?"
zh_text: 「給我帶來了什麼，關於那些謠言的證據嗎？」

en_text: "To have found nothing yet? Ah, well. To return, please, when anything unusual is found. To suggest that you confront the suspect as soon as you have a clue. To wish to stop him before any damage is done to the altars."
zh_text: 「還沒找到什麼嗎？啊，好吧。如果發現任何異常，請回來。建議你一有線索就與嫌疑人對質。希望能在他對祭壇造成破壞之前阻止他。」

en_text: "To be sad to have lost Quan to The Fellowship, human. To have been a good gargoyle when young, but to have fallen into bad company later. To have concentrated mostly on self-aggrandizement and hedonism in the last few years. To be a shame."
zh_text: 「為失去 Quan 給友誼會感到悲傷，人類。年輕時是個好石像鬼，但後來誤入歧途。過去幾年主要專注於自我膨脹和享樂主義。真是個遺憾。」

en_text: "To have been a sad case. To have wished to have been able to save him. To always have been uncontrollable, but to have gotten worse in the last few years. To have seemed to want to start as many fights as possible. To have found a reason for using his strength against all those weaker when to have joined The Fellowship."
zh_text: 「真是個悲慘的案例。希望曾經能夠拯救他。一直都難以控制，但過去幾年變得更糟了。似乎想盡可能地挑起爭端。加入友誼會後，找到了理由將力量對付所有較弱的人。」

en_text: He smiles sadly, but with obvious pride.~
zh_text: 他帶著悲傷的微笑，卻明顯流露出驕傲。~

en_text: "To have been a fine young gargoyle. The pride of us all. To wish to know who was responsible for his dishonorable end."
zh_text: 「曾經是個優秀的年輕石像鬼。我們所有人的驕傲。希望知道是誰導致了他不光彩的結局。」

en_text: "To miss him greatly. To have raised him from an egg. To have been rather vocal in his disagreements with The Fellowship. To have felt it safer for him to leave."
zh_text: 「非常想念他。從他還是一顆蛋的時候就撫養他。他曾相當直言不諱地表達對友誼會的不滿。覺得他離開會比較安全。」

en_text: He sighs, then looks up hopefully.
zh_text: 他嘆了口氣，然後滿懷希望地抬起頭。

en_text: "To be not well? To be terrible! To think there is anything to do to help?"
zh_text: 「不好？太糟糕了！有什麼我可以幫忙的嗎？」

en_text: "Ah. Too bad. To be waiting long for news from him."
zh_text: 「啊。太可惜了。等他的消息等了很久。」

en_text: "To be too late? To mean what by too late? To tell me what has happened!"
zh_text: 「太遲了？太遲了是什麼意思？告訴我發生了什麼事！」
他看起來非常心煩意亂。

en_text: He takes a step back, stunned by the news.
zh_text: 他退了一步，被這個消息驚呆了。

en_text: "To be murdered? To be unbelievable. To have no real enemies!"
zh_text: 「被謀殺？難以置信。他沒有真正的敵人啊！」

en_text: "To tell me, please, exactly what happened."
zh_text: 「請告訴我，究竟發生了什麼事。」

en_text: You relate to him the particulars of Inamo's death. He sighs again.
zh_text: 你向他講述 Inamo 死亡的細節。他再次嘆息。

en_text: "To be such a waste of gargoyle life. To be grateful if you would send news if you discover who was responsible for wanting him dead."
zh_text: 「這真是白白浪費了石像鬼的生命。如果你發現是誰想要他死，請務必通知我，我會非常感激。」

en_text: He is quiet for a few moments, getting accustomed to the situation.
zh_text: 他安靜了片刻，試圖適應這個情況。

en_text: "To apologize. To need some time to grieve. Please to come back later."
zh_text: 「很抱歉。我需要一些時間來哀悼。請晚點再來。」

en_text: "To be caretaker and group leader for the altars of the three principles. To wish to make a donation?"
zh_text: 「是三項原則祭壇的管理員和負責人。想要捐款嗎？」

en_text: "To be an excellent choice. To meditate at the shrine for you for a donation of 5 gold. To be willing to donate 5 gold?"
zh_text: 「是個極好的選擇。捐獻 5 枚金幣就能為你在神殿冥想。願意捐獻 5 枚金幣嗎？」

en_text: "To not have 5 gold? To return	later when you have the gold. To meditate for your success on your journeys."
zh_text: 「沒有 5 枚金幣？等你有了金幣再回來吧。為你旅途的成功冥想。」

en_text: "Ah. To have misunderstood. To apologize. To let me know if you change your mind."
zh_text: 「啊。誤會了。向你道歉。如果你改變主意請讓我知道。」

en_text: "To tell you goodbye for now, human. To return and be welcome."*
zh_text: 「現在先向你道別，人類。歡迎再回來。」*
「請問你需要什麼？」 Runeb 說。

en_text: The gargoyle, obviously in a hurry, ignores you.*
zh_text: 這隻石像鬼顯然趕時間，對你不理不睬。*

en_text: The gargoyle gives you a menacing glare. Judging by his size, he would make a formidable foe.
zh_text: 這隻石像鬼狠狠地瞪著你。從他的體型來看，他絕對是個可怕的對手。

en_text: "To ask what you need?" says Runeb.
"To have a branch here. To meet at usual time each night."
zh_text: 「在這裡有一個分會。每天晚上在平時的時間開會。」

en_text: "To have more important things to do now. To ask me later, human."
zh_text: 「現在有更重要的事情要做。晚點再問我，人類。」

en_text: "To be sorry you know that. To need now to kill Sarpling." He grins at you.
zh_text: 「很遺憾你知道了這件事。現在必須殺了 Sarpling 。」他對你咧嘴一笑。

en_text: He waits for you to leave before he returns to what he was doing.*
zh_text: 他等你離開後才繼續原本的工作。*

en_text: An almost gleeful expression fills his visage.
zh_text: 他的臉上充滿了幾乎是高興的表情。

en_text: "To be very similar to the altar of singularity. To have three principles called the Triad of Inner Strength. To apply three principles in unison to be more creative and happy.
zh_text: 「非常類似於單一性祭壇。有三個被稱為內在力量的三位一體 (Triad of Inner Strength) 的原則。和諧地應用這三個原則會變得更有創造力且更快樂。

en_text: "To see the similarity? To have control, passion, and diligence mesh into one -- singularity. To have Triad -- Strive for Unity, Trust your Brother, and Worthiness Precedes Reward -- applied in unison!"
zh_text: 看見其中的相似處了嗎？控制、熱情與勤勉交織成一體——單一性 (singularity) 。這三位一體 (Triad) ——努力團結、信任你的兄弟、善有善報——和諧地應用在一起！」

en_text: "To suggest talking to Runeb, the Fellowship clerk, or Quaeven. To have jobs needing knowledge of others in Terfin." He grins apologetically.
zh_text: 「建議你跟友誼會的店員 Runeb ，或者是 Quaeven 談談。他們的工作需要了解 Terfin 裡的其他人。」他歉意地笑了笑。

en_text: "To be too busy to know all in Terfin."
zh_text: 「太忙了，無法認識 Terfin 的所有人。」

en_text: "To talk to Runeb, Sarpling, and Quaeven."
zh_text: 「去和 Runeb 、 Sarpling 和 Quaeven 談談。」

en_text: "To have just missed the human Fellowship officials who were here collecting funds. To have left for the Meditation Retreat near Serpent's Hold. To be sorry."
zh_text: 「剛好錯過了來這裡收集資金的人類友誼會官員。他們已經前往 Serpent's Hold 附近的冥想靜修處。很遺憾。」

en_text: The gargoyle seems to be too busy conducting the Fellowship meeting to speak with you now.
zh_text: 這隻石像鬼似乎忙著主持友誼會會議，現在沒空跟你說話。

en_text: You see a winged gargoyle. Noticing you, he turns and says, "To be welcome, human. To need assistance?"
zh_text: 你看到一隻有翼石像鬼。注意到你之後，他轉過身說，「歡迎你，人類。需要協助嗎？」

en_text: "To ask how I may assist, human."
"To have no meaning in Gargish. To be a special name, specific to me," he smiles.
zh_text: 「在石像鬼語中沒有意義。這是個特別的名字，專屬於我，」他笑著。

en_text: "To be the inner voice of guidance that lives in all creatures. To become more distinct and frequent with stronger Fellowship ties."
zh_text: 「是存在於所有生物內心的指引之聲。隨著友誼會聯繫的加強，會變得越來越清晰且頻繁。」

en_text: "To be the only gargoyle city in Britannia. To have fewer gargoyles in the land than during your last visit to Britannia, human." He shakes his head.
zh_text: 「是不列顛尼亞唯一的石像鬼城市。這片土地上的石像鬼數量比你上次訪問不列顛尼亞時還要少，人類。」他搖了搖頭。

en_text: "To have succumbed to the effects of disease and famine that have recently struck Britannia. To tell you that gargoyles breed less frequently, and we have not had the time to make up for losses in our population.
zh_text: 「是因為屈服於最近襲擊不列顛尼亞的疾病和飢荒。告訴你，石像鬼繁殖的頻率較低，我們沒有時間彌補人口的損失。

en_text: "To have new hope, however," he grins, "with The Fellowship."
zh_text: 然而，要獲得新希望，」他咧嘴一笑，「就得加入友誼會。」

en_text: "To hold meetings at 9 p.m., in unity with other branches, human. To be welcome at our meetings."
zh_text: 「與其他分會聯合，在晚上 9 點舉行會議，人類。歡迎參加我們的會議。」

en_text: "To be a boon to gargoyles and humans alike. To have a philosophy to help all creatures of all races reach their highest level of potential."
zh_text: 「是對石像鬼和人類都有益的恩賜。擁有一種幫助所有種族生物達到最高潛能的理念。」

en_text: "To be a boon to gargoyles and humans alike. To have a philosophy to help all creatures of all races reach their highest level of potential."
zh_text: 「是對石像鬼和人類都有益的恩賜。擁有一種幫助所有種族生物達到最高潛能的理念。」

en_text: "To have not seen human Fellowship officials in many days."
zh_text: 「已經好幾天沒見到人類友誼會官員了。」

en_text: "To know nothing of this! To believe it not! To be not possible.
zh_text: 「對此一無所知！不相信！這不可能。

en_text: "To know that all members are content with their lives, and incapable of such acts, even if the altars be outdated.
zh_text: 要知道所有成員對他們的生活都很滿意，而且絕不可能做出這種事，即使祭壇已經過時了。

en_text: "To tell you to speak with members themselves to see and believe."
zh_text: 告訴你親自去和成員們談談，親眼見證並相信。」

en_text: "To need the Triad for proper application to the individual gargoyle -- or person!"
zh_text: 「需要三位一體 (Triad) 來正確應用於每個石像鬼——或人類！」

en_text: "To be the clerk of The Fellowship here."
"To sell magics and such at his shop."
zh_text: 「在他的店裡販賣魔法和相關物品。」

en_text: "To be in charge of the learning center."
"To be impossible for Runeb to be responsible." He smiles kindly. "To be a practical joke."
zh_text: 「Runeb 不可能要為此負責。」他親切地微笑著。「這一定是個惡作劇。」

en_text: "To be too heinous a plot for Runeb." He frowns. "To be some kind of bad joke."
zh_text: 「對 Runeb 來說這陰謀太可惡了。」他皺起眉頭。「這一定是某種惡作劇。」

en_text: The Cube did not vibrate once while speaking with Quan. You realize he is totally innocent of the dangerous powers above him.*
zh_text: 在與 Quan 交談時，立方體沒有震動過一次。你意識到他對上層那些危險的力量完全不知情。*

en_text: "To apply an optimistic order of thought through the Triad of Inner Strength."
zh_text: 「透過內在力量的三位一體 (Triad of Inner Strength) 應用樂觀的思考秩序。」

en_text: "To be a good voice that will help me make choices, and to help win on Buccaneer's Den."
zh_text: 「是一個能幫助我做選擇的好聲音，還能幫助我在海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)贏錢。」

en_text: "To have not the time to speak now. To hurry to Fellowship meeting."*
zh_text: 「現在沒時間說話。趕著去友誼會會議。」*

en_text: The gargoyle, a contented grin on his face, greets you with a handshake.
zh_text: 這位石像鬼臉上帶著滿足的笑容，與你握手打招呼。

en_text: "To express happiness at your return," says Quaeven.
zh_text: 「表達對你歸來的喜悅，」 Quaeven 說。

en_text: "To mean `problem finder.' To be an observant one.
zh_text: 「意思是『發現問題者』。觀察敏銳。

en_text: "To be master of the Recreation Facility and Learning Center. To be in charge of much information valuable to the gargoyle race."
zh_text: 「是娛樂設施與學習中心的主管。負責掌管對石像鬼種族非常有價值的資訊。」

en_text: "To be a good place for gargoyles to go to exercise their muscles. To have many resources available, including stuffed bags to punch and practice fighting skills."
zh_text: 「是個讓石像鬼鍛鍊肌肉的好地方。有許多可用的資源，包含可以用來練習拳擊和戰鬥技巧的沙包。」

en_text: "To be located in the same building as the Recreation Center. To provide an excellent atmosphere for strengthening gargoyle minds. To have a large supply of books and educational material."
zh_text: 「和娛樂中心位於同一棟建築裡。提供極佳的氛圍來強化石像鬼的心智。有大量的書籍和教育資料。」

en_text: "To be a member, too." He holds up his medallion. To have needed The Fellowship to become happy."
zh_text: 「也是一位成員。」他舉起他的獎章。「我需要友誼會才能變得快樂。」

en_text: "To want to know about the organization or the tenets?"
"To be a group of spiritual seekers striving to reach the highest levels of gargoyle potential. To share with all gargoyles and humans."
zh_text: 「是一群努力達到石像鬼最高潛能的精神追求者。與所有石像鬼和人類分享。」

en_text: "To support financially and personally a poorhouse in Paws. To organize feasts and festivals in Britannia to help morale. To be a much needed group by all gargoyles and men. To have needed The Fellowship myself!"
zh_text: 「在財務和個人層面上支持 Paws 的救濟院。在不列顛尼亞舉辦宴會和節慶來提振士氣。是所有石像鬼和人類都非常需要的團體。我自己也需要友誼會！」

en_text: "To be the three concepts of Strive for Unity, Trust your Brother, and Worthiness Precedes Reward."
zh_text: 「就是努力團結、信任你的兄弟，以及善有善報這三個概念。」

en_text: "To have had poor life before The Fellowship. To have been pained, ignored, and mistreated by many.
zh_text: 「在加入友誼會之前過著悲慘的生活。曾被許多人傷害、忽視和虐待。

en_text: "To be happy now in my new life and, to hope to hear the voice soon." His eyes widen in excitement. "To be bringing happiness to another's life soon."
zh_text: 現在在我的新生活中很快樂，並且希望很快就能聽見那個聲音。」他的眼睛因興奮而睜大。「希望能很快為另一個人的生活帶來幸福。」

en_text: "To be working on my first convert. To know the joy and well-being I will bring. To feel content and happy."
zh_text: 「正在處理我的第一個轉化者。知道我將帶來喜悅和幸福。感到滿足與快樂。」

en_text: "To need a little more persuasion," he looks down, "but to be almost ready to join!"
zh_text: 「還需要再稍微說服一下，」他低著頭，「但幾乎準備好要加入了！」

en_text: "To be Betra, the provisioner. To feel confident he will join soon."
zh_text: 「是物資商人 Betra 。有信心他很快就會加入。」

en_text: "To hope for your well-being and happiness."*
He stares at you for a moment.

"To feel I am treated less for an absence of wings. To see Quaeven treated better since joining The Fellowship. To be devoted to the altar of singularity. But, perhaps to change if The Fellowship cares not about wings."
zh_text: 感覺因為沒有翅膀而受到不平等待遇。看到 Quaeven 加入友誼會後待遇變好了。我一直致力於單一性 (singularity) 的祭壇。但如果友誼會不在乎翅膀的話，或許我該改變了。」
你看到一隻皺著眉頭的石像鬼。

en_text: "To ask what you need, human," says Silamo.
zh_text: 「請問你需要什麼，人類，」 Silamo 說。

en_text: "To know my name if I were winged." He scowls at you.
zh_text: 「如果我有翅膀的話，你就會知道我的名字。」他對你怒目而視。

en_text: "To be the gardener," he shrugs, "nothing more."
zh_text: 「是個園丁，」他聳了聳肩，「僅此而已。」

en_text: He does not seem to be interested in speaking with you.
zh_text: 他似乎沒興趣跟你說話。

en_text: "To be also without wings, but to be respected as if he were winged."
zh_text: 「同樣也是沒有翅膀，卻能像有翅膀一樣受到尊重。」

en_text: "To see many others include him in many events from which I am excluded. To know others include him in many more decision-making councils, too."
zh_text: 「看到許多人邀請他參加許多將我排除在外的活動。也知道其他人邀請他參加更多的決策會議。」

en_text: "To not already know about the plot?" he wails.

en_text: She looks at you, puzzled. "Did I not do that already?"

en_text: She takes the stone chips from you and examines them. Using several vials of strange and unusual mixtures, she analyzes the blood. Finally, after a few silent minutes, she looks up, grinning.
zh_text: 她接過你的石片並仔細檢查。使用幾瓶奇怪且不尋常的混合物，她分析了血液。最後，在幾分鐘的沉默後，她抬起頭，咧嘴笑著。

en_text: "I have determined the nature of the blood. It is definitely not human. In fact," she looks back down at the sample and raises one eyebrow, "it is gargoyle blood."
zh_text: 「我已經確認了血液的性質。這絕對不是人類的。事實上，」她低頭看著樣本並挑起一邊眉毛，「這是石像鬼的血。」

en_text: "I am afraid that I must be able to see them to examine them."
zh_text: 「恐怕我必須能夠看到它們才能進行檢查。」

zh_text: 「唉，你剛好錯過他們了。我的好朋友 Elizabeth 和 Abraham 剛在這裡運送資金。我相信他們已經離開這裡去海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)了。」

en_text: You see a young, tan, muscular, handsome man who exudes much verve and geniality.
zh_text: 你看到一個年輕、曬黑、肌肉發達、英俊的男人，散發出活力與和藹。

en_text: "I am the director of this Meditation Retreat for Fellowship members."
zh_text: 「我是這個友誼會成員冥想靜修處的主任。」

en_text: "I manage the various activities and lead the initiates in their exercises in meditation."
zh_text: 「我管理各項活動，並帶領新進成員進行冥想練習。」

en_text: "The activities of the retreat consist of philosophical training and studies."
zh_text: 「靜修處的活動包含理念訓練和研究。」

en_text: "The members must all grow to hear and understand the voice which guides them down the path of Inner Strength. The exercises in meditation accelerate this process."
zh_text: 「成員們必須成長，去聆聽並理解那引導他們走上內在力量道路的聲音。冥想練習加速了這個過程。」

en_text: "It is that voice which one hears inside. We all have the capability of hearing it. Some are able to hear it quite easily and do not have to attend sessions here at the Meditation Retreat. Others, however, find it more difficult to hear the voice. Then they require study at the Retreat."
zh_text: 「那是人在內心聽到的聲音。我們都有能力聽到它。有些人能輕易地聽到，不需要來參加冥想靜修處的課程。然而，其他人發現要聽到這個聲音比較困難。那他們就需要在靜修處學習。」

en_text: "It was set up by The Fellowship so that new members can attend and learn more about our group, get in touch with themselves, and help them to become better brothers in The Fellowship. Most of the work is done inside the barrier."
zh_text: 「這是由友誼會設立的，讓新成員可以參加並了解更多關於我們組織的資訊，與自己聯繫，並幫助他們成為友誼會中更好的兄弟。大部分的活動都在屏障內部進行。」

en_text: "Most of the people who come to The Fellowship are wrestling with the failures in their lives. They are essentially	afraid of themselves. Here at the Meditation Retreat people learn to believe in themselves. And they build up that belief by learning how to best apply the philosophy of The	Fellowship to their lives."
zh_text: 「大多數來到友誼會的人，都在與生命中的失敗搏鬥。他們本質上是在害怕自己。在冥想靜修處這裡，人們學習去相信自己。他們藉由學習如何將友誼會的理念最好地應用在生活上，來建立那份信念。」

en_text: "It was set up to keep out those who are not members. Inside the barrier, Fellowship members find it much easier to hear their inner voice. Each member is given a key which they may use at any time."
zh_text: 「這是為了將非成員擋在外面而設置的。在屏障內部，友誼會成員發現更容易聽到他們的內在聲音。每位成員都會拿到一把隨時可以使用的鑰匙。」

en_text: "Ah, but thou art not a true Fellowship member! Thou art wearing a medallion falsely. I cannot let thee inside. Goodbye."*
zh_text: 「啊，但你不是真正的友誼會成員！你假冒佩戴著獎章。我不能讓你進去。再見。」*

en_text: "Oh, wouldst thou like to meditate with us, fellow brother?"
zh_text: 「哦，你想和我們一起冥想嗎，兄弟？」

en_text: "Then here is thy key. Be happy! Oh, one more thing. There is a rule which must be followed."

must go to Britain and speak with Batlin at our headquarters there. Only he can properly initiate thee into The Fellowship."

en_text: "I am happy to make thine acquaintance,

zh_text: 「事實上，兩位友誼會官員剛剛才來過這裡。他們說在鎮上建立分會之前，了解城鎮的經濟運作很重要。你明白這意味著什麼嗎？」他自豪地笑著。「他們要在 Vesper 建立友誼會分部。」

en_text: "They were the two Fellowship officials that were here! They only stayed for a minute or two. I have no idea where they are now."

en_text: "She is a fantastic worker. Better than most men I have mined with."

en_text: "Well, for a gargoyle, he is not too lazy. He works much harder than that other one who left, Anmanivas. But I would fain let him go if we did not need the extra hand."

en_text: "She keeps the records at town hall."
"His name is Auston. I like him, but I suspect that Liana is the one who truly keeps Vesper in order."
zh_text: 「他的名字是 Auston 。我喜歡他，但我懷疑真正讓 Vesper 保持秩序的是 Liana 。」

en_text: "Well, I know Cador feels as I do, as does his wife. I have heard the mayor express his concern about them. I don't really know his clerk, Liana."
zh_text: 「嗯，我知道 Cador 的想法和我一樣，他的妻子也是。我聽說鎮長對他們表達了擔憂。我不太了解他的書記員 Liana 。」

en_text: "Yvella is a lovely woman. She spends her days caring for their daughter, Catherine."
zh_text: 「Yvella 是個可愛的女人。她每天照顧她們的女兒 Catherine 。」

en_text: "He is in charge of managing the mines. Does a fair job, too. He usually joins me at the Gilded Lizard."
zh_text: 「他負責管理礦區。工作也做得不錯。他通常會和我一起在鍍金蜥蜴 (Gilded Lizard) 喝酒。」

en_text: "That is the tavern here in Vesper. Yongi's the barkeeper. He serves a passing fair tankard of ale."
zh_text: 「那是 Vesper 這裡的酒館。 Yongi 是酒保。他倒的麥酒還算過得去。」

en_text: You see a well-muscled woman who lifts her head in acknowledgement of your presence.
zh_text: 你看到一個肌肉發達的女人抬起頭，以承認你的存在。

en_text: The woman grabs your hand and shakes vigorously. "Hello. M'name's Mara."
zh_text: 女人抓住你的手用力搖晃。「哈囉。我的名字是 Mara 。」

en_text: "The Avatar!" she shouts angrily. "Why thou art the one responsible for bringing those wretched gargoyles into our fine land!"*
zh_text: 「聖者！」她憤怒地大喊。「你就是把那些可惡的石像鬼帶進我們美好土地的罪魁禍首！」*

en_text: She flexes proudly, "I am a miner in Vesper."
zh_text: 她自豪地展示肌肉，「我是 Vesper 的礦工。」

en_text: "This used to be a pleasant town," she looks around, apparently checking if anyone is near, "'til the gargoyles became so unruly. Now most of us have to spend far too much time wondering when the gargoyles will decide they want to kill us."
zh_text: 「這裡以前是個令人愉快的城鎮，」她環顧四周，顯然在檢查是否有人在附近，「直到石像鬼變得如此不受控制。現在我們大多數人必須花太多時間擔心石像鬼什麼時候會決定要殺我們。」

en_text: She shrugs. "There is naught to say, except that they are a menace. This town would be a much better place without them."
zh_text: 她聳聳肩。「沒什麼好說的，只能說他們是個威脅。沒有他們，這個鎮會好得多。」

en_text: "I have only seen her a few times. I do not know her well enough to say this, but I think she is angry about something, for she is always in a bad mood."
zh_text: 「我只見過她幾次。我不夠了解她所以不能這麼說，但我覺得她對某件事感到生氣，因為她總是心情不好。」

en_text: Mara shakes your hand and slaps you on the back, saying, "Fare thee well, friend!"*
zh_text: Mara 握著你的手並拍拍你的背，說道：「再會，朋友！」*

en_text: "'Tis not that I do not trust him. I just wonder about his ability to run the town. His name is Auston. Talk to him and see for thyself what thou thinkest. Better yet, talk to his clerk, Liana."
zh_text: 「不是我不信任他。我只是懷疑他管理城鎮的能力。他的名字是 Auston 。你去跟他談談，看看你怎麼想。更好的話，去跟他的書記員 Liana 談談。」

en_text: A strong, powerful man looks at you and nods acknowledgment.
zh_text: 一個強壯有力的人看著你，點頭致意。

en_text: "What can I do for thee?" asks Zaksam.

en_text: "I teach others to be strong fighters. I am a trainer here in Vesper."
zh_text: 「我教導別人成為強大的戰士。我是 Vesper 的訓練師。」

en_text: "I have taught here for many years. I like the town, but I am not too fond of some of the residents."
zh_text: 「我在這裡教了很多年了。我喜歡這個城鎮，但我不太喜歡某些居民。」

en_text: "The land to the northeast is a bit dry, but the oasis and nearby shores give us plenty of water for drinking and bathing."
zh_text: 「東北方的土地有點乾燥，但綠洲和附近的海岸給了我們充足的飲用和洗浴水源。」

en_text: "Most of us are respectable, but there are a few that I wonder about. Blorn and the mayor, for example.
zh_text: 「我們大多數人都是受人尊敬的，但有幾個人讓我感到懷疑。例如 Blorn 和鎮長。

en_text: "That one I do not like a bit. I do not trust him. He reminds me of those gargoyles."
zh_text: 「那個人我一點也不喜歡。我不信任他。他讓我想到那些石像鬼。」

en_text: "What is there to say, but do not let them get too close or they will rob thee. Any day now they may try to use violence to take over the town. The mayor himself has asked that I fight if necessary. Though I have no fear of death, that is a battle I do not look forward to."
zh_text: 「有什麼好說的，只能說別讓他們靠得太近，否則他們會搶劫你。隨時他們都可能試圖使用暴力接管這個城鎮。鎮長親自要求我在必要時戰鬥。雖然我不怕死，但那是一場我不期待的戰鬥。」

en_text: "I have already heard that some of my fellow residents have had things stolen by those wretched creatures."
zh_text: 「我聽說有些居民，被那些可悲的生物偷了東西。」

"I spend my time at the House of Games or the Fallen Virgin. I love the sound of the die as it bounces against the felt. I love the taste of warm ale as it splashes down my throat! And... I have The Fellowship."
zh_text: 「我把時間花在賭坊 (House of Games) 或墮落處女 (Fallen Virgin) 。我喜歡骰子在氈布上彈跳的聲音。我喜歡溫暖的麥酒滑下喉嚨的味道！而且……我還有友誼會。」

en_text: You tell Mole what Blacktooth said. A change comes over the salty pirate, as if you had just given him a bouquet of flowers.
zh_text: 你告訴 Mole 關於 Blacktooth 說的話。這個老海盜身上發生了變化，就像你剛給了他一束花一樣。

en_text: "Thou must be kidding me! Blackie misses me? I thought he hated mine innards! I shall have to go for a little walk and maybe I will run across that old dog! I thank thee, stranger, for imparting this information to me."
zh_text: 「你一定在開玩笑！ Blackie 想我？我以為他恨透我了！我得去散散步，也許會碰上那條老狗！謝謝你，陌生人，告訴我這個消息。」

en_text: With that, Mole turns away from you, doing a little jaunt.*
zh_text: 說完， Mole 轉身離開了你，邁著輕快的步伐。*

en_text: "For years and years I roamed the seas, pillaging and raping and terrorizing. Now that I am past the age of fifty, I want to live the rest of my life in relative peace and quiet here on Buccaneer's Den."
zh_text: 「許多年來我在海上遊蕩，掠奪、強姦和製造恐懼。現在我已經年過五十，我想在海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)這裡相對平靜安寧地度過餘生。」

en_text: "Well, he is not a brother now! He hates me! If he wants nothing to do with me, so be it!" But Mole quickly adds, "He does not realize what I did for him. I made his life livable! Who was it that nursed him when he had scurvy? Me! Who was it that patched him up when he was sliced to bits by that butcher Silverbeard? Me!"
zh_text: 「嗯，他現在不是兄弟了！他恨我！如果他不想和我扯上關係，那就這樣吧！」但 Mole 很快補充道：「他沒有意識到我為他做了什麼。我讓他能活下去！當他得壞血病時是誰照顧他的？我！當他被屠夫 Silverbeard 砍成碎片時是誰幫他包紮的？我！」

en_text: You see an aging pirate who might have looked extremely dangerous at one time.
zh_text: 你看到一位老海盜，他曾經可能看起來極其危險。

en_text: "My name be Mole, it be! Do not ask me how I came by it. 'Tis a long story."
zh_text: 「我的名字是 Mole ，正是！別問我是怎麼得到這個名字的。說來話長。」

en_text: "Thou dost really want to hear it? 'Tis very long."
"All right. I was born in a cave. So my mother named me Mole."*
zh_text: 「好吧。我出生在一個洞穴裡。所以我母親給我取名叫 Mole (鼴鼠) 。」*

en_text: "I thought thou said it was a long story."*
zh_text: 「我以為你說這是個很長的故事。」*

en_text: "Very well. How 'bout if I just say that I was born in a cave, so my mother named me Mole."Mole shrugs. "I thought I would make a long story short."
zh_text: 「很好。那我就說我是出生在一個洞穴裡，所以我母親給我取名叫 Mole (鼴鼠) 怎麼樣？」Mole 聳聳肩。「我想我長話短說好了。」

en_text: "Very well. How 'bout if I just say that I was born in a cave, so my mother named me Mole."
zh_text: 「很好。那我就說我是出生在一個洞穴裡，所以我母親給我取名叫 Mole (鼴鼠) 怎麼樣？」

en_text: Mole shrugs. "I thought I would make a long story short."
zh_text: Mole 聳聳肩。「我想我長話短說好了。」

en_text: "It is a good life. I grew weary of pirating. I grew weary of the salt water and the raw meat and the sewage on deck and the parrot droppings and the fact that every other word one heard was 'Har!'"
zh_text: 「這是美好的生活。我對當海盜感到厭倦了。我對鹽水、生肉、甲板上的污水、鸚鵡糞便，以及聽到的每隔一個字就是『哈！』感到厭倦了。」

en_text: "The group has given me a new lease on life. I thought I had mates when I was an active pirate, but they were nothing compared to my brothers in The Fellowship.
zh_text: 「這個組織給了我新的生命。我以為我在當活躍海盜時有過夥伴，但他們無法與我在友誼會裡的兄弟們相比。

en_text: "Say, I see that thou art a member! Thou must be of sound character!"Mine old mates, like my friend Blacktooth, have fallen by the wayside."
zh_text: 「嘿，我看到你也是會員！你一定品格高尚！「我以前的夥伴，像我的朋友 Blacktooth ，已經半途而廢了。」

en_text: "Say, I see that thou art a member! Thou must be of sound character!
zh_text: 「嘿，我看到你也是會員！你一定品格高尚！

en_text: "Mine old mates, like my friend Blacktooth, have fallen by the wayside."
zh_text: 「我以前的夥伴，像我的朋友 Blacktooth ，已經半途而廢了。」

en_text: "Blacktooth lives here on the island. We used to be the same link on a chain, knowest what I mean? But since I joined The Fellowship, he does not give me the shadow of a sundial! He acts as though I had the plague or something. I do not understand it. Makes me want to cut something up into mincemeat!"
zh_text: 「Blacktooth 住在這裡的島上。我們曾經是同一條鍊子上的環節，懂我的意思嗎？但自從我加入友誼會後，他就把我當空氣！他表現得好像我得了瘟疫什麼的。我不明白。讓我想把什麼東西切成肉末！」

en_text: "Blacktooth was like my brother. Not like my brothers in The Fellowship, but a 'real' brother, knowest what I mean? We did 'everything' together. We would share booty! We would share wenches! We did it all!"
zh_text: 「Blacktooth 就像我的兄弟。不像我在友誼會裡的兄弟，而是一個『真正』的兄弟，懂我的意思嗎？我們『什麼』都一起做。我們會分享戰利品！我們會分享女人！我們無所不作！」

en_text: "Oh, he was some old pirate with a temper. He's probably dead now, if he knows what's good for him!"
zh_text: 「哦，他是個脾氣暴躁的老海盜。如果他識相的話，他可能已經死了！」

en_text: "Yes, it was a different life in those days..." Mole reflects on some past memory as his eyes glaze over temporarily. Finally he says, "I may have dwelt too strongly on my Fellowship business. Perhaps I pushed him too hard. I am sorry. If he would give me another chance I would probably leave The Fellowship. They are not as wonderful as I made them sound. They are more crooked than the pirates I used to sail with!" Mole frowns. "Thou hast put me in a foul mood."
zh_text: 「是的，那是與現在不同的生活……」 Mole 眼神短暫地失焦，回想著過去的記憶。最後他說：「我可能對友誼會的事情太過執著了。也許我逼得他太緊了。我很抱歉。如果他願意再給我一次機會，我可能會離開友誼會。他們並不像我說的那麼美好。他們比我以前一起航海的海盜還要狡猾！」 Mole 皺起眉頭。「你讓我的心情變得很糟。」

en_text: You see a man whose sinewy body is like steel. The glint in his eye tells you that he is no fool.
zh_text: 你看到一個肌肉如鋼鐵般結實的男人。他眼中的閃光告訴你他絕不是傻瓜。

en_text: "What dost thou want with Lucky?" the pirate asks.
zh_text: 「你找 Lucky 有什麼事？」海盜問。
「我是 Lucky (幸運) ……在所有事情上。」

en_text: "I make my living off the world! It gives... and I take!" The pirate laughs boisterously. "I am a worldly gentleman, friends -- that is my 'job'! Oh, and I train initiates for a bit of pocket change."
zh_text: 「我靠這世界過活！世界給予……而我拿取！」海盜喧鬧地大笑。「我是個見多識廣的紳士，朋友們——這就是我的『職業』！喔，我也訓練新手賺點零用錢。」

en_text: "The ways of the world, is what I mean. I am a man of the road; I am a seasoned traveller. I travel through the world as a hundred different men."
zh_text: 「我指的是世界運作的方式。我是個在路上討生活的人；我是個經驗豐富的旅行者。我以一百種不同男人的身分在世界上旅行。」

en_text: "In truth there are few places where I have not been and little that I have not done."
zh_text: 「事實上，我沒去過的地方很少，我沒做過的事情也很少。」

en_text: "Thou canst be a different person just by assumption. 'Tis an attitude. I am an expert in the art of charismatic communication for the purposes of deception. It gives one many skills. For example, I can walk into any shop and make a purchase. But I will walk away with much more than I bought, for I know how to fool the shopkeeper. Little things like that."
zh_text: 「只要憑藉假設，你就能成為另一個人。這是一種態度。我是為了欺騙而進行充滿魅力的溝通藝術的專家。它賦予人許多技能。舉例來說，我可以走進任何一家店買東西。但我離開時帶走的東西會比我買的多得多，因為我知道如何欺騙店主。就像那樣的小事。」

en_text: "I charge 35 gold for a training session. Doth this meet with thine approval?"
zh_text: 「一次訓練費用是 35 金幣。你同意嗎？」

en_text: Lucky shrugs. "Thou wilt not find another trainer on the island!"
zh_text: Lucky 聳聳肩。「你在島上找不到第二個訓練師了！」

en_text: "I shall be happy to show thee my ways of the world during normal business hours at my residence -- afternoons and evenings."
zh_text: 「我會很樂意在我的住處的正常營業時間——下午和晚上——向你展示我在這世界上的方法。」

en_text: "I can sell thee the deed to my ship 'The Lusty Wench.' She is beautiful, my friend. She is guaranteed to last and is the sleekest vessel on the seas! She goes for 800 gold. Want her?"
zh_text: 「我可以把我的船『 The Lusty Wench 』的地契賣給你。她很美，我的朋友。保證耐用，而且是海上最流線型的船隻！賣 800 金幣。想要她嗎？」

en_text: "That ship sails here frequently. I know it makes regular runs to the mainland, stops here, then moves on to the Isle of the Avatar the next morning. Then it repeats the trip, going the other direction."

en_text: "But I have already sold thee the deed to 'The Lusty Wench'! She was the only ship I had at this particular time! I am sorry!"
zh_text: 「但我已經把『 The Lusty Wench 』的地契賣給你了！她是我目前唯一的一艘船！我很抱歉！」

en_text: "But thou dost not have enough gold! Perhaps thou shouldst visit the House of Games and increase the bulges in thy pockets!"
zh_text: 「但你沒有足夠的金幣！或許你應該去賭坊 (House of Games) 增加你口袋裡的重量！」

en_text: You see a fat, cheerful-looking merchant.
zh_text: 你看到一個肥胖、看起來很快樂的商人。

en_text: "Hello, hello my friend! Thou dost look like thou needest to spend money!"*
zh_text: 「哈囉，哈囉我的朋友！你看起來像需要花錢的樣子！」*

en_text: "The entire island is very opulent. It is not the same island we once knew."*
zh_text: 「整座島都非常富裕。這已經不是我們曾經認識的那座島了。」*

en_text: "How may I help thee?" Budo asks.
zh_text: 「我能怎麼幫助你？」 Budo 問。

en_text: "Budo the Fourth at thy service! 'Tis a fine day today, is it not?"
zh_text: 「為您服務的是第四代 Budo ！今天天氣真好，不是嗎？」

en_text: "Budo's carries nothing but the finest quality armour in all Britannia. I have all the best types of equipment available."
zh_text: 「 Budo 商行只提供全不列顛尼亞品質最好的護甲。我有所有最好的裝備可供選擇。」

en_text: "Budo's offers thee excellent weaponry with superb craftsmanship. Thou wilt not find a better buy for thy money anywhere else!"
zh_text: 「 Budo 商行為您提供工藝精湛的優良武器。你在其他任何地方都找不到更物超所值的選擇了！」

en_text: "Budo's also carries a variety of useful things for thy convenience."
zh_text: 「 Budo 商行也為您的方便準備了各式各樣有用的東西。」

en_text: "A wise move. A magnificent ship for thee!" He takes your gold.
zh_text: 「明智之舉。為你準備的一艘宏偉的船！」他收下你的金幣。

en_text: "Thou art carrying too much, my friend! Unload thyself of some of thy belongings and I will sell thee the deed to this beautiful ship."
zh_text: 「你拿太多東西了，我的朋友！卸下你的一些物品，我就把這艘美麗船隻的地契賣給你。」

en_text: "But thou wilt never see a ship like this one anywhere in the world! Too bad!"
zh_text: 「但你絕對無法在世界上任何地方看到像這樣的一艘船！太可惜了！」

en_text: "The Fellowship has helped me to become a very rich man! Although the business is an inherited enterprise, I owe everything to The Fellowship!"
zh_text: 「友誼會幫助我成為了一個非常富有的人！雖然事業是繼承來的企業，但我將一切歸功於友誼會！」

en_text: "My great-grandfather started this business many, many years ago. He was moderately successful, thanks to the Thieves' Guild. But that era has passed."
zh_text: 「我的曾祖父在很多很多年前創立了這份事業。多虧了盜賊公會，他算是小有成就。但那個時代已經過去了。」

en_text: "My great-grandfather passed the shoppe on to his son, and so forth, down to me. We are born merchants! That is why I know why thou hast come to Budo's! Thou wantest to become a part of the great Budo Legacy! Thou dost need to buy something!"
zh_text: 「我的曾祖父將店傳給他的兒子，就這樣一路傳到我。我們天生就是商人！這就是為什麼我知道你為什麼來 Budo 商行！你想成為偉大的 Budo 傳奇的一部分！你需要買點東西！」

en_text: "There was a period shortly after my father died, just as I had inherited the shoppe, when business was poor. There was a danger that I would not be able to keep the shoppe open. But The Fellowship convinced me that I should join them. I proved my worthiness and The Fellowship helped me financially."
zh_text: 「在我父親去世後不久，也就是我剛繼承這家店的時候，生意很差。店鋪有開不下去的危險。但友誼會說服了我加入他們。我證明了我的價值，而友誼會在財務上幫助了我。」

en_text: "I do not mind telling thee. The Fellowship shares in one half of my profit."
zh_text: 「我不介意告訴你。友誼會分享我一半的利潤。」

en_text: "It is no more. They dwindled away during my grandfather's time. By the time The Fellowship arrived, when I was a boy, there was no trace of them except in family mementos. Even the pirates are different."
zh_text: 「它已經不存在了。它們在我祖父那一代就逐漸衰落了。當我還是個孩子，友誼會到來時，除了家庭的紀念品之外，它們已經沒有任何蹤跡了。就連海盜也變了。」

en_text: "It stops here regularly. Don't know much more about it. The crew is very secretive." Budo looks away, obviously not wanting to talk about the ship.
zh_text: 「它定期停靠在這裡。不知道更多的事了。船員非常神祕。」 Budo 轉過頭，顯然不想談論這艘船。

en_text: "I hope I can help thee again some time, my friend!"*
zh_text: 「我希望有機會能再次幫助你，我的朋友！」*

en_text: The Cube vibrates a moment. "Yes, I know Hook very well. He lives beneath the House of Games. Talk to Sintag. He can direct thee."
